༄༅/ /grub mtha' bzhi dang rgyud sde bzhi yi rnam gzhag bstan pa'i snying po sdom pa gsum gyi don gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gnad bsdus zhar byung bod ka

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/19_KHEZ/KHEZ025_sdom gsum gyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub mtha' bzhi dang rgyud sde bzhi yi rnam gzhag bstan pa'i snying po sdom pa gsum gyi don gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gnad bsdus zhar byung bod kyi grub mtha'i lo rgyus bcas lhan cig tu bkod pa mdo sngags chos tshul snying po'i gsal byed ma rig mun pa sel ba'i dpal ldan 'od zer brgya pa skal bzang blo yi pad tshal bzhad pa don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na maḥsarba dz+nyo nā gardzu na sa ga ra ya/ srid pa gsum na zla bral thams cad mkhyen/ /sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin legs stsal mgon/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen/ /snying nas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs/ /bdud las rnam rgyal 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin 'gro kun gtan bder bkod/ /ston mchog rgyal ba shākya seng ge la/ /gus pas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs/ /gang la theg gsum dam pa'i chos/ /zhu bsdu 'grel bshad byang chub sems/ /dgra bcom paṇa grub 'phags yul gyi/ /rgyal bstan gsal byed rnams la 'dud/ /khyad par 'jam dbyangs byams pa mgon/ /klu sgrub yab sras thogs med mched/ /phyogs glang chos grags yon tan 'od/ /shrī mān dharma pā lar 'dud/ /bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir thub pa'i bstan/ /rgyas mdzad chos rgyal blon 'phags pa'i/ /paṇa grub bod kyi lo tsā ba/ rim par byed pa rnams la 'dud/ /khyad par mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ /pad+ma saṃ bha jo bo rje/ /shākya shrī sprin 'dzin pa zhabs/ /dad byed go cha rnams la 'dud/ /lo chen be ro ska cog dang / /rin chen bzang po rngog pa tshab/ /'gos gnyan ba ri 'brog mi dang / /mal dang rwa lo chen por 'dud/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po/ /gong ma rnam lnga dbon dang slob/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i tshogs la 'dud/ /khyad par rje btsun grags pa'i mtshan/

/'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ /rgyal ba ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ger 'dud/ /ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /grub mchog dbang po rdo rings pa/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mang du thos/ /klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ /paṇa chen ngag dbang chos kyi grags/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po mchog la 'dud/ /drin can gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang / /rigs kun bdag po thar rtse rje/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos yar rlung pa/ /rje btsun 'chi med mtshan can 'dud/ /skyabs mchog 'jam mgon sa skya pa/ /maṅga la dang rat+na'i mtshan/ /yab sras sku mched rnams la 'dud/ /byang chub bar du brtses skyongs mdzod/ /mdo sngags smra ba'i seng ge mchog /lam 'di bka' drin stsol ba'i rje/ /byams pa smon lam grags pa yi/ /zhabs la gus pa chen pos 'dud/ /mchog gsum dgyes mdzad sogs yi dam/ gur zhal rnam gnyis bka' bstod bcas/ /nor lha'i tshogs la'ang gus pas 'dud/ /grub gnyis dge tshogs mchog stsol cig /legs pa'i lam bzang mdo sngags lam/ /legs par bgrod tshul rim pa ni/ /legs bshad don 'dus go bde bar/ /legs pa'i lam bzang 'di na 'god/ /chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /bstan bcos mkhas pa'i 'jug sgo nas/ /mkhas pas 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' ni/ /sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs byed/ /de las gzhan pa'i blun po yis/ /glo bur btags pa'i grub mtha' yin/ ston pa dang 'grel byed sogs khungs ldan med pa'i rigs/ /glo bur zhes pa kla klo sogs/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab las/ /phyir phyogs thar pa'i mu'am stegs/ /la brten lam sgrub khas 'che ba'i/ /mu stegs rtog ge sde lnga ni/ /rig byed grangs can 'ug phrug pa/ /zad byed tshur rol mdzes pa ba/ /de las rig byed par grags pa/ /khyab 'jug tshangs pa lhar 'dzin te/ /khyab 'jug lha rdzas kyi ngo bo/

/'chi ba med pas 'gro thams cad/ /bskyed par 'dod cing de'i lte ba'i/ /pad+mor tshangs pa skyes par 'dod/ /de yi rig byed bstan par bshad/ /bdag khyab 'jug gis snod bcud thams cad la/ kun la khyab sogs su 'dod/ /khyab 'jug yon tan bsgom pa yis/ /bde ba thob cing grol gyur bshad/ /grangs can pa yi sa bon ni/ /skya bo'i skabs na myu gu sngo/ /mi gsal tshul du gnas pa bzhin/ /rkyen gyi mngon par gsal bzhin pa'i/ /rgyu 'bras gcig 'dod snying stobs rdul/ /mun pa'i rang bzhin gsum cha mnyam/ /des byas gtso bos byas zhes 'dogs/ dpe byas pa'i/ bdag shes rig pa'i skyes bu ni/ /rtag pa rang dbang can lus can/ /rnams kyi snying la gnas zhes zer/ /de nyid stag tshang lo tsā'i grub mtha' kun shes su gsal/ nyer lnga shes grol bshad/ /'ug phrug pa zhes dbang phyug pas/ /snod bcud skye 'gro bde sdug sogs/ /thams cad dbang phyug gis blo yis/ /g.yo ba sngon btang byas par 'dod/ /'jig lta yul la ma 'khrul bar/ /mthong nas de yi 'dzin stangs la/ /gsal snang 'don te dbang bskur byed/ /tshig don drug stag tshang lo tsā'i grub mtha' kun shes su gsal/ shes grol bar bshad/ /zad byed gcer bu pa zhes pas/ /grangs can pa ltar bdag sems kyi/ /mtshan nyid yin cing bdag dang srog /skyes bu rnam grangs yin par 'dod/ /las ni gsar du mi bsog phyir/ /sdom pas bsdams dang sngar gyi las/ /zad phyir zas mi za ba sogs/ /dka' thub sna tshogs byed nas ni/ /de dag zad nas 'jig rten gyi/ /steng na thar pa gdugs dkar po/ /gyen bkan 'dra bar grol bar 'dod/ /de bzhi rtag lta'i sde tshan yin/ /tshu rol mdzes byed rgyang 'phen pa/ /lus sems rdzas gcig 'dod nas de/ /sran zlum tsher rno rma bya yi/ /sgro thig stes dbang glo bur du/ /grub pa ltar du ma shi bar/ /bdag bdag 'dzin rtag brtan ther zug can 'dod pa/

shes reg tu skyes la shi/ /de nas chad 'dod las rgyu 'bras/ /tshe ni snga phyi sogs med 'dod/ /chad lta shin tu tha chad do/ /de ltar rtog ge sde lnga po/ /rtag chad gnyis su 'dod pa'o/ /mu stegs thams cad bdag 'dzin mthun/ /rtag smra rnams kyis bdag yod par/ /rtag par 'dod cing chad smra rnams/ /bdag yod shi nas chad par 'dod/ /snga ma gsum ni rig byed 'dod/ /phyi ma gnyis kyis khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug lhar 'dzin/ rig byed 'dor/ /bdag yod pa ni thams cad mthun/ /blta ba'i bye brag gzhan mi 'dra/ /phyi nang grub mtha'i khyad par ni/ /dbye tshul rnam pa skyabs 'gro'i khyad dang lta ba bka' rtags bzhi zhes pa mi rtag sdug bsngal stong zhing bdag med bzhi dang / bsgom pa srid rtse'i gnyen po yod med kyi khyad par kyang rang sde gnas ma bu'i sdes brjod du med pa'i bdag khas blangs kyang / /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ni med par mi 'dod pas skyon can min cing kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed pa'i 'di legs par mngon/ mang mchis kyang / /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /lam la brten nas thar pa mchog /'dod min sgo nas phyi nang gi /khyad par dbye ba rtsod bral yin/ /don du bdag med rtogs ma rtogs/ /kho nas phye ba mkhas la grags/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed pa 'di phul du byung zhing legs par mngon/ /nang pa sangs rgyas grub mtha' la/ /snying po kyai yi rdo rje yi/ /rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai yi rdo rje bstan/ /dang po bye brag smra ba ni/ /bshad gzhi dam chos mngon pa ni/ /ston pa mchog gi yul gang zag /sna tshogs don du thor bur shes rab can gyi mchog shā ri'i bu sogs bdun/

gsungs/ /phyis su dgra bcom bdun gyis bsdus/ /sde bdun zhes grags de'i dgongs 'grel/ /dgra bcom lnga brgyas mdzad pa yi/ /bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo zhes/ /'phags bod mkhas grub slob dpon gyis/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de'o/ /shes bya'i gzhi lnga bden grub tu/ /smra bas bye brag smra zhes grags/ /de la thams cad yod smra dang / /dge 'dun phal chen gnas brtan sde/ /mang bkur rtsa ba'i sde bzhi dang / /de las gyes pas bco brgyad byung / /da lta bod kyi sdom rgyun ni/ jo bo rje phal chen pa dang / dad byed go cha gnas brtan pa'i mkhan po bod du phebs myong ba tsam las/ gzhan sde pa gsum po ma byung / /thams cad yod par smra ba yis/ /gsung rab legs sbyar skad du 'don/ /mkhan po rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin/ /las brgyud snam sbyar snam phran dgu/ /yan chad nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zung du ma gyur rtags 'khor lo/ /pad+ma ming la mkhan brgyad kyi/ /mtshan gyi sgra dang ldan par 'dogs/ /bye brag smra ba kha che dang / /nyi 'og ces pa gnas kyi khyad/ /de la bye brag smra ba'i lugs/ /shes par bya ba'i gzhi lnga ni/ /gzugs sems sems las byung ba dang / /mi ldan 'du byed 'dus ma byas/ /snga ma bzhi ni mi rtag rdzas/ /phyi ma gcig ni rtag rdzas 'gyur ldog skye 'jig bri gang med pa la rtag pa zhes gsung / so/ /de yang spyir ni gzugs snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi bsags lugs/ la gnyis/ /rdzas rdul phra rab zhes pa dang / /bsags rdul phra rab gnyis su gnyis/ /gzugs can kun gyi chung mtha' ni/ /phyogs kyi cha chung mtha' med rdul phra yan gar ba/ rab/ /dus kyi thung mtha' mtha' ma skad cig skyes bu'i sel gol rtog yun la skad cig ma gcig de brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma gcig de drug cu la rgyang gcig de sum cu la yud tsam/ de sum cu la zhag ma/

/de lta'i rags pa'i rtsom gzhir gyur pa/ rdzas rdul phra rab bdun/ /rdul las bsags rdul bsags pa'i rdul rags pa'i chung mtha'o/ 'di rnams dngos po yin cing yan gar ba dang rdul phran 'di dbang yul du mi mngon phran gcig /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma shig /nas bcas rim bzhin bdun de nas bdun la sor gang de nyi shu la gru gang de bzhi la 'don gang gzhu 'don lnga brgya la rgyang grags gcig de brgyad la dpag tshad gcig 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzugs can rags pa rnams/ /rdzas grangs du dang ldan zhe na/ /'dod pa'i sa yis bsdus pa la/ /nyung mtha' rdzas brgyad ldan par skye/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung 'di 'byung ba ni rgyu'i 'byung ba bzhi yin/ da lta mngon gyur pa 'di 'bras bu'i 'byung ba bzhi yin/ bzhi'i rdul/ /gzugs dri ro reg rdul 'dod pa'i las bsdus pa'i bsags rdul gong bu yin na rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus yin pas khyab ces so/ /'di'i skabs grangs ni nus pa'i grangs 'dus pa yin/ bcas brgyad/ /de steng lag pa 'di nas bzung rags pa lta bu yi/ /cha shas ldan tshe dgu ru 'gyur/ /mig sogs dbang po ldan pa na/ /bcur gyur de steng sgrar ldan pas/ /rdul rdzas bcu gcig lhan cig skye/ /gzugs khams sas bsdus dri ro gnyis/ /med pas 'byung bzhi gzugs reg drug /lus kyi cha shas ldan tshe bdun/ /dbang po gzhan ldan brgyad 'gyur ro/ /gzugs med pa yis bsdus pa la/ /rdul rdzas brtsi rgyu med pa'o/ /shes bya'i gzhi lnga'i dang po la/ /snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi dngos gzugs kyi gzhi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /gzugs su rung zhing gzugs can gyis/ /gnod pa bya rung zhig la 'jug /gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang don/ /lnga dang rnam rig byed mi nyid/ /ces pa'i mtshan nyid gzugs su rung / /gzugs dang gzugs can gzugs phung rnams/

bem po yin na gzugs can yin pas khyab/ gzugs can yin na bem po yin pas mi khyab bo/ /phyi bem ni ri ra khang khyim/ nang bem ni lus sogs so/ /phyi bem dang nang bem 'di bye brag tu smra ba las gzhan la ma grags/ /don gcig ming gi rnams grangs so/ /gzugs ni mig sogs dbang po lnga/ /gzugs sogs don lnga rnam pa ni/ 'dod yon lnga/ /rig byed ma yin te bcu gcig /dbang khams skye mched ming don gcig /dbang lnga'i mtshan nyid mig sogs dbang po lnga rnam shes lnga'i/ /bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs gyur pa'i/ /nang gzugs dwangs ma mig la ni/ /zar ma'i me tog ltar gnag pa/ /sna la zangs khab gshib 'dra ba/ /lce la zla ba bkas lta bu/ /rna ba gro ga'i 'dzer ba 'dra/ /lus la bya srog chags reg 'jam pags mtshungs/ /dbang po lnga yi spyod yul du/ /gyur pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg /skye mched dam ni khams zhes 'dogs/ /gzugs gzugs sogs don lnga la kha dog dbyibs gzugs gnyis/ /rtsa ba'i/ kha dog sngo ser dmar po dkar/ /sprin dang du ba rdul khug sna/ / lho nus/ grib ma nyi ma snang ba mun/ /dbyibs kyi gzugs la ring thung gnyis/ /gru bzhi/ lham dang zlum po mtho dman gnyis/ /mnyam pa/ phyal le ba dang phya le min/ mi mnyam pa/ /gzugs rdzas nyi shu tham pa'o/ /sgra ni skyes bu'i rtsol ba las/ /zin pa pi wang lta bu'i sgra/ /mi snyan sgrogs sgra lta bu'o/ /ma zin 'byung ba la brten pa'i/ /snyan pa/ sgra ni chu klung lta bu'i snyan/ /mi snyan brag ral lta bu'o/ /sems can ngag la ston pa'i sgra/ /snyan pa mi'am ci'i glu sogs/ /mi snyan khros pa'i nga ro 'dra/ /sems can ngag la mi ston pa'i/ /sum cu rtsa gsum/ snyan pa lha yi rnga chen las/ /'dus byas mi rtag zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos stong shing bdag med/ myang 'das zhi ba/ rtsol med sdom gzhi ston pa'i sgra/

/mi snyan sgra mi snyan pa la/ /'chi sgra grags pa lta bu ste/ mdzod 'brel las ni/ sgra la skyes bu'i rtsol bas zin pa dang ma zin gnyis la sems can rgyud la ston mi ston gnyis re phye bas bzhi/ bzhi po de la sgra snyan pa dang mi snyan pa gnyis re phye bas brgyad du bshad/ gnyis gnyis phye bas brgyad du 'gyur/ /dri ni zhim dang mi zhim gnyis/ /dri mi ngad pa shas che chung gi dbye ba'o/ mnyam dang mi mnyam gnyis te bzhi/ /ro la mngar skyur lan tshwa ba/ tsha ba si ling lta bu/ tsha dang tig ta'i ro lta bu/ kha dang zho yi ro lta bu/ bska ba drug /reg la 'byung bzhi 'jam rtsub gnyis/ /lci yang gnyis dang grang ba dang / /nang la ltos/ bkres skom gnyis dang bcu gcig go /rnam pa rnam rig byed min gsum/ rig byed ma yin gzugs/ /dbyibs kyi rnam pa mi mthong yang / /sdom dang sdom min bar ma yi/ /sdom 'di so thar lta bur thog mar sdom pa len dus rnam pa rig byed kyi sgo nas blang zhing / skad cig gnyis pa nas gang zag gi rgyud la gnas/ shi ba sogs kyis gtong ba'i skye 'jig yod pa de la gzugs kyi tha snyad 'di skabs 'dogs/ kun dga' ra ba brtsigs pa sogs bar ma dang / shan pas srog bcas par khas len pa'i mi dge ba yang des 'gres/ gzugs khams kyi bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa yang dbyibs mtshungs ste bsam gtan ni nyams na phyir lhung ba dang / yon tan yar ldan du gyur tshe 'pho/ zag med kyi sdom pa'ang yon tan yar ldan du gyur tshe na 'phar bas 'pho ba ste 'di rnams kyang mngon gyur mthong ba med kyang skye 'jig byed pa'i dbang gis so/ pa rgyud la gnas der bshad/ /zhar byung 'bras gzugs dbyibs dang kha dog smos pa/ gzhan yang 'byung bzhi'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sra zhing 'thas dang brlan gsher ba/ /tsha bsreg yang zhing g.yo ba'o/ /de dag dbyibs la gru bzhi dang /

/zlum po gru gsum ring po dang / /kha dog dkar ser dmar sngo ni/ /gzugs su gtogs shing khams min no/ /tshor ba 'di ni 'dir phung po'i gral du drangs shing gzhi lnga las sems byung kun 'gro lnga'i nang tshan du bgrang rgyu gong ma'i dgongs rgyan las gsal bar gsung / tshor ba'i mtshan nyid rang stobs kyis/ /rang yul myong ba'i rnam pa can/ /sim dang gdung ba bar ma gsum/ /de la lus tshor sems tshor gnyis/ /dbang po lngar brtan lus tshor dang / /drug pa yid la brten pa ni/ /yid tshor yin no rnam shes drug /re rer bde sdug bar ma gsum/ /byas pas bco brgyad du'ang bgrangs/ /'du shes mtshan 'du shes 'dir phung po'i gral du bris pa las gzhi lnga las sems byung kun 'gro'i nang tshan du bsdu ba gong ma'i dgongs rgyan du gsal nyid rang stobs kyi/ /rang yul spu ris so sor ru/ /phye nas 'dzin pa'i sems byung ngo / /de la bdag med pa la bdag /mi rtag rtag dang sdug bsngal la/ /bde ba mi gtsang gtsang ba yi/ /'du shes log dang de las ldog bdag med pa sogs so so'i mtshan nyid tshul bzhin pa/ /phyin ci ma log 'du shes so/ /'du byed phung po'i sems dang mi ldan pa'i 'du byed bcu bzhi phar bcad/ sems ldan 'du byed thams cad sems byung yin no/ /gzhi lnga bzhag skabs 'di gnyis so sor rtsis/ so so'i rnam grangs 'og tu 'byung mtshan nyid ni/ phung po gzhi las gzhan pa yi/ /yul 'di'i rnam grangs sems byung dang ldan min 'du byed skabs su gsal rnams 'du byed rnams la grags/ /'di gtso bo sems kyi gzhi 'dod kyang dngos kyi sa bcad 'og nas 'byung rnam shes phung po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rang byung ngo bo rang stobs kyi/ /rnam pa gtso rig rnam rig dang / /rnam shes yid dbang gtso sems dang / /yid dang sems khams skye mched dang / /rnam shes phung po zhes pa rnams/

/don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ /nang gses dbye bas mig rna sna/ /lce lus yid kyi rnam shes drug so so'i mtshan nyid 'og nas 'byung // ༈ /skye mched ces pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sems dang sems byung skye ba yi/ /sgor gyur pa'o dbye ba ni/ /nang gi skye mched mig sogs drug /phyi yi skye mched gzugs sgra dri/ /ro dang reg bya chos bcas drug /de dag skye mched mtshan nyid ni/ /mig gi rnam shes 'khor bcas sogs/ /skye ba'i sgo ru gyur pa'o/ /khams kyi mtshan nyid sems sems byung / /'byung ba'i khungs su gyur pa ste/ /dbye na 'di skabs rang 'gags ma thag tu mig sogs rang 'bras kyi rnam shes skye ba'i rigs su gnas pa de/ skye rung du gnas pa de dbang po'i khams so/ rten gyi dbang po drug /dmigs pa'i yul gyi gzugs sogs drug /brten pa rnam shes drug pa ste/ /khams ni bco brgyad ces su grags/ /mig sogs dbang lnga gzugs la sogs/ /don lnga gzugs kyi khams skye mched/ /phung po bar pa gsum po dang / /rnam pa rig byed ma yin gzugs/ /drug pa yid kyi rnam shes kyi/ /skye ba'i sgo dang 'byung khungs su/ /gyur pas chos kyi skye mched khams/ /'di la khams bdun 'dod pa'i tshe/ /rnam shes tshogs drug gang rung ba/ /'das ma thag pa'i rnam shes de/ /rang 'bras yid kyis rnam shes kyi/ /rten byed cha nas yid khams dang / /yid kyi dbang po 'jog pa'o// 'di ltar bshad cing rnam shes tshogs drug dang / tshor 'du/ /'du byed gsum snga ma 'gag rjes ma mngon gyur ma skyes pa'i gang du'ang ngos ma bzung pa de chos khams dang chos kyi skye mched du 'jog pa ste gong du bdun du 'jog tshul gyi yid kho na bshad pa dang / rjes ma 'di bcas don mtshungs shing 'di bzhin ma bzhag na khams bco brgyad kyi skabs chos kyi skye mched dang yid kyi khams 'jog rgyu med 'dra/

'o na rten dang der mtshungs kyi/ /khyad par dbang po drug gis ni/ /yul rnams kyi ni yul can dang / /rnam shes rnams kyi rten byed do/ /yul drug dbang po rnam shes kyi/ /yul dang dmigs pa gnyis ka byed/ /rnam shes drug gi dbang po'i rten/ /yul gyis yul can byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtso bo sems kyi gzhi/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid rang gis yul/ /rang gis stobs kyis rig pa'o/ /mig dang rna ba sna lce lus/ /yid kyi rnam par shes te drug /sems dang sems byung nges par ni/ /lhan cig skye zhing sems med na/ /sems byung mi skye sems de yi/ /'khor du sems byung 'byung nges phyir/ /skabs 'dir rnam shes tshogs drug gi /don gyi rnam pa ma shar bar/ 'di bye smra rang gi dgongs pa shes pa rnam med du don 'dzin pa dang rang rig med pa'i 'dod tshul/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i don tsam 'dzin/ /de yang gzung 'dzin dus mnyam par/ /bar du ma sgrib thug phrad 'dzin/ /de yis rang nyid ma rig pas/ rang gi shes pas shes pa rang yul ma myong bar 'dod/ /rang rig med par 'dod pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa sems byung gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor sems byung gi gzhi 'di 'du byed phung po'i gras so/ /rang yul khyad par rig par bshad/ /de yang mngon pa gong ma la/ /sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig gsung / /'og ma'i skabs 'dir rdzas su yod/ /bzhi bcu zhe drug btags yod lnga/ /de la kun tu 'gro ba lnga/ /nyams su blangs ba'i tshor ba dang / tshor 'du lta bu gcig gi gtso sems 'khor du gsal bar yod pa'i tshe sems byung gzhan rnams mi gsal bar bag la zha ba'i tshul gyis tha dad du gnas par 'dod dgos/ /dmigs pa'i yul la sems g.yo ba/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dang / /don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang / /gsum 'dus yul la dpyod pa'i reg /yul nges lnga ni chos rnams kun/ /rab tu 'byed pa'i shes rab dang /

/'dris pa'i yul la ma brjed dran/ /dmigs pa la gtan yid la byed/ /nges pa'i dngos po la nges mos/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig pa'i ting 'dzin/ /sems kyi sa mang po zhes bya/ /dge ba yi ni sa mang bcu/ /sems dwangs pa yid dad pa dang / /dge la goms pa'i bag yod dang / /sems can las rung shin tu sbyang / /rtsol ba med pa'i btang snyoms pa/ 'di tshor ba'i btang snyoms dang mi gcig /yon tan can gus ngo tsha shes/ /sdig la 'dzems pa'i khrel yod dang / /zag bcas nyon mongs rnams la 'dod chags dben/ /sems can rnams la zhe sdang med/ de la snying brtses 'tshe ba bral/ /dge la spro ba'i brtson 'grus so/ /nyon mongs chen po'i sa mang drug /dmigs pa mi shes rmongs pa dang / /mi dger goms pa'i bag med pa/ dge la mi spro'i le lo dang / /sems ma dwang ba'i ma dad pa/ /sems mi gsal ba'i rmug pa dang / /sems gzhan 'phro ba'i rgod pa'o/ /mi dge ba yi sa mang gnyis/ /yon tan can la ma gus pa'i/ /mngon pa gong ma las/ gzhan las kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem pa ngo tsha med pa dang / rang las kha na ma tho ba la khrel med pa la 'chad/ ngo tsha med dang sdig pa la/ /ma 'jig pa yi khrel med do/ /nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa bcu/ /gnod pa byas la khro ba dang / /de la rgyun par 'khon du 'dzin/ /nyes pa khas mi len pa'i g.yo/ /gzhan gyi yon tan la phrag dog /gzhan gnod mi bzod 'tshig pa dang / /nyes pa gsang ba'i 'chab pa dang / /yo byad nan 'dzin ser sna dang / /yon tan can 'chos pa yi sgyu/ /rigs sogs cher chags rgyags pa dang / /sems can thod 'tshams rnam par 'tshe/ /ma nges pa yi sde tshan brgyad/ /sems rtsing par gyur rtog pa dang / /zhib par byed pa'i dpyod pa dang / /sngar byas yid la bcag pa'i 'gyod/ /sems rgyud rang dbang med pa'i gnyid/ /sems 'khrugs pa yi khong khro dang / /zag bcas la sred 'dod chags dang / /sems khengs pa yi nga rgyal dang /

/dmigs pa rtse gnyis the tshom mo/ 'di yan la sems byung rdzas yod bzhi cu zhe drug song / de steng btags yod lnga dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig go /btags yod lnga ni bden pa bzhi/ /shes pa'i gti mug med pa dang / /mi gtsang ba la gtsang ba ru/ /blta ba shes bzhin ma yin pa/ /don dang mi mthun pa rnams kun/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i lta ba'o/ /gsum ni shes rab cha las btang / /dmigs pa mi dran brjed nges ni/ /gong gi dran pa'i cha las btags/ /dmigs pa gzhan du 'phro ba yi/ /rnam g.yengs ting 'dzin nyon mongs can/ /de ni ting 'dzin cha las btags/ /sems byung rnams gtso sems kyi 'khor du 'gro lugs/ 'di dag rnam shes drug po yi/ /'khor du ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ /kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges lnga/ /dad sogs bcu dang nyon mongs pa/ /chen po'i sa drug ma nges pa'i/ /sde tshan nang gi rtog dpyod gnyis/ /chags sdang gnyis bcas rnam par shes/ /drug char 'khor du ci rigs 'byung / /gzhan rnams yid kyi rnam par shes/ /kho na'i 'khor du 'byung bar bshad/ /de dag sde tshan go rim ni/ sems byung rnams kyi sde tshan go rim/ /sems kyi sa mang bcu po ni/ /gtso sems thams cad las 'byung bas/ /khyab ches pas na dang por bstan/ /dge dang mi dge sa mang po/ /mchog dman rim pas gnyis pa dang / /gsum par bstan no nyon mongs che/ /chung ngu sa mang rtsa nyon dang / /nye nyon rim pas bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa la ni bshad pa'o/ /ma nges brgyad po sde tshan lnga/ /gang du yang ni ma nges so/ /de dag sgra don gtso sems dang / /bdag rkyen dbang po rnams la brten/ /yul rnams so sor dmigs pa'i mthus/ /sems byung rnams kyang gtso sems kyi/ /bdag rkyen la brten yul der dmigs/ /bzhi pa ldan min 'du byed gzhi/ ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi gzhi/ /sems dang sems byung bcas pa dang / /bye smra rang gis gsung pa'i chos skad/ mi mtshungs pas na mi ldan dang /

/phung po gzhan dang 'dus ma byas/ /sel bas 'du byed ces pa'i don/ gzhan sel gyi don gzhan rnams phar bcad don/ /dper na srog gi dbang po bzhin/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang / /'du shes med snyoms 'jug pa gnyis/ so skye 'phags pas bsgom pa'i snyoms 'jug /srog dang skye gnas rga mi rtag /ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs de rnams/ /lus sems lta bu/ de dag dngos las gzhan pa yi/ /'dus byas gyur pa'i rdzas yin no/ /'dus ma byas rag pa'i gzhi gsum/ lnga pa 'dus byas ma yin pa/ /rtag pa'i gzhi la rnam pa gsum/ /dang po nam mkha'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gzugs can mi sgrib go 'byed pa/ /snod kyi 'jig rten sa chu rlung / /rten byed nus pa rdzas su 'dod/ bye smra rang gi chos skad/ nam mkha'i khams dang mi mtshungs te/ /'di ni 'dus ma byas yin la/ /gcig shos dkar khung la sogs pa'i/ /bu ga'i stong cha'i nam mkhar 'jog dmigs su bkar bas gzugs kyi skye mched du 'gyur ba'ang bshad/ /gnyis pa so sor brtags 'gog gi /mtshan nyid bden bzhi gang rung la/ /so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /dpyad pa'i bar chad med pa'i lam/ /bral 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung yin pa shes nas de spangs pas sdug bsngal 'gog pa lta bu'o 'gog pa de la bshad/ /gsum pa so sor brtags min 'gog /dper na sbyor lam bzod pa thob/ /de yi stobs kyi mi dge'i las/ /'gog pas ngan 'gror mi skye ba/ /lta bu rkyen ma tshang ba yi/ /ma 'ongs 'bras bu mi 'byung pa'o/ /de ltar shes bya'i gzhi lnga ni/ /bye smra rang lugs kyi bden gnyis bzhag tshul/ bden gnyis 'jog tshul gang zhe na/ /sems dang sems byung mi ldan pa'i/ /'du byed 'dus ma byas kyi gzhi/ /rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med ni/ /rig pas dpyad bzod grub pa'i rdzas/ 'di dngos po 'dug dang mi 'dug zhes dbye ba byed pa'i don/

'di la bye brag smra bas 'dus ma byas sogs la dpyad bzod grub pa dang / bum pa sogs la ma grub zhes 'dod pa yin zhes pa sngags 'chang lo tsā ba sogs gsungs/ bcom gzhig blo yi gzhig kyang der/ /'dzin blos mi 'dor don dam bden/ bcom dang bsal yang de yi blo 'jug pa/ phra rab rdul dang skad cig sogs don dam dngos rang mtshan don dam bden pa zhes 'dod/ /snang ba gzugs kyi gzhir gyur pa'i/ /rags pa 'jig rten na grags pa'i/ /bum pa chu la sogs pa dang / /phung por btags pa'i gang zag sogs/ /rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus pa'i chos/ /rigs pas dpyad bzod ma grub rdzas/ /bcom blos gzhig na der 'dzin gyi/ /blo 'dor ba ni kun rdzob bden/ /'di bzhin bye brag smra ba yi/ /bden pa rnam gnyis 'jog tshul la/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yi/ /don dam 'jog tshul chad mtha' dang / /kun rdzob 'jog tshul rtag mtha' las/ /grol bas 'khrul med gnad yin gsungs/ /bye smra'i lugs 'dir chos thams cad/ /rdzas yod dngos por khas len te/ /'di ni nam mkha' gzugs can go 'byed rdzas su yod ces dang / rlung chu sa yi dkyil 'khor rnams nam mkhar brten pa sogs kyis dngos por yang khas len par snang ngo 'dus ma byas gsum rtag dngos 'dod/ rtag rdzas su'ang 'dod/ 'dus ma byas gsum dngos po dang rdzas su 'dod pa bye smra kho na'o/ /'dus byas chos kun dus gsum gyi/ /bsdus shing rdzas grub nyid du 'dod/ 'das ma gnyis rdzas grub 'dod pa ni bye smra kho na'o/ /de nas lam la zhugs tshul ni/ de dag lam gyi skye tshul ni/ /mdzod kyi lung / tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /ma chags 'phags rigs zhes pa'i don/ /sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin/ gtso bor zag bcas la/ /'dod pa chung zhing chos gos dang / /bsod snyoms gnas mal ngan ngon gyis/

/chog shes tshul la gnas pa dang / /nyon mongs spangs dang lam bsgom par/ 'dir rje btsun rin po che'i ljon shing chen mo las/ gang zag 'jug pa'i go rim bzhi ste dang po kho nar tshul khrims la gnas pa la rab du sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa de'i gong du gsung rab kyi don thos par byed pas thos pa la sbyor ro/ /gsum pa thos pa de bsam pas phyin ci ma log par sems par byed do/ /bzhi pa bsam nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la rab tu sbyor bar byed do/ /zhes sogs dang / yang ljon shing chen mo las/ de la thos bsam gnas ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rgyu tshogs pa yin pas/ de sngon du song nas zhi gnas sgrub pa dang / lhag mthong bskyed pa'o/ /dang po bsgom pa la 'jug pa na/ mi dge ba'i rnam par rtog pa sogs thag bsring nas bsgom mo/ /de yang 'dod chags nas che na mi sdug pa nas/ dang po bsgom la rnam pa rtog pa shas che na bgrang ba dang / rjes su rtog pa rlung nas dang por bsgom pa yin te/ mdzod las/ de la 'jug pa mi sdug dang / dbugs 'byung rngub pa dran pa yi/ nyon mongs rnam rtog lhag rnams la/ zhes gsung pa'o/ /de ltar rnam pa gnyis kyi zhi gnas grub nas/ de nas lhag mthong bskyed par bya ba'i phyir lam lnga la 'jug mngon par dga' des zhi gnas dang / /lhag mthong rnal 'byor rnam pa gnyis/ /dang po 'dod chags shas che na/ zhi gnas/ /gnyen por rnam par bsngos pa sogs mi sdug pa bsgom mo/ 'dir gsung ngag skabs snang gsum la me tog sngon po la sems 'dzin gyi don dang mtshungs par/ nyan thos kyi thog mar zhi gnas btsal ba'i skabs su 'dod chags kyi rtog pa byung dus lus de mi gtsang ba bsngos pa 'bu'i g.yeng sa sogs bsgom pas 'dod chags kyi rtog pa ldog pa dang / yang dbugs phyi nang rgyu ba la sems gtad pa sogs kyi sems nang du gnas thabs kho na la 'bad pas zhi gnas skye ba'o/

/rnam rtog shas cher gyur pa'i gnyen/ /dbugs 'byung rngub la dran pa 'jog 'di gnyis bye smra'i gzhung mdzod rtsa ba rang gi dgongs pa yin/ zhe sdang 'di sogs gzhung gzhan las 'byung gnyen po byams pa dang / /gti mug gnyen por rten 'brel lam/ /bsgom zhes gzhung gzhan las gsungs so/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong rnal 'byor la/ /spang bya'i gnyen por gyur pa'i lam/ /thams cad mdor na bzhi ru bsdu/ slob lam bzhi/ /de yang rang gi mjug thog tu/ /bar chad med pa'i lam bskyed byed/ /lam ni sbyor ba'i lam yin te/ /de yang mthong lam la sbyor lam/ /drod dang rtse mo bzod pa gsum/ /'jig rten chos mchog bzhi las 'dir/ /phyi ma 'di rang ston gyi bzhed pa yin gsung / nyid ni gtso bor 'dod/ /spang bya spangs te bar chad med/ /bar chad las grol rnam grol lam/ /de phyin khyad par lam yin no/ /gzhan yang zhi gnas sngon song gi /tshogs kyi lam ni chung ngu'i skabs/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi bsgom ste/ /de yang rim bzhin rang rang gi /dmigs pa gzugs phyi snod ri rab sogs dang nang sems can gyi lus phung gi bsdus lus/ /tshor ba rnam shes phung po sems/ /de las 'du shes 'du byed 'dus ma byas/ gzhan pa'i chos rnams la/ /dmigs nas rang rang lus tshor sems chos rnams rang rang so so'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid dang / /'du byas mi rtag zag bcas rnams/ 'dus byas spyi yi mtshan nyid/ /sdug bsngal la sogs spyi'i mtshan nyid/ /gnyis la yongs su brtags te bsgom/ 'di nas bzung dmigs pa rnam bden pa bzhi nang gses phye ba'i bcu drug po de ka yin 'dug cing / de yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / de'i rgyu kun 'byung las dang / nyon mongs pa las byung ba zhib par sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lam dang 'gog pa zhar byung du nges shing so so'i nang gses bcu drug po'i rgyu mtshan rjes su 'byung ba ni sbyor lam bzod pa nas bzung ste rim gyis mngon gyur dang /

mngon gyur gyi nus pa thob pas gsungs shing / thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang bsgom pa nyams len 'di nas bzung bden bzhi kho na'o/ /dran pa nyer gzhag ngo bo ni/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i shes rab gsum/ /gang rung kho na las 'byung ngo / /tshogs yang dag spong bzhi lam 'bring por yang dag spong bzhi/ 'di mngon pa'i gzhung dngos bstan yin/ ljon shing rtsa 'grel las ni/ tshogs lam du dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ sbyor lam drod la yang dag spong bzhi/ rtse mo rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi/ bzod par dbang po lnga/ chos mchog stobs lnga/ mthong lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ bsgom lam byang chub yan lag bdun du bzhed/ sdug pa spong / /skye ru mi 'jug thabs la 'bad/ /dge ba spel zhing slar bskyed pa'i/ /brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /tshogs lam chen por dge la 'dun/ /spro ba'i brtson 'grus yid la sems/ /dge la spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /gtsor gyur rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /de dag las byung yon tan gyi/ /tshogs lam mthar phyin zag med kyi/ /ye shes me skye'i snga ltas drod/ sbyor lam dros/ /dmigs pa bden bzhi'i spyod yul can/ /rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug re rer bzhi tshan phyed bas sdug bsngal mi rtag stong dang bdag med sogs bcu drug /de la'ang che 'bring chung gsum yod/ /mthar phyin sbyor lam rtse mo skye/ /rtse mo'i ming don dge ba yi/ /rtsa ba g.yo ba rnams kyi rtse/ /g.yo ba'i don ni rtse mo yi/ /chung 'bring man du dge rtsa la/ /nyams pa 'byung srid de yis so/ /rtse mo'i dmigs rnams drod dang 'dra/ /dbye ba che 'bring chung gsum yod/ /dad sogs dbang po lnga bsgom ste/ drod rtse gnyis char du/ /dwangs 'dod yid ches dad pa dang / /dge la spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang / /de yi dmigs pa ma brjed dran/ /de la rtse gcig ting 'dzin brtan/

/blang dor gnas shes shes rab kyi/ /dbang po lnga yis bsgom pa'o/ /de nas sbyor lam bzod pa skye/ /dge rtsa yongs su mi nyams pa'i/ /sgo nas bden pa la cher bzod/ spang byas bcom mi thub pa'i nus pa thob pa la bshad/ /de na bzod pa zhes bya'o/ /de la che 'bring chung gsum yod/ /chung 'bring gnyis kyi dmigs rnams ni/ /rtse mo dang 'dra bzod chen gyis/ /'dod pa'i sas bsdus sdug bsngal gyi/ /bden pa kho na'i yul can yin/ / bzod thob ngan song yang mi 'gro zhes pa 'di yi skabs so/ de nas sbyor lam chos kyi mchog /de yi ming don 'jig rten gyi/ /chos kyi mchog tu gyur pas so/ /de la'ang che 'bring chung gsum yod/ /dmigs rnams bzod chen dang 'dra'o/ /skabs der dad brtson dran ting 'dzin/ /shes rab de dag khyad par du/ /'phags te mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa'i/ /mthu dang ldan pa'i stobs lngas bsgom/ /drod/ rtse/ bzod/ chos bzhi la nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi zhes gsung / nges 'byed cha mthun thams cad la/ /dmigs pa bden bzhi'am sdug bsngal/ /bzhi ka'i gnad don gyis tshang / bden par dmigs nas de'i rnam pa/ /mi rtag la sogs bcu drug gam/ /ji ltar rigs pa'i rnam pa can/ chos mchog gi mjug thog nas 'dod khams kyi sdug bsngal la dmigs pa chos bzod chos shes nas bzung / skad cig ma bco lnga skyed/ bcu drug pas sgom lam zin/ chos bzod kyi go don ni spong bya de yi brdze mi nus pa/ chos shes ni spang gnyen gyi rgyu mtshan ji bzhin shes pa/ de yi rjes de las cung phra ba khams gong ma la de ltar 'byung ba la rjes bzod rjes shes 'dod pa'i go don no/ /shes rab gtso bor gyur pa yin/ /de yi 'khor du rjes 'brang ba'i/ de rnams kyi skabs dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung phung po lnga la ched du dmigs par 'gro zhing 'di yan nas spong bya rag pa rnams spong rjes der dmigs pa'ang je phra la 'gro bas 'dir phung po lnga po zhes 'di kun khyen rjes dmigs bsal gnang ba'o/

/phung po lnga yod sbyor lam gyi/ /rten gyur pa yi sa zag bcas/ /mthong lam rten gyur sa zag med/ /yin pa'i rnam dbye bcas pa'o// ༈ /de nas 'phags lam bsgom tshul ni/ /mthong ba'i lam du byang chub kyi/ /yan lag bdun bsgom 'phags lam gyi/ 'di mngon pa rang rkang la/ byang chub yan lag lam yan lag zhes dngos su bstan/ ljon shing la mthong lam yan lag bdun dang / sgom lam yang yan lag brgyad gsung / yan lag brgyad po mthong dang bsgom/ /gnyis char bsgom par bya ba bshad/ /gtso bo mthong ba'i lam du ni/ /mngon du byed pa'i nus thob nas/ /bsgom pa'i lam du mngon du gyur/ /mi slob lam du'ang de ltar bstan/ /dge ba'i dmigs pa ma brjed pa'i/ /dran pa yang dag byang dor gyi/ /chos rab rnam 'byed dge ba la/ /spro ba'i brtson 'grus zag med kyi/ /dga' ba lus sems lus su rung / /shin sbyangs lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /rtsol bas dor ba ma yin pa/ btang snyoms dmigs pa la sems 'jog /ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag bdun/ /bden bzhi mngon sum shes pa yi/ /yang dag lta ba yang dag pa'i/ /kun nas slong ba'i rtog pa dang / /bden par smra ba'i yang dag ngag /mi dge spangs pa'i yang dag las/ /log 'tshe spang ba'i yang dag 'tsho/ /dge la spro ba'i yang dag rtsol/ /dmigs pa ma brjed yang dag dran/ /rtse gcig yang dag ting nge 'dzin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad nyid do/ /de ltar byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /sde tshan bdun las dang po lnga/ dran bzhi/ spong bzhi/ rkang bzhi/ dbang lnga/ stobs lnga/ zag bcas zag med gnyis ka dang / /byang chub yan lag bdun 'phags lam brgyad/ phyi ma gnyis ni zag med do/ /de ltar lam lnga bshad pa'i skabs/ /mthong ba'i lam la skad cig ma/ /bco lnga sbyor tshul 'di ltar te/ /sbyor lam chos mchog mjug thog tu/ /'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i/ /chos bzod dang ni chos shes skye/ /de yi rjes su khams gong gi

/sdug bsngal la dmigs rjes bzod dang / /rjes shes skye zhing rnam pa ni/ /sdug bsngal bden par skye ba dang / sems can/ khams gsum/ /skye gnas sdug bsngal rnams pa gsum/ sdug bsngal/ 'gyur/ 'du byed/ /phrad bral 'gyur dang re ba med/ /skye rga na dang 'chi ba ste/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i khyad chos bzhi 'di go rim dang tshig don ljon shing chen mo las gsung ba nyid do gsum mam brgyad kyis sdug bsngal ba/ /gtan du ma yin mi rtag pa/ /sdug bsngal za ba po'am myong ba po rang las gzhan med pas sdug bsngal bden pa'i/ nang gi skyes bu dang bral stong / /'dod dgur byed med bdag med pa'o/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i kun 'byung la/ /dmigs pa'i chos bzod shes gnyis dang / /khams gong rjes bzod rjes shes gnyis/ /skye zhing mtshan nyid kun 'byung bden/ /der skye'i rgyu gyur las nyon mongs/ /'ong ba'i tshul gyis na rgyu'o/ slar yong rgyu'i rgyu/ kun 'byung khyad chos bzhi 'di'ang ljon shing chen mo las gsung ba nyid do/ ma 'ongs 'bras 'byung kun 'byung ngo / /'phel byed pas na rab skye'o/ /so sor 'brang ba'i don gyis rkyen/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /'gog pa la dmigs chos bzod dang / /chos shes khams gong gi bzod shes/ /gnyis skye mtshan nyid 'gog pa'i bden/ /sdug bsngal rgyur bcas 'gag gyur pa/ /'gog pa zhi ba gnyis ljon shing chen mo ji lta ba/ rgyu 'bras 'brel zhig phyir 'gog pa/ /skye gnas 'jig bral zhi ba ste/ /ljon chen las/ dge ba'i phyir gya nom pa/ zag med dge ba gya nom pa/ /'khor ba las thar nges 'byung ngo / yid brtan pa'i mchog min pas nges par 'byung ba zhes gsung / /de bzhin 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /gnyen po lam la dmigs pa yi/ /chos bzod chos shes khams gong gi /rjes bzod dang ni rjes shes skye/

/mtshan nyid lam gyi bden pa ni/ /gong gi 'gog pa thob byed lam/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal du shes shing / /kun 'byung spang bar bya ba shes/ /'gog pa mngon du bya bar shes/ /lam la brten shes rnam bzhir bden/ /lam bden khyad chos bzhi 'di ljon shing chen mo ji lta ba sogs/ lam ngan gnyen por gyur pas lam/ /rig min 'joms byed rig pa'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa yi grong / /mi 'gal phyir na sgrub pa'o/ /srid pa thams cad 'joms pa yi/ /gnyen po'i phyir na nges 'byin pa'o/ /de yang sdug bsngal chos bzod nas/ /lam gyi rjes bzod par bco lnga/ /de dag thams cad mthong lam yin/ /sdug bsngal chos bzod la sogs brgyad/ /bden don gsar mthong yod pa'i phyir/ /bar chad med pa'i lam yin no/ /shes pa bdun la gsar mthong re/ /med kyang lam gyi rjes bzod la/ /gsar mthong yod phyir shes bdun kyang / /rnam grol lam du bzhag pa'o/ /bcu drug lam gyi rjes shes ni/ /mthong zin goms par byed pa'i phyir/ /bsgom pa'i lam du bzhag pa'o/ /de lta'i mthong lam spang bya la/ /'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang ni/ /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal dang / /ma rig the tshom 'jig tshogs kyi/ /phung po lnga la bdag bdag gir/ /lta dang de bzhin rtag chad mthar/ 'jig tshogs lta ba/ /'dzin dang rgyu 'bras med lta ba/ log lta/ /de sogs dman la mchog tu lta/ mchog 'dzin/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog rlom lta/ 'dzin/ /'dod pa'i kun 'byung mthong spang la/ /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal dang / /ma rig the tshom log par lta/ /mchog 'dzin lta ba dang bcas bdun/ /'dod pa'i 'gog pa'i mthong spang ni/ /snga ma dang 'dra 'dod pa yi/ /lam gyi mthong spang de yi khar/ /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin bsnan/ /de dag kun sdom 'dod pa yi/ /phra rgyas sum cu rtsa gnyis yod/ /de bzhin gzugs khams gzugs med kyi/

/sas bsdus sdug bsngal mthong spang la/ /khong khro med pas dgu re 'byung / /kun 'byung 'gog pa'i mthong spang la/ /drug re 'byung zhing lam mthong spang / /bdun re yod pas khams gong ma/ /gnyis kyi mthong spang lnga bcu drug /bsgom lam rnam gnyis gsung pa ni/ /zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i bsgom lam/ /ming mtshungs tsam las lam dngos min/ /zag med 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bsgom lam lam lnga'i nang tshan gyi/ /bsgom spang dngos gzhi'i gnyen po'o/ /'dod pa'i sas bsdus bsgom spang ni/ /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal dang / /ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i gzhi/ /gzugs khams gzugs med sas bsdus pa'i/ /bsgom spang khong khro ma gtogs pa'i/ /gsum re 'byung zhing mthong bsgom gnyis/ /spang bya thams cad bsdams pa yis/ /phra rgyas dgu bcu rtsa brgyad do/ /de na mi slob pa yi lam/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /mjug thog rnam par grol ba'i lam/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po dang / /nyon mongs zag pa gtan nas zad/ /slar yang mi skye pa ste bcu/ /yang dag rnam par grol ba dang / /de bzhin zag pa zad pa dang / /slar yang mi skyes shes pa yi/ /yang dag pa yi shes pa ste/ /yan lag bcu dang ldan pa'o/ /de nas gang zag dbye ba la/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas kyi/ /rig ma can gsum las nyan thos ni/ /rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las/ /thar bar sems bskyed mthong lam du/ /sdug kun gnyis la yid 'byung dang / spangs blang rgyu mtshan ji bzhin nges pa mthar phyin pa/ /bsgom pa'i lam du chags pa bral/ srid par/ /'khor ba/ nyon mongs pa las rnam grol ba'i/ /bsam pas nyan thos sde snod la/ /dmigs nas mya ngan 'das mtha' dang / /rjes su mthun pa'i lam bsgrub pas/ /khams su 'dod chags dang bral te/ /lus zhig tshor ba bsil bar gyur/ /'du shes 'gag cing 'du byed zhig /rnam par shes pa nub gyur pa/ /'di 'dra 'dis ni sdug bsngal thar/

/zhes pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mngon byed 'dod/ /de ltar nyan thos 'bras bu ni/ /brtson 'grus myur bas tshe gsum la/ / 'bras bu la yun thung ba ni thob bya cung dman pa'o/ /bul ba la ni nges med bshad/ /rang rgyal rigs ni rang bzhin gyi/ /nyon mongs chung bas 'du 'dzi la/ /mi dga' gcig pu la dga' zhing / /snying rje chung bas gzhan don la/ /mi sems slob dpon med pa dang / /'gran zla med par byang chub 'dod/ /'khor bar yid 'byung mthong lam gyi/ /'dod chags dang bral bsgom lam gyi/ /nyon mongs pa las grol ba dang / /nyan thos sde snod la dmigs nas/ /sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i zhing du/ /sngar bshad bzhin gyi mtshan nyid kyi/ /byang chub mngon du byed par bshad/ /de yang dbang po rnon po ste/ /bse ru bskal pa brgya yis 'grub/ /'dir dbang rnon dang dbang 'bring la bskal grangs mang nyung byung kyang / dbang rnon ni thob 'bras ches 'bras che 'phags pa dang / dbang 'bri thob 'bras dman pa'i dbang gis 'byung ngo / dbang 'bring bskal grangs nges pa med/ /nges 'byed cha mthun slob dpon las/ /bskyed nas phung khams skye mched dang / /bcu gnyis/ rten 'brel gnas dang gnas min drug dge bas bde ba las sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba/ mkhas byas tshogs spyod che ba'o/ /dbang brtul sangs rgyas sogs mnyes byas/ /gnas drug la ni mkhas byas te/ /rgyun phugs phyir 'ongs phyir mi 'ongs/ /dgra bcom 'bras bu bzhi thob pa/ /de ni tshogs spyod chung ba'o/ /de gnyis spang rtog nyan thos 'dra/ /gang zag gi ni bdag med tsam/ /rtogs shing bse ru lta bu'i ni/ /gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs/ /nyi 'og pa rnams de ltar 'dod/ /kha che pa rnams tshogs spyod pa/ /mi 'dod slob pa med par 'dod/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskal pa ni/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ /srid pa tha ma'i rten la ni/

/srod la bdud btul nam gung la/ /mnyam par bzhag cing tho rangs su/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la/ /drod nas bzung ste lam thams cad/ /stan thog gcig tu mngon par byas/ /rnam grol go 'phang mchog grub bo/ /de ltar nyan thos 'phags pa yi/ /gang zag zung bzhi ya brgyad ni/ /mthong spang skad cig bco lnga par/ /gnas pa rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'o/ /skad cig bcu drug pa la ni/ /gnas pa de yi 'bras gnas so/ /'dod pa'i bsgom spang nyon mongs bzhi/ /re res nang gses che 'bring chung / /dbye bas sum cu so drug 'byung / /dril bas rnam grangs bzhi la che 'bring chung gsum dang de re re la'ang nang gses gsum re dbye bas sum cu so drug de bzhi la re re brtsis pa'i 'bor bsdom dgu dgur gnas pa'i/ /lnga yi bar du spangs pa ni/ /phyir 'ong zhugs pa drug pa spangs/ /de yi 'bras gnas bdun nam brgyad/ /spangs pas phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa/ /dgu pa spangs pas de'i 'bras gnas/ /bsam gzugs brgyad po spangs pa na/ /dgra bcom zhugs pa srid rtse yi/ /nyon mongs dgu pa ma lus pa/ /spangs pas bar chad med pa'i lam/ /rdo rje lta bu la gnas pa/ /de ni de yi 'bras gnas so/ /de la'ang dgra bcom dbang po brtul/ /dran dang shes pas zin ma zin/ /gang yang rung ste mthong chos kyi/ /bde gnas dgra bcom ma thob bzhin/ /bar der bsam gtan las nyams la/ /ma shi bsam gtan las nyams dogs/ /ma nyams shi nas thob par sems/ /dran shes kyis ni zin pa yi/ /mi nyams rjes su srung ba dang / /rang sems 'bad rtsol cung zhan pas/ /dbang po ma sbyong pa yi na/ /gnas las mi bskyod pa zhes dang / /'bad dang rtsol bas dbang po yi/ /rnal 'byor mtha' ru dbyung ba yi/ /rtogs pa'i skal ba can zhes dang / /rang bzhin gyi ni dbang po rnams/ /ma sbyangs kyang ni mi nyams pa'i/ /mi g.yo ba yi chos can zhes/ /drug las phyi ma gnyis mchog go /de nas gang zag de rnams kyi/

/shes pa'i dbye ba 'di lta ste/ /gsum du bsdu na kun nyon shes/ /chos shes pa dang rjes su shes/ /bcu ru dbye na chos shes 'dod khams sdug bsngal la sogs bden bzhi shes pa/ dang / /rjes thob de bzhin khams gong ma gnyis kyi bden bzhi rjes su shes pa/ dang ni kun bum pa sogs 'dus byas dang nam mkha' 'dus ma byas zhes pa/ rdzob shes/ /pha rol sems gzhan sems shes pa/ shes bden dang po bden bzhi'i ming shes pa/ bzhi shes/ /zad bden bzhi'i blang dor shes pa/ dang mi skye bden bzhi'i dbyer med par shes pa/ shes pa'o/ /chags bral sngon du ma song na/ sred pa/ /kun rdzob shes pa gcig pur ldan/ /chags bral sngon du song ba la/ /gzhan sems shes pa dang ldan no/ /skad cig gnyis par kun rdzob shes/ mthong lam skad cig bco lnga'i nang yin/ /chos shes sdug bsngal shes pa gsum/ /skad cig bzhi par de gsum steng / /sdug bsngal rjes shes drug pa la/ /de bzhi'i steng du kun 'byung shes/ /skad cig bcu par de lnga'i steng / /'gog pa shes shing bcu bzhi par/ /de drug steng du lam shes 'phel/ /de nas mi slob lam gyi skabs/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa'o/ shes pa bcu po 'di go rim ltar na gzhan sems shes pa bden bzhi'i gong du 'byung kyang chags bral min gyi dbye ba'i dbang gi gnyis gong du brjod/ de nas bdun po dang / mthar phyin skabs kyi gnyis ni rjes su 'byung bzhin pa bcas don bcu'o/ /sangs rgyas yon tan thun min ni/ /dang po ma 'dres pa yi chos/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad mnyam dang mi mnyam phun sum tshogs pa dang gsum gyi dang po/ /bco brgyad nang nas stobs bcu ni/ /dge las mtho ris 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ngan song 'byung gnas ma yin pa/ /mkhyen pa'i stobs dang sems can rnams/ /rang rang las las de yi 'bras/ /'byung ba'i rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs/

/sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /mkhyen pa'i stobs dang nyan thos sogs/ rigs kyi sna tshogs khams mkhyen bas/ /dad sogs dbang po'i khyad mkhyen stobs/ /de dang 'tshams pa'i chos gsung pa'o/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i lam zhes pa/ /ngan 'gro bde 'gro thar pa yang / /thams cad 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen stobs/ /dad sogs byang phyogs so bdun gras dbang po stobs dang byang chub kyi/ /yan lag dang ni bsam gtan bzhi/ dang / /rnam par thar brgyad dang ting nge 'dzin/ bzhi/ /snyoms par 'jug dgu dang kun nyon spang bya/ dang / /rnam byang rnam par bkod mkhyen stobs/ thob 'bras/ /sngon gnas sems can gyi spyod pa/ skye ba snga ma/ /rigs rus tshe tshad bde sdug sogs/ /mkhyen pa'i stobs dang lha mig gis/ slar/ /'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs/ /nyon mongs zag pa zad mkhyen stobs/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ni rtogs pa dang / /spangs pa phun tshogs zhal gyis bzhes/ /lam spyi/ bar chad dang ni bral ba dang / /nges 'byin lam ston mdzad pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag gsum ni/ /'khor rnams gus pas chos nyan la/ /rjes su mi chags ma gus pas/ /nyan kyang khro ba mi mdzad dang / /'dres ma gnyis ka mi 'gyur bar/ /dran shes bzhin du btang snyoms bzhugs/ /thugs rje che ni 'gro kun la/ /dmigs pa'i thugs rjes dus drug tu/ /gzigs nas 'gro kun sdug bsngal ba/ /rgyu dang bcas las sgrol bar bzhed/ stobs bcu nas 'di bar ma 'dres bco brgyad do/ /gnyis pa mnyam dang mi mnyam cha/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rgyu tshogs bsags/ /'bras bu chos sku brnyes pa dang / /'gro don phrin las mdzad pa mnyam/ /sku tshe'i tshad dang rigs sku bong / /tha dad pas na mi mnyam bshad/ /bye brag smra bas sangs rgyas la/ /chos sku gzugs sku gnyis su 'dod/ /longs sprul tha snyad mi 'dod do/ /ston pa thub pa'i dbang po yang /

/rdo rje gdan la gsar du ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs sku tsam zhig 'dod/ /'on kyang ston pa 'di nyid kyis/ /sprul gzhi mdzad nas gdul bya rnams/ /gang la gang 'dul de yi ched/ /sna tshogs sprul pa mdzad pa rnams/ /sprul pa'i cha ru bzhed pa'ang yod/ /bye brag smra ba'i skabs 'di ru/ /sa bcu'i rnam gzhag mi mdzad do/ /gsum pa bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /bar ma chad par tshogs gnyis la/ /goms mdzad rgyu yi phun sum tshogs/ /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib/ /bag chags bcas pa zad par spong / /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas spangs pas/ /chos nyid ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /gdul bya mngon mtho nges legs la/ /'god mdzad ji snyed mkhyen pa yi/ /rnam par grol ba'i chos kyi sku/ /gang sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis/ /brgyad pa mngon gyur gzugs kyi sku/ /'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gdul bya ngan song 'khor ba las/ /thar bar mdzad de theg gsum gyi/ /'bras bu bde 'gro la 'god mdzad/ /phan 'dogs phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gzhan dang thun mong pa la gnyis/ yon tan thun mong pa las dang po nyan thos dang thun mong la nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes yang dag rig bzhi mngon shes so/ /zhes pa'i/ nyan thos dang ni 'jig rten pa/ /dang po nyon mongs med pa ni/ /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs 'dul/ /de yi gnyen po mdzad pa dang / /de lta'i 'gro la brtse bar mdzad/ /nyan thos sogs kyis rang la dmigs/ /nyon mongs skye ba tsam spong las/ /gzhan gyi nyon mongs sel mi byed/ /smon gnas mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub/ /gzugs la sogs par chags pa spangs/ /shes bya thams cad thogs med mkhyen/ /rtag tu mnyam gzhag 'dri kun gyi/ /lan ldon the tshom gcod par mdzad/ /nyan thos smon gnas shes pa ni/ /snyoms 'jug la brten nyi tshe tsam/ /shes kyi the tshom gcod mi nus/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi ni/

/mtshan gzhi chos dang don mtshan gnyis/ /nges pa'i tshig gi sgra don dang / /mkhyen pa'i spobs pa dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa sogs dang / gnyis pa 'jig rten pa dang thun mong / mngon shes bsam gzugs tshad med dang / rnam thar zil gnon zad par ro/ /zhes pa'i/ /thun mong pa yi yon tan ni/ /mngon shes drug ni sku thugs gsung / 'di 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi thub pa dgongs gsal ltar yin/ gzhan go rim sna tshogs 'dug kyang don gcig /rdzu 'phrul sku yi mngon par shes pa yis/ /gdul bya gang na gnas pa der/ /gshegs dang thugs kyi gzhan sems mkhyen pa'o/ /lha yi rna gzugs kyis ba'i mngon shes kyis/ /'gro ba so so'i skad mkhyen cing / /sngon gnas rjes su dran pa yis/ /sngon gyi mtha' nas 'dir 'ong dang / /'chi 'pho shes pa lha mig gis/ /'di nas phyi ma'i mthar 'gro dang / /zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa yis/ /srid las nges par 'byung ba'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi ni sems kyi rtog pa dang / /dpyod dang dga' ba bde ba yi/ /ting 'dzin lnga ldan dang po'o/ /nang du rab tu sems dwangs pa dang / /dga' dang bde ba ting nge 'dzin/ /bzhi dang ldan pa gnyis pa yin/ /btang snyoms dang ni dran pa dang / /shes bzhin dang ni bde ba dang / /ting nge 'dzin lnga ldan gsum pa'o/ /tshor ba btang snyoms lhun grub kyi/ /btang snyoms dran dang yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /yang dag bzhi ldan bzhi pa'o/ 'di skabs sogs btang snyoms kyi rigs la chags sdang la sogs pa spangs te blo btang snyoms chen po la bzhag pa dang / tshor ba bde sdug ci yang ma skye ba'i bar pa dang 'bad rtsol ma dgos par rang bzhin lhun gyi grub pa'i btang snyoms te btang snyoms 'di rnams dbye ba so sor go dgos 'dra/ /gzugs med bzhi ni sbyor ba'i tshe/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas yid la byed/ /dngos gzhi'i sems la gzugs ma gtogs/

/phung po bzhi la dmigs pa yi/ /snyoms par 'jug pa rtse gcig pa/ /rnam pa de bzhin sbyor ba'i dus/ sbyor dngos/ /rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so/ /yid la byed dang dngos gzhi'i dus/ dngos gzhi gzugs ma gtogs bzhi la dmigs pa bzhi char 'dra/ /ci yang med de yid la byed/ /'du shes rag pa med pa dang / /phra ba med pa ma yin bzhi/ /rnam rtog mtha' dag spong ba yi/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang dgu'o/ bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med bzhi 'gog snyoms dang dgu'o/ /de dag rim bzhin snyoms 'jug rnams/ /seng ge rnam par bsgyings zhes sogs/ /sangs rgyas rnams la ting nge 'dzin/ /gzhan las 'phags pa mang bzhugs so/ /'di dag rnams ni nyan thos kyi/ /sems las rung dang snang ba skyo/ /'gag phyir 'gog pa la snyoms 'jug /sangs rgyas rnams las ting 'dzin la/ /dbang 'byor bya ba'i phyir yin zhing / /sangs rgyas gyi ni ting 'dzin la/ /dbang 'byor pa nyid lhun gyi grub/ /tshad med bzhi ni byams pa dang / /snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms so/ /dang po gnyis ni zhe sdang bral/ /gsum pa yid bde'i rang bzhin dang / /bzhi pa ma chags rang bzhin no/ /rnam thar brgyad las dang po ni/ /bsam gtan dang po gnyis par brten/ /nang du gzugs kyi 'du shes dang / /ldan pas phyi rol gzugs rnams ni/ /rnam par bsngos pa la sogs pa'i/ /mi sdug pa ru lta ba ni/ /gzugs can gzugs lta'i rnam par thar/ /gnyis pa nang du gzugs med pa'i/ /'du shes ldan pas phyi rol gzugs/ /rnam pa bsngos sogs mi sdug par/ /lta ba gzugs med gzugs la ni/ /lta ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /gsum pa bsam gtan bzhi pa la/ /brten nas gzugs kun yid 'ong bar/ /lta ba gzugs sdug pa'i rnam par/ /de gsum steng du gzugs med pa'i/ /gong gsal/ snyoms par 'jug pa dge ba bzhi/ /yod min med min/ srid rtse'i sems la brten pa yi/ mtshan gzhi nyan thos la 'di bzhin dang sangs rgyas lam sbyang ba'i 'phags chos so/

'phags pa dag gi 'du shes dang / /tshor ba rags pas skyo ba yi/ /zhi bar gnas pa'i ched du ni/ /sems dang sems byung 'gog pa yi/ /snyoms 'jug dang bcas brgyad po'o/ /zil gnon brgyad ni bsam gtan gyi/ gzugs khams kyi bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi sems la brten nang gzugs yod med du 'du shes shing phyi'i gzugs che chung la lta/ /sems la brten na nang gzugs su/ /'du shes phyi yi gzugs chung che/ shes bya rab gsal las/ nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi kha dog bzang ngan dang / gzugs bzang ngan zil gyis gnon/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi kha dog bzang ngan dang / gzugs bzang ngan zil gyis gnon zhes gsungs/ /lta zhing zil gyis mnan pa na/ /zhi gnas gyis shes lhag mthong gis/ /mthong bas de dag zil gyis gnon/ bltas pa'i mdo la nyi ma'i 'od lta bu las kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi gzi brjid ches cher 'bar ba'o/ /de bzhin nang du gzugs med par/ /shes pas bshad chung ngu chen po ma thag pa bzhin/ /zil gyis gnon par gyur pa bzhi/ /de bzhin sngon po ser po dang / /dmar po dkar po'i kha dog la/ /lta zhing kha dog sogs zil gyis gnon zil gnon bzhi ste brgyad/ /zad par bcu ni sa dang chu/ /me rlung kha dog sngon po dang / /ser po dmar po dkar po dang / /nam mkha' dang ni rnam shes te/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ting 'dzin la/ /brten nas gang 'dod pa'i phyogs su/ /de dag bsgom stobs kyis sa sogs/ /khyab par byed de dang po brgyad/ /ma chags pa yi rang bzhin la/ /tha ma gnyis ni nam mkha' dang / /rnam shes mtha' yas bsam gtan bzhi pa dang gzugs med dang po gnyis kyi mthus 'byung bzhi dang kha dog bzhi po gang 'dod pa'i sa der de ma thag sprul nus pa'i don rang bzhin no/ /byed las gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /bai ḍūr+ya yi mig mang ris/

/bris sogs sna tshogs ston pa'o/ /de ltar rnam par brgyad sogs ni/ /'jig rten pa yi sgrib gnyis las/ /ma grol nyan thos rang rgyal gyis/ /nyon mongs pa yi sgrib pa spangs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas ni shes bya yi/ /sgrib pa las ni grol ba'o/ /zil gnon 'jig rten pas rang gi /spyod yul tsam ni zil gyis gnon/ /nyan thos stong gnyis bar ma dang / stong gi rnam bzhag la/ spyi phud stong gis 'jig rten/ de stong 'gyur te 'phar ba'i bar pa stong gi 'jig rten stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten gsum 'byung / 'jig rten khams thams cad de las kyang rgya che ba'i grangs dang gzhal du med pa/ /rang rgyal stong gsum sangs rgyas kyis/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /zad bcu 'jig rten pas rgya chung / /shes zhing nyan rang de las che/ /sangs rgyas shes bya thams cad la/ /khyab par gzigs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /'jig rten pa rnams ma grol zhing / /nyan rang nyon mongs bag chags kyi/ /sgrib pa phra mo ma spangs shing / /shes bya'i sgrib pa las ma grol/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa las/ /yongs su grol ba sangs rgyas so/ /de ni bye brag smra ba yi/ /grub mtha'i rnam gzhag mdo rtsam mo/ /zhib par 'phags yul paṇ+ḍi ta/ /dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi mdzod rtsa ba/ /de yi rjes zhugs 'phags bod kyi/ mkhas grub rnams kyi bstan bcos la/ /zhib tu sgro 'dogs bcad par bya/ /gnyis pa mdo sde pa yi ni/ /grub mtha' bshad la byed smra bas/ /bstan bcos bye brag bshad pa la/ /tshad mar byed cing shes bya yi/ /gzhi lnga rdzas su yod par 'dod/ /de nas bye smra dgag pa la/ /bstan bcos mdzad pa'i dgra bcom rnams/ /nyon mongs nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs mod kyang de yi phra ba chos bdag yongs su rdzogs pa tsam ma spangs/ ma yin pa yi mun/ /ma spangs 'khrul pa srid phyir dang / /bka' la gtso bor ma brten na/ /ston par ma gus 'gyur phyir te/

/'phags mchog dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis kyang / /mdo nyid gtso bor bya bar gsungs/ /de lta ma yin mdo rnams ni/ /gdul bya la dgongs gsungs pa mang / /drang don shas tshe yin snyam na/ /spyir ni sangs rgyas gsung rab la/ /mtha' drug gsung pa de shes pas/ mtha' drug gi bshad pa 'di 'phros don las dngos nas bstan pa min no/ /gzhung bshad pa la shin tu mkhas/ /de yang drang don nges don gnyis/ /sgra de ji bzhin pa dang ni/ /ji bzhin ma yin pa zhes dang / /dgongs pa can dang dgongs min te/ /drug las dang po drang don ni/ /tshig las don dngos ma yin kyang / /gang zag bsam pa dang bstun nas/ /blo sna drang ste nges don la/ /'jug pa'i gzhi ru gyur par bshad/ /de yi mtshan gzhi dbu ma pas/ /'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde las/ /sems can rgyud la mtshan dpe yi/ /brgyan sogs khyad chos dang ldan pa'i/ /bde gshegs snying po bden grub tu/ /yod par gsungs pa sems can rnams/ /rnam grol lam bzang 'jug pa la/ /blo nus zhum sogs skyon lnga'o/ /spang phyir gsung nas byang chub kyi/ /lam la drang ba'i khyad lta bu/ /gnyis pa nges don ngo bo ni/ /ji ltar gsung pa'i rjes 'brang bas/ phyin ci ma log rtog pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i yum las 'di skad du/ /gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa sgra ni ji bzhin du/ /dgongs dang dgongs par mi ltos par/ /brjod bya bden pa nyid gsungs pas/ /sbyin pas longs spyod tshul khrims kyi/ /bde ba thob pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa sgra ni ji bzhin du/ /ma yin pa ni brjod bya de/ /bden par mi gsung de dag gi pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhes/ pha ni zag bcas kyi las/ /ma ni nyon mongs pa ste de dag bcom pa'i don/ /dgongs pa dang ni dgos pa yi/ /dbang gis gsungs pa'i mdo lta bu/

/lnga pa dgongs pas bshad pa ni/ /tshig des sangs rgyas dgongs pa ni/ /dngos su mi longs dgongs pa gzhan/ /btsal dgongs pa ru bshad pa'o/ /drug pa dgongs pa ma yin pa/ /dgongs pa gzhan btsal mi dgos par/ /tshig des sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/ /dngos su ngo sprod byed pa'o/ /gong gi dgongs pa bshad pa la/ /dgongs pa can dang ldem dgongs gnyis/ /dgongs pa can la bzhi las/ snga mar bzhi las dang po ni/ /mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa ni/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas rnam gzigs su/ /gyur zhes spangs rtogs nyams la dgongs/ /gnyis pa don gzhan la dgongs pa/ /sangs rgyas mang por bsnyen bskur bas/ /chos don mngon sum rtogs par gsungs/ /gsum pa dus gzhan la dgongs pa/ /bde ba can phyir smon pa yis/ /de ru skye bar srid la dgongs/ /bzhi pa gang zag bsam pa la/ /dgongs te sbyin pas chog pa ru/ /rlom pa'i gnyen por tshums khrims bsngags/ /gnyis pa ldem por dgongs pa bzhi las/ ldem por dgongs la bzhi/ /zhugs pa ldem por dgongs pa ni/ /nyan thos theg chen la gzhug phyir/ /gzugs sogs yod par gsungs ltar ro/ /mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa ni/ /rang gi mtshan nyid skye ba dang / snang srid kyi chos thams cad la rang rang gi skye 'gag gnas gsum yod kyang / don dam las gzhal na skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba la dgongs nas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /don dam ngo bo nyid gsum la/ /dgongs nas chos kun ngo bo nyid/ /med ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa ni/ /sangs rgyas chos la brnyas pa dang / /le lo cung zad mchog 'dzin dang / /nga rgyal 'dod chags spyod pa dang / /'gyod dang ma nges ldog pa ni/ /sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa ste/ /brgyad kyi gnyen por nga nyid ni/ /de tshe sangs rgyas rnam gzigs su/ /gyur 'di ma dad pa'i rkyen sel ba'i ched lta bu/ zhes gsung ba lta bu'o/

/'gyur ba ldem por dgongs pa ni/ /tshig sgra ji bzhin ma yin pas/ /don gzhan 'gyur nas go dgos te/ /snying po med la snying por shes/ /snying po med ni g.yeng ba dang / /ma g.yengs dran pa de la ni/ /snying por shes zhes lta bu dang / /phyin ci log la legs gnas pa/ /zhes pa rtag pa bde ba dang / /gtsang ba bdag 'dzin las ldog ste/ /de yi ldog phyogs mi rtag sogs/ /bzhi la gnas dgos bstan lta bu/ /nyon mongs pas ni rab nyon mongs/ /zhes don yun ring dka' spyad kyis/ /ngal bar shin tu nyon mongs pa/ /dka' ba spyad dgos bstan lta bu/ /'di la dbu ma pas gzhal na/ /'dir bshad gzhug pa ldem dgongs dang / /mtshan nyid ldem dgongs gnyis po ni/ /ldem dgongs mtshan nyid can ma yin/ /gzugs sogs yod par gsungs pa dang / /chos kun ngo bo nyid med pa/ /gsungs 'di don la gnas phyir ro/ /dgongs pa can dang ldem dgongs khyad/ /dgongs pa dang ni dgongs gzhi yi/ /ldog pa'i cha nas nyer bzung ba/ /tsam du rong ston ṭi kar bshad/ /de gnyis 'gal ba'ang ma yin te/ /dgongs pa can ni bzhi char ro/ /gnyen po ldem dgongs yin pas so/ /mdor na de lta'i mtha' drug la/ /drang don ji bzhin ma yin sgra/ /dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs bzhi/ /'jig rten theg pa la dgongs te/ /tshig de mngon sum ma yin la/ /nges don ji bzhin gyi sgra gnyis/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i theg pa rnams/ /tshig don mngon sum nges pa'o/ /de rnams 'phros don tsam bshad nas/ /snying po slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ /gzugs sogs skye mched yod pa ni/ /de yi 'dul ba'i skye bo la/ /dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste/ /glo bur/ brdzus te byung ba'i sems can bzhin/ /gsungs ltar gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi/ /don dang mthun par gsungs pa'i bka'/ /de la bstan nas bstan bcos kyang / /brtsams pa'i phyir na bka' gtso'o/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen rang gzhung las/

/nyon mongs dug gsum gnyen po ru/ /chos kyi phung po gsungs par bshad/ /de yi phyir na bka' thams cad/ /legs par gsungs pa kho na'o/ /de bye smras gzhi lnga rdzas yod 'dod pa dgag pa/ nas bye smras shes bya yi/ /bzhi lnga bye smra'i rdzas zhes pa bem dngos gnyis ldan bden grub zhig 'dod/ rdzas yod 'dod pa ni/ /dgag pa'i tshul ni gzhi lnga po/ /de dag rdzas su yod pa ci/ /tha snyad ming btags rung ba'am/ /rang gi mtshan nyid yod la zer/ /tha snyad ming btags rung tshad la/ /bden grub 'dod na btags de de'i mtshan nyid gzhan la ltos dgos pa/ yod ni/ /gtan nas mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid yod pa la/ /zer na spyi don khas len gyi/ /dbang du byas na dbang po lnga/ /gzugs sogs don lnga gtso sems dang / /sems byung rdzas su mdo sde pas bem po dang bden grub mi 'dod rdzas su bzhed/ 'dod pa bden/ /rnam pa rig byed ma yin gzugs/ /mi ldan pa yi 'du byed dang / /'dus ma byas gsum rdzas grub min/ /rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa'i/ /gzugs de rdzas su yod zer na/ /gzugs kyi mtshan nyid gzhig gzhom rung / /dgos pa'i phyir na de mi 'thad/ /rdul phran ma bsags bem po zhig /mi srid mngon sum gyis ma grub/ /'dus ma byas kyi gzhi gsum ni/ /phyogs gang du yang mi dmigs shing / /don gang du yang ma 'dres phyir/ /rjes dpag gis kyang mi 'grub bo/ /ldan min 'du byed thob pa sogs/ /gzugs sems sems las byung ba yi/ /gnas skabs chos la btags pa tsam/ /yin gyi de ltar ma yin na/ /gzugs sems sems byung gsum las rdzas/ /gzhan zhig yin nam gcig yin dpyod/ /mdor na shes bya'i gzhi lnga las/ /rnam pa rig byed ma yin gzugs/ /ma gtogs gzugs dang sems sems byung / /gzhi gsum rdzas su grub pa yin/ /'dus ma byas dang ldan min gyi/ /'du byed rig byed ma yin gzugs/

/rdzas su ma grub par khas len/ /gzhan yang bye smras dus gsum po/ /rdzas yod 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa 'gal zhing / /ma skyes pas na da lta min/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug po/ /don gyi rnam par ma shar bzhin/ /thug phrad 'dzin pa mi 'thad de/ /yul zhig med na/ rnam pa med na sngo ser sogs/ /rtogs pa'i dbye ba mi nus phyir/ /rang rig med 'dod mi 'thad de/ /dran pa las kyang bdag rig grub/ /ces pa'i lung des gnod phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mdo sde pa rang gis grub mtha' bzhag pa mdo sde pa rang gi /grub pa'i mtha' yi 'jog tshul la/ /mdo yi rab tu dbye ba ni/ /snying po mchog las 'di skad gsungs/ /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang / /tshigs bcad ched brjod de lnga ni/ /nyan thos mdo sde gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu 'byung gsum/ /nyan thos 'dul ba skyes rabs ni/ /byang sems 'dul ba shin tu rgyas/ /rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi sde/ /gnyis ni byang sems mdo sde'o/ /gtan la phab pa'i sde zhes pa/ /gnyis ka'i mngon pa'i sde snod yin/ /rang rgyal sde snod logs su med/ /nyan thos sde snod la dmigs so/ /mdo don gtan la dbab pa ni/ /ji snyed pa dang ji lta ba gnyis yod pa'i dang po/ ji snyed pa'i don phung khams dang / /skye mched rnam par bzhag pa ni/ /phal cher bye smra dang mthun la/ /thun mong ma yin 'dod pa ni/ /tshor 'du rnam shes phung rags pa ma yin zhing snga ma 'gag phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar gyi dbyings cha de'o/ po gsum/ /rnam pa rig byed ma yin gzugs/ /'dus ma byas gsum rnams la ni/ /chos kyi khams dang skye mched 'jog /tshor 'du rnam shes gsum po rags pa/ dang / /gzugs dang mtshungs ldan 'du byed rnams/ /rdzas su grub cing rigs min gzugs/ /ldan min 'du byed 'dus ma byas/ /gsum ni rdzas su ma grub bo/

/'das pa song zhing ma 'ongs pa/ /ma skyes da lta ba kho na/ /rdzas su yod par 'dod pa'o/ /rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa/ /gzugs su mi 'dod sdom sogs kyi/ /sems pa grogs dang bcas par 'dod/ /ji lta gnyis pa ji lta ba/ ba bzhin yod pa ni/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang ni/ /stong nyid bcu drug dge mi dge /lung ma bstan gsum bka' 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ zag pa dang bcas pa thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad ni bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad zhi ba'o// rtags kyi/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang rnam par thar/ /sgo gsum gtan la 'bebs pa ste/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis ni/ /bye brag smra dang sgo bstun nas/ /de las khyad par 'phags tshul bstan/ /rdul phran rnams ni don dam pa/ /des brtsams rags pa kun rdzob bo/ /rdul phran reg la ma 'byar ba/ rdul cha drug /bar med reg par 'du shes so/ /shes pa skad cig ma thams cad/ /yul gyi rnam par bcas par 'dod/ /dmigs pa'i yul ni phyi rol don/ /myong yul gsal ba shes pa yin/ /de ltar 'jog byed phyi rol don/ /dper na shes pa shel dang mtshungs/ /yul ni sna tshogs gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gzugs 'dzin snga phyi dus tha dad/ /rgyu 'bras yin cing de bzhin gyi/ /shes pa'i rnam par 'jog nus rgyu/ /de las skad cig snga ba yi/ /shes par mngon sum mi snang ba'i/ /lkog na mo zhes rang 'dzin la/ /rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed yod/ /mi ldan pa yi 'du byed rnams/ /gzugs sems sems byung gnas skabs la/ /btags pa tsam yin 'dus ma byas/ /gsum ni dngos med yin pa la/ /ming gi btags pa tsam du 'dod/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang dngos med 'dod/ /lam dang gang zag gi 'dod tshul/ /nyan rang gnyis ni bye smra dang / /phal cher 'dra la khyad par du/ /byang chub sems dpar sa bcu dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas la sku gsum mam/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das zhes te/

phung po lhag med myang 'das kyang / /sems can don rgyun mi chad pa/ /'byung zhes mdo las gsungs ltar 'dod/ /de dag ston byed mdo sde 'chad tshul/ mdo yi tshig gi bshad tshul la/ /bshad bya'i chos de'i dgos nyan papa gus pa bskyed phyir dgos don bstan pa/ bstan pa/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de thos nas/ /dgos pa phun tshogs thob phyir du/ /nyan dang 'dzin la 'bad pa dang / /chos der gus pa bskyed phyir yin/ /brjod bya gang de'i don bsdus pa/ gzhung don rags pa rtogs phyir bsdus don bshad pa/ /tshig de gsal la ma 'dres pa/ /sa mtshams ma 'phyug chod che ba/ /gsal la brjod med ngag snyoms pa/ /tshig snyoms la sogs yon tan ldan/ /de yi ldog phyogs skyon bral zhing / /bsdus don de yi gzhung gi don/ /go bar byed pa nyid yin no/ /tshig bya byed las gsum sbyar la tshig don len pa/ gi don la brten nas ni/ /don tshol phyir du thun mong du/ /grags pa'i bum pa spyi ming / lta bu'i ming / /de la bye brag tshig gser bum zhes lta bu'i/ /ming dang de'i yig 'bru'i gzhi/ /gsum dang mngon de las byung ba'i ming gi mngon brjod brjod brda' sgra ka tsan sogs kyi ris la bsgrub pa sprod kyi/ /bstan bcos sogs las 'byung ba yi/ /spros pa rnams la mkhas byas te/ /phyi nas bshad bya'i chos gang zhig /de dang de yi don la ni/ /mkhas par byed pa'i ched du'o/ /mtshams snga phyi'i 'brel pa rtogs phyir mtshams sbyar ba/ sbyor dgos pa gzhung tshig don/ /tshig don snga phyi 'di ltar du/ /'grel zhes gsal por mtshams sbyor dang / /mdo ru dril nas rgyas bshad dang / /spang gnyen rgyu 'bras phan tshun sbyor/ /de yis gzhung don rtogs sla zhing / /sgro 'dogs legs par chod par 'gyur/ /brgal rtogs dka'i gnad rnams brgal lan sgo nus bsnyad pa/ lan gzhung don slob ma yi/

/rtogs par dka' ba 'ga' zhig la/ /dogs gnas de dag 'gal mi 'gal/ /lung dang rigs pas so so yi/ /dbye ba byed cing 'gal spong dang / /gzhung don tshol zhing 'khrul ma 'khrul/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa byed pa'o/ /grub mtha'i rnam bzhag mdo tsam mo/ /tshad ma smra ba'i dpal chos kyi grags pa sogs/ mdo sde pa/ /de ni theg chen bkar bsgrub pa/ /mi dgos 'bum sogs mdo sde rnams/ /bka' ru 'dod pa yin phyir ro// ༈ /gsum pa rnal 'byor spyod pa la/ /de yi sgra don phyi rol gyi/ /snang ba thams cad sems tsam du/ /'dod cing dngos por smra ba yi/ /sems tsam pa ru grags pa ste/ /nang gses rnam bden rnam brdzun gnyis/ /'di yi grub mtha'i 'jog tshul la/ /theg chen bkar sgrub nyan thos bkag /rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa'o/ /mdo sde pa rnams kho rang gi /khas blang de las sher phyin dang / /phal chen la sogs bkar snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa/ mi 'dod/ /de ni 'thad pa ma yin ste/ /theg pa che ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /bka' min gyur na rgyal ba ma 'ongs 'jig ltar sngar lung ma bstan/ des/ /lung bstan rigs na'ang de ma gsungs/ /de bzhin theg chen sher phyin che chung theg pa ston pas lhan cig gsung pa/ sogs/ /nyan thos theg dang lhan cig tu/ /byung kyis phyis su byung ba min/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i rgyal las gzhan gyi zab rgyas 'di yul min/ skor/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos 'di dag /rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis gsung kyang bka' ru sgrub/ gzhan gyis gsung zer na/ /de yang sangs rgyas bka' ru grub/ /theg chen yod na 'di las theg chen yod na 'di las gzhan med tshul/ gzhan/ /med cing mdo sde gzhan la yang / /de dang tshul mtshungs las gzhan ci/ /zab zab rgyas theg pa med na sangs rgyas med/ mo stong pa nyid dang ni/ /rgya che byang chub spyod pa'i tshul/

/med na sangs rgyas ga la 'byung / /theg chen nyon mongs theg chen nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po gnyen por gyur/ /sna tshogs sgras sna tshogs sgras gsung rtog pa dka' gsung rtogs dka' bas/ /theg chen rgyal ba'i bka' grub bo/ /gzhi lnga las ni gzugs kyi gzhi/ /phyi don phra rab rdul mdo sde pa'i 'dod rdul drug cha reg la ma 'byar/ tsam ni/ /grub 'dod 'thad pa ma yin te/ /khyod lugs sgra med phra rab kyis/ /rdul 'di don du nus pa brgyad 'dus yin kyang 'di skabs bsags rdul lta bur bshad/ 'di yang phra rag la cha dang gong bu'i tha snyad kyis phra rab ming med 'gro ba la dgongs/ rdzas brgyad 'dod so so nas/ /grub pa med phyir de 'dus pa'i/ /rdul nyid yod pa ma yin no/ /cha med phra rab rdul yod ces/ /zer na de'ang mi 'thad de/ /dbus rdul phra rab gcig la ni/ /phra rab rdul drug gis bskor na/ /dbus mar phyogs cha drug cha drug yod pas phra rab las che bar 'gyur/ yod 'gyur/ /de la 'byar cha drug yod pa/ /yin na gcig gi go sa der/ /gzhan mi 'byung gyur gcig gi ni/ /go sa gang yin drug char gyi/ /go sa yin na gong bur gyur/ /de nyid drug 'dus pa'i gong bu rdul phrag gcig pa'i go sar tshud na chung thal/ dbang shes mi snang 'gyur/ /rdul phran cha med mi sbyor gyis/ /'dus pa phan tshun sbyor zhe na/ /'dus pa med par mi rigs te/ /'dus rgyu'i rdul phran rdul phran ni cha med yin pas mi sbyor/ de 'dus par 'dod na gong gi tshe chung skyon du thal ba'i rdul phran med pas/ cha med du/ /'dod pas sbyor ba med phyir ro/ /gzugs sogs don la yod min te/ /sems nyid 'khrul pa las byung phyir/ /gal te phyi don yod bshad pa/ /drang don dgongs pa can yin no/ /de bzhin sems rgyun mi chad par/ /dgongs nas bar srid yod par gsung /

/de yi dgongs gzhi 'di yin te/ /gzugs su snang ba rnam rig gi /gzung rung sa bon la dgongs nas/ /gzugs dang mig gi skye mched gsung / /chos kun rnam par sems tsam pa rang gi bzhed pa/ rig tsam du/ /gsungs pa'i theg chen gyi tshul ni/ /snang ba shes par 'dod pa yi/ /rnam bden pa dang snang ba ni/ /rnam par shes pa'i sgro btags su/ /'dod pa rnam brdzun gnyis su 'dod/ /mi ldan 'du byed btags tsam 'dod/ /de bzhin 'dus ma byas pa ni/ /med pa kho nar mi 'dod cing / /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang / /de la dmigs nas ngar sems pa'i/ /rnam pa can gyi nyon yid de/ /rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad 'dod/ /btsun pa yang dag ldan zhes pas/ /de yi steng du dri med pa'i/ /yid dang dgu ru 'dod par bshad/ /rnam bden pa yi tshogs drug 'dod/ /'di dag zhib tu bkral ba la/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa ni/ /'di la rnams par smin pa dang / /sa bon cha ni gnyis su phye/ /rnam smin glo bur ma yin pa/ /thog ma med nas sngon bsags pa'i/ /las kyis ched du ma dmigs kyang / /rten 'brel tsam gyi kun nyon gyi/ ma rig pa/ /chos kun skye ba'i rgyur gyur cing / /chu las rkyen ni mang nyung gi /dbang gis rba rlabs mang nyung ltar/ /bag chags sad byed rkyen la brten/ /dbang shes chos rnams 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa ni/ /'byed pa can gyi rten 'brel lo/ /sa bon zhes pa der bgos pa'i/ /kun nyon las kun bsdu ba'i gzhi/ /nus pa tsam las mngon gyur med/ /ngo bos ma sgrib lung ma bstan/ /skye ba snyoms 'jug sogs rgyu byed/ /gzhan rig tsam gyi yid mngon yin/ /dmigs pa brtan g.yo thams cad ni/ /phyogs dang ris su ma chad dmigs/ /rnam pa kun gzhi de rang gi /dmigs pa brtan g.yo thams cad la/ /dmigs nus phra zhing mi gsal ba/ /'jug pa'i tshul ni sems can gyi/ /skabs su rgyun mi chad par 'jug

/de yi 'khor ni kun 'gro lnga/ /len pa'i rnam shes zhes bya ste/ /'chi 'pho'i skabs su dge sdig gi /rnam smin len pa'i rkyen byed cing / /skye ba sogs kyi rgyu yang byed/ /yid dang 'jug pa'i shes pa rnams/ /ci rigs pa ni de las byung / /ldog tshul la sogs 'og tu shes/ /nyon mongs pa yi yid byed pa/ /rtag tu nga ru sems pa yi/ /sgrib kyi lung ma bstan pa ste/ /khams gsum la yod de'i ngo bo/ /lung du ma bstan dmigs pa ni/ /kun gzhi la dmigs rnam pa ni/ /nga'o snyam pa can yin no/ /'jug tshul so skye kun la 'jug /'khor ni kun 'gro lnga dang ni/ /tshor dang nga rgyal ma rig pa/ /lta ba dang bcas dgu yis bskor/ /ldog dus theg chen dgra bcom dang / /mthong lam thob nas nges par dag /mig gis gzugs mthong rna ba yis/ /sgra thos sna yis dri snom zhing / /lce yis ro myang lus kyi ni/ /reg bya shes pa sgo lnga yi/ /rnam par shes pa zhes su grags/ /de yang yid de las 'phros pa'i/ /'jug shes zhes pa dbang shes la/ /sgo lngar brten pa tsam zhig las/ /yid gzhan ched du ma gtad dang / /gzugs la sogs par ched gtad gnyis/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid rang yul ni/ /rang gi stobs kyis rig pa'o/ /de las 'phros rnams sems byung grags/ /lnga bcu rtsa gcig 'og tu 'byung / /'jug shes 'khor du 'byung tshul ni/ /dbang shes la gzhan 'char rang gi nus pa gnas/ yid gzhan ma gtad pa'i/ /'khor du kun 'gro lnga po 'byung / /yul gzhan la/ yid gtad 'khor du sems byung ni/ /lnga bcu rtsa gcig thams cad 'byung / /yid kyi shes pa yid 'jug yul/ /rkyen la 'jug rung nye bar gnas tsam la/ /'khor du kun 'gro lnga yid de/ /ngan song yul la rtog pa 'phro/ ba'i/ /'khor du dad sogs dge ba dang / /the tshom la sogs mi dge ba/ /nga rgyal la sogs sgrib lung ma/ /bstan dang gnyid sogs ma bsgribs pa'i/

/lung du ma bstan rnams 'byung ngo / /yid kyi dbang po la brten pa'i/ /drug pa yid kyi rnam shes ni/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa ni/ /'gag ma thag pa de la 'jog /de yang rtogs par gyur pa yi/ /yid shes yul ni sna tshogs la/ /brten pa'i nang gi rnam par rtog /rtog med shes pa'i yid shes ni/ /shes pa rtog med nang gnas so/ /de la bdag po'i rkyen zhes pa/ /sgo lngar brten nas don lnga rtogs/ /yid kyi bsgos skal yid dbang gi /bdag rkyen la gzugs dngos 'char min/ /yid yul sna tshogs 'char ba'o/ /mtshungs ldan zhes pa dper mtshon na/ /dngos po mthong rung mig shes kyi/ /sems byung de yi gzugs dngos por/ /zhib tu dpyad cing 'dzin lta bu/ /dmigs yul rnam pa rten dang dus/ /rdzas bcas lnga dang mtshungs pas so/ /'jug tshul sems las gyur pa yi/ /rang rig rang yul rang stobs kyis/ /rig pa'i gtso sems sems byung las/ /gyur pa'i rang gi rig pa ni/ /rang gi yul la rang stobs kyis/ /rtse gcig sems pa'i ting 'dzin no/ /sems las gyur pa'i gzhan rig gi /gtso sems sgo lnga yid shes bcas/ /sems byung las gyur gzhan rig ni/ /dbang po dang ni yid yul du/ /'char ba'i rnam par rtog rnams so/ /nyams myong sgo nas rtogs pa yi/ /nyams su myong ba'i rang rig ni/ /yid la rnam rtog sna tshogs pa/ /'char zhing myong ba rtog med kyi/ /shes pa'i rang rig yid la ni/ /rnam rtog ci yang ma 'char gnas/ /de yang rten gyi gang zag ni/ /so skyer de bzhin theg gsum gyi/ /'phags pa'i rjes thob rtogs pa dang / /mnyam bzhag rnam rtog med pa'o/ /'dzin stangs rtog par gyur pa yi/ /'khrul shes bzang ngan la ched du/ /rtog pa'i mdo la go bzlog gi /rtog gnyis gcig char skyes pa bslad/ /rtog pas bcing kyang don mi nus/ /ngal dub myong ba'i rnam rtog rnams/ /rtog med dbang shes 'khrul pa ni/ /zla ba gnyis snang dang skra shad/

/'dzag par snang bar lta bu'o/ /ma 'khrul dbang shes ched dmigs ltar/ /mngon sum dbang mngon gyur pa'o/ /yid shes ma 'khrul mngon sum du/ /yid yul shar ba'i yid mngon no/ /dbang shes yid shes gnyis 'dus kyis/ /tshul bzhin mthong ba mngon sum gyi/ /shes pa yin no thag khrar sbrul/ /shing ni phal par tsan+dan du/ /mthong ba log pa'i shes par grags/ /de dag rnam kyang sgo gsum gyi/ /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /sna tshogs las su 'du ba'o/ /gang ltar rig rgyu'i bzung ba'i don/ /gzhan du yod na bye smra gzhan rig 'gyur/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa yi/ /rang rig sems tsam pa/ kho nar 'dod pa'o/ /sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig ni/ /tshor dang 'du rags par ma gyur pa'i phra ba/ shes sems pa dang / /reg pa yid byed kun 'gro lnga/ /'dun mos dran pa ting 'dzin dang / /blo gros zhes bya ba yul nges lnga/ /dad dang ngo tsha shes khrel yod/ /mi chags mi sdang gti mug med/ /brtson 'grus shin sbyangs bag yod dang / /btang snyoms rnam par mi 'tshe dge /srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /'dod chags de bzhin khong khro dang / /nga rgyal ma rig lta ba dang / /the tshom yin te nye nyon ni/ /khro ba 'khon du 'dzin pa dang / /'chab dang 'tshig dang phrag dog dang / /ser sna dang ni sgyu bcas dang / /g.yo rgyu rnam 'tshe ngo tsha med/ /khrel med rmugs dang rgod pa dang / /ma dad pa dang le lo dang / /bag med pa da brjed nges dang / /rnam g.yengs shes bzhin ma yin pa/ /gnyid 'gyod rtogs dpyod gzhan 'gyur kun bsdom pas lnga bcu rtsa gcig go bzhi/ /sems tsam rang gi 'dod pa ni/ /dang po shes bya'i gnas dang ni/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum/ /gsum pa de ru 'jug pa dang / /bzhi pa de yi rgyu 'bras dang / /lnga pa de yi rab dbye dang / /drug pa bslab pa gsum dang ni/ /bdun pa de 'bras spang ba dang /

/brgyad pa ye shes theg pa mchog /de yi dang po shes bya'i gnas ni/ dang po kun kun gzhi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan/ kun gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ /de ldog dus/ /dbang phyug la sogs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bzhi las dang po/ gzhi la/ /de nyid yod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /lus len pa dang rnam smin myong / /snyoms 'jug las ldang 'chi 'pho dang / /skye ba'i skye ba la sogs mi srid pa'i skyon yod/ rgyu ru gyur pas so/ /nyan thos rnams la ma bstan te/ /shes bya phra dang zab mos bsdus/ /rgya che'i shes pa lhur mi len/ /des na lus len rgyun 'jug sogs/ /bdag dang 'khrul bar srid pa'i phyir/ /rang 'bras rnam grol gegs byed pa'i/ /phyir na mdo las ma bstan gsung / /kun gzhi de yi mtshan nyid ni/ de yi mtshan nyid/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes de nyid la/ /zag med yon tan rkyen phrad na/ /byang chub thob byed nus pa'ang yod/ /de la rnam smin sa bon gyi/ /cha gnyis yod las snga ma ni/ /glo bur ma yin thog med nas/ /gnas shing kun nyon ma rig chos kun gyi/ /bag chags sa bon 'dzin pa ste/ /kun nyon ma rig chos kun skye ba'i rgyu/ /gyur cing dbang po gzugs rnams kyi/ /rgyu yang yin la dper mtshon na/ /chu la rkyen gyi mang nyung gi /rba rlabs mang nyung 'byung ba bzhin/ /bag chags sad byed rkyen la brten/ /yid dang 'jug pa'i shes pa rnams/ /ci rigs 'byung ba'i rgyu yin la/ /chos kun bag chags la brten nas/ /byung bas 'bras bu du yang gyur/ /de la ming gi rnam grangs ni/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang / /rnam par smin pa'i rnam shes dang / /len pa'i rnam shes zhes su grags/ /ngo bo nyid gsum gnas yin pas/ /shes bya'i gnas zhes bya bar 'dogs/ /sa de la sogs pa'i gnyis pa bon kun nyon chos rnams kyi/ /bag chags nus pa tsam gyi ni/ /ngo bor gnas shing shes rig ltar/

/rdzas su grub pa ma yin no/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes de ni/ /kun 'gro lnga yi grogs dang 'grogs/ /tshor ba btang snyoms kho na'o/ /dge dang mi dge gang du'ang / /ma nges ma sgrib lung ma bstan/ /de ldog pa'i dus/ kun gzhi de ni 'khor ba'i skabs/ /rgyun mi chad 'jug ldog dus ni/ /sa bon nyan rang dgra bcom thob/ /theg chen sa brgyad thob tshe ldog /nyon mongs ma lus spongs pas so/ /rnam smin cha ni nyan rang gi /phung po lhag med rgyun chad pa'i/ /tshul gyis ldog la theg chen pas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mjug thog me long lta bu yi/ /ye shes nyid du gnas gyur pa'i/ /tshul kyis ldog pa zhes bshad do/ /dbang phyug sogs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ de ni dbang phyug la sogs dang / /mi 'dra ba yi khyad par ni/ /phyi rol pas ni ltos med du/ /rang grub dbang phyug la sogs kyis/ /blos byas rtag pa rang dbang can/ /'dod cing 'di ni de min te/ /kun gzhi sems can re re bzhin/ /yod cing rten cing 'brel 'byung bar/ /skad cig ma yi rang bzhin stong / /rkyen gyis yongs su bsgyur ba las/ /rtag par rang dbang can min no/ /de la gnyis mtshan nyid gsum ni pa mtshan nyid ni/ /gzhan dbang kun brtags yongs grub gsum/ /gzhan dbang kun gzhi'i rnam shes las byung ba'i/ /bag chags phung khams skye mched sogs/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par snang rnams so/ /dper na stag tshang lo tsā bas bzhed/ sgyu ma mkhan zhig gis/ /shing dum lta bur mig 'phrul gyi/ /sngags kyis glang por bsgyur ltar ro/ /kun brtags zhes ni rnam rig gi kun brtags/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i yul de dag /bdag gir bzung dang 'di zhes pa'i/ /sna tshogs ming gi sgro btags pa/ /dper na sgyu mas shing dum la/ /glang por bsgyur de glang po che/ /nges par yin snang byas ltar ro/ /yongs grub yongs grub de bzhin nyid dang ni/
