/rnam par mi rtog ye shes te/ /tha mal pa yi bdag 'dzin dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'o/ /dper na sgyu ma'i glang po de/ /'khrul ngor snang ba rgyu rkyen las/ /skyes kyang rig pas dpyad pa'i tshe/ /sgyu ma mkhan dang rigs sngags dang / /rdzas gsum so sor dbye ba'i tshe/ /glang por grub pa med pa yi/ /rgyu mtshan rtog pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar yin na sems rnam rig la/ /gzung 'dzin snang ba ci yi phyir/ /zhe na 'di la sems tsam pas/ /grub mtha' tha dad mang smra ste/ /sems tsam rnam bden pa slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang / /bram ze bde byed dga' sogs pas/ /bstan bcos dmigs pa brtag pa las/ /nang gi rnam rig shes bya'i ngo bo ni/ /phyi rol ltar snang gang yin de/ /don yin rnam shes ngo bo'i phyir/ /gsung ltar phyi rol gyi yul la/ /ltos pa'i gzung snang ba bya bden pa med/ /nang gi shes pa la ltos pa'i/ /gzung byed de tsam du sems yin bden grub 'dod/ /de ltar rnam bden pa la'ang gsum/ /gzung 'dzin sgo nga phyed tshal dang / /sna tshogs gnyis med pa zhes dang / /gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa gsum 'dod/ /dang pos gzung 'dzin sgo nga phyed tshal phyi rol yul la ni/ /ltos pa'i gzugs rnams bden ma grub/ /nang gi shes pa la ltos pa'i/ /gzung rnam bden par grub ces 'dod/ /kha cig yul ni bzung ba'i char/ /snang ba de ni rnam rig phyed/ /yin cing yul can 'dzin cha rung / /snang ba de yang rnam rig gi /phyed de sgo nga bkas lta bu/ /gnyis pa sna tshogs gnyis med sna tshogs gnyis med pa/ /rnam pa du mar snang nyid kyang / /rnam sems rig du ma nyid yin phyir/ /'dzin byed rnam rig du ma nyid/ /skad cig shes pa sna tshogs la/ /'jug pas sna tshogs gnyis med 'dod/ /gsum pa gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pas/ /yul ni rnam pa drug yin la/

/yul can rnam shes tshogs drug gi /rnam par rig pas gzung 'dzin gnyis/ /grangs mnyam nyid du 'dod pa'o/ /'phags pa thogs med chos mchog sogs/ sems tsam rnam brdzun pa/ /snang ba shes par sgro btags pa/ /rnam pa brdzun ma yin pa ste/ /snang ba rab rib can dag la/ /skra shad 'char ba ji bzhin 'dod/ /de la dri bcas dri med gnyis/ /slob dpon dul ba'i lha sogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas la'ang gnyis snang gi /dri ma yod par 'dod pa dang / /'phags pa thogs med chos mchog la sogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas pa la gnyis snang gi /dri ma med par bzhed pa'o/ /mdor na sems tsam pa gnyis kas/ /phyi don bden pa med pa dang / /shes pa rang rig rang gsal bas/ /myong ba'i gnyis gzung 'dzin gzhan dbang med shes pa de/ /dam pa'i don du yod par mthun/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen zhabs dang ni/ /slob dpon chos kyis grags pa yi/ /gnyis ka'i phyogs su bzhed pa'o/ /ming gi don la gzhan dbang zhes/ /rang gi bag chags sa bon las/ /skyes shing skye nas skad cig kyang / /mi sdod phyi ma re bskyed pa/ /sems kyi gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa yi/ /dbang du song bas gzhan dbang grags/ /de ni ma dag gzhan dbang ngo / /dag pa'i gzhan dbang zhes pa ni/ /'phags pa dag gi rjes thob la/ /dag pa 'jig rten ye shes te/ /bag chags stobs kyi gnyis snang gi /tshul tsam skye ba la 'dogs so/ /kun brtags kun brtags gzhan dbang de nyid la/ /med bzhin bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin/ /gang zag chos kyi tha snyad kyi/ /byis pa'i blo yis kun brtags kyi/ /sna tshogs ming du btags pa'o/ /yongs grub shes pa rang rig cing / /rang gsal de la don gyis na/ /rnam pa la sogs gang du yang / /grub pa med cing de nyid ni/ /rtag pa 'gyur ba med cing rnam par dag /dge ba rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /lam gyi bden pa yongs grub grags/ /nang gses dbye ba gzhan dbang la/

/dag dang ma dag gong bshad ltar/ /kun brtags la nang gses dbye ba/ kun brtags gnyis su dbye ba ni/ /gnyis su dbye ba'i dang po kun tu rtogs pa/ dang po kun tu rtog pa ni/ /dper na mig la sogs pa la/ /dbang po zar ma'i 'bras lta bu'i/ /byed las dngos po mthong ba sogs/ /rgyu mtshan kun tu rtog pa'o/ /gnyis gnyis pa khyad par rtogs pa pa khyad par rtog pa ni/ /de dag mi rtag pa yi ni/ /rang bzhin nyid du shes pa'o/ /lnga ru dbye na lnga ru dbye ba'i dang po ming la brten nas don rtog pa ming la brten/ /don rtog bum pa zhes pa yi/ /ming thos nas ni bum pa ni/ /lto ldir zhabs zhum yin snyam ltar/ /gnyis pa don la ming du rtog pa/ don la ming du rtog pa ni/ /lto ldir zhabs zhum zhes brjod pas/ /bum pa yin par shes ltar ro/ /gsum pa ming la ming du rtog pa/ ming la ming du rtog pa ni/ /na ra gi ri'i gling pa yis/ /ba lang zhes bya'i sgra thos pas/ /don ma rtogs kyang ba lang gi /ming gis yod par shes lta bu'o/ /don la bzhi pa don la don du rtog pa don du rtog pa ni/ /ba lang zhes bya nog lkog shal/ /can mthong ming don brda' 'phrod do/ /ming don 'brel par shes pa ni/ /ba lang dngos mthong ming mtshan nyid/ /gnyis kar kun tu rtog pa'o/ /yongs grub la'ang rnam pa gnyis/ /yongs grub gnyis su dbye ba'i dang po/ 'gyur med yongs su grub pa zhes/ /rtogs bya de bzhin nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa phyin ci ma log yongs grub ni/ /de nyid rtog pa'i thabs lam bzhi/ /bzhi ru dbye na bzhi ru dbye ba'i dang po ma dag pa'i/ /gnas skabs yi ni chos de'i dbyings cha/ nyid dang / /gnyis pa shin tu rnam dag bsgom pa'i ting 'dzin chos nyid dang / /gsum pa mya ngan las ni 'das pa gsum/ /de gsum 'gyur med yongs grub bo/

/bzhi pa bzhi pa lam gyi bden pa ste/ /phyin ci ma log yongs grub bo/ /dpe ni gzhan dbang rmi lam mtshungs/ /kun btags de la bden 'dzin dang / /yongs grub de nyid bden med rtogs/ /gsum pa de de la 'jug pa ni la 'jug pa ni/ /theg pa chen po'i rigs gyur pa/ /gzhan don tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / /smon lam btab pa'i gang zag go /sangs rgya go 'phang don gnyer dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i lam bsgrub par/ /ma zhum snying ma zhum spang ba zhi lhag gsum gyis 'jug zhes pa'i dang po ma zhum pa stobs ldan pa'o/ /rang don yid byed nyan rang dang / /theg chen chos la som nyi dang / /chos la phyogs 'dzin rnam rtog la/ /mngon zhen gnyis pa spangs pa spangs pa'i gang zag go /de yi zhi lhag gsum pa zhi lhag bsgom tshul ni/ /sems gnas ting nge 'dzin dang ni/ /shes rab bskyed thabs zhi gnas dang / /lhag mthong la gus 'jug pa'o/ /gang la 'jug na mtshan nyid gsum/ /dang po kun tu brtags pa la/ /thos pa'i sgo nas ming don ngo bo khyad par btsal bas de dag ma dmigs par don kun brjod pa tsam du rig chos thams cad rnam rig tsam du shes/ de ldog nas chos dbyings thob tshul rnams rim par ston pa thos pa'i sgo nas gzugs nas brtsams/ /rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos rnams kyi/ /ming btsal de la brten nas ni/ /dngos po don tshol de yi ni/ /ngo bo nyid btsal bye brag brtags/ /khyad par btsal ba'i sgo nas ni/ /de dag mi dmigs par shes shing / /thams cad yid kyis yid kyis legs par dpyad par 'jug 'dra brjod pa yi/ /mtshan nyid du ni brtags par rtogs/ /gzhan dbang chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rnam par rig pa tsam du shes/ /yongs grub rnam par rig tsam gyi/ /'du shes kyang ni ldog pa'o/ /dus sam gnas skabs la 'jug don/ /byang sems 'jug pa'i gnas skabs lam lnga ston pa lam lnga las ni tshogs sbyor gnyis/

/tshogs lam mtshan nyid spang rtog yon tan dang / rnam dbye byed las nges tshig dngos/ zhes pa'i dang po mtshan nyid mtshan nyid mtshan med don/ /rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i/ /sgo nas rnam mkhyen bsgrub pa yi/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems/ /dang po'i las can mngon rtogs so/ /spang bya shin tu rags pa yi/ gnyis pa spang rtogs mdor dril rtsa nyon lnga ni/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig the tshom/ lta ba lnga ni/ 'jigs lta/ mthar lta/ lta ba/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ log lta dang lnga/ /'khor ba'i sdu bsngal bskyed byed rnams/ /rnam par sun 'byin gnyen pos sbyangs/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med tsam/ /thos bsam bsdom pa'i shes rab kyis/ /don spyi'i tshul du rtog pa yi/ /tshogs lam khyad par can yin cing / /bdag med ma gtogs tshogs lam ni/ /tshogs lam phal par chos shes bzhed/ /yon tan sangs rgyas las chos nyid/ /gzhung don 'dzin par nus sogs so/ /ngo bo bzhi pa rnam dbye tshogs lam che 'bring chung / /rnam grangs dang po'i las can pa/ /dad pa'i sa dang thar cha mthun/ /dang por go cha bgos pa/ de nas g.yul du 'jug pa/ de nas dpung gi tshogs ma lus par bsog pa/ de nas pha rol po dang g.yul bskrad de/ de las rgyal ba dang bzhi yod pa ltar/ 'dir yang spangs bya gnyis po de spong ba'i ched du/ bsam pas go bgos pa ni go sgrub/ sbyor bas tshul bzhin du zhugs pa ni 'jug sgrub/ gnyen po'i dpung tshogs bsog ste spang bya dang g.yul bskrad pa ni tshogs sgrub/ mi mthun phyogs las nges par 'byung ba thob pa nges 'byung sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir go cha sgrub pa la sogs so/ /yon tan sgo nas sangs rgyas sogs/ /yul lngar mkhas pa'i tshogs lam mchog /mi mkhas tshogs lam phal pa'o/ /mchog ni sangs rgyas mchog gsum la/ sangs rgyas sogs yul lnga la mkhas pa ni sangs rgyas sogs dang ba'i yul byed par mkhas pa/

/dwang ba'i yul byed phar phyin drug sbyin sogs phar phyin drug nyams len mkhas pa/ /nyams len bsam pa phun sum tshogs/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa mi brjed par mkhas pa/ /brjed pa med cing ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa la mkhas pa/ /'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog par/ /chos thams cad mi dmigs par shes par mkhas pa chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du/ /mi dmigs par shes mkhas pa'o/ /byed las lnga pa byed las yongs su rgyud smin cing / /sbyor lam 'dren par byed pa'o/ /drug pa nges tshig nges tshig rgyud la yon tan gyi/ /tshogs kyi gang zhing thar pa'i lam/ /yin pas tshogs lam zhes bya'o/ /dngos ni dang po'i las can rnams/ /thar pa cha mthun dge rtsa ni/ /rgyud la yon tan tshogs gang zhing / /rnam grol 'jug ngogs gyur pa ste/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag la gnas/ /mig gis gzugs rnams mthong ba rnams/ /mtshan ma mngon rtag tu mi 'dzin/ /dbang po rnam par bsdam pa dang / /kha zas sman dang 'dra bar rig /zas kyi tshod rig nam gyi char/ /mi nyal rnal 'byor la brtson dang / /bsam pa shes bzhin gnas pa la/ /rtag tu mngon par dga' ba ste/ /thar pa yi ni rgyur gyur pa'i/ /chos lnga po la slob pa dang / /de bzhin dad dang tshul khrims dang / /sbyin pa btang dang thos pa dang / /khrel yod pa dang ngo tsha shes/ /shes rab phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun rgyud la 'byor/ /rtag tu rgyud la nyes skyon gyis/ /gos min brtags shing nongs na bshags/ /'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /thub pa dgongs gsal las byung ba'i/ /spyod yul lam khyer dag la slob/ /yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang / nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ bsod nams phung po gzhal du med de bzhin chos spyod bcu po bsgrub/

/mdor na 'phags pa'i lam gyi rgyur/ /gyur pa'i dge tshogs sgrub pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang mkhas pa yi/ /bstan bcos rnams la thos pa dang / /de don rig pa'i bsam pa dang / /de dag mi 'gal bsgom pa las/ /byung ba'i shes rab gsum la slob/ /'khol ba'i sdug bsngal spangs nas ni/ /thar pa'i bde ba 'dod pa yi/ /dang po'i las can rnams kyis ni/ /bslab pa'i lam mchog 'di dag go /tshogs lam chung ngu'i gnas skabs su/ /lus dang tshor ba sems pa chos/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag bzhi'i bsgom/ /de la rtse gcig 'jog pa ni/ /zhi gnas yin cing der de la phyi nang gi lus kyi mtshan nyid sogs de dag gi don la zhib tu dpyad pa/ dran pa'i/ /shes rab nyid ni lhag mthong ngo / /'bring po'i skabs su mi dge ba'i/ /chos ma skyes pa mi skyed dang / /skyes pa rnams spangs dge ba'i chos/ /ma skyes skyed cing skyes pa rnams/ /gnad dang 'phel ba'i thabs la 'bad/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi'i bsgom mo/ /tshogs lam chen po'i gnas skabs su/ /dge la 'dun dang de don sems/ /brtson 'grus rtsom dang der spyod pa'i/ /ting 'dzin nyon mongs spong ba yi/ /'du byed dang ldan rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /rkang pa bzhi yis bsgom pa'o/ /sbyor lam la'ang de bzhin dang / /de yi mtshan nyid sbyor lam gyi dang po mtshan nyid tshogs kyi lam/ /rdzogs pa'i rjes su mthong lam dang / /sbyor bar byed pa'i mngon rtogs so/ /de yi spang bya gnyis pa spang rtog nyon mongs gong 'dra dang / /shes bya'i sgrib pa kun brtags rnams/ /rnam par gnon pa'i tshul gyis spong / /bden pa nang gses dbye ba bcu drug po rnams las chos kyi bdag /phyed cha phyi bzung ba'i rtog pa ni/ /rang bzhin med par rtog pa'o/ /gsum pa yon tan yon tan sbyor lam rtse mo zhes/ /thob nas dge rtsa rgyun mi chad/ /bzod pa thob nas ngan song du/

/gtan nas mi skye'i gdeng thob bo/ /byang sems dbang po rnon po yis/ /gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las/ /phyir mi ldog ste gzugs la sogs/ /bden zhen mngon gyur pa zhi nas/ /gos sogs la ni sro shig bral/ /gtsang sbra kun spyod sogs rtags thob/ /bzhi pa rnam dbye rnam par dbye la ngo bo yi/ /sgo nas phyi gzung ba rang bzhin med/ /sems kyi gsal snang thob pa'i tshe/ /drod dang de la gsal ba'i snang / /snga ma las gsal snang cung che mched pa'i tshe na rtse mo'o/ /phyi don med par nges shes thob/ /de kho na yi don gyi phyogs/ kun la/ /gcig la zhugs tshe bzod pa dang / /rnam rig 'du shes 'jigs pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin ni chos mchog go /lnga pa byed las rnam grangs nges 'byed cha mthun dang / /sbyor ba 'jug sgrub de las mthong lam 'dren/ /thar pa thob par byed sogs so/ /nges tshig drug pa nges tshig mthong ba'i lam la ni/ /dngos su sbyor bar byed pa'o/ /ngo bo bdun pa dngos gong du bshad pa yi/ /yon tan rnams dang khyad par du/ /bden pa bcu drug rnams la goms pa ni/ /snang ba thob pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /de rtogs shes rab dang mtshungs ldan/ /sbyor lam drod bcas te dro bar gyur pa ni/ /snang ba mched pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /de nyid shes rab dang mtshungs ldan/ /bcas pa de ni rtse mo rtse mo'o/ /de bzhin bden pa bcu drug rnams la ni/ /phyogs gcig lhan gcig zhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /shes rab mtshungs ldan bden rjes mthun/ /bzod bzod pa yin cing de bzhin du/ /bden rnams bcu drug de ma thag pa yi/ /ting 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan pa/ /'jig rten pa yi chos mchog go chos mchog /de dag la'ang chung 'bring che'i/ /rnam pas gsum gsum du 'gyur ro/ /sbyor lam drod rtse'i gnas skabs su/

/dad dwangs 'dod yid ches dang brtson 'grus bden bzhi'i don rnams la dran pa dang / /ting 'dzin shes rab dbang po lngas/ /gtso cher bsgom zhing bzod chos gnyis/ /skabs su dad gong ma stobs su gyur pa'o dang brtson 'grus dang / /dran dang ting 'dzin shes rab stobs/ /lnga yis gtso cher bsgom pa'o/ /mthong ba'i lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mthong lam gyi dang po mtshan nyid/ /sbyor lam mthar phyin bsgom pa'i lam/ /ma skyes gong gi mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa spang rtogs spangs rtogs mthong spangs lta min nyon mongs lnga dang lta ba lnga/ khams gong mar khong khro med sa bon bcas/ /rtsad nus spangs shing chos nyid ni/ /ji lta ba'i don mngon sum rtogs/ /chos can ji snyed pa'i don yang / /ji ltar rigs par rtogs pa'o/ /de yi theg chen mthong spangs ni/ /gzung rtog dang ni 'dzin rtog gnyis/ /gzung rtog gzhi rten can zhes ni/ /rang gi dbang po'i spyod yul dang / /dor lta ba lta min bya gzung ba la dmigs nas/ /dor byar mngon par zhen pa de/ /theg pa chen po'i mthong spang ngo / /gnyen po gang de'i rten can gzung rtog ni/ /rang yul blang ba'i gzung ba la/ /dmigs nas blang byar mngon par zhen/ /theg chen skabs kyi mthong spang ngo / /'dzin par rdzas 'dzin rtog pa ni/ /lta min lnga ni 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig nyon sgrib chos dang gang zag gi /rdzas yod la dmigs 'dzin pa yis/ /bden zhen theg chen mthong spang yin/ /btags 'dzin rang yul chos gang zag /btags lta ba lnga ste/ 'jigs lta mthar lta/ lta ba/ tshul khrims/ brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ log lta dang lnga/ yod la dmigs 'dzin pa po/ /btags pa tsam du mngon zhen pa/ /theg chen skabs kyi mthong spang yin/ /'di dag yid mngon gtso cher 'dra/ /gsum pa yon tan yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis rjes thob tu/

thob/ /bzhi pa rnam dbye nyan rang theg chen rnam gsum la/ /mthong lam gsum gyur ngo bo yi/ /bden pa bzhi por chos bzod dang / /chos shes rjes bzod rjes shes te/ /bzhi bzhir phye bas bcu drug go /lnga pa byed las byed las sgom lam 'dren byed dang / /'phags pa thob pa la sogs so/ /nges tshig drug pa nges tshig chos nyid sngar ma mthong / /gsar mthong byed pas mthong lam mo/ /ngo bo bdun pa dngos sbyor lam chos mchog gi /mjug tu 'phags pa'i bden rnams la/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa mi dmigs pa'i/ /ting 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan bcas/ /chos nyid mngon sum gsar mthong zhing / /gtan bde rnam par grol ba yi/ /ma nor lam bzang nyid gyur to/ /de ltar bden bzhi la dmigs nas/ /mthong ba'i lam gyi spang bya'i sgrib/ /spang ba'i sdug bsngal chos bzod nas/ /lam gyi rjes bzod bar bco lnga/ /mthong lam yin cing lam rjes shes/ /bden don gsar mthong med mod kyang / /bsgom pa'i lam du 'dod dgos so/ /de dang lhan cig sa dang po/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis thob/ /de dag skabs su dran pa dang / bden bzhi'i don rnams/ /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa dang / /brtson 'grus dga' ba shin tu sbyang / /ting 'dzin btang snyoms yang dag pa/ /byang chub yan lag bdun nyid bsgom/ /zag bcas bsgom lam zhes pa ni/ /lam lnga'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i/ /bsgom lam min kyang spyir btang gi /bsgom lam 'dogs te so skye yi/ /rgyud kyi bsgom lam yin phyir ro/ /zag med bsgom lam mtshan nyid ni/ bsgom lam gyi dang po mtshan nyid/ /mthong lam legs par rtogs nas ni/ /mi slob lam ma skyes pa yi/ /gong gi mngon rtogs spang rtogs ni/ gnyis pa spangs rtogs/ /mthong spangs nyon mongs pa thams cad/ /slar mi skye bar zad par spangs/ /rang gi ngo skal spang bya ni/ /spang byar rags pa nyon sgrib phra ba shes sgrib shes sgrib gtso cher spangs pa dang /

/chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa yi/ /mthong ba'i lam dang rjes mthun no/ mthong zin rgyun ldan du gom pa/ gsum pa yon tan yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis ni/ /ting 'dzin brgya thob der snyoms 'jug /sangs rgyas brgya mthong de'i byin rlabs/ /zhing khams brgyar 'gro 'jig rten khams/ /brgya ni bskul dang snang bar byed/ /smin par byed cing bskal pa brgyar/ /gnas shing sngon dang phyi mthar 'jug /chos brgya 'byed cing lus brgya ston/ /lus rer byang sems brgya phrag res/ /'khor gyis kun nas yongs su bskor/ /'gyur du brtsis pa'i sa bcu yi/ /yon tan khyad par mang du thob/ /bzhi pa rnam dbye ngo bo'i sgo nas mnyam rjes sam/ /'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams gsum pa dgu re re la/ /bsgoms spang shes sgrib chen po yi/ /chen po nas ni chung ngu yi/ /chung ngu'i bar gyi dgu po la/ /'dod pa sa gcig gzugs khams la/ /bsam gtan sa bzhi gzugs med khams/ /sa ni bzhi ste dgu po yi/ /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig 'jig lta mthar lta/ khams gong ma la lnga bsgom spangs chen po dgu'i gnyen po/ /gcig char bskyed nas sa bcu pa/ /bar chad kun las grol ba yi/ /lam des sa dgu'i bsgom spongs ni/ /chung ngu'i chung ngu dgu po yi/ /gnyen po gcig char nyid du bskyed/ /'dir brten bsgom pa'i spang bya ni/ /dgu dgu brgyad bcu gya gcig yod/ /spong gnyen dbye bas grangs der 'gyur/ /lnga pa byed las byed las rang gi yon tan tshogs/ /yongs su rdzogs par thob pa dang / /gzhan dag sems can 'khor du bsdus/ /de rnams smin cing rnam par grol/ /grol rnams mthar phyin lam la 'god/ /drug pa nges tshig nges tshig chos nyid mthong zin de/ /goms par byed pa'i lam yin no/ /ngo bo/ bcu drug bdun pa dngos ni/ bden bzhi'i chos nyid mthong zin bstan/

/rnam grol lam gyi 'jug ngogs gyur/ /de ltar sngar bshad pa dgu po/ /zag pa med pa'i lam du gyur/ /gnyen po chung rim nus skye zhing / /spang bya che rim nus 'gag pa/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yi/ /legs bshad rmad du byung ba'o/ /khyad par du'ang byang sems rnams/ /dang po'i sa yi mthong ba'i lam/ /rdzogs pa'i lhag ma nas brtsams te/ sa bcu'i bar la tshogs gnyis kyi/ /khyad par rim gyis 'phel ba'o/ /de dag skabs su yang dag pa'i/ /bden bzhi mngon sum du shes pa'i lta ba/ kun nas slong ba'i rtog pa/ bden par smra ba'i ngag mi dge spong ba'i las mtha' log 'tsho spong ba'i 'tsho ba/ dge la spro ba'i rtsol ba/ ma brjed pa'i dran pa/ rtse gcig pa'i ting 'dzin rnams so lta ba rtogs pa ngag dang ni/ /las kyi mtha' dang 'tsho ba dang / /rtsol ba dran pa ting nge 'dzin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyis bsgoms/ /mtha' phyin lam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mthar phyin lam gyi dang po mtshan nyid/ /mya ngan kun las 'das pa yi/ /gtan bde'i go 'phang mthar phyin de/ /mthar thug phul 'byung 'bras bu yi/ /mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa spang rtogs spang rtogs thar pa'i gegs gyur pa/ /ma lus spangs shing chos can gyi/ /ji lta ba ni mngon sum/ ji snyed pa de 'dra ba'i rigs la 'jug ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / /chos nyid ji ltar bzhin rtogs pa'i/ /spang rtogs mtha' ru phyin pa'o/ /gsum pa yon tan yon tan dgra bcom zag pa zad/ nyon mongs zad pa/ /zhes sogs rnams dang khyad par du/ /theg pa chen po'i mthar phyin lam/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs la sogs pa/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /bzhi pa rnam dbye rnam dbye mi slob pa'i mthar thug chos rnams/ /sgrib pa spong ba'i sa la dgongs/ /lnga pa byed las byed las rnam grol nyams su myong / /rgya che'i phrin las spro ba'o/

/drug pa nges tshig nges tshig bslab pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /sar bsgrod mthar phyin lam zhes so/ /ngo bo rdo rje lta bu yi/ /bdun pa dngos ni/ ting 'dzin la brten gnas ngan len/ /thams cad spangs shing gnas ma lus/ /yongs su gyur pas zad pa dang / spang bya thams cad zad mi skye ba ste nyan rang gi skabs slar gtan nas mi skye/ byang chub sems dpa'i skabs ye shes thob pa'o/ /mi skye shes pa'i ye shes ni/ /mthar thug thob ste nyan rang gi /sangs rgyas mtshan nyid sa thob par/ /theg chen lam la ltos dgos phyir/ /lam ni mtshan nyid pa yin cing / /'bras bu btags pa tsam du bzhed/ /theg pa che rnams spangs rtogs ni/ /mthar phyin phyir na lam btags pa/ /'bras bu mtshan nyid pa yin la/ /mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa yi/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid thob/ /de ltar lam lngar tshogs sbyor la/ tshogs sbyor la gtso cher ming la 'jug /ming dang mthong ba'i lam du don/ mthong lam du don la 'jug /bsgom lam de nyid goms pa dang / /mthar phyin don de mthar phyin par/ /grub pa rnams la gtso bor 'jug /bzhi pa de yi de yi rgyu 'bras rgyu 'bras ni/ /dge ba yi ni mi mthun phyogs/ /drug gi gnyen por pha rol phyin/ /phyin pa drug las 'di lta ste/ /'khor ba las mi thar ba'i rgyu/ /longs spyod khyim la chags pa yi/ /gnyen por sbyin pa tshul khrims gnyis/ /de las ldog rgyu gzhan gyis ni/ /gnod pas sun dang dge la yun/ /dka' spyad la skyo'i gnyen po ni/ /bzod pa dang ni brtson 'grus so/ /de yang chud mi za ba'i rgyu/ /rnam par g.yengs dang gti mug gi /gnyen por bsam gtan dang shes rab/ /de dag snga ma snga ma la/ /brten nas phyi ma rnams 'byung zhing / /spang bya snga rags phyi ma phra/ /gnyen po rim bzhin mchog tu gyur/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos nor gzhan la phan pas ster/ tshul khrims gzhan gyi don du ni/

/rang gis kha na ma tho spangs/ /bzod pa gzhan gyis gnod byed par/ /sems mi 'khrugs shing brtson 'grus ni/ /gzhan don dge la spro ba'o/ /bsam gtan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /don du mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /shes rab shes bya'i gnas lugs ni/ gnas lugs don dam rtogs/ /ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'o/ /de dag spyi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /dam pa dag dang ldan pa ste/ /byang chub sems la brten pa rten/ /dngos po mtha' dag rab 'jug dngos/ /sems can phan bde'i ched bya ba/ /'khor gsum mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /zin pa thabs dang byang chub rgyur/ /yongs su bsngo dang sgrib pa gnyis/ /byang byed rnam par dag pa drug /de rnams bsgom pa mdor bsdus na/ /tshe rabs rtag tu rang gzhan gnyis/ /sbyin sogs la 'jug kun sbyor dang / /dad 'dod gnyis kyis sbyin sogs la/ /don gnyer skyes pa mos pa dang / /dge ba'i ro myang rjes yi rang / /mngon par dga' ba yid byed dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /zin pa thabs la mkhas pa dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phar phyin drug /yongs su rdzogs nas thugs bskyed kyis/ /rtsol mi dgos par gdul bya yi/ /skal ba bzhin du phyin drug gi /gzhan don nan du mdzad pa ltar/ /bya ba grub pa bsgom pa lnga/ /phar phyin drug las nang gses la/ /sbyin par zang zing mi 'jigs chos/ /tshul khrims nyes sdom dge ba sdud/ /gzhan don byed gsum bzod pa la/ /gnod par ji mi snyam pa dang / /sdug bsngal dang len chos la ni/ /nges par sems te zab rgyas kyi/ /chos la mi skrag pa gsum dang / /brtson 'grus dge ba'i chos la brtson/ /go cha lta bur sbyor ba'i dus/ /dge chos la brtson spro ba yi/ /spro ba mi nyams gnod mi 'khrug /byang chub la ni reg kyi bar/ /bar ma do ru mi btang bar/ /mi zhum mi 'khrugs chog mi 'dzin/ /gsum dang bsam gtan mthong chos kyi/ /bder gnas mngon shes sogs yon tan/

/khyad par can ni mngon par sgrub/ /sems can don sgrub la gnas dang / /mngon par sgrub dang bya ba bsgrub/ /gsum dang shes rab la kun rdzob/ /shes pa sbyor ba dngos gzhi ni/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i rjes su/ /thob pa'i shes rab dang bcas gsum/ /de dag go rim longs spyod la/ /sbyin pa ma chags btang dang nyon mongs pa'i/ /tshul khrims sdug bsngal med dang sdug bsngal la/ /bzod pa sems 'khrug med cing le lo med/ brtson 'grus/ /dge ba'i las la sbyor ba dang / /bsam gtan yengs pa med par rtse gcig gnas/ /shes rab chos rnams rab tu 'byed pa'o/ /pha rol phyin drug chos thams cad/ /dge ba'i mtshan nyid de dang mthun/ /de yi 'bras bu'i bsdus phyir ro/ /gnas skabs 'bras bu 'phags pa mchog /klu sgrub zhabs kyis nyan thos la/ /sa brgyad theg pa chen po yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa bcur gsungs/ /theg chung lam gyi sgrub pa'i sa/ /brgyad ni dkar po rnam mthong ba'i/ /sa ni nyan thos kyi tshogs lam/ /gcig tu dkar ba thar pa yin/ /de mthong dge ba yin pas so/ /brgyad pa'i sa ni nyan thos kyi/ /dgra bcom sa nas brgyad pa yin/ rgyun zhugs/ /mthong ba'i sa ni de'i 'bras gnas/ /bden bzhi mngon sum mthong ba'o/ /bsrabs pa'i sa ni lan cig phyir/ /'ong ba'i 'bras gnas 'dod nyon mongs/ /phal cher spongs pa 'dod chags dang / /bral ba'i sa ni phyir mi 'ong / /'bras gnas 'dod chags bral de'o/ /byas pa rtogs pa'i sar grags pa/ /dgra bcom bden bzhi mngon gyur ro/ /nyan thos sa zhes lan cig phyir/ /'ong dang mi 'ong dgra bcom pa/ /'bras bu zhugs pa gsum la grags/ /rang rgyal sa ni sngar bshad pa'i/ /byang phyogs sum cu rtsa bdun dag /rang nyid gcig pu sangs rgyas pa/ /'dod pa'i sems bskyed bskal chen brgyar/ /goms byas skye ba'i tha ma la/ /sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jigs rten du/

/slob dpon gzhan la ma ltos par/ /rang nyid gcig pu byang chub ni/ /thob gyur bse ru ltar grags pa/ /yon tan phrin las khyad par 'phags/ /tshogs spyod zhes pa mang po dang / /lhan cig zhugs pa gnyis su yod/ /de dag la yang dang po gnyis/ /'jig rten pa dang lhag ma drug /'jig rten 'das pa'i sa ru bshad/ /'dir bstan sa rnams byang sems kyi/ /rgyud la yod pa'i theg dman gyis/ /rtog rig yin zhes thams cad mkhyen/ /bsod nams seng ge'i dgongs pa'o/ /de rab dbye ba lnga pa de rab dbye ba ni/ /theg pa chen po'i 'bras bu ni/ /sa bcu'i dbye ba 'di dag la/ /shes bya chos dbyings sa bcu la/ /sgrib byed ma rig sa bcu yod/ /de yi gnyen por byang sems la/ /sa bcur bzhag cing rjes thob tu/ /chos dbyings kun du 'gro la sogs/ /nges pa 'dren phyir mnyam bzhag tu/ /dbyings bcu bsgom pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'jug ste dang po'i sa yis ni/ /rjes thob chos dbyings stong pa che/ /dbyings la rim gyis 'jug pa kun 'gro'i tshul du rtogs pa yis/ /de don mnyam par bzhag cing dbyings/ /bsgom mo de bzhin du rim bzhin/ /gnyis pa chos kyi dbyings kyi mchog /rang bzhin 'od gsal don du rtogs/ /gsum pa chos dbyings rtogs pa yi/ /rgyu mthun gsung rab la thos pa/ /don du gnyer bya'i mchog can rtogs/ /bzhi pa chos kyi dbyings la ni/ /bdag dang bdag gir ba la sogs/ /gang yang 'dzin med don du rtogs/ /lnga pa bdag dang gzhan rgyud kyi/ /chos dbyings tha dad med don rtogs/ /drug pa sems kyi rang bzhin du/ /gyur pa'i kun nas nyon mongs dang / /de nyid spangs pa'i rnam par dag /yod pa ma yin don du rtogs/ /bdun pa chos dbyings la mtshan ma/ /sna tshogs tha dad med don rtogs/ /brgyad pa chos dbyings rang bzhin gyi/ /dag pas mtshan ma dang bral ba/ /bri ba med cing mtshan ma ni/ /'phel ba med pa'i don du rtogs/

/brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa rnams/ /dbyings la dbang ba'i rnam pa bzhi'i/ /gnas su rtogs te brgyad pa ni/ /lhun gyis grub par mtshan bral dbyings/ /mi rtog ye shes la dbang gnas/ /ji ltar bzhed bzhin sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing 'khor ston pa'i mthu brnyes pas/ /dbyings zhing dag par dbang ba'i gnas pa rtogs/ /dgu pa chos don tshig spongs par/ /yang dag rig bzhir dbang thob dbyings/ /ye shes dbang ba'i gnas su rtogs/ /bcu pa bzhed bzhin sprul tshogs kyi/ /sems can dag gi don mdzad dbyings/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las la/ /dbang ba'i gnas su rtogs pa'o/ /de ltar shes bya'i dbyings rnam bcur/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams nyan thos kyi/ /spang bya nyon mongs can min yang / /byang chub sems dpas spang bya yi/ /nyon mongs can gyi ma rig bcu/ /de yi gnyen por sa bcu yi/ /rnam par bzhag ste nyan thos kyi/ /gnyen po'i sa 'dir mi 'jug dang / /dman pa'i mya 'das sgrib byed gegs/ /mi byed phyir na spang bya min/ /byang chub sems dpas de spang bya/ /yin te des ni mi gnas pa'i/ /myang 'das thob pa'i gegs byed pas/ /spangs dgos phyir na de'i gnyen por/ /sa bcur ye shes bcu 'byung ngo / /dang po rab tu dga' zhes pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan sbyin pa'i pha rol tu/ /phyin pa rdzogs nas sngar ma mthong / /chos dbyings mngon sum mthong ba dang / /bdag gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ /byed par nus pa'i dga' ba ni/ /skyes pas rab tu dga' zhes bya/ /gnyis pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs pas tshul khrims ngan pa'i las/ /rmi lam du yang mi byed cing / /theg pa gzhan la stsol ba'i dri/ /med pas dri ma med pa'o/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs pas lus dang srog la yang / /mi lta sde snod rnams la ni/ /thos pa byas pa'i sgo nas ni/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis ma shes sel/ /shes rab bskyed pas 'od byed grags/

/bzhi pa brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs nas byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /bsgom pas ye shes mi skye ste/ /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya yi/ /sgrib pa'i bud shing bsregs pas na/ /'od 'phro ba can zhes su grags/ /lnga pa bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ting 'dzin las kyang mi nyams/ sems can don byed yang rgyun mi gcod pa gnyis shin tu dka' ba mgo mnyam du gcod ye shes ting nge 'dzin las kyang / /mi nyams sems can don byed yang / /rgyun mi gcod gnyis shin tu dka'/ /mgo mnyam gcod pas sbyangs dkar grags/ /drug pa shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs nus rten cing 'brel 'byung bar/ /skye 'gags med pa mngon gyur pas/ /mngon du gyur zhes yongs su grags/ /bdun pa thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs nas rnam par mi rtog pa/ /bsgrod pa gcig pa sa brgyad dang / /'bad dang rtsol ba'i 'jug pa ni/ /mthar phyin mtshan ma dang bral ba'i/ /bdun pa ring du song zhes grags/ /brgyad pa stobs kyi pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs nas mtshan ma med pa ru/ /lhun gyis grub ste ye shes kyi/ /stobs kyis mtshan ma yod med kyi/ /rtsol ba'i 'du shes zil gnon pas/ /brgyad pa mi g.yo ba zhes grags/ /dgu pa smon lam pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs nus chos don nges tshig dang / /spobs pa so so yang dag rig /bzhi dang ldan pas sa dgu pa/ /legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya'o/ /bcu pa ye shes pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs nas ye shes thugs rje yi/ /sprin las chos kyi char phab nas/ /sems can zhing la dge ba yi/ /lo tog bskyed cing spel bas na/ /chos kyi sprin zhes yongs su grags/ /'di dag ji ltar bsgom tshul ni/ /dang po'i sa nas bcu yi bar/ /zhi lhag rnam pa lngas bsgoms te/ /de yang sa ni dang po dang / /lhag ma rnams kyi rtogs bya yi/ /chos dbyings 'dres par bsgom pa dang /

/de yang keng rus la sogs pa/ /mtshan ma med par bsgoms pa dang / 'bad dang rtsol bar ma ltos pa/ /lhun gyis grub par bsgom pa dang / /mchog dang mchog min gnyis 'dzin med/ /mchog tu 'bar bar bsgom pa dang / /dang po'i sa la bsgom tsam gyis/ /chog par 'dzin pa ma yin pa/ /rnam grol go 'phang khyad par can/ /mngon du gyur par bsgom pa'o/ /mdor na sa bcu po rnams su/ /pha rol phyin bcu bsgom dgos te/ /sa ni dang por sbyin pa yi/ /pha rol phyin la long spyod nas/ /bcu pa ye shes phar phyin la/ /lhag par longs spyod dgos pa yin/ /gzhan yang sa ni phyi ma bzhir/ mdo sde rgyan las bshad pa gong du tshang ma song / tshig ris snga phyi mi 'dra ba'i dgongs rgyan ltar/ /shes rab phar phyin rjes thob zhing / /phyin drug dge rtsa bsags pa rnams/ /sems can kun tu thun mong bya/ /byang chub chen por bsngo ba thabs/ /slar yang sna tshogs smon lam ni/ /mngon du sgrub pa smon lam dang / /so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /bsgom pa'i mthu las phar phyin gyi/ /de rgyun mi gcod pa ni stobs/ /phyin drug nyid kyi ye shes la/ /longs spyod gdul byar de don bshad/ /sems can smin byed ye shes so/ /sa rnams thob tshul rnam pa bzhi/ /chos rnams la mos gtsor spyod pa'i/ /'jug pa mos pas thob pa dang / /chos spyod bcu yi tshul rnams la/ /ji 'dod bzhin gnas spyod pas thob/ /dang po'i sa yi chos kyi dbyings/ /mngon sum shes sogs pa rnams rtogs pas thob/ /bsgom pa mthar phyin rnam grol mchog /'bad med lhun grub grub pas thob /byang chub sems dpa' mos pa ru/ /spyod pa'i skabs su bskal pa ni/ /grangs med gcig dang sa dang po/ /zin nas bdun pa'i bar dag la/ /grangs med gcig dang dag pa yi/ /sa gsum gyi ni gnas skabs su/ /grangs med gcig ste gsum gyis rdzogs/ /bslab pa gsum drug pa bslab pa gsum po la/

/slob pa'i tshul ni tshul khrims kyi/ /bslab par sgo gsum gzhan gnod las/ /ldog cing yon tan chos thams cad/ /thob pa'i phyir du dge ba yi/ /chos rnams la ni 'bad par bya/ /sems can yal bar mi 'dor zhing / /de dag bsam pa yongs bskang ba'i/ /sbyor bar rtag tu gnas par bya/ /nyan thos rnams la phyi ma gnyis/ /med cing rang don kun slong gi /cung zad 'bras smin byang sems la/ /kun slong gzhan phan nyes spyod sdom/ /thun min dge ba chos sdud dang / /gzhan don byed pas yon tan tshogs/ /rgya cher zab pas khyad par 'phags/ /mdor na sgo gsum gzhan gnod ldog /yon tan thob phyir dge chos sgrub/ /rtag tu sems can don bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa las/ /mtshan nyid dmigs bden bzhi byang phyogs sogs kyi par yid rtse gcig /mnyam par 'jog cing rang bzhin ni/ /dmigs pa nyan thos las khyad 'phags/ /byang sems theg chen chos la dmigs/ /sna tshogs zhes pa ting nge 'dzin/ /gang la mnyam par bzhag zhe theg chen la na/ /mtha' dag chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs snang ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /bsod nams bsags pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /'jig rten pa yi rgyal po bzhin/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bdag po/ /yin pas ting 'dzin bzang skyong dang / /dmag dpon bzhin du bdud 'joms par/ /dpa' bas dpa' bar 'gro ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'o/ /chos rnams thams cad dbyings gcig tu/ /'dres par dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /khyi'u khyi'u ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa chu 'dren pa'i dpe'ang bshad dbyung ba yi/ /tshul gyis kun gzhi la yod pa'i/ /gnas ngan len pa phra rags kun/ /rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin phra mos kyang / /'byin par nus pa'i gnyen po'o/ /ting 'dzin nus pas bsam gtan las/ /ma nyams bzhin du ji 'dod pa'i/ /skye ba bzung nas sems can gyi/ /don byed las su rung nyid do/ /ting 'dzin mthu yis 'jig rten khams/

/kun tu thogs pa med pa yi/ /mngon par shes pa bsgrub pa ste/ /'jig rten khams g.yo byed pa dang / /'bar bar byed dang khyab par byed/ /sangs rgyas sku sogs ston pa dang / /dngos po phal pa gser sogs bsgyur/ /'jig rten mtha' yas 'gro 'ong byed/ /stong gsum phra rab rdul gcig sdud/ /rdul gcig gis ni 'jig rten khams/ /khyab dang rgyas par byed pa dang / /gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i/ /lus ni thams cad la 'jug cing / /ston dang gdul bya'i zhing du bgrod/ /snang dang mi snang byed pa dang / /brgya byin sogs kyis gzugs bsgyur ba/ /dbang byed gzhan gyi rdzu 'phrul ni/ /zil gyis non dang gdul bya la/ /gang la'ang mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dran pa bde ba sbyin/ /pho nya lta bu'i 'od zer btang / /dka' ba spyod pa mngon par sgrub/ /phar phyin bsgom dang sems can smin/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni zhing sbyang dang / /sangs rgyas chos kun bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rnams kyi las/ /rab tu dbye ba lta bar bya/ /mdor na yon tan de dag kun/ /thob phyir 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i ting 'dzin bsam gzugs dang / /'gog snyoms dang bcas dmigs yul la/ /sems gtad pa dang dmigs pa med/ /bsgom bya sgom byed las grol ba/ /mi sdug pa bsgom theg pa 'og mas keng rus sogs spong ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi mngon shes dang / /rdzu 'phrul 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /ye shes la sogs sgrub pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la spyod pa'o/ /shes rab bslab pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i blo/ /de yi rang bzhin ngo bo ni/ /gzugs la sogs pa ci yang ni/ /yid la mi byed spong tsam gyis/ /mi rtog ye shes ma yin te/ /gnyid ni mthug po log pa'i skabs/ /sems dang sems byung ma nges dang / rtogs spyod zhen bral tsam gyis kyang / /ma yin bsam gtan gnyis pa yan/

/sems dang sems byung ma nges dang / /yid shes 'khor gyi tshor 'du gnyis/ /bkag pa tsam gyis ma yin te/ /'gog snyoms kyis kyang ma nges dang / /gzugs sogs 'dzin rtog ngo bo ni/ /spong tsam gyis min de'i rnam pa/ /sngon po la sogs ma nges dang / /'di ni chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /de kho na nyid yin snyam du/ /lta bur 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi/ /shes pa de yang mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes ma yin ston pa dang / /rnam pa lnga po de spangs nas/ /mtshan ma gang yang yid mi byed/ /de bzhin nyid ni gsal bar snang / /'dzin pa med par 'jog pa ni/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes so/ /gnas ni gzugs la sogs mtshan ma/ /yid la byed pa'i sems ma yin/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings la snang ba yi/ /sems nyid ye shes de yi gnas/ /mtshan ma yid byed ye shes kyi/ /gnas ni ma yin ye shes de/ /gzugs sogs don la mi sems so/ /sems med bem po'ang de yi gnas/ /ma yin ye shes de nyid ni/ /sems kyis 'phen pa'i gnas skabs las/ /sems kyi rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa'i gnas/ /sems min pa yi sems nyid de/ /don la mi sems rgyus byung phyir/ /gzhi ni theg pa chen po yi/ /sde snod thos pa'i bag chags la/ /yid kyis brjod pa dang bcas te/ /ye shes snang ba'i don tshul bzhin/ /yid la byed pa gzhi'am rgyu/ /dmigs pa kun brtags dang bral bas/ /bsam brjod las 'das pa'i brjod med brjod du med pa'i chos rnams dang / /gnyis ka bdag med de bzhin nyid la dmigs/ /de yang gzhan dbang la dmigs pa/ /ma yin dngos su dmigs pa med/ /mi rtog pa yi ye shes yin/ /mtshan gzhi mi rnyed pa yin te/ /de bzhin ji lta ba nyid dang / /ji snyed gzhan dag brjod pa bral/ /de yi chos nyid la dmigs phyir/ /de yang shes pa ma yin na/ /ye shes su 'gal de yin na/ /rtog par gyur ro zhe na ni/

/shes pa yin te de kho na/ /nyid ni shes pa'i rig pa yin/ /'on kyang rnam rtog ma yin te/ /'di'o snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs bral/ /des na shes bya chos dbyings dang / /de shes shes pa khyad med de/ /dbyer med mi rtog ye shes yin/ /rnam par shes par bya ba yi/ /dmigs pa'i chos rnams kyi ni dbyings/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma med rtogs pa'i/ /'dzin stangs gang yin pa de'i/ /rnam par mi rtog rnam pa ni/ /shes bya dmigs pa de nyid la/ /mtshan ma med gang de yin gsung / /mdor na mtshan ma rnam par rtog /thams cad spangs te rtogs med par/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa dang / /rjes thob sgyu ma ltar spyod pa/ /shes rab kyi ni bslab pa'o/ /de 'bras spang ba bdun pa spang ba phun tshogs ni/ /de ltar bstan pa'i lam goms pas/ /las nyon sgrib pa rnams spangs te/ /mi gnas mya ngan las 'das thob/ /de ni thos pa'i bag chags goms/ /nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa yis/ /ma dag gzhan dbang mtshan ma kun/ /'gags pas 'khor bar mi gnas la/ /shes sgrib spangs pas rnam par byang / sgrib pa thams cad/ /shin tu rnam dag de kho na/ /nyid du snang bas yang dag pa'i/ /gzhan dbang gnas 'gyur ma 'gags pas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mtha' mnan te/ /snying rjes sems can don la gnas/ /'khor 'das gnyis su med pa yi/ /don ni mngon du gyur pa'o/ /brgyad pa ye shes phun tshogs ye shes phun tshogs ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu ste/ /ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /khyad par la ni sku gsum ste/ sku gsum dang ni yan lag lnga/ /ma 'dres la sogs yon tan no/ /zhes pa'i don rim par ston pa la/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa sems tsam par/ /gzung ba 'dzin pa gnyis med pa'i/ /shes par rang rig rang gsal ba/ /chos kyi sku ste don ma bzhed/ sems tsam par sku gsum gyi rnam bzhag mdzad pa'i chos sku /longs sku'i gnas kyi nges pa ni/ longs sku nges pa lnga ldan du bzhed pa'i dang po gnas nges pa/

/'og min stug po bkod pa nyid/ /dus kyi nges pa gnyis pa dus nges pa 'khor ba ni/ /ji srid ma stong bar du bzhugs/ /ngo bo'i nges pa gsum pa ngo bo'i nges pa mtshan dpes spras/ /'khor gyi nges pa bzhi pa 'khor nges pa sa bcu pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' kho nas bskor/ /chos kyi nges pa lnga pa chos nges pa theg chen gyi/ /chos ni sha stag la longs spyod/ /de ltar longs sku bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /'og min stug po bkod pa de/ /gzugs khams nang gi 'og min min/ /de nyid ji ltar yod zhe na/ /mi 'dzad 'jig rten khams la sogs/ /du ma nang du tshud pa yi/ /zhing khams la ni gzhi dang ni/ /snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /zhing khams de 'dra du ma ni/ /nang chud zhing khams rgya mtsho zhes/ /longs sku rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i/ /phyag gi lhung bzed nang du gnas/ /de kun sprul pa sku'i zhing khams/ /rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho/ /'khor ni sa bcu'i sems dpas bskor/ /bzhugs der 'og min stug po bkod/ /des na 'og min tsam dang ni/ /'og min stug po bkod pa gnyis/ /khyad par yod de longs sku yi/ /gnas ni phyi ma kho na'o/ /sprul sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sprul gzhi byas las byung ba ste/ /bzo ba sprul sku dri za yi/ sprul sku la bzo skye mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gsum du gsungs pa'i dang po bzo ba sprul sku/ /rgyal po rab dga' 'dul don du/ /sprul pa'i pi waṃ mkhan lta bu/ /gnyis pa skye ba sprul sku skye ba sprul sku de ltar gyi/ /dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa yi/ /byams pa mgon po lta bu'o/ /gsum pa mchog gi sprul sku mchog gi sprul sku shākya thub/ /'od dpag med pa lta bu'o/ /yan lag lnga ni/ gnas 'gyur dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi/ /gnyis med rag pa bsam mi khyab/ /zhes sngar gsungs pa'i dang po gnas gyur yan lag lnga ni phung po lnga/

/gnas gyur pa ste gzugs phung po/ gzugs gnas gyur zhing sogs/ /zhing dang dbyangs dang mtshan dpe sogs/ /dbang 'byor tshor ba zag med kyi/ tshor phung gnas gyur zag med sogs/ /bde ba 'du shes ming 'du shes gnas gyur ming sogs/ dang tshig /yi ge'i tshogs bstan 'du byed gnas gyur sprul bsgyur sogs 'du byed kyi/ /sprul bsgyur 'khor dang chos bsdu ba/ /rnam shes kyi ye shes bzhi la dbang 'byor rnam shes ye shes bzhir dbang 'byor/ /kun gzhi gnas gyur me long ye shes kun gzhi gnas gyur me long dang / /nyon yid gnas gyur mnyam nyid nyon yid mnyam pa nyid ye shes/ /yid shes gnas gyur sor rtog yid shes so sor rtogs ye shes/ /sgo lnga gnas gyur bya grub sgo lnga bya grub ye shes so/ /gnyis pa dkar po'i chos dkar po'i chos la phar phyin drug /rdzogs la brten nas dbang bcu thob/ /de'ang sbyin pa las ni tshe/ /sems las su rung ba sems dang yo byad la dbang thob/ /tshul khrims kyis ni las dang ni/ las sgrib kun zad sangs rgyas kyi phrin las/ sems can don du bsam bzhin skye ba/ skye ba la dbang bzod pa yis/ /sems can gyi mos pa la sogs dang mthun par 'don byed mos par dbang zhing brtson 'grus kyis/ /smon lam la dbang bsam gtan las/ /rdzu 'phrul dbang thob shes rab kyis/ /ye shes dang ni chos la dbang / /gnyis su med zhes chos thams cad/ gsum pa gnyis su med pa/ /kun tu yod dang med dang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ gcig min mang po min phyir gnyis su med/ /zhes go rim ltar/ kun tu brtags pas dngos med pas/ /yod pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin dang / /stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi/ de yod med gnyis ka min pa'i med mtha' min pa'i/ /dngos po yod pas med pa yi/ /mtshan nyid ma yin yod dang med/

/mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa'o/ /las dang nyon mongs kyis 'dus byas/ /de'i ngo bo de ni 'dus ma byas su snang / /kun tu ston pas 'dus byas dang / /'dus ma byas pa gnyis med pa'i/ /mtshan nyid gnas ni chos kyi dbyings/ /tha dad ma yin bdag 'dzin gyis/ /phye ba'i rgyud la tha dad med/ /tha dad med mtha' bkag sngon du lam la slob pa'i skabs/ /tha dad lus kyi rjes 'brangs pa'i/ /lus la tha dad btags pa dang / /byang sems rnams kyi tshogs tha dad/ /bsags la dgos pa med 'gyur dang / /sangs rgyas kun la phrin las kyang / /tha dad pa dang sangs rgyas la/ /thog ma yod par 'gyur ba'am/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen bkur ma byas pa'i/ /byang sems de ni thog ma ru/ /'tshang rgya pa la rgyu med du/ /thal bas gcig kyang ma yin la/ /dri ma mtha' dang yod mtha' bkag thams cad bral ba'i gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings la'ang dbye ba med/ /tha dad mang po'ang ma yin pa'i/ /spros pa kun las yongs su 'das/ /'di bas bzhi pa rtag pa chos sku rtag par bzhed/ /rtag tu chos kyi dbyings las ni/ /ma g.yos de bzhin 'gyur ba med/ /thugs rje chen po rgyun mi chad/ /smon lam zad mi shes pa'i phyir/ /sems can ma lus pa thams cad/ /byang chub la 'god de srid du/ /de srid mdzad pa rgyun mi chad/ /ston mchog de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /sus kyang dpag par mi nus pa'i/ /lnga pa bsam mi khyab yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de la yon tan gyi sde tshan/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig 'di lta ste/ /yon tan sde tshan nyer gcig gi dang po byang phyogs so bdun gcig tu rtsis pa gong lam gyi skabs su smon zin dang po byang phyogs so bdun ni/ /lam gyi skabs su smon de dag /sgrub 'bras mngon du gyur de'o/ /tshad med bzhi gnyis pa tshad med byams snying rje/ /dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi po'o/ /tshig don go sla tshang ba yi/ /gnas bzhi thar pa cha mthun gyi gnas skabs tshangs gnas su skye/

stong nyid dang snying rjes zin pa phyogs dang tshad bral gyi 'phags pa'i tshad med chen po bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad la rim bzhin bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis par brten nas nang gzugs kyi 'du shes dang ldan pas/ phyi gzugs ngan par lta ba dang / nang gzugs med pa'i 'du shes kyi phyi gzugs ngan par lta ba dang / gsum pa dang bzhi pa la brten nas gzugs mdzes par blta ba dang / nas ni sangs rgyas bar/ /yon tan khyad par gong 'phel lo/ /gsum pa rnam par thar brgyad ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /gzugs can gzugs la lta ba dang / /de bzhin gzugs med gzugs la lta/ /yid 'ong sdug pa 'gog rnam rtog mtha' dag dpyad cing spangs pa'i 'gog snyoms dang rnam pa'am dngos po gzugs ma gtogs pa'i dang po bzhi la dmigs/ nam mkha' bzhin mtha' yas so dang / rnam shes mtha' yas dang / ci yang med pa dang / stong rkyang med mtha'/ rags pa med/ phra ba ma yin bzhi/ pa bzhi/ /gzugs med bzhi dang brgyad pa'o/ /snyoms 'jug dgu bzhi pa la ni bsam gtan bzhi/ /gzugs med bzhi dang 'gog pa ste/ gong du bshad ma thag go /snyoms 'jug dgu'o lnga zad par bcu/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka dga' bde ting 'dzin yan lag lnga dang / rtog pa med la dpyod pa yod pa sems rab tu dwangs pas/ dga' bde'i ting 'dzin yan lag bzhi dang rtog dpyod gnyis ka spang ba dran shes bde ba ting 'dzin yan lag lnga dang / gnyis ka yongs su spangs pa tshor ba dang lhun grub btang snyoms dran pa ting 'dzin yan lag bzhi rnams dang ldan pa'o// pa ni/ /'byung ba bzhi dang sngo ser dkar/ /dmar gyi skye mched mkha' mtha' yas/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched de/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med dang po gnyis kyi mthus/ 'byung ba bzhi dang kha dog bzhi gang 'dod pa der sprul pa'o/ /zad par bcu dang drug pa ni/ /zil gnon brgyad gzugs can chung ngu gzugs khams kyi bsam gtan dang /

gzugs med snyoms 'jug gi sems la brten nas nang gzugs yod med du 'du shes pas phyi yi gzugs che chung la lta ba/ 'i gzugs la lta/ /gzugs can chen po la lta dang / /de bzhin gzugs med chung dang che/ /lta ba dbyibs kyi zil gnon bzhi/ bltas pa'i mod la nyi ma las kyang ting nge 'dzin 'od zer ches 'bar ba'o/ /sngo ser dmar po dkar po'i gzugs/ /kha dog zil gyis gnon te brgyad/ /bdun pa nyon mongs med nyon mongs med pa ni/ /nyan thos rnams kyis gzhan rgyud la/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i dmigs rkyen ni/ /mi byed tsam yin gzhan rgyud kyi/ /nyon mongs rgyun bcad mi nus la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gzhan rgyud la/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i dmigs pa'i rkyen/ /mi byed ma zad gzhan rgyud kyi/ /nyon mongs pa yi rgyun bcad do/ /brgyad pa mchog tu bsngags/ smon gnas mkhyen pa la lnga yod pa rim par/ smon gnas mkhyen pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /'bad rtsol re ba med pa ru/ /lhun gyis grub cing gzugs la sogs/ /chags pa spangs shing shes bya kun/ tshig don spyi/ /mkhyen pa thogs pa med pa dang / /gzhan gyi don ni rgyun mi chad/ /rtag gnas 'dri ba 'di la rtag par mnyam par bzhag bzhin zhes pa'ang 'byung kun gyi ni/ len 'debs don byed nus te lnga/ /dgu pa sku yi gdul bya gang gnas gshegs so rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ mngon shes drug /lha yi sems can gyi 'chi ba dang 'pho ba shes mig dang rna ba gsung gi 'gro ba so so'i skad mkhyen/ dang / /sngon gnas sems can skye ba snga ma dang da lta slar 'phro ba bcas mkhyen rjes dran gzhan sems shes/ thugs kyis/ /zag pa nyon mongs zad zad de mngon shes drug /'bras bu'i skabs 'di'i yang dag rig bzhi bcu pa legs gsungs chos dang ni/ /de don tshig dang spobs blo pa ste/

/rten/ dmigs pa/ thugs/ ye shes yongs su dag pa bzhi rim par yang dag rig bzhi bcu gcig pa/ rnam par dag pa/ /rnam par dag la nyon mongs pa/ /bag chags thams cad kyi rten ni/ /skye ba gang 'dod bzhed ma lus spangs pas lus gang bzhed/ /mdzad pa las dang sku tshe ji bzhed du/ /gnas pa dang ni btang ba dang / /spros bral dmigs pa yongs su dag pa yi/ /med dang yod par sprul bsgyur dang / /thugs ni yongs su dag pas na/ /gnas ngan ngan song len pa drug dang bral/ /ye shes yongs su dag pa yis/ /ma rig pa yi rgyun bcad pas/ /shes bya'i gnas ni thams cad la/ /ye shes sgrib pa med pa bzhi/ /bcu gnyis dbang bcu gong bshad ltar/ /stobs bcu bcu gsum gnas dang dge las mtho ris sdig las ngan song 'byung ba gnas min dang / /sems can gyi las kyi rnam smin las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / /sems can gyi mos pa sna tshogs 'jig rten khams/ nyan thos sogs rigs gsum/ /du ma dbang po dad pa sogs mchog mchog min/ /ngan 'gro bde 'gro rnams mkhyen thams cad du ni 'gro ba'i lam/ /kun nas spang bya nyon mongs pa dang ni/ /rnam byang phyogs so bdun/ bsam gtan bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad/ 'gog snyoms par byang chub sngon gyi gnas/ skye ba snga ma/ /rjes dran 'chi slar 'pho skye ba dang / /nyon mongs brgyad zag pa zad mkhyen stobs bcu'o/ /mi 'jigs bzhi bcu bzhi rang don rtogs dang spangs/ /gzhan la lam spyi'i spang bya lam byang chub ston pa/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi bco lnga ni/ /srung ba med pa gsum sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi ni/ /spyod pa yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ /la las skyon 'don sogs dogs pa/ /mi mnga' bas na 'khor gyi nang / /bag bag mi za brkyangs bzhugs nas thams cad pa/ /zil gyis mnan nas chos gsung pa'o/

/bcu drug dran pa nyer bzhag gsum dran pa nyer bzhag ni/ /chos la gus pas nyan par chags/ /ma gus kho nas nyan la sdang / /phyed phyed chags sdang gnyis bral gsum/ /bcu bdun bsnyel ba mi mnga' bsnyel ba mi mngal ba'i/ /chos nyid sems can gyi don la/ /skad cig bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /chos kyi bdag nyid can yin no/ /bco brgyad bag chags bcom pa sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas/ /yongs su dag pa'i ye shes so/ /bcu dgu skye bo thugs rje chen po thams cad la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan drug tu/ /gzigs pa'i thugs rje chen po'o/ /nyi shu sangs rgyas chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad ma 'dres bco brgyad ni/ /'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa spangs/ /ca co sgro 'dogs mnyam par ma bzhag dang / /dran pa nyams pa tha dad pa'i/ /'du shes so sor ma brtags pa/ /spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa drug /bdun pa brtson 'grus dran ting 'dzin/ /shes rab rnam grol nyams pa med/ /rtogs pa'i dbang du byas pa drug /sku gsung rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yon tan so sor gsal ba thugs kyi phrin las kyi/ /ma 'dres 'das 'ongs da lta ba/ /chags thogs med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /ma 'dres gsum te bco brgyad do/ /nyer gcig pa ni chos thams cad/ /de yi rnam pa thams cad pa/ /mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa/ /rtogs pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa/ ye shes bye brag bcas/ /byang phyogs so bdun nas brtsams te/ /'di yi bar la zag med kyi/ /sde tshan nyi shu rtsa gcig go /zhib par 'dod na mdo sde rgyan/ /chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa dang / /dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rjes 'brang bcas/ /khyad par du ni theg bsdus sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa yi/ /mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams las shes/ /gzhan yang gong gi sa lam skabs/ /tshig zin 'byung zhing nyer mkho ba'i/

/rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po yis/ /mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa yi/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi rnam bzhag las/ /sems ni gnas par byed pa'i thabs/ /dgu las dang po ming rten sam/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las sangs rgyas kyi sku dang / gsung ngag skabs su me tog sngon po sogs/ /tha mal rnam rtog kun spangs te/ /nang du sems ni 'jog par byed/ /dus kun de bzhin 'jog par byed/ /de la nges par 'jog par byed/ /de bzhin nye bar 'jog par byed/ rtog pa spangs shing dul bar byed/ /rnam rtog rnams ni zhi bar byed/ /de bzhin nye bar zhi bar byed/ /sems kyi dang ma de bzhin rgyud gcig byed pa bcas/ /mnyam par 'jog par byed pa'o/ 'di dag tha mal pa'i tshul dang rtog pa spangs te dge ba bzhi gnas la rtse gcig tu 'bad pa'i don no/ /yid la byed pa bcu gcig ni/ /de ltar rtogs shing dpyod bcas dang / /rtog pa med la dpyod pa dang / /rtog dpyod gnyis ka med pa dang / /zhi gnas yid la byed pa dang / /de bzhin lhag mthong yid la byed/ /de gnyis zung 'brel yid byed dang / /de don rab tu 'dzin pa yi/ /rgyu mtshan yid la byed pa dang / /de bzhin zhi gnas dang btang snyoms/ /rgyu mtshan yid la byed pa dang / /de yi nyams len la rtag tu/ /gong gi don la rtsal bton cing 'bad pa sbyor dang gus par yid la byed/ /de ltar gnas pa'i thabs dgu dang / /yid byed bcu gcig rgyun bsring pas/ /de nas de yi lus dang sems/ /shin tu sbyang ba che thob nas/ /yid la byed dang bcas zhes ltar/ /lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde bas/ /lus ni shing bal ltar yang dang / /sems ni ting 'dzin la nam 'dod/ /bkol nus bde ba chen po skye/ /de ni bsam gtan dang po yi/ /nyer bsdogs tsam yin bsam gtan gyi/ /nyer bsdogs yid la byed bdun ni/ /dang po mtshan nyid ni rab tu/ /yid la byed ni 'dod khams kyi/

/sems can nyon mongs des dkrugs pa'i/ /sdug cing de yi tshe thung dang / /khams ni gong ma gnyis po la/ /nyon mongs pa yi sems mi dkrug /sems bde de yi stobs kyi tshe/ /shin tu ring par gyur pa'o/ /'dod khams thos bsam shes rab kyis/ /shes pas sems ni shin tu sbyangs/ /bsam gtan dang po'i tsam po ba/ ting 'dzin skye/ /de yi 'dod khams kyi sems rag nyon mongs pa zhi ba/ bsam gtan dang po'i sems zhi bar/ nyon mongs pa/ /rig cing mos pa las byung ba/ /snga ltar sbyangs pas bsgom byung gi /shes rab kyis ni thos bsam las/ /'das pa'i bsam gtan dang po yi/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rkyang pa skye/ /rab tu dbye la yang snga ma bzhin/ /bsgom pas bsgom pa spyi 'dod khams kyi bsgom spangs/ /chen po spang ba'i gnyen po skye/ /nyon mongs mngon gyur pas spangs pa/ /dga' bas sdud par rab tu ni/ /dben pa las byung dga' ba dang / /bde ba chung ngu rag pa rnams/ /spang ba dga' zhing de'i phan yon/ /mthong bas dus dus dad pa thob/ /nyon mongs 'bring spong gnyen po bskyed/ /dpyod pa zhes pa de ltar gyi/ /gnyen pos nyon mongs phal cher spang / /thams cad spang snyam blo skyes te/ /slar yang nyon mongs skye mi skye/ /brtag pa'i dpyod pa yid la byed/ /sbyor ba'i mtha' ni de ltar du/ /brtag pas nyon mongs skye mthong ste/ /gong bzhin sngar bzhin bsam gtan zhi rag nyon mongs rnam pa ru/ /bsgom pas nyon mongs chung ngu yi/ /gnyen po rgyud la skye ba'o/ /sbyor ba'i mtha' yi 'bras bu ni/ /yid la byed ni de'i rjes la/ /bsgom pas de dag thams cad kyi/ /'bras bu nyams myong yid byed pa'o/ /yid byed bdun po'i rgyun gom las/ /'dod pa'i bsgom spang phal cher nub/ /dga' ba bde ba dang bcas pa'i/ /bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yi/ /ting nge 'dzin ni mchog gyur thob/

/bsam gtan dang po ji lta bar/ /gnyis pa nas ni srid rtse'i bar/ /yid byed bdun gyis thob par 'gyur/ /de yang gnyis pa phyin chad la/ /mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa dang / /mos pa las byung gnyis sbyor lam/ /rab tu dben dang dga' bas sdud/ /sbyor ba'i mtha' gsum sbyor lam gyi/ /bar chad med lam dpyod pa ba/ /khyad par lam yin sbyor ba'i mtha'i/ /'bras bu yid la byed pa ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam yin no/ /mthong sgom gnyis la'ang de bzhin no/ gsal bar ma bshad kyang zhi gnas yid byed bdun la tshogs lam/ sbyor lam drod las bsam gtan dang po zin pa'i lam gsum 'di bzhin sbyor ba ni/ 'di las zhal gsal ma thon kyang sbyor lam dang sbyor lam bar chad med pa'i khongs su sbyor lam nges 'byed bzhi dang / /mthong sgom gyi spong bya spangs pas bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad kyi lam de dri go chod cing bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' mi slob mthar phyin gyi lam gnyis don gcig pa snang ngo / /de nyid yan lag lnga ldan zhing / /zhi lhag zung du 'brel pa ni/ /yid ni mi g.yo bar 'dzin pa/ /bsam gtan dang ni dmigs pa la/ /snyoms par 'jug pa snyoms 'jug go rtog pa gzhan gyis ma dkrugs par ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu zhed 'jag par gnas pa'o/ /yan lag lnga ni 'di lta ste/ /rtog pa dang ni dpyod pa dang / /dga' ba bde ba ting nge 'dzin/ /lnga ldan bsam gtan dang po'o/ /de yang rtog dpyod bcas pa ni/ /tsam po ba yin rtog pa med/ /dpyod pa tsam gyi ting 'dzin ni/ /dngos gzhi khyad par can yin no/ /nang la rab tu dwangs pa dang / /dga' ba bde ba ting nge 'dzin/ /gzhi ldan bsam gtan gnyis pa'o/ /btang snyoms dran dang shes bzhin dang / /bde dang ting 'dzin yan lag lnga/ /ldan dang bsam gtan gsum pa'o/ /tshor ba btang snyoms lhun grub kyi/ /btang snyoms dang ni dran pa dang / /ting 'dzin yongs su dag pa ste/ /bzhi ldan bsam gtan bzhi pa'o/

/nam mkha' mtha' yas dang rnam shes/ /mtha' yas ci yang med pa dang / /yod min 'du shes rag pa med cing phra ba med med min skye mched bzhi/ /thar pa cha mthun dang de yi sems las kyi dbang gis bsam gtan bzhi/ /skye mched mu bzhi'i lhar skye ba/ /'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan dang / /rnal 'byor pa rnams der 'jug nas/ /yon tan rnams kyi rten 'gyur phyir/ /rgyu yi bsam gtan snyoms 'jug go /'di dag zag pa bcas bsgom na/ /'jig rten yi bsam gtan tsam/ /zag med lam gyi bden pa dang / /ldan pas bsgom na rnam par grol/ /mya ngan 'das thob 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i bsam gtan snyoms 'jug go /de ltar zhi gnas sems gnas kyi/ /thabs dgu nas bzung shin sbyang bar/ /bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la/ /brten nas bsam gtan dang po yi/ /dngos gzhi khyad par can thob nas/ /sbyor lam drod nas bzung rim gyis/ /sems bskyed dang ni rtog bya yi/ nyan rang gi zhi gnas skabs keng rus dang dbug sogs la brten na sems 'gog thabs kho nar 'bad/ /byang chub sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sogs la dmigs rten tsam du byed/ sems kyi rgyun kho na la 'jog zhing phyi don zhal bzhes min gyi chos bdag rtogs min gyis khyad zhugs pa'o/ /rigs can gsum la khyad zhugs nas/ /nyan rang gnyis kyi mthar phyin lam/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten no/ /byang chub sems dpas bsgom pa'i lam/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa shin tu ni/ /rnam par dag pa la brten cing / /de steng seng ge rnam par bsgyings/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mthar phyin lam ni mngon gyur to/ /de lta'i ting 'dzin de dag ni/ /'jig rten pa ni rgya chung zhing / /dman so skye la zag par bcas pa'o/ /nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /de bas rgya che zag pa med/

/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /sems bskyed bdag med gnyis rtogs kyis 'phags bsam gtan pha rol phyin la gnas/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /mdo rgyud rnams nas 'byung ba de/ /ming yang nyan rang gis mi shes/ /bsam gtan phar phyin med phyir ro/ /bsam gtan bsgom pa'i phan yon ni/ /tshe 'dir bsam gtan zhi gnas skye/ /de yi nyon mongs glo bur ba/ /ldog cing 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /mgo snyoms bsam gtan dga' bde thob/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes la sogs pa/ /yon tan 'byung zhing lhar bcas kyi/ /'jig rten yid dga'i gnas gyur te/ /skye ba gzhan du'ang de ltar thob/ /mthar thug mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don grub cing / /yang dag bzhi sogs thob pa'o/ yang dag rigs bzhi 'di byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs nas yod cing mthar phyin pa sangs rgyas skabs so/ /mthar thug theg pa gcig bzhed skabs/ /nyan thos lam lnga gang rung nas/ /theg chen tshogs lam chung ngu 'jug /nyan rang theg chen lam zhugs can/ /de la sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis/ /theg chen chos kyi rnam grangs 'chad/ /nyan dang thugs bskyed mthu la brten/ /dman sems dor nas gzhan don gyi/ /smon sems skyes ma thag pa nas/ /theg chen tshogs lam chung ngu zhugs/ /dus mnyam yin zhes kun mkhyen che/ /bsod nams seng ges legs par gsung / /de yang 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ /sher phyin dgongs par theg gsum gyi/ /sbyor lam thabs kyi khyad par dang / /nges 'byed bzhi la rang rang gi /dmigs pa gsal dang mi gsal gyi/ /khyad par tsam las gang zag bdag /rtogs la khyad par mi bzhed cing / /de yang nyan thos lam lnga po/ /rtog bya rim gyis rdzogs che chung / /dbye bas lam la myur bul gyur/ nyan thos lhag med kyi thob bya dman cing myur na tshe gsum gyis thob/ /rang rgyal thob bya de las cung 'phags cing bse ru bskal pa brgya yis thob/

byang chub sems dpa' thob bya ches 'phags shing bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi thob cing lam myur bul thob bya mtho dman gyis so/ /nyan thos lhag med dgra bcom dang / /theg pa chen po'i bzod chen gyi/ /lam gnyis na mnyam gyur pa'o/ /gzhan yang rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi/ /rnam bzhag snying po mdor bsdus pa'i/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung bcu gnyis ni/ /bye brag smra ba rnams kyi ni/ /skye ba snga ma nyon mongs pa/ /spyod pa'i skabs kyi phung po lnga/ de la bdag tu 'dzin pas/ /de la ma rig pa zhes bya/ /de bzhin 'og ma rnams la yang / /rang rang gang gtso'i ming btags te/ /phung po lnga lnga thams cad kyi/ /rjes 'brangs yin par shes par bya/ /'du byed skye ba snga ma'i las/ /dge dang mi dge'i gnas skabs so/ /rnam shes de dag gis 'phags pa'i/ /skye srid nying mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /ming dang gzugs ni mngal skyes nas/ /mig la sogs pa dod pa'i bar/ /gzugs yin nang gsal ming zhes pa/ /tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang / /rnam par shes bzhi gzugs nur nur/ /mer mer gor 'phrang rkang lag 'gyus/ /skye mched drug po mngal du mig /sogs pa dod nas dbang shes yul/ /'dus nas yul dpyod mi shes bar/ /reg pa dbang yul rnam shes gsum/ /'dus nas yul la longs spyod nas/ /bde sdug rgyu mtshan mi shes bar/ /tshor ba bde sdug gi rgyu shes/ /byis pa yi ni dus nas bzung / /'khrig pa spyod mi nus kyi bar/ /sred pa 'khrig pa spyod nus nas/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i skabs yin no/ /len pa rgyu nor thob pa'i phyir/ /tshong khe la sogs byed pa'o/ /srid pa de dag len pa'i mthus/ /srid pa phyi mar 'phen pa'i las/ /bsag pa yi ni gnas skabs so/ /skye ba de nas shi 'phos te/ /phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba'o/ /rga shi de yi bar skye ba phyi ma skye ba phyi ma yi/ /skabs te rgyun chags su 'dod do/

/mdo sde pa yi bzhed pa ni/ /mi rig rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /'du byed kun slong dge dang sdig /bar ma'i las kun bsags pa'o/ /rnam par shes ni de dag gi /rnam shes skye ba'i gnas su 'phangs/ /ming gzugs mngal gnas phung po lnga/ de yi/ /skye mched drug po mig sogs dod/ /reg pa yul dbang rnam shes gsum/ /'dus nas yul la spyod pa'o/ /tshor ba de las skyes pa yi/ /bde dang sdug bsngal btang snyoms myong / /sred pa bde ba'i yul la chags/ /len pa yul de don gnyer ba/ /srid pa de dag gi kun slong / /skye ba phyi ma grub las sogs/ /skye ba las de'i phyi ma yi/ /skye bar nying mtshams sbyor ba'o/ /rga shi phyi mar skye de'i tshe'i/ /mtha' ru phyin nas shi ba ste/ /'brel ba'i rten 'brel yin par 'dod/ /skad cig ma yi rten 'brel ni/ /dper na 'ga' zhig srog gcod na/ /de yi kun slong ma rig pa/ /'du byed srog gcod las byed pa/ /'bad mkhan des bsad bya rig pa sogs yul de rig pa rnam shes dang / /phung po lnga yod ming gzugs dang / /mig la sogs pa'i skye mched drug /gsum 'dus yul dpyod reg pa dang / /de thub pa'i bde sogs myong ba tshor ba dang / /sha sogs la ni sred pa dang / /des cher 'phel ba len pa'o/ /srog gcod las bsog srid pa dang / /sngar med skad cig ma srog gcod kyi las pa ni skye ba dang / /de rgyun 'gyur ba de nas las gzhan du 'gyur ba rga shi'o/ /tshe gsum gyis bsdus rten 'brel ni/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed kyi/ /skye ba snga ma'i las bsdus te/ /de ni rgyu yi yan lag go /rnam par shes pa ming dang gzugs/ /skye mched drug dang reg pa dang / /tshor ba rnams ni tshe 'dis bsdus/ /'bras bu yi ni yan lag go /sred len srid pa gsum po ni/ /tshe 'dis bsdus pa'i rgyu'i yan lag /skye ba dang ni rga shi ni/

/tshe ni phyi mas bsdus pa ste/ /'bras bu'i yan lag rten 'brel ni/ /rgyu 'bras tshar gnyis kyis bsdu'o/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs ldog ni/ /'di gnyis tshe sngon ma'i mtha' ma rig 'gag pas srid pa ni/ /skye ba'i rgyur gyur 'du byed 'gag /de 'gag las kyi 'phangs pa yi/ /rnam par shes 'di drug da ltar 'byung ba dang ming dang gzugs/ /skye mched drug dang reg pa dang / /tshor ba 'gag pas tshe phyi mar/ /skye ba'i las kyis kun slong ba'i/ /sred pa 'di gnyis snga phyi'i gsos 'debs dang ni len pa 'gag /de 'gag pa yi phyi ma yi/ /phung po grub pa'i las kyi mthu/ /ldan pa'i 'di gsum phyi ma'i mtha' srid pa 'gag par 'gyur/ /de 'gag pas ni skye ba dang / /rga shi dang bcas sdug bsngal gyi/ /phung po ma lus pa 'gag go /theg chen dbu ma pa'i bzhed pa/ /lung bstan brnyes pa klu sgrub kyis/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /rtsa 'grel gnyis pas 'di skad gsung / /yan lag bye brag bcu gnyis so/ /thub pas rten 'byung gsung de dag /ma rig pa dang sred pa dang / /len pa gsum ni nyon mongs pa/ /'du byed srid pa gnyis ni las/ /rnam shes ming gzugs skye mched drug /reg pa tshor ba skye ba dang / /rga shi bdun po sdug bsngal yin/ /bcu gnyis chos ni gsum du 'dus/ /gsum las srid pa'i 'khor lo de/ khams gsum po/ /nyid ni yang nas yang du 'khor/ /'di la sems can byed pa po ci yang med/ /stong pa kho na'i chos rnams las/ /stong pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar zad/ /bdag dang rten 'byung bcu gnyis des gcig gis gcig la dmigs res ma byas pa bdag gir med pa'i chos/ /kha ton mar me me long rgya/ /me shel sa bon skyur dang sgras/ /phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba yang / /mi 'pho bar yang mkhas rtogs bya/ /shin len pa'i rnam shes zab cing phra ba tu phra ba'i dngos la yang /

/gang gis chad par rnam brtags pa/ /rnam par mi mkhas de yis ni/ /rkyen mdo las/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod pa min/ /rkyen la rag las gang de stong par bshad/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ zhes so las byung ba'i don ma mthong / /stong nyid kyi don 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba ci yang med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ /ma 'gag snang ba 'di la ni/ /rten 'brel dang ni stong pa nyid/ /phan tshun rgyu 'bras 'brel ba ste/ /dper na byas dang mi rtag pa'i/ /khyad par nges pa'i gang zag gi /de ltar nges pa'i blo skye ltar/ /dbu ma pa yis sa bon la/ /myu gu skye bar nges de'i tshe/ /sa bon dang ni myu gu gnyis/ /rang bzhin stong par nges pa bzhin/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i rten 'brel dang / /yod dang med la sogs pa'i mtha'/ /gang du yang ni ma grub pa'i/ /stong pa nyid gnyis dbyer med gnas/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba nyid/ /mthar 'dzin lta ba thams cad kyi/ /gnyen po yin cing snang ba yis/ /steng du rten 'brel gyis stong par/ /nges shes 'dren pas stong pas na/ /rten 'brel la ni nges shes skye/ /de yi rten 'brel dang stong pa/ /zung du 'jug par rtogs pa ni/ /dbu ma'i snying por shes bya gsungs/ /de nas dbu ma'i grub mtha' la/ /dbu ma zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ /rang gi gong na mtshan nyid kyi/ /theg pa'i grub mtha' smra ba po/ /gzhan med pa'am yang na ni/ /mtshan nyid theg pa'i sgrub pa'i mtha'/ /smra ba thams cad kyi gong na/ /gnas pas dbu ma zhes bya'o/ /snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /sems tsam pas ni gzhan dbang yod/ /kun tu brtags pa med pa dang / /yongs grub yod cing dbu ma'i lam/ /yin par smra mod de yin na/ /gzhan dbang de ni don dam du/

/yod dam kun rdzob nyid du yod/ /kun rdzob nyid du yod zer na/ /de ni kun brtags yin dgos shing / /kun brtags med par 'dod min nam/ /don dam yod na yod pa yi/ /mthar lhung phyir na dbu ma min/ /sems tsam pas dbu ma pa la yang ni khyod kyi don dam med/ /med na med mthar lhung zhe na/ /dbu ma pas nged kyi dbu mar don dam par/ /ma grub phyir ni med mi 'dod/ /dbu ma pas nged kyi 'dod par kun rdzob tu/ /ji ltar gnas pa de ltar du/ /'dod pas chad pa'i mtha' las grol/ /don dam yod med gnyis ka ni/ /'dod pa med pas mtha' kun las/ /grol bas dbu ma zhes su 'dogs/ /dbu ma pas sems tsam pa la yang khyod yongs grub spros bral de/ /gzhan dbang las grub zhes yin na/ /bye smras myang lhag med 'das stong nyid kyi/ /rdzas grub 'dod de khyad med gyur/ /gzhan dbang don dam yod zer na/ /sems tsam gzhung du rnam par rig pa tsam du'ang / gang tshe mi 'dzin de yi tshe zhes 'dod khyod kyi rnam par rig tsam du/ /mi 'dzin smra ba ma yin nam/ /yod na 'dzin pa can du 'gyur/ /dbu ma pas sems tsam pa la yang ni skad cig ma tsam gyis/ /don dam grub par khyod 'dod na/ /de la skye ba la sogs kyi/ /cha shas gsum po med par 'gyur/ /de 'dod na ni snga phyi'i bar/ /mi gnas pa yi skyon yod do/ /skad cig kyang ni ma yin 'gyur/ /dbu ma pas sems tsam pa la yang ni khyod kyi gnas gyur zhes/ /'dod de don dam kun rdzob gang / /don dam don dam par gnas gyur na yin na don dam gyi/ /don dam mtshan nyid ma tshang gyur/ /kun rdzob kun rdzob du gnas gyur na yin na bdag 'dzin dang / /'jig rten yongs grags kyi med nges/ ri bong rwa yang gnas 'gyur gyur/ /gzhan dbang yod pa de don dam dang kun rdzob gnyis gang du yod pa yin no snyam na gzhan dbang don dam dang kun rdzob/

/gnyis ka ma yin no snyam na/ /des ni tshul bzhin ma shes te/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /dam pa'i don gyi bden par gsungs/ /bden gnyis rnam gzhag ma shes na/ /zab mo'i de nyid rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dbu ma la ni bka' 'khor lo bar par nges don gtsor ston de yi gzhung / /brten gzhir gyur pa'i 'di la gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma zhes dbu ma dngos dbu ma dang / /grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin dbu ma gnyis/ /dang po gzhung gi dbu ma'i gsal byed ni/ /rgyal ba lung bstan brnyes pa yi/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs dang ni/ /de yi thugs sras 'phags pa lha/ /rgyal sras zhi ba lha sogs yin/ /grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin bye smra dang / /tshul mtshungs dbu ma mdo sde spyod/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma sogs/ /de las 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ /rjes 'brang thal rang gnyis su gyes/ /de yi khyad par mdor bsdu na/ /bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dang gang la yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa'i dam bca' bzhi po 'di/ /thal rang gnyis ka'i dam bcar 'dod/ /de yi sgrub byed gtan tshigs kyi/ /thal rang gnyis kyi mtshan khyad par gyur pas thal rang gnyis/ /slob dpon zla grags kyi tshig gsal las grags shing dbu ma pa yin na/ /rang rgyud pa yi rjes dpag tu/ /rig pa min te phyogs gzhan du/ /khas blang med do cis zhe na/ /gnas lugs la ni dpyod pa'i tshe/ /phyogs gzhan dgag bya 'gog rgyu dang / /rang phyogs bsgrub bya sgrub rgyu la/ /khas mi len par dgongs pa'o/ /rang rgyud pas kyang mnyam gzhag skabs/ /khas len bral bar 'dod pa gcig /'di sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang mnyam bzhag gnyis kar gtan tshigs kyi bsgrub mi dgos par bstan yang bstan bcos 'jug pa las gtan tshigs bstan tshul stag tshang lo tsā ba'i gsungs las 'byung /

dam bca' sgrub skabs cung zad kyi/ /khyad par lta bur gyur pa'o/ /dbu ma thal 'gyur srol 'byed ni/ /thog mar slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyang / /de rjes dpal ldan zla ba grags/ /rig pa'i khu dbyug che chung dang / /gangs can mgon po jo bo rje/ /dpal ldan a ti sha la sogs/ /'phags pa'i yul du rgyas par mdzad/ /bod du sa tshab lo tsā ba/ nyi ma grags/ /de slob gong ma she'u dang / zla bas legs bkral nyi mas bsgyur ba'i srol/ bu bzhi las 'ong zhes pa'i sa tshab kyi thugs sras bzhi/ /gtsang pa 'bri rgur dang rma bya/ /byang btson pag thang ba dang bzhi'i/ /thog mar srol btod bar du ni/ /dpal sa skya'i dga' ldan bla brang gi chos las pa re mda' gzhon blos rgyas par spel/ /tha mar kun mkhyen rong ston pa/ /shes bya kun rig smar khams pa/ /grags pa bzang po rje kun mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas 'phel dang thub bstan gyi/ /nyi ma go rims paṇ+ḍi ta/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs/ /mkhas pa shākya mchog ldan dbu ma thal 'gyur gyi bstan bcos yang re 'ga' mdzad cing lta ba'i skabs skyong mdzad bshad/ sogs/ /'chad nyan dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ /mkhas pa tsong kha pa chen po/ /blo bzang grags pas 'chad spel mdzad/ /de slob dge dpal la sogs pas/ /'grel ṭīka mang tsam 'bur dod kyi/ /grub mtha'i khyad chos rtsom par mdzad/ /rang rgyud srol 'byed thog ma ni/ /slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad/ /de srol slob dpon dpal sbas skyong / /slob dpon ye shes snying po dang / /byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po ka ma la/ /shī la rang ye snying / zhi mtsho/ ka ma la shī la gsum la rang rgyud shar gsum grags rgyud shar gsum gyis/ /'phags pa'i yul du rgyas par mdzad/ /bod du rngog lo chen po ni/ /blo ldan shes rab gsung sgros rgyun/ /gro lung blo gros 'byung gnas gsan/

/rig pa'i dbang phyug cha pa che/ /sras kyi thu bo se chen brgyad/ /jo sras rnam bzhi grub thob gsum/ /shes rab can gyi mi gsum gyis/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'o/ /'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde grol sde rnam gnyis seng ge bzang / /dbu ma thal rang gang yang min/ /byams pa'i rjes 'brang kho na'o/ /phyis grags dbu ma gzhan stong ni/ /don dam bden pa rang ngos nas/ /mi stong kun rdzob chos gzhan la/ /ltos nas stong pas gzhan stong 'dod/ /de yi sgrub byed rgyud bla mar/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur gyis ni khams stong la/ /rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyi stong ma yin/ /zer yang lung don 'byor bar dka'/ /lung bstan brnyes pa klu sgrub kyis/ /skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa dang / /ma grub phyir na 'dus byas min/ /'dus byas rab tu ma grub pas/ /'dus ma byas yang ji ltar grub/ /rig pa drug cu pa las/ zhes pa'i lung gis shin tu gnod/ /sems tsam rnam brdzun pa la dbu ma yi/ /ming btags yin te de'i srol 'byed/ /rgya gar yul du shān+ti pa/ /bod du dol pos shes rab rgyal mtshan srol phyes nas/ /paṇa shāka pas yang de srol skyongs/ /dbu ma pa yi grub mtha' ni/ /shes bya thams cad kun rdzob tu/ /yod mnyam don dam med mnyam 'dod/ mtha' gang du'ang khas mi len/ /tha snyad bden pa thabs gyur dang / /don dam bden pa thabs byung ngo / /thal 'gyur pas/ tshig spyi don byed mi nus pa 'dus ma byas nam mkha' lta bu shes bya yin na yod ma khyab/ /kun rdzob kun rdzob kyi tshig spyi tsam ri bo rwa lta bu yod na yod pas khyab/ /tha snyad yod na 'jig rten yongs grags yod khyab bo/ /bden pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ /'jig rten grags sde pa yi ni/ /kun rdzob bden pa ma rig pa'i/ /bden 'dzin gyis bslad snang ba brdzun/

/rnyed don de yang glo bur gyi/ /'khrul rgyu'i ma bslad pa'i dbye bas/ /yul can dbang shes gnyis yod pas/ /yul la bden rdzun gnyis 'byung ste/ /mtshan gzhi mu stegs rtag pa'i bdag /brtag dang mtha' bzhi skye la sogs/ /sgyu mas sprul pa'i rta glang dang / /rab rib can la skra shad snang / /sogs te log pa'i kun rdzob yin/ /'di la gnyis te med bzhin pa'i/ /'khrul snang snang log de la ni/ /de der 'dzin pa btags log go /'di ni 'jig rten gyis grags pa'i/ /kun rdzob tsam yin 'jig rten na/ /kun rdzob bden pa ma yin no/ /yang dag kun rdzob mtshan gzhi ni/ /'khrul rgyu ma bslad so skye yi/ /blo la lhan skyes snang ba yi/ /dngos por yongs su grags rnams yin/ /de la'ang 'jig rten rang ga ma'i/ /lung la don dam pa yin yang / /'phags pa rnams kyi gzigs pa las/ /bden med de kho nyid mthong ba/ spros bral/ /sgrib byed phyir na snang cha der/ /kun rdzob bden par grags pa'o/ /ngar 'dzin lhan skyes rang rgyud kyi/ /phung po'i steng du yod 'dzin pa'i/ /nga tsam so so skye bo yi/ /rgyud la rtogs pa nang shes pa lhan skyes dang / /bden par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi/ /bzung cha dper na phyi yul myu gu la/ /bdag gi myu gur bzung lta bu'i/ /rtog pa dang ni myu gu dang / /ma 'phrad bar du myu gu yi/ /ngos 'dzin rtog pa ma byas kyang / /don la myu gu yod lta bu/ shes pas yod par 'dzin/ ༈ ched du sems pa ma yin pa'i de yi mod rtog gnyis gcig char de yi 'gal zla sogs 'char/ /de lta la yang yid shes la/ /'khrul pas bslad pa'i yid mngon ni/ /log pa'i kun rdzob don mi ston/ /'khrul pas ma bslad yid mngon ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku gser sbyang mas grub pa lta bu la yid gtad pas de bzhin du 'char ba don byed nus de yang dag gi /kun rdzob zhes su 'dod pa yin/

/de ni mkhas rmongs kun thun mong / /de la gtan tshigs kyis sgrub pa'i/ /bden pa med pa mkhas pa yi/ /kho na rtogs kyi dbang shes gnyis/ /glo bur 'khrul pas ma bslad de/ /kun rdzob yin pa de yi ngor/ /bden par ma grub bden pa ste/ /zung 'brel de la kun rdzob kyi/ /bden par slob dpon zla bas bzhed/ /bye brag smra dang tshul mtshungs pa'i/ /kun rdzob rnam gzhag gzugs dang sems/ /sems byung ldan min 'du byed dang / /'dus ma byas dang lngas phye ste/ /smra de blo la rnam med sogs/ /de dang cha 'drar 'dod pa'o/ /rmi lam yul dang bar snang la/ /skra shad zla ba gnyis snang dang / /don spyi zhes pa ka ba dang / /bum pa gnyis la thun mong du/ /don spyir yod kyang so so yi/ /don byed mi mtshungs pa yi phyir/ /don spyi tsam du log pa yi/ /kun rdzob yin cing ka bum gnyis/ /so so'i mtshan nyid tshang ba ni/ bum pa lto ldir zhabs zhum chu skyor don nus/ ka ba gdung bteg don byed nus/ /tha snyad du ni don byed nus/ /de ni yang dag kun rdzob yin/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i dbu ma ni/ /phyi nang phung khams skye mched rnams/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' smra rnams kyi/ /btags pa'i yod med yin min dang / /rtag dang mi rtag la sogs pa/ /'dod ltar ma yin snang yang de/ /ngo bos stong pas rten 'brel gyi/ sgyu ma tsam du ston par byed/ /mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa/ /kun rdzob shes bya'i gzhi gsum po/ /mdo sde pa dang mthun smra zhing / /tha snyad rdul phran blo rnams bcas/ /la sogs 'thad par bshad pa'o/ /de yang rigs pas dpyad bzod kyis/ /kun rdzob tu ni mi bzhed de/ /de nyid 'ba' zhig pa zhes bya/ /ngo bo nyid kyi dri tsam gyis/ /ma gos pa zhes gsung pas so/ rigs pas dpyad bzod zhes pa ni rgyu mtshan 'di dang 'di zhes rigs ngor ngos bzung yod pa dang / dpyad mi bzod pa zhes rigs pas dpyad dus mtha' gang du'am grub par spyi btang bzhed la/

nyan thos sde gnyis kyi skabs bum pa sogs bcom gzhig byas nas/ de blo 'dor ba rnams dpyad bzod min pa dang / rdul phran sogs bcom gzhig mi nus shing blos mi 'dor ba rnams rig pas dpyad bzod nus par bzhed pa de sgos kyi chos skad yin 'dug /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma ni/ /gzugs rdzas nyi shu gzugs la sogs pa'i snang ba dang / /de bzhin sems tshogs brgyad dang sems las byung / lnga bcu rtsa gcig /de dag thams cad rmi lam gyi/ /snang ba ltar du sems nyid kyi/ /bag chags las ni 'khrul pa yi/ /'khrul pa sna tshogs snang tsam ste/ /phyi don tha snyad tsam du yang / /mi bzhed de dag kun rdzob bzhed/ 'di la yang dag kun rdzob dang log pa'i kun rdzob kyi dbye ba ma mdzad/ /de dag don dam bden pa ni/ /yod med lar sogs spros pa kun/ /nye bar zhi ba thams cad mthun/ /de ltar grub mtha' de dag la/ /rang rang dbu mar khas len kyang / /dbu ma'i ming las dngos min no/ /da ni dbu ma dngos nyid kyi/ /bden pa gnyis kyi 'dod tshul la/ /mthong ba brdzun pa'i yul sems can de/ /kun rdzob bden pa zhes su grags/ /de la yang dag kun rdzob ni/ /glo bur 'khrul rgyu'i ma bslad pa'i/ /dbang po skyon med so skye yi/ /shes pa mtha' dag yin pa ste/ /phyi chos dang gang nang zag la bdag 'dzin/ /bum 'dzin rtog pa lhan skyes sogs/ /tshur mthong rgyud kyi gzung 'dzin gyi/ yul/ yul can/ /mngon sum nyid du gyur rnams so/ /log pa'i kun rdzob glo bur ba'i/ /'khrul rgyu'i bslad ste chos gang zag /bdag la kun brtags ched du 'dzin/ /zla ba gnyis snang dbang shes sogs/ /'di yang bum pa lta bu la/ /rang gi 'dzin byed blo la ltos/ /bum pa yul kun rdzob bden pa ru/ /'gyur bas bum 'dzin yul can rtog pa la/ /bum pa yul kun rdzob bden pa yis/

khyab pa gnad kyi don yin gsung / yin zhes kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges gsungs/ /yul gyi yang dag kun rdzob ni/ /'khrul pas ma bslad dbang po drug /gang rung shes pa dngos yul ste/ /tshur mthong rgyud kyi gzung dang 'dzin/ /mngon sum pa ni thams cad yin/ /yul dang gyur pa'i gzugs sogs dang / /ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis dmigs pa'i/ /yul du gyur pa'i nga lta bu/ /yul la sogs pa'i kun rdzob log pa'i kun rdzob glo bur gyi/ /'khrul rgyu'i bslad pa'i dbang po drug /shes pa'i dmigs yul rab rib can/ /snang bar skra shad 'dzag pa dang / /phyi rol pa yi bdag bdag 'dzin pa'i/ /kun brtags bdag gir 'dzin pa bdag dang sgyu ma yi/ /rta glang skra shad sogs pa ni/ /'jig rten tha snyad du'ang med/ /don dam rtogs pa'i thabs mi 'gyur/ /de dag log pa kun rdzob bden pa yi/ /tha snyad tsam du yod pas khyab/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang sogs kyis don byed mi nus 'jig rten na yod kun rdzob kyi/ /yod pa nyid la ma khyab pa/ /kun mkhyen bla mas bzhed pa'i gnad/ /yang dag kun rdzob bden pa la/ /yul can blo yi sgo'i dbye na/ /kun rdzob kyi ni bden pa dang / /kun rdzob tsam pa gnyis su yod/ /yul ni bum par bden 'dzin gyi/ /lhan skyes ma rig pa la blo/ sems/ /kun rdzob yin te de yi ngor/ /'dzin bden pa'i snang cha kun rdzob bden/ /'phags pa 'og ma'i rjes thob ngor/ /kun rdzob tsam du snang cha nas/ /yul can blo thugs la ltos pa yi/ /snga ma las 'dzin cha cung phra kun rdzob yin tsam 'gyur phyir ro/ /don dam bden pa dngos dang btags/ /gnyis mi phyed na rtogs pa yi/ spros bral/ /don dam bden dang bstan pa yi/ de'i don bstan pa e yin/ /don dam bden pa gnyis su grags/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med/ /dpe na skye 'gag la sogs pa'i/
