/spros pa'i rab rib dang bral ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid de don dam pa'i/ /bden pa yi ni ngo bo yin/ /bden 'dzin 'khrul pas bslad pa yi/ /so skye'i blo ngor skye 'gag sogs/ /sna tshogs snang yang 'phags pa yi/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i gzigs ngo la/ /ci yang mi dmigs spros bral gyi/ /gnas lugs gsal bar snang ba la/ /don dam bden par 'jog phyir ro/ /don dam bden pa nges byed kyi/ /tshad ma'i bsam byung khyad par can/ /rig pas shes dang rjes dpag la/ /de'ang gtan tshigs la brten dgos/ /rang byung pa dang thun mong gi /rtags chen lnga po bshad pa ni/ /'khrul ngor snang ba dper mtshon na/ /yul bum pa sogs dang dbang po mig sogs shes pa rnam shes drug gsum/ /'dus te mig shes gcig skye dang / /sa bon gcig las myu gu ni/ /mang po snang sogs 'khrul ngo yin/ /de dag la ni thug med du/ /gyur pas dpe ru 'jog bya min/ /grub tu zin pa'i rig ngo la/ 'di yi gnad ni/ yul la yul snang zhes phyi yul dbang mngon la gser bum mthong ba/ yul can nam sems snang zhes yid mngon du gser bum 'char ba de gnyis ka'i mgor gtan tshigs bkod/ mtha' bral sgrub pas de ltar rtog dus/ bsam la bum 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i rjes dpag de yang bum pa mtha' bram du rtogs pas rang sar zhi nas phyi nang gnyis ka'i 'dzin pa gcig char du bcad pa go dgos/ /snang ba'i dngos por gtan tshigs bkod/ /de yang ngo bo la dpyad pa/ /gcig dang du bral gtan tshigs ni/ /snang ba'i dngos po 'di chos can/ /bden pa'i gcig min cha dang bcas/ /bden pa'i du ma ma yin te/ /rtsom byed bden pa'i gcig med phyir/ /gnyis pa rgyud la dpyad pa yi/ /rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs la/ /myu gus chos can bden pa yi/ /skye ba med de nas lta bu'i/ /myu gu rang las rang mi skye/ /'bru gzhan myu gur nas mi skye/ /gnyis las mi skye gnyis min las/

/mi skye skye ba med phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la dpyod pa'i/ /yod med skye 'gog gtan tshigs la/ /yod pa slar yang mi skye shing / /med pa skye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /yod med gnyis ka yin min las/ de yi rig pas yod pa skye bar mi 'gyur bas yod med gnyis las skye ba med/ med pa skye bar mi 'gyur bas yod med gnyis min pa khegs/ /mi skye skye 'gag bral bas so/ /bzhi pa mu bzhi skye 'gog gi /gtan tshigs snang ba'i dngos po 'di/ /'khrul ngor gcig dang du ma ru/ /snang yang rig ngor rgyu gcig de/ rig ngor rgyu gcig gis 'bras bu gcig dang du ma mi skye/ rgyu du mas 'bras bu gcig dang du ma mi skyed de/ /rig ngor gcig nyid mi rig la dpe du ma bden grub kyang khegs pas so/ /cha bcas yin phyir du ma ni/ /rtsom byed gcig med du ma zhig /mi skye du mas 'bras bu gcig /mi skye du ma rtsom byed kyi/ /gcig med cha shas bcas phyir ro/ /'di ni gcig dang du ma yi/ /rtsa ba can zhes mkhas kyis bzhed/ /lnga pa thams cad la dpyod pa/ /rten 'brel chen mo'i gtan tshigs ni/ /rnam gcod 'gog par snang ba kun/ /chos can bden med rten 'brel yin/ /yang gcod sgrub par snang ba kun/ /chos can kun rdzob tsam du yod/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung yin phyir ro/ /de dag rnams ni mtha' bzhi yi/ /nang nas gtso bo yod pa'i mtha'/ /'gog byed bdag med gnyis nang nas/ /gtso cher chos kyi bdag med pa/ /sgrub par byed pa'i rig pa yin/ /de ltar dgag bya'i sgo nas ni/ /yod mtha' 'gog tshul snang ba yi/ /dngos po la sogs rtsod pa'i gzhi/ /'dus byas steng nas 'gog pa gtso/ /yul snang dang sems snang sogs shes pas rtogs pa'i rigs 'dus byas dag la bden 'dzin ni/ /zhugs pa shas che 'dus ma byas/ rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa'i bum pa sogs stong gi stong pa'i tshig spyi/

/dngos med bden shes pa rtog med 'dzin shas chung bas/ /'dus byas yul snang dang / sems snang sogs bden grub bkag pa yi/ /shugs kyis khegs par 'gyur bar bshad/ /de nas med mtha' 'gog tshul ni/ /dper na myu gu'i bum pa sogs steng du ni/ /yod mtha' bkag tsam zin pas kyang / /bden med nyid du zhen pa'i phyir/ /de tsam ma yin myu gu la/ bum pa sogs rtags chen lngas mtha' bzhi bral bar sgrub pa ste/ dper na myu gu dang bum pa sogs rig ngor skyes zin pa de yod pa skye ba med cing ri bong gi rwa lta bu/ /med pa la skye ba med/ /yod med gnyis ka gcig thog tu yin pa/ gnyis ka min pa zhig 'ong mi srid pas rig pa gcig gis mtha' bzhi 'gog des nas kun rdzob bden pa grub pa dang / rten 'brel tsam kun rdzob med pa gnyis mi yong / /de ltar du yod med gnyis ka lhan gcig pa dang yod med gnyis ka min pa zhig mi yong bas so/ /bden par yod dang med pa dang / /yod med gnyis dang gnyis ma yin/ /mtha' bzhi bkag pas myu gu'i mtha'/ /gang du yang ni ma grub phyir/ /de yang myu gu bden med tsam/ /de ltar myu gu sogs la mtha' bzhi bral ba rtogs nas de'o snyam pa'i blo rtog pa'i rjes dpag myu gu mtha'/ /bzhi bral rjes dpag gnyis su phye/ /snga ma bden med yin pa dang / /phyi ma min pa'i rnam dbye bcas/ /de la khyad par ci zhe na/ /mtha' bzhi'i nang tshan med mtha' ni/ myu gu mtha' bzhi dang bral lo snyam pa la zhen pa'i blo de/ /tha snyad du yang med pa'i phyir/ /dbu ma'i rig pas dgag byar 'gyur/ /log pa'i kun rdzob yin phyir ro/ /gtan tshigs chen po lngas bsgrub pa'i/ /mtha' bzhi bral te bdag med dang / de ltar rtogs te de bas mtshan 'dzin gyi blo bral ba/ chos dang gang zag gi /mnyam pa'i spros kun las 'das so/ /yod mtha' sogs bkag dgos pa ni/

/yul der zhen pa'i yul rkyen gyi/ /blo spangs pa yi ched yin te/ /yul bkag pa yi yul can gyi/ /blo yang khegs par 'gyur ba'o/ /de skad du'ang bzhi brgya par/ /rtog pas mthong ba 'ching ba ste/ /de ni 'di ru bkag zhes bya/ /de ni bsgom pa nyams len dang / /sbyar tshe snang ba'i dngos po spyi/ /rang la bden 'dzin lhang nge'i tshe/ /gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i/ /rig pas gtan la phab pa yis/ /sgo nus bden med nges shes bsgoms/ /de tshe bden 'dzin mngon gyur pa/ /khegs pa'i lta ba skyes mod kyang / /bden med nyid du mngon zhen pa'i/ bden med do snyam pa'i mtshan 'dzin dam sbreng nge ba/ /mtshan 'dzin dus mnyam 'byung bas na/ /so sor ma 'dres dbye ba ni/ /'byed pa gal che dper mtshon na/ /lcags gong me ru 'bar ba'i skabs/ /lcags dang me rdul tha dad pa/ /yod la ltos zhes thams cad mkhyen/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gsungs/ /nyan rang byang chub thob pa la/ /bden pa med la mngon zhen pa'i/ /mtshan 'dzin cher dgag mi dgos kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la/ /gegs kyi gtso bo mtshan 'dzin yin/ /de nyid 'gog par byed pa la/ /med mtha' 'gog pa'i rig pa yis/ bden med du zhen 'dzin 'gog /dpyad la bden med du 'dzin bral/ /bsgom tshe de la rtag pa mthar bzung du gnyis dkar 'dzin pa byung na zhen pa yi/ /mtshan 'dzin byung na de la yang / /rig pas dpyad la mthar mtshan gnyis/ /bral ba'i nges shes bsgom pa na/ /gnyis ka gang yang ma yin pa'o/ /snyam pa'i mtshan 'dzin byung ba na/ /de yang gtan tshigs rig pa yi/ /spyod la mtha' bzhi bral ba yi/ /nges shes bskyed cing nges shes de/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges/ gnas lugs dpyod pa'i so skye'i blo gros kyis/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa gcig char mi kheg kyang / skye 'gog tshul gyis bzhi char bkag nas ni/ tshul bzhin bsgom pas mthong lam skyes pa'i tshe/

lta ba chos dbyangs mthong ba'i tha snyad mdzad/ /sems gnas zhi gnas dang zung 'brel/ /gyur nas bsgom pa'i gnas lugs don/ /de bzhin nyid sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa yi/ /gsal snang khyad par can skye zhing / /de las theg chen mthong ba'i lam/ /dang po'i sa yi ye shes ni/ /skye la tshegs med de yi tshe/ /chos dbyings mngon sum rtogs par gyur/ /go rams paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ /bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs kyis bzhed/ /de la lam lnga sa bcu yi/ nges 'byed bzhi mthong spang sgom spang sogs/ /sa bcad rnam gzhag sems tsam dang / /mtshungs shing mnyam gzhag lta ba'i skabs/ /spros kun bral ba rtogs min gyi/ bden med kyi zhen pa mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba/ /dbang gis 'phags chos khyad par gyur/ /de lta'i mthong lam sa dang po/ mdo sde sa bcu pa'i dgongs pa ltar 'chad pa la/ /rab tu dga' ba'i yon tan bshad/ /ming 'pho ba'i yon tan/ don thob pa'i yon tan/ dpes bstan pa'i yon tan/ gzhan zil gyis gnon pa'i yon tan/ phar phyin lhag pa'i yon tan dang lnga rim par ming 'pho'i yon tan don dam par/ /sems bskyed goms pa'i byang chub sems/ /lta ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa yi/ spros bral mtshan nyid pa/ /byang sems don gcig de rnams ni/ /dang po'i sa thob yan yod kyi/ /so so skye bo'i gnas skabs med/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ de nas bzung ste de ni thob par 'gyur ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'i sgra nyid can nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /don gyi thob pa'i yon tan ni/ /don dam byang chub sems bsgom pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs mchog tu/ /skyes sogs yon tan mang dang ldan/ /dper na 'phags pa nyan thos brgyad po las/ /rgyun zhugs der gnas yon tan dang / /thob pa'i tshul ni mtshungs pa'o/ /zil gnon yon tan sa dang po/ /thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /nyan rang dgra bcom bsod nams stobs/

/zil gyis gnon nus don dam pa'i/ /byang chub sems bskyed stobs kyis so/ /'o na byang sems tshogs sbyor bas/ /nyan rang zil gnon mi nus sam/ /zhe na don dam sems bskyed kyi/ /stobs kyis zil gyis mi non kyang / /kun rdzob sems bskyed gyis stobs kyi/ /zil non phar phyin lhag pa'i yon tan ni/ /dang po'i sa thob rjes thob tu/ /phar phyin drug las sbyin pa yi/ /pha rol phyin la lhag par spyod/ /btang ba'i snying stobs ches che zhing / /rang gzhan gnyis kar phan bde spel/ /gnyis pa dri ma med pa yi/ /sa yi yon tan rjes thob tu/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa la/ /longs spyod rmi lam tsam du yang / /'chal ba'i las bral dge ba'i las/ /cher 'phel tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ /nyes pa'i skyon dang bral ba yi/ /dri ma med par yongs su grags/ /gsum pa 'od byed rjes thob tu/ /gzhan gyi gnod pa la mi khro/ /snying rje lhag par 'phel ba yi/ /gnod bya gnod byed gnod tshul gsum/ /rang bzhin med par mngon sum mthong / /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /ye shes me 'od ches che bar/ /'phro bas 'od byed sa zhes grags/ /lnga pa sbyang dka'i rjes thob tu/ /bdud rnams kun gyis brdzi mi nus/ /thub bkas sbyang dka' zhes su grags/ /bsam gtan phar phyin lhag par spyod/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/ /blo gros zhib mos rtogs pa yi/ /yon tan mchog ni thob pa'o/ /drug pa mngon gyur la gnas pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' sher phyin la/ /lhag par longs spyod stobs kyis ni/ /theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob gyur te/ seng ge rnam par bsgying ba/ sgyu ma lta bu/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin/ /zhi gnas phul phyin mnyam gzhag la/ /gnas pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /ches cher mngon du gyur par phyogs/ /chos nyid mngon sum lhag mthong rten 'brel zab mo yis/

/mngon sum de bzhin nyid mthong ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen por gyur/ /bdun pa ring du song ba ni/ /drug par thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /'gog snyoms thob kyang skad cig gi /'jug ldang mi nus 'di yi skabs/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la/ /'gog pa yang dag mtha' la ni/ /'jug ldang nus shing thabs kyi ni/ pha rol phyin la lhag par spyod/ /brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'i gnas skabs/ /rnam par mi rtog pa la ni/ /dbang bsgyur rnam rtog gi bar gcod/ /bral zhing 'bad rtsol la mi ltos/ /bskal pa 'bum du bsags pa yi/ /dge rtse'i tshogs las cher lhag pa/ /yud tsam zhig la bsags nus pa/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid myur du thob/ /smon lam pha rol phyin pa la/ /lhag par spyod pa nyid yin no/ /dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros ni/ /stobs kyi pha rol phyin pa la/ /lhag par spyod cing yon tan gyi/ /khyad par so sor yang dag par/ /bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i chos/ tshig don/ spobs pa rig pa bzhi thob de'i stobs kyis/ /lta zhig mtha' dag dag gyur te/ /de bzhin yang dag rig pa'i chos/ /rang gi yon tan yang dag thob/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi de ni bye brag smra ba yi/ /nyan thos/ sor 'dod pa dgra bcom gyis thob mngon pa ni/ /sde bdun gyi ni dgongs pa dang / /'di ltar sa dgu pas thob pa/ 'dir bstan dbu ma'i lugs la so so yang dag rig bzhi/ /de ni mdo sde sa bcu pa'i/ /dgongs pa yin cing sangs rgyas kyi/ so so yang dag rig bzhi/ /thun mong ma yin yon tan du/ /bshad pa shes rab phar phyin gyi/ /dgongs pa yin zhes kun mkhyen rje/ /bsod nams seng ges dpyis phyin par/ /gsung pa bla na ma mchis par/ /blo ldan dag gis go dgos so/ /bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob tshe/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes chen po'i 'od zer gyis/ /mngon par dbang bskur legs thob cing /

/ye shes pha rol phyin pa la/ /lhag par spyod nas gdul bya rnams/ /dge ba'i lo tog bskyed pa'i phyir/ /chu 'dzin chen po 'khrigs pa ltar/ /'bad med lhun grub chos kyi char/ /rgyun chad med par 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /yon tan mchog la dbang thob bo/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas sa bshad par/ 'di la byang chub brnyes pa'i tshul/ brnyes bya sku'i rnam gzhag dus kyi sgo nas mchog tu bsngags dang gsum rim par ston pa/ /byang chub dam pa brnyes tshul ni/ /sangs rgyas sa myur thob mkhyen nas/ /gong gi sems tsam sangs rgyas yon tan bshad pa'i skabs gsal stobs bcu bskyed phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /sa la 'bad pa brtsams 'gyur zhing / /'bad de'i 'bras bu 'og min du/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog zhi ba/ /yon tan mthar thug brnyes pa'o/ /brnyes bya'i sku yi rnam gzhag ni/ /sku gsum yon tan bcas bshad par/ /shes dang po sku gsum bshad pa bya'i bud shing bsreg nas ni/ /skye 'gag sogs kyi spros pa dang / /bral ba'i skye med mngon gyur pa/ /zhi ba 'dir bstan chos sku yi/ /ngo bo chos sku de nyid kyi/ /gzugs kyi sgo nas dpag bsam gyi/ /shing ltar mtshan dpe gsal bar snang / /mdzad pa'i khyad par yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu bzhin du rnam par ni/ /mi rtog theg chen chos ston dang / /sku tshe sku tshe'i khyad par 'khor ba ji srid bzhugs/ /gdul bya'i khyad par spros bral mngon gyur pa'i/ /byang sems 'phags pa kho na la/ /snang ba'i skur bstan longs spyod rdzogs/ /de lta'i chos sku longs sku ni/ /ji ltar rigs pa'i mthu las ni/ /dang po rang gi thugs bskyed dang / /tshogs bsags pa dang de dag skabs/ /sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /gzhan yang dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs bskyed nas ni byang chub bar/ /mdzad spyod thams cad ba spu yi/ /khung bur dus gcig gsal snang ba'i/

/sku rnams rgyud mthun gyi sku yin/ /de nyid sku gsum gang zhe na/ /longs sku'i khong du bsdu dgos tsam/ /gnyis pa brten pa yon tan bshad pa yon tan bzhed pa tsam gyis kyang / /mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i yon tan ni/ /phra rab rdul gcig go sar yang / /nam mkha'i mtha' yas 'jig rten bstan/ /de nyid che chung mi 'gyur dang / /skad cig dus la'ang spyod pa ni/ mdzad phrin/ /sna tshogs 'dzam gling ma lus pa'i/ /phra rab rdul grangs ji snyed du/ /yod pas lhag par ston nus pa/ /sngar bshad sku gsum yon tan yin/ /mkhyen pa'i yon tan stobs bcu ni/ /sems tsam 'bras bu'i skabs bshad zin/ /sprul sku phrin las bcas bshad par/ /de ltar sku gsum brnyes zin nas/ /slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /mdzad pa rnam pa bcu gnyis kyis/ /rigs can gsum la rang skal dang / /mtshams par mngon mtho lha mi yi/ /bde ba nges legs myang 'das gsum/ /ci rigs pa la 'god par mdzad/ /mthar thug theg pa gsum bstan pa/ /yin nam zhe na mthar thug ni/ /theg pa gcig nyid kho na ste/ /slob dpon dpal ldan zla ba yi/ /gang phyir de ltar kho na nyid/ /gcig yin yul can ye shes ni/ /tha mi dad phyir theg pa gcig /zhes gsung theg dang lam myang 'das/ /yin na mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi/ /nyan rang gi lhag med myang 'das thob kyang sangs rgyas kyi myang 'das ma yin te myang 'das yin pas khyab par gsungs/ /theg gsum bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ /mthar thug theg pa che kho na/ /yin nam gnas skabs theg gsum du/ /bstan pa'i dgongs pa ci zhe na/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can rnams/ /nyon mongs shas che sangs rgyas par/ /theg chen lam la bkri mi gtub/ /thugs rje yal bar 'dor mi srid/ /des na re zhig 'khor ba'i skyon/ /nyes dmigs bshad nas rang gcig pu/ /thar pa tsam bkod ngal sems phyir/ /gdul bya'i blo tshod dang bstun no/ /gsum pa dus kyi sgo nas mchog tu bsngags pa dus kyi sgo nas mchog tu ni/

/bsngags la thog mar byang chub mchog /brnyes dus thog ma gang zhe na/ /thog mar byang chub dam pa bsnyes pa'i dus/ tha mar 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs pa'i dus dang gnyis las/ dang po/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas pa'i dus kyi thog ma gang zhe na 'jig rten khams ni yod do cog /rdul phran phra rab ji snyed pa/ /de grangs snyed pa'i bskal pa bzang / /de rnyed tshe na sangs rgyas so/ /de skad 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ /sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyu med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas lus bcas de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron/ /zhes gsung thog ma med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas de la dgongs pa yin/ /mkha' khyab 'jig rten khams mtha' yas/ /de rdul phra rab mtha' yas dang / /de snyed bskal pa bgrang yas par/ /thog ma med nas sangs rgyas bshad/ /gsar du sangs rgyas de ltar min/ /lam la 'bad pas de yi rigs/ nyan thos kyi shākya thub pa so skye'i gang zag zhig gsar du sangs rgyas par 'dod/ /theg chen la shākya thub pa gdod nas sangs rgyas zin/ de yi tshad bzung du med/ de bzhin du tshogs bsags pa'i dus tshad dang / mthar sangs rgyas pa'i dus kyang tshad bzung med pas bsam mi khyab la bzhag 'on kyang gdul bya kha drang pa'i phyir slar yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus kyi rnam gzhag mdzad/ /sangs rgyas thob pa lta bu yi/ /dus kyi thog ma'i tshad nges phyir/ /des na thog mar byang chub mchog /brnyes pa'i dus la tshad 'das pas/ /sgo nas mchog tu bsngags pa'o/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /gnyis pa sangs rgyas nas dus ci tsam bzhugs dus ni ji tsam bzhugs zhe na/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thabs shes rab/ /zung 'jug yon tan khyad par can/ /mthu las ma 'ongs dus kyi mtha'/ /mi mngon ji srid sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas sa la bkod pa'i bar/ /ji srid nam mkha' ma zhig bar/ /gzhan don phrin las mdzad cing bzhugs/

/'gro don rgyun chad med pa yi/ /mdzad pa mchog la bsngags pa'o/ /de ltar dbu ma'i grub pa'i mtha'/ /zhib par rgyal bas lung bstan pa/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs dang ni/ /slob dpon ār+ya de wa dang / /dpal ldan zla ba la sogs pa'i/ /bstan bcos dgongs 'grel las shes bya/ /de dag gi ni rgyu phar phyin/ /theg pa'i rnam gzhag bshad zin nas/ /'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje yi/ /theg pa'i rnam gzhag cung smos na/ /mdo las khyad par 'phags tshul ni/ /bstan bcos tshul gsum sgron me las/ /don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /gsung ltar phar phyin theg pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa gnyis thob bya sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang / /kun slong byang chub sems dang ni/ /rtog bya spros bral rtogs pa la/ /khyad par med kyang rtogs tshul la/ /phar phyin theg pa so skye'i skabs/ /chos nyid dpe yi tshul mngon gsum/ /mthong ba'i ye shes skye ba med/ /rdo rje theg par thabs zab mo'i/ mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes su/ /mngon gsum spros nus khyad par 'phags/ /sgrub tshul phar phyin theg pa las/ /ji skad bshad steng thabs kyi rgyud/ /mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig sogs/ dbang / bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ spyod pa/ nye rgyu/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ sbyin sreg rab gnas/ las tshogs/ /dam tshig /thabs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab 'phags/ /phar phyin theg par dka' ba ni/ /du ma spyad dgos rdo rje yi/ /theg par 'dod yon lam khyer gyi/ /spyod par bde zhing tshegs chung ba'i/ /'bras bu bde ba che thob 'phags/ /phar phyin 'bras bu thob pa la/ /bskal pa grangs mdo sum cu rtsa gsum 'gor zhing ji myur yang / /grangs med gsum 'gor rdo rje yi/ /theg par sangs rgyas sgrub pa la/ /gang zag dbang po'i khyad par gyi/ /tshe rab 'di 'bring bar do skye ba tha ma bdun/

/tha mas shin tu skye ba bcu drug na/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ni/ /mngon du byed nus khyad par 'phags/ gsang sngags pa rang bzhin gyi dbang po rno bas/ /de lta'i sngags lugs dngos bshad par/ /rgyud sde'i dbye ba mtha' yas kyang / /slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /rdo rje gur gyi rjes 'brang nas/ /rgyud sde bzhir bshad ltar 'chad na/ /phyi yi lus ngag bya ba khrus/ /gtsang sbra gtsor ston bya rgyud la/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud legs grub dang / /dpung bzang bsam gtan phyi ma ste/ /spyi yi rgyud chen bzhi zhes grags/ /so so'i rgyud la rdo rje 'i rigs dang / /pad+ma nor bu lnga rtsen las/ /'jig rten rigs te sgo drug yod/ /nang gses dbye ba mtha' yas so/ /sgrub tshul bya rgyud rang rkang la/ /rang nyid tha mal nga rgyal gnas/ /mdun gyi bris lhar bsgom pa yi/ /thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od kyi/ /spro bsdu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /byin rlabs bsdus nas sngags bzla zhing / /kun spyod gtso bo dka' thub dang / /gtsang sbrar gnas nas lhag pa'i lhar/ /rje dpon lta bu'i dngos grub len/ /sgrub thabs tshad ldan 'ga' zhig la/ /bya rgyud lha la bdag bskyed kyi/ /sgrub thabs yod rnams rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud la sogs ltar bkral ba'o/ /de bzhin smin byed dbang la ni/ /chu dang cod pan kho nar nges/ /sngags kyi bzlas lung bkru byab srung / /rin chen sna bdun rdzas brgyad rnams/ /byin rlabs dbang gi ming btags yin/ /bya rgyud rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /chu dang cod pan kho nar nges/ /dbang bzhi rim gnyis med par bzhed/ /'o na rgyud sde 'og ma'i skabs/ /bris sku lha ru bsgom pa de/ /kun rdzob snang ba lhar bsgom pa/ /'gyur ro zhes na gnad mi 'dra/ /bris 'bur sku rten rab gnas can/ /lhar bsgom phyag mchod phul ba yis/ /bsod nams tshogs rdzogs dgos pa yod/

/de ni lhar bsgom thabs mkhas kyi/ /khyad par yin la kun rdzob kyi/ /snang ba gzhan la dgos khyad med/ /bya ba'i rgyud la bdag lhar bskyed/ /de la bsnyung gnas mi rung ste/ /rang lhar bskyed nas brnyas na sdig /mchod na bsod nams thob 'gyur bar/ /bris sku lhar bsgom pa nyid legs/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la lus ngag gi /bya ba nang gi ting 'dzin gnyis/ /cha mnyam ston pas spyod rgyud grags/ /de la rnam snang mngon byang dang / /khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal sogs/ /sgrub tshul bris sku rang gnyis kar/ /lhar bsgom ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /spyan drangs tsam las mi bstim par/ /grogs po phan tshun phan 'dogs pa'i/ /tshul gyis dngos grub len pa'o/ /de yi smin byed chu cod pan/ /rdo rje dril bu ming dbang lnga/ /rnal 'byor rgyud zhes nang gi ni/ /ting nge 'dzin la gtso bor ston/ /de las rtsa bshad cha mthun rgyu/ /gsum sde de nyid 'dus pa dang / /ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs so/ /lha yi sgrub tshul phyi rol gyi/ /bris sku lha bskyed la dmigs pa'i/ /rkyen tsam byas nas gtso bo ni/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems par bskyed/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan 'dren bstim/ /phyag rgya ma bkrol de srid bzhugs/ /dngos grub len cing bkrol nas gshegs/ /dam tshig sems pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /thun mtshams bya ba rnam sgrub pa/ /smin byed dbang la chu cod pan/ /rdor dril ming dang de yi steng / /phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang / /slob dpon gyi ni dbang zhes grags/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa ni/ /ting 'dzin khyad par bla na 'phags/ /thabs kyi cha nas gtsor ston pa/ /pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa ste/ /'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis/ /bkral ba mi bskyod rdo rje dang / /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ /bkral ba 'jam pa'i rdo rjer grags/ /bod du 'gos lo lhas btsas dang / /mar pa chos kyi blo gros dang /

/gnyen lo chen po sogs kyis spel/ /gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs zhes pa/ /jo bo chen pos bkral ba'o/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skor/ /rwa chen lo tsā skyo 'od 'byung / /zhang pa shes rab bla ma dang / /chag lo glo bo lo tsā ba/ /shes rab rin chen sogs las 'phel/ /ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog ni/ /rgya gar slob dpon dril bu pa/ /lū hi pa dang nag po pas/ /bkral ba'i lugs gsum gtso bo dang / /gzhan yang slob dpon la ba pa/ mai tri'i bcu gsum ma gnyis dang / /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sdom 'byung dang / /sbyong ba'i yon tan bong zhal sogs/ /mang mod bod du mal lo tsā/ /rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras/ /ngor chen brgyud 'dzin bcas las dar/ /gnyis med rgyud kyi gtso bo ni/ /snying po kyai yi rdo rje la/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas/ /bkral ba'i man ngag lugs dang ni/ /de bzhin ḍom+bhi he ru ka /mtsho skyes rdo rje nag po pas/ /bkral ba'i bka' bab rnam pa bzhi/ /'phags pa'i yul na yongs su grags/ /bod du kyai yi rdo rje yi/ /smin grol gdams pa rgyud rgya gzhung / /bshad bka' ma lus yongs rdzogs ni/ /'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po/ /shākya ye shes ma dros pa'i/ /mtsho las chu bo bzhi lta bu'i/ /'khon ston dkon mchog rgyal po dang / /se ston kun rig mnga' ris pa/ /gsal ba'i snying po mchims lo tsā/ /bzhis blang yur ba lta bu yi/ /sgyi chu dgra lha 'bar dang ni/ /zhang ston chos 'bar gnyis kyis drangs/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yongs rdzogs kyi/ /bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa/ /yab sras slob brgyud bcas pa la/ /brgyud de dar zhing rgyas pa'o/ /dam pa dang po yi sangs rgyas/ /dus kyi 'khor lo rgya gar du/ /tsi lu pa dang dus zhabs pa/ /che chung sogs kyis rgyas par spel/ bod du kha che zla ba mgon/ /'bro lo rwa lo chos rab sogs/ /brgyud de bu ston thams cad mkhyen/

/brgyud par bcas pa sogs las 'phel/ /bla med lha yi sgrub tshul ni/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems par bskyed/ /ye shes 'khor lo bstim nas ni/ /nam yang mi 'bral tha mal gyi/ /'jug pa'i snang grags chos thams cad/ /lha bsgom de bzhin nyid dag pa/ /lha ni so so'i dag pa dang / /de bzhin rang rig dag pa ni/ /gsum las nam yang mi g.yo ba'i/ /sgo nas dngos grub len pa yin/ /'di yi smin byed dbang bzhi dang / /grol byed lam ni rim gnyis las/ /brten nas gtan bde phyag rgya che/ /mchog gi dngos grub tshe gcig la/ /'grub pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par gyi/ /legs tshogs phul du byung ba'o/ /'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang de bzhin du/ /so nam tshul bzhin byas pa yis/ /lo tog rim gyis smin pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i sa bon ni/ /nyi ma gcig la lo tog smin/ /rdo rje theg pa'i thabs shes na/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub/ zhus so// ༈ /gtan du bde ba mchog thob lam/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /sdom gsum bka' drin legs stsol mgon/ /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par 'dud/ /grub mtha' bzhi dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /nyams len snying por dril ba na/ /de dag sdom pa gsum du 'dus/ /bdag nyid chen po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gis/ /legs gsung sdom gsum rab dbye yi/ /dgongs don mdor bsdus 'di ltar bkod/ /thog mar bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan don/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab dbye zhes/ /so thar byang sems sngags sdom gsum/ /len pa'i cho ga de'i bslab bya/ /mthar thug 'bras bu 'byin tshul dang / /nyams su len pa'i gnad so so'i/ /'khrul pa bkag nas ma 'khrul pa/ /sgrub pa'i rnam dbye'i gsung yin no/

/sdom pa gsum gyi tha snyad ni/ /rgyud ni rdo rje rtse mo las/ /gsung de sum ldan gyi rgyud kyi/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la/ /sdom pa gsum yin sngags sdom gtso/ /skabs 'di'i so byang gnyis po ni/ /sngags kyis rtsis kyi ma zin pa/ /kho na yin pa'i rnam dbye gces/ /mchod brjod dang po rtsa ba yi/ bla ma dam pa sogs dang mchod brjod sh+lau ka gcig /bla ma grub gnyis mchog sbyin pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur ni/ /yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon skabs 'di ru/ 'di stag tshang dang / dga' gdong pas bshad tshul 'dra min byung / rang lugs bdag nyid chen por tshangs spyod dge bsnyen lugs gnyis byang sdom sngags sdom stsol ba sogs bzhed/ /rje btsun rin po che nyid do/ /de nas mchod brjod tshig skyon med yon tan sogs/ rkang gnyis/ /sdom gsum bca' ba'i ston pa mchog /shākya seng ger phyag 'tshal mdzad/ /de nas tshig rkang dad ldan sangs rgyas sogs/ gnyis po ni/ /bshad yul bshad bya'i chos bstan pa/ /de nas tshig mkhas rnams dga' ba'i sogs/ bzhi bshad tshul lo/ /de nas tshig bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa sogs/ bzhi kun slong bstan/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang / /zhes nas rnam dbye bshad kyi nyon/ /bar 'di bstan bcos mchog gi lus/ /don tshan bcu gcig gis 'khrul pa/ /'gog cing ma 'khrul bar bsgrub don/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ /zhes nas skyes bu de la ni/ /sde snod rnam dbye med par zad/ /zhes 'di sor sdom nyams len la/ /'bri gung pa yi sor sdom la/ /ji srid 'tsho sgra lus dang sems/ /gnyis kar dgongs zhes zer ba dang / /de la sems bskyed kyis ma zin/ /so thar sdom pa gtong yang des zin pa'i/ /sdom pa mi btang zer ba bkag /rang lugs nyan thos sor sdom ni/ /rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa'i/ /lus ngag las ni skye ba yi/

/gzugs can sdom pa 'chi tshe gtong / /dge 'bras tshe 'phos nas kyang 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed ni/ /gzugs can ma yin sems la skyes/ /ji srid sems ni ma nyams bar/ /de srid sdom pa yod par bzhed/ /lung rigs 'thad ldan mang pos sgrub/ /lus ngag sems las skyes pa gnyis/ /ldog tshul rnam dbye de ltar mdzad/ /bye brag smra ba'i bsnyen gnas nas/ /yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams che/ /bar 'di'i bka' gdams pa la las/ /bsnyen gnas 'bul dang gzhan la 'chol/ /lha bsgom tha dad log rtog dgag /bye smras bsnyen gnas dge slong las/ /len cing gling gsum mi kho na/ /mdo sde'i blang yul dge bsnyen sogs/ /gang rung las blang gling gsum gyi/ /mi dang klu klu gzhon nu tsam pa ka dang bcas la skyes/ /nyan thos sde gnyis cho ga skyabs 'gro'i tshul gyis 'bog /don zhags rtogs par bsnyen gnas ni/ /rang nyid kyis blang cho ga ni/ /sems bskyed 'dra ba'i khyad par gsung / /bye brag smra bas tho rangs kyi/ /mtha' nas sang gi tho rangs bar/ /de bzhin mdo sde pa yis kyang / /nam 'dod tshe nas sang de'i bar/ /srung ba'i nyin zhag gcig gis khrims/ /blang skyes 'bul dang 'chol mi dgos/ /lha bsgom nyan thos gzhung lugs la/ /ma bshad byas na'ang 'gal ba med/ /rnam rgyal stong mchod lta bu gso sbyong dang 'brel gsang sngags kyi/ /yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams 'phel/ /theg pa chen po las byung ba'i/ /zhes nas so thar rigs brgyad po/ /byang sems so sor thar par gyur/ /zhes bar rang lugs theg chen gyi/ /so thar cho ga nub ma nub/ /sogs kyi dbye ba so so ru/ /phyes nas deng sang lag len du/ /dgos pa'i cho ga dmigs bsal gsung / /byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar/ /'bog chog yod mod phar cher nub/ /gso sbyong rang gi blang ba sogs/ /cho ga'i lag len yod par gsung / /da lta'i phyag len gnang ba ni/

/bsam pa byang chub sems kyis zin/ /cho ga nyan thos lugs bzhin mdzad/ /blang ba'i so thar rigs brgyad po/ /byang sems so thar gyur zhes bzhed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /so thar sogs nas lugs gnyis po/ /de 'dra'i rnam dbye shes par bya/ /zhes pas rang lugs theg chen gyi/ /so thar len pa'i cho ga las/ /'phros nas bslab bya'i khyad par gsung / /byang sems so thar bslab bya ni/ /sdig to mi dge ba yi phyogs/ /nyan thos bzhin srung rang 'dod kyi/ /dben pa'i ltung ba byang sems kyi/ /lugs bzhin srung nas 'jig rten pa/ /ma dad gyur rnams 'bad pas srung / /'jig rten thar pa'i lam 'jug pa'i/ /rgyu ru gyur na theg pa che/ /so sor thar pa la ni gnang / /nyan thos sems can don yin yang / /'dod pa chen la ltung ba 'byung / /theg chen byang sems gzhan don phyir/ /'dod chen ltung ba med ces bzhed/ /theg chen so sor thar sogs nas/ /'bras bu shi yang 'byung gi bar/ /zhar byung gtor tshul nyan thos kyi/ /cho ga las blang sdom pa yi/ /ldog pa shi ba'i tshe na gtong / /byang chub sems kyi ldog pa dang / /dge 'bras shi yang 'byung bar bzhed/ /las 'bras skabs kyi 'khrul bkag don/ /des na las dang rnam smin gyis/ /sogs nas nyid du gyur bar don/ /theg pa che chung gnyis mthun par/ /las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin du/ /byed pa so thar bslab bya'i gtso/ /las la dge sdig lung ma bstan/ /yin ces rgyal bas mdo las gsung / /dge ba legs par spyad pa ste/ /rnam smin bde ba skyed pa yin/ /sdig pa nyes par spyod pa ste/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal skyed par byed/ /btang snyoms gnyis ka ma yin pas/ /rnam par smin pa'ang gnyis ka min/ /'di dag byas pa'i las yin pas/ /'dus byas yin par shes par bya/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'dus ma byas/ /yin pa'i phyir na las ma yin/ /des na dge dang sdig pa min/ /las la thub pas rnam gnyis gsungs/

/sems pa dang ni bsam pa'o/ /sems pa yid kyi las yin te/ /bsam pa de ni lus ngag gi'o/ /chos kyi dbyings ni gnyis ka min/ /de phyir dge sdig las las grol/ /gzhan yang las la rnam bzhi gsungs/ /las dkar rnam smin dkar ba dang / /las gnag rnam smin gnag pa dang / /las dkar rnam smin gnag pa dang / /las gnag rnam smin dkar ba'o/ /bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin pa sogs/ /gnyis ka dkar bas mkhas pas bya/ /bza' ba'i don du gsod pa sogs/ /gnyis ka gnag pas mkhas pas spang / /mang po bskyabs phyir gcig gsod sogs/ /las gnag rnam smin dkar na bya/ /gzhan don 'byung nges lung rigs kyis/ /gyur nges rang 'dod ma 'dres bya/ /ma brtags pa dang yin zol spangs/ /bsod phyir sbyin pa gtang la sogs/ /las dkar rnam smin gnag pa spang / /gzhan yang las la rnam gnyis gsungs/ /'phen byed las dang rdzogs byed las/ /de dag dbye na mu bzhi yod/ /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed kyang ni dge ba dang / /'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed kyang ni sdig pa dang / /'phen byed dge la rdzogs byed sdig /'phen byed sdig la rdzogs byed dge /las kyis 'phangs dang 'phen zhes pas/ /skye ba yin zhing las gtso zhes/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gsungs/ /de dag dper brjod mdor bsdus pa/ /bshad par bya yis yid la zungs/ /mtho ris gsum po 'grub pa ni/ /dge ba'i las kyis 'phen pa yin/ /de dag bde ba 'byung ba ni/ /rdzogs byed dge bas 'phangs pa yin/ /ngan song gsum du skye ba ni/ /'phen byed sdig pa yin par gsungs/ /de yi sdug bsngal bye brag kun/ /rdzogs byed las ni sdig pa yin/ /mtho ris dge bas 'phangs mod kyi/ /de yi nad dang gnod pa kun/ /rdzogs byed sdig pa yin par gsungs/ /ngan 'gro'i 'phen byed sdig yin yang / /de yi lus sems bde ba yin/ /gnas skabs dge bas 'phangs par gsungs/

/gzhan yang gcig tu dkar ba dang / /gcig tu gnag dang 'dren ma'i las/ /rnam pa gsum du thub pas gsungs/ /gcig tu dkar bas bde ba bskyed/ /gcig tu gnag pas sdug bsngal bskyed/ /'dren ma'i las kyi bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal 'dren ma bskyed par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don 'di dngos 'gal la/ /lhan cig 'dres pa mi 'byung mod/ /kun slong gtso che'i sbyor ba yi/ /'bras de sngon myong kun slong gi /'bras bu rjes su 'byung ba yin/ /'di 'dra'i las dang rnam smin gyi/ /rnam par dbye ba shes gyur na/ /da bzod las kyi rgyu 'bras la/ /shin tu mkhas pa nyid du 'gyur/ /bod kyi bla ma zhang g.yu brag /sogs kyis gshis la dge sdig yod/ /zer ba'i log rtog bkag pa ni/ /mu stegs grangs can pa rnams kyis/ /zhes nas de nyid rgyal sras kyi/ /dge ba yin par shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar du lung rigs kyis/ /dgag dang sgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ /'khrul gzhi rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi/ /bsngo bar 'gro kun dge ba ni/ /ji snyed yod ces tshig sgra dang / /mngon par don dam dge ba zhes/ /de la 'khris te rang byung gis/ /grub 'dod bde gshegs snying po zer/ /rgyu yi skabs nas 'bras bu ni/ /gnas par 'dod pa mu stegs lugs/ /bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med rnams don gcig /chos dbyings zhes pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ /'khor 'das chos snod bcud bem shes dge sdig bar ma gsum sogs/ rnams kun gyi dbyings/ /ris bral mang nyung dang 'gyur ba med/ mu bzhi dus gsum las/ /'das pa dri med lung gis 'grub/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid/ /'gyur med dpe ru nam mkha' gsungs/ /'di skabs bkrol lung don 'di bkol ba yin/ /'bri gung pa 'gas gzhi bde gshegs snying / /stong nyid lam snying rje'i snying po ru/ /'dod kyang bde gshegs snying po'i khams/

/sbyong byed tsam las khams dngos min/ /de yang mdo rgyud lung gis ston/ /nyan thos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /dge zhes sems byung dad sogs bcu gcig yin/ /don dam dge ba de bzhin nyid/ /sdig pa 'khor ba nam mkha' dang / /so sor brtag min lung ma bstan/ /bshad pa'i btags don 'khor ba las/ /sdig 'byung mkha' dang brtag min gnyis/ /'bras 'gog phyir na lung ma bstan/ /dge ba 'bras bu bde bskyed pa'i/ /dge dngos min kyang sdig mngon gyur/ /med pa'i phyir na dge ba zhes/ /dper na nad bral lus bde la/ /mya ngan med pas sems bde zhes/ /sdug bsngal med pa tsam zhig la/ /bde bar 'jig rten la grags pa/ /dpe ru mdzad cing chos dbyings ni/ /dge byas ha cang thal 'gyur te/ /chos kun chos dbyings la gtogs phyir/ /sdig dang lung ma bstan dger 'gyur/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i 'gro mi 'byung / /la las byams dang snying rje sogs/ /gshis dger 'dod kyang nges pa med/ /gnyen du byams nas dge 'dun gyi/ /'tsho ba byin pas dmyal bar skye/ /ris bral 'gro la byams snying rjes/ /gnas skabs mngon mtho mthar thug du/ /nges legs thob byed thabs kyis ni/ /sbyin sogs la 'jug dge ba yin/ /de ltar 'gro kun gyis byas pa'i/ 'bad pas sgrub pa'i/ /dge ba la dgongs 'gro kun gyi/ /dge ba ji snyed yod ces gsungs/ /chos dbyings spros pa kun bral la/ /ji snyed mang nyung tha snyad med/ /mdor na sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /gus par byed kun chos kyi dbyings/ /mtha' bzhi las grol bya byed sogs spros kun bral/ shes bya gsungs/ /gzhan yang yod dge chos nyid yin/ /zhe na 'gro kun dge smos kyi/ /yod mtha' bem po dngos med mtha' med 'phags pa yi/ lam sgrub pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i phyogs te chos dbyings khongs su 'du/ /'di gsum khongs su chos dbyings mi 'du/

/chos nyid rnam grangs bgrang dgos 'gyur/ /gzhung de'i dgongs don nges pa ni/ /mchod sbyin lta bu 'gro kun gyi/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pa yi/ /sgo nas byas pa'i dge ba ni/ /ji snyed zhes pa mang po'i tshig /byas pa 'das dang byed 'gyur ni/ /ma 'ongs byed pa da ltar ba/ /dus gsum gis bsdus gzhan dge dang / /rdo rje rgyal mtshan nyid kyis kyang / /dus gsum mdzad pa'i dge ba la/ /sbyar yang rung ste de ltar yin/ /de ltar yod pa zhes bya ni/ /dus gsum du bsgrub dge ba'i tshogs/ /yod rnams zhes pa'i don yin no/ /bsngo ba'i don ni dam pa gsum/ kun slong sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi dmigs med/ rjes bsngo ba/ /gyis zin dge rtsa bsgyur spel ched/ /yin gyi chos dbyings 'dus ma byas/ /mtha' bral 'gyur ba med pa la/ /bsngo ba 'bras bu'i dben pa yin/ /gal te bsngo bya'i dge min yang / /byang sems blo sbyang gis bsngo rung / /zer na mi rung nyes pa yod/ /chos dbyings spros bral dger dmigs na/ /dmigs pa'i bsngo ba dug can 'gyur/ /chos dbyings spros bral mdangs 'gag med/ /ngang nas dge tshogs sgrub pa rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du bsngo ba ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong gyur/ /dmigs pa med pa'i bsngo ba'i gnad/ /yin zhes mdo rgyud kun las gsungs/ /chos nyid 'di yongs grags kyi brjod pa de yin mi 'gyur bden pa zhes/ /bden stobs brjod bya yin bzhin du/ /de nyid bsngo bya ga la yin/ /la las bde gshegs snying po'i sgra/ /sems can kho na khams yin 'dod/ /de ni dngos yod dang don byed nus min dngos med/ /spros bral gsum las gzhan mi 'byung / /dngos yod bem po sems can zhes/ /'dod pa de ni mu stegs lugs/ /rig pa shes par rnam shes tshogs brgyad po/ /'dus byas yin pas bde gshegs kyi/ /snying po 'dus ma byas pa de/

/ma yin skabs 'gar zag med kyi/ /sems rgyud gsungs pa kun gzhi yi/ /rnam par shes kyi gsal char dgongs/ /ma bsgribs lung ma bstan zhes pa/ /tshogs drug dmigs pas ma thog pa/ /lung du ma bstan dge ba yi/ /tha snyad med cing dngos med na/ /dge sdig mi 'thad spros bral na/ /sngar gyi chos dbyings de las ci/ /de ni dge sdig gnyis ka'i phyogs/ /ma lhung rgyun mtshan sngar bstan zin/ /bem dbyings bde gshegs snying min yang / /sems can chos dbyings bde gshegs snying / /yin nam snyam na de min te/ /chos dbyings dbyer med spros bral yin/ /sems can 'khrul grol gnyis ka 'byung / /'phags mchog klu sgrub zhal snga nas/ /stong pa nyid la kun rung gsung / /byams pas skyon lnga sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag cag lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ spang phyir dang / /sems can myang 'das la drang phyir/ /bde gshegs snying po gsungs pa yang / /dgongs gzhi stong nyid la dgongs so/ /bsngo tshe chu sbreng mu stegs lugs/ /sngon gyi lo rgyus thams cad sgrol sbyin yul ni/ /bram ze mgu ba'i thabs mkhas tsam/ /de las gzhan du dgos ched med/ /bsngo ba la ni mdor bsdu na/ /gnas dang gnas min gnyis su gsung / /gnas kyi bsngo ba mtshan gzhi bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa nyid sogs tshig bzhi'i don lta bu/ sems can gyi/ /don phyir rang gi dge ba'i tshogs/ /sgrub nus rang nyid sangs rgyas thob/ /de thob mchog gi yon tan des/ /sems can srid mtsho las sgrol smon/ /des ni sems bskyed khyad par can/ /thabs mkhas dge ba'i 'bras bu yi/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas nges par thob/ /de thob pas ni sems can kun/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol nus par/ /nges de gnas kyi bsngo ba yin/ /gnas min mtshan gzhi dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun sogs tshigs bzhi'i don lta bu rang gi dge ba'i tshogs/

/bsgrub mthus 'khor ba stong gyur cig /smon kyang dbyings kyi chos nyid ni/ /min rung 'khor ba'i mtha' med pa/ /lta bu rten 'brel dmigs pa med kyang 'gag med rten 'brelachos nyid de/ /smon pas mi 'gyur gnas min gyi/ /bsngo bar bshad cing de gnyis ka /mdo las gsung zhing rang nyid kyis/ /byang chub thob pa'i phan yon 'byung / /des na bshags bya'i sdig pa dang / /bsngo bar bya ba'i dge ba ni/ /byas pa yi ni las zhig dgos/ /de yi rnam gzhag mdor dril na/ /chags sdang rmongs gsum gtogs kun sdig /ma chags mi sdang rmongs med dge /de yang nyan thos byang sems gnyis/ /dge sdig rnam gzhag mi mtshungs te/ /sdig to kun spang gnyis ka mtshungs/ /nyan thos gzhan don byas na yang / /nyes par brtsi zhing byang sems kyis/ /'dod pas dben pas gzhan don du/ /'gyur med thabs mkhas kyis zin pa'i/ /'dod yon lnga la spyod pa sogs/ /ltung ba med cing dge bar 'gyur/ /'bri gung pa 'gas las kyi 'bras/ /dkar nag zangs thal log rtog ni/ /dgag la dkar nag zangs thal nas/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin shes par gyis/ /bar gsung de ni drang don la/ /nges pa'i don du 'khrul pa yin/ /thub dbang bsnyun tshul bstan pa sogs/ /sngon nas rnam smin du gsungs pas/ /gdul byar dgongs dgos drang don yin/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo yis gsal/ /gal te las smin longs sku la/ smin par/ /rigs te thub dbang sprul pa tsam/ /dper na sgyu ma mkhan po yi/ /las ngan sgyu ma mkhan de las/ /des sprul sgyu mar mi 'byung mod/ /ye bkag ye gnang zhes sogs nas/ /sangs rgyas yin par gsung pa'i don/ /rang bzo'i rig pas ye bkag dang / /ye gnang 'dod pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i nang min nyan thos kyi/ /sde bzhi'i srung tshul gnang bkag rnams/ /tha dad lung gis gsal bar ston/ /de bzhin rab tu byung la bkag /khyim par bkag med nyan thos la/

/gnang ba theg chen la bkag dang / /mdo sngags phan tshun gnang bkag gi /rnam dbye tha dad yod pa rnams/ /rang rang lugs bzhin byed pa gces/ /rab byung la bcas 'gro gzhan la/ /min pa rjes 'brang la snying nad/ /sangs rgyas bde sdug byed po ru/ /zer ba 'brel med log rtog go /thub dbang mchog gi phan bde yi/ /'bras 'byung sdom pa'i zhing stsal ba/ /snying nad yin na 'jig rten na/ /zhing med dbul por zhing bzang byin/ /snying nad du 'gyur tha shal gtam/ /chags sdang rmongs gsum kun la sdig /so byang sdom pa blang zin nas/ /'gal bar gyur na bcas pa'i sdig /ma bcas ltung ba 'byung 'dod 'khrul/ /longs sku grub thob brtul zhugs spyod/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma rnal 'byor gyi/ /chas su zhugs rnams ye bkag gi /gshis kyi ma dge can 'dod dam/ /thub pa'i dbang pos tshul khrims kyi/ /bslab pa bcas kyang bde sdug gi /byed por mi 'gyur bde sdug rgyu/ /las kyi byed po sems yin pas/ /de nyid 'dul ba'i thabs zab mo/ /bslab pa 'cha' yi byed po ni/ /ston mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /gshis la rang grub dge ba med/ /cha lugs tsam la'ang dge yod min/ /kun slong dge zhing sdom pa blang / /bslab bya cha lugs tshul bzhin ldan/ /dge ba rnam grol lam bzang yin/ /nyan thos so thar dgag pa yi/ /'dul spyod ma yin spangs dgos don/ /sbu gu can dang gong ba can/ /zhes nas la sogs bya ba kun/ /'dul ba'i gzhung dang mthun par gyis/ /zhes gsung don ni 'dul ba yi/ /spyod 'gal 'gyod pas bshags par bya/ /bstan phan bsgrub par ma nus yang / 'gal rigs rnam pa kun mi bya/ /bsgrub pa'i bslab bya mdo bskul sogs/ /'dul gzhung mthun par bya dgos don/ /mdo bskul ring mo zhes sogs nas/ /bden brdzun dbye bar nus ma yin/ /zhes don mdo rgyud las ma bshad/ /rang bzo 'bad pas sgrub na 'khrul/ /dka' sla gang du gyur na yang /

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsung ltar bsgrub/ /la la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhes nas sgo gsum de ltar gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /nges don bod dag sangs rgyas kyi/ /bka' dang dgongs 'brel bstan bcos ni/ /rnam dag nyan bshad mi byed pa/ /'brel med blun po'i tshig bstan bcos/ /nyan bshad ngal ba don med yin/ /dri ma med pa rgyal ba'i bka'/ /dgongs 'grel mkhas dang grub pa yi/ /bstan bcos rnams la thos bsam bsgoms/ /tshul bzhin byas pas don gnyis 'grub/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin par bsngags/ /so thar skabs te dang po'o/ /byang sems sdom pa'i nyams len ni/ /sems bskyed nyan rang theg chen ste/ /theg pa gsum gyi sems bskyed gsum/ /theg chen dbu sems lugs gnyis yod/ /len pa'i cho ga bslab bya sogs/ /tha dad yod ces spyir bstan don/ /sems bskyed la ni nyan thos dang / /zhes pa sogs nas phyir bcos dang / /bslab par bya ba'ang so sor yod/ /gzhan ni go sla nyan thos kyi/ /lhag med dgra bcom thob 'dod dang / /rang rgyal rnams kyis rten 'brel ni/ /lugs ldog mtha' ru phyin pa'i 'bras/ /bdag med phyed dang gnyis rtogs nas/ /rang rgyal gyi ni byang chub zhes/ /sangs rgyas med pa'i zhing khams su/ /gdul bya rnam dag lam la bkri/ /de ltar thob 'dod sems bskyed pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis sems can don/ /sems bskyed bcas la rnam gsum bshad/ /theg chen dbu ma sems tsam gnyis/ /lta ba mtho dman tha dad pas/ /cho ga ltung dang phyir bcos dang / /bslab bya'ang mi 'dra so sor gsung / /sems tsam sems bskyed kyi skabs su/ /bka' gdams dge bshes phyag ser bas/ /rmi lam la brten sems tsam gyi/ /sems bskyed skye bo kun la byas/ /don dam sems bskyed cho ga las/ /len pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /sems tsam pa yi sems bskyed 'di/ /bod na byed pa zhes sogs nas/

/dbu ma pa yi gzhung bzhin gyis/ /zhes don dbu ma sems tsam gnyis/ /lta ba mtho dman tha dad pas/ /sems bskyed cho ga yang dog gyur/ /rang lugs sems tsam lugs kyi ni/ /sems bskyed skye bar rung ba'i rten/ /sdig shas chung zhing so sor thar/ /rigs bdun gang rung sdom ldan dgos/ /gzhan la mi rung tshul 'phags pa/ /thogs med zhabs dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /jo bo chen po'i gsung gis gsal/ /de yi cho ga'i phyag len ni/ /sbyor ba'i skabs su phyag 'tshal dang / /skyabs 'gro byas nas sems bskyed kyi/ /rten du 'os min bar chad dri/ /dngos gzhi smon pa sems bskyed dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la/ /bslab cing de don nges nas ni/ /'jug pa sems bskyed nyid len dang / /cho ga'i tshig la nyan tsam las/ /rjes zlos mi byed de yi mjug /mkhyen par gsol bar mdzad pa'o/ /ltung ba'i bslab bya slob dpon ni/ /tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa yi/ /sdom pa nyi shu ji bzhin srung / /ltung ba bcos tshul nyon mongs pas/ /chen pos pham pa lta bu yi/ /chos bzhi bskyed na sdom pa ni/ /gsar du len cing nyon mongs 'bring / /chung ngu spyad na yul sdom ldan/ /gsum la gcig gi mdun du bshags/ /dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed ni/ /'bog pa'i yul ni gang yang rung / /sdong po bkod pa skal bzang dang / /dkon brtsegs rgyal por gdams pa dang / /nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las gsal/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub zhi ba lhas/ /gsung bzhin sbyor bar yan lag bdun/ /tshang par mdzad cing dngos gzhi'i skabs/ /smon 'jug gnyis ni stabs gcig len/ /mjug du rang gzhan dga' ba bsgoms/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i mdor gsungs ltar/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhir bslabs/ /byang chub sems dpa' skya rings la/ /gsol ba btab pas nam mkha'i snying / /rmi lam du ni 'byung ba la/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bshags pa dang / /spyod 'jug shes bzhin srung ba yi/

/le'ur bshad ltar bsgrub pa'o/ /des na dbu sems rnam gnyis la/ /lta ba'i yangs dogs khyad par gyis/ /rten la sdom ldan dgos min dang / /bslab bya'ang mang nyung cung zad 'gyur/ /dbu ma lugs kyi lung kun 'khor lo bar pa nyid/ /yid bzhin sems tsam lung mi 'gyur/ /rten dang cho ga'i khyad par lam/ /lta ba dbu ma ltar byed nas/ /spyod pa sems tsam ltar byas na/ /lta spyod shin tu legs par 'gyur/ /de ltar rnam dbye shes par bya/ /gdul bya ris su ma chad par/ /sangs rgyas sa bon 'jog 'dod na/ /cho ga 'khrul pa med pa yi/ /dbu ma'i lugs bzhin byas na legs/ /bka' gdams pa ni kha cig gis/ /don dam sems bskyed cho ga las/ /len pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /don dam sems bskyed ces zhes nas/ /ci 'gyur brtag dgos po yi bar/ /gsungs pa'i don ni don dam gyi/ /sems bskyed cho ga sbyor dngos rjes/ /tshang ba rgyal dang mkhas pa yi/ /gsung pa med cing dbyibs mtshungs tsam/ /yod na brda las byung ba dang / /dam bca'i tshig yin cho ga min/ /don dam chos nyid kyis thob zhes/ /lam ni ji bzhin bsgom pa yis/ /mthu las byung ste bsam gtan dang / /zag med sdom pa lta bu yin/ /sbyin btang la sogs dam bca' rigs/ /cho ga yin na thug med 'gyur/ /bslab bya dbu sems thun mong du/ /ltung ba'i rnam gzhag bstan pa ni/ /de ltar sems tsam dbu ma gnyis/ /sogs nas de ltar gsung gi bar/ /ltung med bsam pa dge ba yis/ /sbyin pa la sogs yin mi dge ba'i/ /srog gcod rnam kun ltung bar 'gyur/ /gzhan phan 'gyur nges yin na gzhal bsad pa sogs/ /ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan yin gzhan la ni/ /gnod par 'gyur na brdzun dngos ni/ /min kyang ltung med gzugs brnyan yin/ /mdor na dge sdig sems nyid gtso/ /gnad kyi gtso bo gzhan phan yin/ /'bri gung pa 'gas bdag dang gzhan/ /brje yi sems bskyed bsgom mi rungs/

/zhes pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /byang chub sems kyi bslab pa zhes/ /sogs nas bar du'ang 'jig rten gyi/ /phun sum tshogs par 'byung bar gsungs/ /bar gyi lung rigs kyis bsgrub don/ /grub thob gsung la drang nges don/ /ma rtog dor zhen tsam gyis min/ /bdag gzhan dngos rje'i skabs ma yin/ /smon 'dun tsam gyis brje ba yin/ /zad dang mi skye bzod thob zhes/ /bden bzhi mngon du 'gyur pa'i skabs/ /spang byas mi brdzi bzod pa thob/ /dbu ma pa yi sa dang po/ /sems tsam ltar na sa brgyad thob/ /'khor bar mi ltung sdug bsngal med/ /zhi ba lha yi spyod 'jug las/ /'khor ba spong phyir lam gyi gtso/ /bdag gzhan brje bar bsgom dgos zhes/ /gsung 'di dang po'i las can gyi/ /skabs su mthong zhing 'phags rgyud kyi/ /lung min de yis gsal bar 'gyur/ /dge la sdug bsngal 'byung mi srid/ /bdag gzhan brje bar bsgom pa ni/ /byang chub sems pa'i bslab bya yi/ /gtso bo 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /bdag 'dzin gdul ba'i gnyen po'i mchog /gnas skabs phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /mthar thug rnam grol go 'phang mchog /myur thob bdag gzhan brje ba yi/ /byang chub sems bsgom legs pa yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'o/ /byang chub sems bskyed nyams len gyi/ /gnad ma 'phyug pa dgos pa'i don/ /byang chub sems kyi gnad sogs nas/ /sangs rgyas rgyu yi gtso bo yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni sangs rgyas pa/ /thob byed gzhan med byang chub kyi/ /sems kyi gnad nyid ma 'khrul gtso/ /nyan thos dag gi gang zag bdag /phung khams skye mched stong par shes/ /nam mkha' lag mthil mnyam pa sogs/ /chos kun rtogs pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ /'bras bu 'gog pa lhag med kyi/ /myang 'das thob kyang snang srid kyi/ /chos kun mnyam nyid ma rtogs dang / /so sor thar pa'i mdo bklag dgos/ /sems can thub dbang thub 'dod bsngo/ /gzhan gyi don du rang nyid kyis/

/sangs rgyas bsgrub dang de spros bral/ ma rtogs rdzogs sangs rgyas mi thob/ /byang chub sems dpas gang zag bdag /phung khams skye mched phyi rol gyi/ /yul dang yul can chos thams cad/ /stong pa'i bdag med gnyis ka rtogs/ /gzhan gyi don du rang nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang mngon gyur pa/ /byed dang de ba'i don du bsngo/ /de yang spros bral rtogs pa yi/ /shes rab zung du 'jug pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i/ /thabs kyi khyad par shes par bya/ /gnad don 'phyug nas ma dag pa'i/ /sbyin sogs bkag don sangs rgyas dgongs/ /sogs nas shes par gyis par don/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes par/ /chos ltar bcos pas blun po 'ga'/ /ngo mtshar bskyed kyi mkhas pa rnams/ /khrel bar 'gyur ba 'di 'dra yod/ /chang dang dug dang mtshon cha dang / /gzhan gyi longs spyod ster ba dang / /gsod par phyugs ma ster ba dang / /mchog gsum mchod rdzas dge 'dun gyi/ /yo byad nor rdzas gzhan la sbyin/ /ma dag pa yi sbyin pa yin/ /nyan thos cho ga la brten pa'i/ /so thar dge slong yin bzhin du/ /rang 'dod 'chal spyod byang sems kyi/ /gzhan phan yin rlom khag 'dogs dang / /byang sdom sems bskyed blang bzhin du/ /gzhan phan 'gyur dang byed nus la/ /ngo srung rang 'dod sor sdom la/ /khag 'dogs tshul 'chos byed pa dang / /rang nyid tshul khrims bsrungs na yang / /tshul khrims la ni mchog 'dzin cing / /gzhan la khyad gsod byed pa ni/ /ma dag pa yi tshul khrims yin/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /gnod cing bstan pa 'jig pa la/ /rang 'dod g.yo sgyu ma yin par/ /bstan 'gro yul der 'phral phug la/ /phan byed khros nas nus bzhin du/ /bzod pa bsgom na ma dag pa/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang mkhas pa yi/ /rnam dag gzhung dang mi 'brel ba'i/ /log pa'i chos la dga' ba dang / /thos bsam bsgom gsum nor ba la/ /brtson 'grus chen po byed pa sogs/

/ma dag pa yi brtson 'grus yin/ /lung rigs thos bsam mi byed cing / /gzung 'dzin sgrog las ma grol ba'i/ /mi mkhas stong nyid bsgom pa dang / /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ma lon pa'i/ /gnad 'phyugs pa yi thabs lam sogs/ /rnam rtog 'ga' zhig 'jil ba dang / /ting 'dzin phra mo skyed pa'i thabs/ /'bad pa chen pos bsgoms na yang / /yang dag ye shes mi skye bas/ /ma dag pa yi bsgom pa yin/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang mi mthun zhing / /rnam dag gzhung dang mi 'brel ba'i/ /brtsam chos nyams mgur gter brdzu sogs/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la mkhas gyur cing / /bya ba thams cad shes gyur kyang / /ma dag pa yi shes rab yin/ /gdul bya 'khor ba las thar zhing / /thar pa'i lam la mi bkri bar/ /chos ltar bcos nas 'khor bar khrid/ /bla ma ngan la dad pa dang / /'khor ba spang shing dug gsum gyi/ /gnyen por mi 'gro dge brdzu yi/ /chos ngan pa la mos pa dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis las ma grol zhing / /bdag 'dzin gnyen por mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bsgom ngan pa la dga' ba ni/ /ma dag pa yi dad pa yin/ /nad pa dga' ba'i kha zas ster/ /rnam dag bstan bcos rnam dkar rgyun/ /'gro mang la 'tshe dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /sgrub par byed pa'i rmu rgod kyi/ /ngan par dpyod pa tshar mi gcod/ /dbang bskur med par gsang sngags ston/ /snod min pa la chos 'chad sogs/ /'phral la phan pa ltar snang yang / /phyi nas gnod pa cher 'gyur bas/ /snying rje'i dbang gis byed na yang / /ma dag pa yi snying rje yin/ /'khrul med bstan dang khungs thub chos/ /lung rigs 'brel ba'i rnam dkar rgyun/ /'gro mang gnas skabs bde ba dang / /mthar thug thar lam 'tshol ba yi/ /gdug pa can la byams pa dang / /bu dang slob ma mi 'chos dang / /srung ba'i 'khor lo mi bsgom zhing / /khro bo'i bzlas pa 'gog pa sogs/ /rgyud sde kun dang 'gal bas na/ /ma dag pa yi byams pa yin/

/mdor rgyud kun las ma gsungs shing / /rigs pas bsgrub par mi nus pa/ /drod dang bde ba skye ba dang / /mi rtog ltar snang skye ba sogs/ /nad gdon cung zad sel ba dag /blun po dga' ba bskyed na yang / /mu stegs byed la'ang yod pa'i phyir/ /ma dag pa yi thabs lam yin/ /bdag lta'i rtsa ba ma chad cing / /'khor 'das gnyis la smon pa can/ /dge ba la ni ngo mtshar blta/ /chos kun spros bral mi shes pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsngo na yang / /ma dag pa yi smon lam yin/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi gnad 'phyugs pas/ /dge bar byed par snang na yang / /ma dag pa ru shes par gyis/ /bsam pa lhag bsam rnam dag gis/ /thos bsgoms ma 'khrul byed gdams pa/ /mdor na sangs rgyas zhes sogs nas/ /bstan par shes par bya zhes bar/ /de don rgyal gsung dri med dang / /'phags bod mkhas dang grub pa yi/ /bstan bcos ma nor lam bzang la/ /thos bsam bsgom pa tshul bzhin du/ /byed na sangs rgyas bstan pa'o/ /byang sdom skabs te gnyis pa'o// ༈ /rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len ni/ /smin byed nor pa med pa yi/ /dbang bzhi'i don ni rdo rje theg /zhes nas sdom pa sum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes don gsang sngags la brten nas/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub la smin grol gnyis/ /la 'bad smin byed dbang bskur ni/ /rdo rje 'chang nas rang nyid kyi/ /mtshan ldan bla ma brgyud pa'i phreng / /nges gsal 'dren rgyu yod pa dgos/ /dbang gi chu bo ma nub zhes/ /rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par du/ /gsung ngag skabs kyi rgyu dus dang / /khyad par lam dus dbang gi ni/ /chu bo slob dpon rang nyid kyis/ /thog mar nos pa'i dus tshod de/ /rlung sems mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus de las/ /lam dus tha na thun gnyis su/ /chag med rgyun dang ldan pa yis/ /nyi tshod phra mo ma brgal bar/ /nyams len chag med dbang gi ni/

/chu bo ma nub khyad par gnad/ /byin brlabs brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ /zhes ni bsgom pa bya ba'i don/ /thos bsam sgro 'dogs legs par bcad/ /snyan brgyud brda tshig don brgyud mthong ba phyag len brgyud/ /khong du chud pa nyams blangs mtha'/ /blang des rang gi rgyud la ni/ /skyon med nyams skye myong ba'i mtha'/ /de mthus gnyis med ye shes ni/ /rang byung 'char ba byin rlabs mtha'/ /de 'bras dbang bzhi'i grub pa'i mtha'/ /mngon du grub pa bzhi dang ldan/ /srid pa'i 'dod yon gnyen po yi/ /zin byas lam khyer sngags kyi gnad/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa yis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gi gsungs/ /mkhas dang grub pas legs bkral ba'i/ /spang bya de dang cha 'dra ba'i/ /gnyen po thabs mkhas sna tshogs kyis/ /phyi yi snang grags nang gi lus/ /lus rtsa yi ge khams rlung la/ /dbyibs la bum pa rtsa gsang ba/ /khams la sher dbang rlung sems la/ /bzhi pa'i rten cing 'brel 'byung ni/ /rim gyi bsgrig la dang po ni/ /dbang gis rgyud la sku bzhi yi/ /sa bon 'debs nus sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung bzhin mdzad cing gnad don ni/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i bla ma la/ /dbang bzhi blang pas rang nyid kyi/ /rgyud la sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /rang rang cho gas so byang gnyis/ /sngon du thob dang gzhan yang ni/ /dbang bskur skabs su thun min gyi/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ldog pa yis/ /so byang sdom pa dang na mnyam/ /thob cing cho ga nyan thos ltar/ /sems bskyed ldan blang theg chen gyi/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sdom pa thob lugs gnyis rgyud sde las/ /gsung bzhin thob pa'i byang chub sems/ /de yis rdo rje theg pa yi/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob nas ni/ /so byang sdom pa sngags sdom gyi/ /ngo bor gyur cing gsum ldan gyi/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin mchog thob/ dbang bskur las thob pa'ang ngo bo sum ldan dang /

/de ltar rang cag so so'i cho ga las thob pa ni 'di bzhin no/ /bod kyi phyag rgya pa kha cig /byin brlabs tsam gyis smin byed dbang / /'dod sogs 'khrul par gyur pa rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du dgag pa la/ /deng sang rdo rje phag mo zhes/ /sogs nas sngon gyi cho gar bshad/ /bar gyi don ni phag mo yi/ /byin rlabs bskur nas chos sgo phye/ /gtum mo sogs bsgom smin byed bkag /dbang bskur sngon du ma song ba'i/ /byin rlabs nam yang mi bya'o/ /rgyud kyi dngos bstan grub thob kyi/ /bla ma'i ngan ngag gis phye ba'i/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gnad ldan pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba/ /smin byed dbang zhes de la zer/ /de yi sdom pa gsum ldan gyur/ /byin rlabs nyan rung gsang sngags kyi/ /lam sgom la dbang gzhan du ni/ /skyabs sems rgyun bshags lha'i byin rlabs/ /ye shes phab dang lha bsgom sngags/ /bzla rung byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul/ /phyag mtshan gtad dang tshe la ni/ /dbang phyir tshe yi dbang bskur sogs/ /dbang gi ming tsam btags pa yin/ /dpe na dbang dang byin rlabs dang / /rjes gnang gnad kyi rnam dbye ni/ /shes par bya dgos sngags kyi sdom ldan pa/ /lam kun bsgom rung dbang bzhi bskur dgos/ /de yis smin nas byin rlabs dang / /rjes gnang zhus pas ngo skal gyi/ /lam bsgom rung gi lam kun min/ /de ltar gnad rtogs gal che zhing / /brgyud ldan man ngag rten 'brel gnad/ /mi ldan sdom pa 'bog chog dang / /dkyil 'khor dbang bskur rang bzo yin/ /sngon chog rnams kyang deng gi dus/ /mi rung phyir na rang bzo spangs/ /cho ga rnam dag gal che'o/ /grangs nges med par dbang bskur ba/ /dgag pa des na nyan thos theg /sogs nas 'jug pa yin gyi bar/ /rgyud sde bzhi las spyod rgyud kyi/ /slob mar dbang bskur grangs nges med/ /gzhan gsum la ni nyer lnga'i bar/ /zung du ma gyur nges par dgos/

/gsang ba spyi rgyud rgyud sde bzhi/ /kun gyi kha bskang spyi 'gro yin/ /rgyud sde'i dbang la nyin dang por/ /sta gon byas te dngos gzhi yi/ /cho ga sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ /rjes chog bar du nyin zhag gis/ /ma chod pa zhig nges par dgos/ /mtshan mor bshad pa rgya gar du/ /gsang sngags dbang bskur dam tshig rdzas/ /snod min gsang ba ches dam pas/ /mtshan mo mi yi rgyu 'grul sogs/ /dkon par mdzad dang mtshan mo'i dus/ /mkha' 'gro 'du dang byin rlabs dus/ /gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /slob ma re re bzhin bskur dang / /spros bcas rigs pa'i dbang kyai rdor ḍom bhi lugs lta bu lnga bskyar/ /slob dpon dbang yang tshar grangs kyi/ /nyin zhag khongs su grub min la/ /dgongs 'dra deng sang phyag len la/ /rigs pa'i dbang lnga slob dpon dbang / /mu 'brel mdzad cing slob ma yang / /nyi shu rtsa lngar stabs gcig tu/ /mdzad pas 'gor skyon mi 'ong 'dra/ /dus 'khor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs/ /cho ga rgyas pas nyin zhag gis/ /ma chod dka' tsam dus 'khor ni/ /bla med spyi dang bab mi 'dra'i/ /khyad par 'ga' zhig yod par snang / /'jam mgon bla mas gsang sngags kyi/ /dbang bskur phyag len dngos gtsang phyir/ /dogs mtha' bkag ste 'doms par mdzad/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor ma dag pa/ /dgag don deng sang byin rlabs zhes/ /sogs nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkag /bar gyi don ni sangs rgyas kyis/ /rgyud sde nas gsung dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga rdul tshon la brten par/ /phyi ru 'dom gang gru bzhi dang / /nang gi sems la byang chub kyi/ /phyogs chos sum cu so bdun yod/ /de yi rten 'brel gyi stobs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /'byung ba yin zhing de 'dra bar/ /dbang bskur pas ni rten 'brel 'grigs/ /sdom pa skye zhing smin nus pa'i/ /gnad yod rdul tshon dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i man ngag gis/

/bkral zhing dam pa'i phyag len la/ /mdzad pas ras bris tshad ldan la/ /brten pa 'di gnyis gtso bor bzung / /cho ga ma dag dbang bskur byed/ /dgag don dbang bskur byed sogs nas/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs yin gyi bar/ /don ni rgyud dang man ngag gis/ /ma zin rang bzo'i cho ga yi/ /dbang bskur byas pas slob ma yi/ /lus ngag yid la 'phar g.yo sogs/ /byung yang gdon gyi cho 'phrul yin/ /rgyud dang man ngag gis zin pa'i/ /rnam dag cho ga'i dbang bskur las/ /byung ba sangs rgyas byin rlabs yin/ /dbang bskur med par zab lam bsgoms/ /dgag don dbang bskur med sogs nas/ /srung phyir 'bad par bya ba'i bar/ /zhes don dbang bskur ma thob pas/ /rgyud lung lta rtogs dbang 'chad nyan/ /las tshogs sgrub pas char 'bebs dang / /'dre 'dul byin rlabs phran tshegs tsam/ /byung byung 'dra yang phyi ma ni/ /dmyal ba'i rgyu yin spang bar bya/ ༈ /dbang la dbang po rab dang 'bring / /phye nas smra ba dgag pa ni/ /kha cig gang zag la sogs nas/ /rgyud las bkag zhes bar gsung don/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sngon chog yin/ /da lta'i gang zag skabs mi 'brel/ /gang zag rab 'bring thams cad kun/ /rab tu rdul tshon dkyil 'khor dang / /yang na ras bris la brten dgos/ ras bris/ yang man ngag gi zin cing phyag len la mdzad kyang gsum ngag skabs sogs bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang 'dra ba'i cho ga brgyad kyi rnam bzhag tshang ba rdul tshon 'od khyad par 'phags shing nges par mdzad/ /tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la sogs spangs/ /sems bskyed tsam gyis gsang sngags bsgom/ /dgag don la la sems bskyed zhes/ /sogs nas rnam dbye shes dgos so/ /zhes don bya rgyud rnam gsum las/ /don yod zhags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /zhib mo yi ni cho ga dang / /dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs pa/ /dmigs bsal tsam las bya rgyud kyi/ /legs grub dpung bzang yan chod dang /

/spyod rgyud rnal 'byor bla med bcas/ /gsang sngags bsgom la dbang bskur dgos/ /gzhan yang sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs/ /rjes gnang la yang bla med kyi/ /dbang bskur thob nas kun zhu rung / /gzhan du rang rang rgyu sde de'i/ /dbang bskur thob na rjes gnang rung / /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gsung / /gtor ma ting 'dzin gyi dbang bskur/ /smin byed 'dod dgag gtor ma'i dbang / /sogs nas gsung pa med zhes bar/ /rjes gnang sogs la gtor ma ni/ /mgo thog bzhag nas lha bsgom bstim/ /dmigs bsal yod dang ting nge 'dzin/ /dmigs pa tsam gyis dbang bzhi len/ /de yis dbang bskur go bcad spangs/ ༈ /dbang bskur phyi nas khas len byed/ /bkag don 'ga' zhig gsang sngags sogs/ /zhes nas chos bzhin gyis zhes bar/ /zhes don sngon du dbang bskur nas/ /chos bshad gong 'og ma 'jol gnad/ /sems nyid rtogs na dbang mi dgos/ /bkag don la la sems nyid sogs/ /zhes nas spang ba'i gsang tshig bar/ /zhes don sems nyid rtogs rlom gyi/ /kun gyi go chod log rtog spang / /dwags po'i brgyud 'dzin kha cig gi /cho ga med par bla ma yi/ /lus dkyil tsam la smin byed len/ /bkag don kha cig cho ga med/ /sogs nas rigs can yin gsung bar/ /zhes pa'i don ni cho ga ni/ /tshig gcig med par bla ma yi/ /lus las dbang bskur len zer ba/ /'brel med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung pa'i sdom gsum cho ga kun/ /spangs pa'i log rtog 'di spangs shig /rnam grol lam kun bden pa gnyis/ /zung 'brel la brten don dam par/ /chos kun spros pa kun las bral/ /de nyid rtogs thabs thabs byung gi /sdom gsum len thabs lam sa 'bras/ /rnam bzhag kun rdzob zung 'brel dgos/ /bya rgyud sogs la dbang bzhi dang / /rim gnyis yod 'dod bkag pa yin/ /kha cig bya rgyud sogs zhes nas/ /gsung pa'i dngos grub 'byung gi bar/

/zhes pa'i don ni rgyud sde bzhi/ /rang rang rgyud nas gsung pa bzhin/ /bya zhing rang bzo'i bsre lhad spangs/ /rgyud don ma 'khrul dngos grub 'byung / /bka' brgyud pa 'gas gsang sngags la/ /mos pa chos kyi sgor byas nas/ /zab lam bsgom rung 'dod bkag pa/ /la la dbang bskur ma byas zhes/ /sogs nas rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /bar don sngags la mos tsam gyi/ /dbang ma thob par lam bsgom spangs/ /dper na zhing la so nam ni/ /ma byas kyang ni lo tog la/ /mos pa za rgyu'i sgo yin pas/ /za 'dod tsam las zhing bzang la/ /rtsol ba so nam ma byas mtshungs/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/ /dbang bskur ba nyid gtso bo ste/ /phyi dang nang gi chos kun la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel gnad/ /khyad par can yod de la byed/ /dbang bskur cho gas rten 'brel ni/ /bsgrig tshul slob ma'i phung khams dang / /skye mched rnams la slob dpon gyi/ /rigs lnga sogs su ngo sprod thabs/ /chu dbang la rigs pa'i dbang lnga brtul zhugs slob dpon gang la gsum sogs sogs rim bskur bas/ /phra zhing phra rnams ye shes su/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan btab/ /de rgyun skyong pas rab tshe 'di/ /'bring gi bar do mtha' skye ba/ /bcu drug tshun chad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mngon du byed la dbang bskur btags/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti sogs/ /gang zag rab nyid dbang gis grol/ /'bring man de rgyun grol byed lam/ /bsgom zhing bum dbang gnas skabs su/ /tha mal rnam rtog spong ba yi/ /sdom pa thob cing mi nyams par/ /srung zhing bsgom la bskyed rim dang / /gong ma'i gnas skabs gya nom lhar/ /zhen pa'i rnam rtog spong ba yi/ /sdom pa thob cing rdzogs rim bsgom/ /dper na thog mar rnam dag gis/ /dbang gi cho gas dkyil 'khor bzhir/ /sku bzhi'i nas kyi sa bon btab/ /de nyid dam tshig srung sdom dang / /lam gyis bsod nams char rgyun gyis/

/skyong pas mi nyams gong 'phel gyis/ /'bras bu sku bzhi'i lo thog smin/ /de ltar dbang nyid mchog tu gyur/ /ras chung rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig gis/ /dbang bskur mu bzhi 'dod bkag pa/ /la la dbang bskur zhes sogs nas/ /yin zhes bya ba'i bar gyi don/ /dbang sogs mu bzhi brtsi ba spangs/ ༈ /rnying ma kha cig gsang sgrogs kyi/ /ltung ba med 'dod bkag pa ni/ /kha cig gsang sngags zhes sogs nas/ /gnod tshig yin zhes bar gyi don/ /zab mo'i chos la gsang mi gsang / /rgyal bas ji skad gsung ltar bya/ /de nas grol byed rim gnyis la/ /phyag rgyas 'gas sngon byung gi /grub thob thabs lam re re yis/ /grol ba yin gyi rim pa gnyis/ /bsgom pa dgos med smra bkag don/ /kha cig 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med/ /zhes nas mkhas rnams gus kyi bar/ /zhes pa'i don ni thabs shes rab/ /gnyis ka ma tshogs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs gzhan med pa ste/ /de yang thabs kyis myang 'das mtha'/ /shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /mtha' gnyis gnon pa'i lam bslab pas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /dbang gi sa bon btab byin rlabs/ /rim pa gnyis bsgom rten 'brel gyis/ /ye shes rtogs nas rnam grol brnyes/ /lam kun rim gnyis la 'dus te/ /bskyed rim rlung dang gtum mo yi/ /dmigs pa sogs ni rim gnyis dngos/ /byin rlabs de yi 'bras bu'i tshul/ /lta ba de gnyis dag byed thabs kyi/ /yan lag yin phyag rgya chen po ni/ /de las skyes pa'i ye shes dang / /lam de bogs dbyung byed pa'i phyir/ /spros bcas spros med spyod pa'o/ /de dag thams cad tshogs pa yin/ /gnad kyis yin rung las rten 'brel/ /stobs kyis nus pa'i gsal kha ni/ /dper na nad pa'i lus gso ba/ /bza' btung kun gyis byed mod kyang / /de nang zho chang la sogs 'gas/ /thog mar yi ga 'byed byed mtshungs/ /de lta'i gnad shes phyogs re las/

/ma zhen smin byed dbang rim gnyis/ /zung 'brel gyi ni 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /lam bzang tshang la ma nor ba/ /yin pa'i gnad 'di snying la bcang / /gong gi nang tshan spyod pa la/ /in+d+ra bhu ti'i mdzad pa ni/ /spros bcas bhū su ku spros med/ /shin tu spros med rim pa gnyis/ /brten phyir rnal 'byor dbang phyug sogs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'o/ /pha rol phyin dang rdo rje theg /gnyis ka 'khrul med lam bzang la/ /pha rol phyin lam bsgrod tshul ni/ /lam ni stong nyid snying rje yi/ /snying po can dang phar phyin drug /bsgom des dbang rnon brtson 'grus ni/ /myur yang bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /dka' spyad dgos te tshogs sbyor la/ /grangs med gcig dang sa bdun bar/ /grangs med gcig dang sa brgyad dgu /bcu ste grangs med gsum bar dgos/ /de ltar dang po byang sems bskyed/ /grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsog /sa brgyad dgu pa bcu pa'i bar/ /yang dag mtha' dngos mi bya bar/ /smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /sems can yongs su smin pa dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing snod bcud/ /gcig bsdus legs sbyong mthar phyin te/ smon lam phar phyin brnyes sogs don gcig go /sa bcu'i rgyun mthar bdud bzhi btul/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs/ /bdud bzhi zhes pa gnas nges len/ /phra zhing 'dzin pa'i mtha' phra ba'i rgyun gyi cha/ /ye shes kyis spong de yin zhes/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges bzhed/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam bsgrub pa/ /ma nor dbang blang 'khrul med kyi/ /rim gnyis bsgom zhing de las byung / /mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes skye/ /de la goms byas drod thob rtags/ /chos brgyad mgo snyoms de 'khor 'das/ /blang dor 'dzin med bsre ba'i phyir/ /rnam dag spyod pa spyad pa yi/ /nang lus rlung sems dbu mar zhugs/ /sa lam kun bsgrod rdo rje 'dzin/

/bcu gsum pa yi sa thob bo/ /lam 'di sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i/ /dam chos snying po rnal 'byor rgyud/ /man chad la sbas bla med kyi/ /rgyud sde rnams kyi gsang tshig mchog /skal ldan 'tshang rgya'i myur lam yin/ /de ltar mdo sngags lam gnyis la/ /sangs rgyas gnyis gsung ji ltar yin/ /snyam na de yi gnad 'di yin/ /rgyud yi che ba 'don pa'i phyir/ /phar phyin theg par sa bcu yin/ /sbas pa yin zhes gsung pa dang / /bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i 'grel pa las/ /skyu ru ra ni chu dang ni/ /'o mas bcus gnyis so so'i dpe/ /mdzad dang saṃ bhu ṭa'i lung las/ /gang dag bsam gyis mi khyab gnas/ /mngon du ma byas pa de ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa ste sangs rgyas/ /yin la mtshan gzhi mtshon pa ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa yang dag pa'o/ /gsung don sangs rgyas yin zhes don/ /mdo lugs sangs rgyas mtshan gzhir bstan/ /mtshan gzhi mtshon pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /yang dag pa zhes sngags lugs kyi/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni mtshan gzhi yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mngon byas don/ /yul dang yul can snang ba kun/ /bde stong dang du ro gcig par/ /'dres pa'i sangs rgyas rang snang gi /ye shes mngon gyur bcu gsum pa/ /de gnyis gang zhig nyams len ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mdo dang ni/ /rgyud sder ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /de dang mthun par nyams len gnad/ /so thar nyan thos pha rol phyin/ /theg chen byang sems gsang sngags te/ /de gsum gzhung dang mi mthun pa'i/ /chos pa sangs rgyas chos lugs min/ /mdo dang rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang / /lam bzang tshang la ma nor ba/ /so thar rigs bdun sems bskyed dang / /dbang bskur las thob sdom pa ni/ /legs par blang zhing bsrung ba la/ /dge tshogs rlabs che rim gnyis gnad/ /shes nas bsgom pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thob pa'i lam yin de ltar gyi/ /gnad rtogs shin tu gal che'o/ ༈ /de nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba ni/

/sdom gsum nyams su len tshul sogs/ /rim par dgag par byed pa ni/ /sdom gsum len tshul bkag don ni/ /gang dag rab byung zhes pa sogs/ /dga' bar bya phyir yin bar don/ /sor sdom len la nges 'byung dgos/ /byang sems sdom pa klu sgrub dang / /thogs med gsung dang ma 'gal dgos/ /gsang sngags bsgoms pa mang sogs nas/ /rang bzor gsang sngags spyod par zad/ /bar don gsang sngags nyams len la/ /rgyud sder gsung bzhin nyams len dgos/ /de la khag 'dogs phal cher gyis/ /'phral gyi spyod pa bag yangs su/ /ci 'dod bde ba'i 'du shes kyis/ /rang bzo'i gsang sngags nyams len spangs/ /gal te dbang bskur zhes sogs nas/ /gus pas len zhes bar gyi don/ /bye brag dbang bskur rgyud man ngag /ma gtogs 'khrul dang rang bzo spangs/ /gong du smos bzhin rgyud man ngag /bla ma dam pa'i phyag len bzhin/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba yi/ /dbang bskur byang chub thob byed gtso/ /rang bzo'i krong bskyed drod skye tsam/ /gtum mo yang dag min pa yi/ /dri bcas ye shes bkag pa'i don/ /rgya la bskyed rim bsgom sogs nas/ /lam mi 'gyur zhes bar gyi don/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnad mi shes/ /rang bzo'i krong bskyed rtsa thig rlung / /rnam shes sems dbyings khyab rlung gi drod/ /zhu bdes rig stong rtog pa yi/ /gnad mi shes par btsan thabs kyis/ /rlung gi drod skye ras rkyang tsam/ /chog dang rnam rtog cung zad tsam/ /bkag la mchog 'dzin de nyams nas/ /slar yang 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur spangs/ /rgyud dang man ngag gis zin pa'i/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed cho ga yi/ /yan lag kyai yi rdo rje nas/ /gsungs pa'i mngon byang lnga dang ni/ /rdo rje'i cho ga gsum las bskyed/ /bde mchog sogs nas sgra tshul gyis/ /rten 'brel dang ni gsang 'dus las/ /gsungs pa'i ting 'dzin gsum dang ni/ /gshin rje'i gshed nas gsung pa yi/

/rnal 'byor bzhi sogs nyams su len/ /khyad par mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i bcud/ /gsung ngag yid bzhin nor bu mchog /lam dang 'bras bur bcas pa yi/ /gdams ngag las byung gzhi rgyu rgyud/ /thun mong thos bsam thun min skabs/ /dri med spros bral lta ba yi/ /rgyud sbyong ma 'gag rig pa'i gdangs/ /bum dbang bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam/ /snying po kyai yi rdo rje yi/ /mngon rtog yan lag drug ldan dang / /zab mo lus dkyil dbang dang bcas/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes rim pas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa thun mong du/ /ngo skal sbyong gzhi sbyong byed kyi/ /skye gnas phyed dang bzhi sbyong zhing / /thun min de dag re res kyang / /sbyong gzhi mtha' dag sbyang bar gyur/ /snang ba sems su ngo sprad pas/ /dug gsum rtog pa mtha' dag sbyong / /de ltar bskyed rim bya ba dang / /byed pa can gyi bskyed rim las/ /nga rgyal rnam pa spyi bye brag /rgyan can rgyan med sems 'dzin gyi/ /dmigs pa sum cu rtsa bdun po/ /legs bsgom bsam gtan dug dbyung zhing / /dug gsum ngo bo nyid gsum bcas/ /thun mong gsal stong zung 'jug tsam/ /thun min rig thog bdar sha bcad/ /gzhi yi dri ma rang sar dag /sbyong byed lam gyi ngo bor gyur/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / /spros bcas rdzogs rim gsang dbang dang / /sher dbang bzhi pa'i lam rnams la/ /sngon 'gro sgo gsum sbyong gnad dbab/ /bsgom pa gsum dang dngos gzhi ni/ /gnyis pa bdag byin brlabs pa'i lam/ /rtsa yig thig le'i dwangs snying ni/ /'byed pa khyab byed rlung sbyor bdun/ /legs sbyong kha sbyor rlung la 'bad/ /khyab byang man ngag gtum po'i dmigs/ /gang ba thig le mthug po ni/ /rtsa yig thig rlung gsum gcer bu/ /mi dmigs gtso ston bco brgyad po/ /man ngag bogs 'don 'khrul 'khor bcas/ /de la bde drod nyams myong skyes/ /gsal yang thun mong thun min la/

/rig thog nyid du bdar sha bcad/ /de yi skyon yon so sor 'byed/ /yon tan tshogs rnams gong 'phel gyur/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam/ /dngos dang ye shes phyag rgya la/ /brten pa'i sbyor ba mnyam pa gsum/ /'du shes sum ldan des rgyas par/ /man ngag gnad kyi byang chub sems/ /dbab bzung bzlog khyab mi nyams srung / /bsdus pa'i sbyor bar thur sel gyi/ /rlung la dbang byas dngos gzhi la/ /dbab bzlog sogs pa dus mnyam bya/ /rjes la 'dren dang khyab par bya/ /bde stong thun mong thun min ni/ /rig pa'i thog du bdar sha bcad/ /bzhi pa rdo rje rba rlabs lam/ /'og rlung bskyod pa lus rba rlabs/ /ngag ni 'dren pa zhi drag gi /ting 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs kyis/ /thabs kyi rgyud sbyang g.yas bzung ba/ /g.yon du 'dzin pa dbus gnyis ka'i/ /rba rlabs rings la skad cig gsum/ /shes rab la'ang de bzhin gsungs/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi rgyud so sor/ /skad cig gcig ste rnam pa bdun/ /de las mas brten dga' ba bzhi/ /myong ba thun mong thun min la/ /rig thog bdar sha bcad pa yis/ /de ltar bskyed rdzogs ye shes ni/ /gang skyes nyon mongs rnam rtog dang / /dper na ngang pas chu 'o ma/ /so sor phye ltar dwangs snyigs 'byed/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa yi/ /myur lam bla na med pa'o/ /gong gi rig thog zhes pa'i don/ /dngos po yin tshad bem rig ni/ /gnyis su 'dus shing de skabs kyi/ /rig pa rnam shes don gcig cing / /de ni 'dus byas 'dzin pa'i cha/ /yin gyi skabs 'di'i rig pa ni/ /snying po kyai yi rdo rje yi/ /rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ /rang rig bde ba chen po nyid/ /rang rig nas ni byang chub gyur/ /rang rig phyir na bsgom nyid gsung / /'phags mchog klu sgrub yab sras kyis/ /dbu ma dang ni sngags gsang 'dus/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /gshed dmar spros med man ngag las/

/rang rig zhes bzhed rgyal ba yis/ /lung bstan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / /mchog gi rnam bshad zla zer la/ /'di ltar drang mdzad 'dus ma byas/ /spros bral bde ba chen po'o/ /de bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rig byed ma/ /gur zhal la yang thun min gyis/ /skabs su 'di 'dra'i gnad dang ldan/ /'di dag rgyal gsung rgyud sde dang / /grub pa'i man ngag las byung ba'i/ /'khrul pa med pa'i rim gnyis lam/ /skal bzang mchog la bdag nyid che/ /'jam mgon bla mas gdams pa yi/ /gsang tshig mchog du shes par bya/ /zhes gsung don de bstan bcos lus/ /sa bcad dngos de gong gi ni/ /grol byed rim gnyis lam gyi skabs/ /phyogs re'i thabs kyis mi grol bar/ /rim gnyis zung 'jug dgos pa'i tshul/ /gsung 'di yin mod der mdor bstan/ /rnam grangs tsam gsung skabs 'di ni/ /sngags sdom nyams len skabs 'phros la/ /brten nas bskyed rdzogs skyon yod ni/ /tshig gsal gnang bar mdzad 'dug cing / /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis/ /mdzad par 'di skabs bde kye gsang / /gshin rje gshed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi/ /tshig gsal mdzad pas der rjes dpag /gsung ngag bskyed rdzogs rnam bzhag 'di/ /skabs 'phros gsal tsam byas pa'o/ /mdo sngags bla ma'i khyad par gyi/ /'khrul pa dgag don bla ma la/ /sogs nas bla ma med kyi bar/ /zhes don bla ma'i dngos 'dzin ni/ /sor byang sdom thob mkhan po de/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs bar blta/ /gsang sngags dbang bskur tshul bzhin du/ /thob pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dngos/ /dge slong byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /dbang bskur gsum ka stsal ba ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos las lhag /de la gsol btab gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug phun sum tshogs pa grub/ /gnad sdom mi ldan sdom ldan du/ /'gyur 'dod bkag don sdom pa med/ /sogs nas chom rkun yin gsung bar/ /zhes don sdom gsum len srung gal/

/dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i/ /ye shes phyag chen la mtshon byed/ /des dang mtshon bya de gnyis las/ /chos pa 'ga' zhig rtog pa ni/ /nang du kha tshon phyag chen 'dod/ /bkag don phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ /sogs nas dgos par gsung gi bar/ /zhes don phyag chen ming btags kyis/ /rnam rtog phyi yul la mi 'phro/ /nang du kha 'tsham stong had de/ /ci med cang med du go nas/ /der bzung bsgom pas dud 'gror skye/ /chad lta bsgom de tha shal yin/ /yang ni gzugs snang mtha' dag bkag /gzugs la chags bral nam mkha' ltar/ /stong rkyang rnam par shes pa tsam/ /gzugs bya ci yang med pa dang / /'du shes rags med phra yod tsam/ /dmigs pa'i zhi gnas de rnams ni/ /las kyi dbang gis gzugs med ni/ /skye mched mu bzhi'i lhar skyes pa'i/ /sems rgyud la gnas de bzhi dang / /gzugs snang 'gag pa'i stong pa gnyis/ /sbrel nas bsgom na lhar skye 'bring / skye mched mu bzhi'i/ /'phags pa gsum gyi gzugs med khams/ /de yi nyon mongs spong ba'i phyir/ /zhi gnas 'di bsgom de'ang ni/ /so so'i lhag mthong 'brel ba yis/ /lam gyi yon tan yar ldan rgyu/ /'khor bar nges 'byung nam mkha' dang / /rnam shes mtha' yas gnyis bsgom dang / /rnam rtog gzhan 'gog stong tsam du/ /thag chod ngo 'phrod nyan thos kyi/ /'gog par re zhig thar pa'i rgyu/ /gal te de gsum du ma lhung / /sgo gsum shin sbyang bde ba dang / /ldan pa'i zhi gnas spros pa kun/ /nyer bzhi'i lhag mthong zung 'brel du/ /bsgom pa dbu ma'i lugs yin kyang / /ji srid tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs bar/ /de srid bsgom de mthar mi phyin/ /bskal pa grangs med yun du 'gor/ /de ltar tha 'bring bzang dang rab/ /de rigs bsgom kun phyag chen min/ /rang lugs phyag chen ngos bzung ba/ /nged kyi phyag rgya che sogs nas/ /gsang sngags gzhung bzhin sgrub gyi bar/ /zhes don bkral na 'di lta ste/

/rang lugs phyag rgya chen po yi/ /ngo bo bla med dbang dang ni/ /rim gnyis gang rung las byung ba'i/ /dri ma med pa'i nyams de ni/ /rang byung gi ni ye shes so/ /de yang bla med smin byed kyi/ /dbang bskur nus brtsams nyams skyon can/ /rdzogs pa'i bar de gang zag ni/ /tshogs lam rang rkyang pa yin no/ /bde stong ye shes mtshan nyid pa/ /rgyud skyes rnam par mi rtog nyams/ /rgyun chags byung yang rnam rtog gi /bag chags phra mo dang bcas pa/ /nam langs nyi ma shar lta bu/ /dpe yi ye shes skyes pa ni/ /sbyor lam rnam kun mchog ldan gyi/ /stong pa mngon sum du rtogs nas/ /rnam par mi rtog phyag rgya che/ /don gyi ye shes mtshan nyid pa/ /thog mar skyes tshe mthong lam thob/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba la/ /mtshon byed dpe dang mtshon bya ni/ /don gyi phyag rgya chen po gnyis/ /dpe yi phyag chen ngo bo ni/ /bla med dbang lam gang rung la/ /brten nas skyes pa'i nyams skyon med/ /chos nyid de ni mngon sum du/ /ma mthong ba yi rigs gnas so/ /dbye ba bla med dbang la ni/ /brten la rgyu lam 'bras gsum las/ /rgyu lam gnyis la dpe'i ye shes/ /yod cing 'bras dbang ye shes ni/ mtshon bya don gyi ye shes yin/ /dbang la ma rten pa ltar na/ /rten gyi sgo nas theg chen gyi/ /so skye'i rgyud kyi dpe'i ye shes/ /'phags rgyud dpe yi ye shes gnyis/ /'phags rgyud de la don gyi ni/ /ye shes yin pas khyab snyam na/ /spyi tsam khyab kyang dmigs bsal gyi/ /phar phyin rang rkang 'phags pa ni/ /bla med lam du zhugs pa'i tshe/ /dpe yi ye shes gsar skyes dgos/ /theg chen mthong lam 'phags pa yi/ /ming mnyam na'ang mdo sngags gnyis/ /mthong lam 'phags chos khyad par ro/ /mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen ni/ /de rgyu bla med dbang dang lam/ /gang rung la brten ye shes ni/ /skyes pa'i gang zag gis chos nyid/ /mngon sum mthong ba'i rigs su gnas/
