/bla med theg pa'i slob lam gyi/ /'phags pa'i rjes thob ye shes 'ga'/ /mtshon bya don gyi ye shes ni/ /yin yang chos nyid mngon sum du/ /mthong bar ma nges pa yi phyir/ zhes pa ni bla med theg pa'i lam slob lam brnyes pa'i 'phags pa la mnyam gzhag tu don gyi ye shes yin mod kyang / rjes thob la blo khyad kyis chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba la nges par bshad/ /dbye ba lam gyi mtshon bya yi/ /phyag chen dbang bzhi'i lam la brten/ /de'ang rgyu lam 'bras gsum gyi/ /dbang la brten nas skyes pa yi/ /mtshon bya don gyi ye shes gsum/ /rgyu dus skabs kyi dbang bzhi pa/ /kho nar brten nas skye ba srid/ /de skye ba la rtsa dbu ma'i/ /mdud pa gcig grol sa dang po/ /nges par thob dgos de yang ni/ /bla med sa thob dbang bzhi char/ /ma thob pa la mi 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang dbang gi ye shes dbab/ /gsum pa'i dbang skabs skye ba srid/ /de yi don ni tshe 'di'am/ /snga ma bla med dbang bzhi yi/ /sbyangs pa sngon sogs las 'phro can/ /rang gi ngang gi khams 'du dang / /mos gus can la byin rlabs kyi/ /khams 'du zhes pa de 'dra la/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes dbab/ /sogs kyis sad byed rkyen byas te/ /mtshon bya don gyi ye shes skye/ /tshe 'dir dbang gis ma smin par/ /mi srid rgyu med 'bras mi 'byung / /gnad 'di shes dgos 'bras bu yi/ /phyag rgya che ni bcu gsum pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid yin no/ /'o na lam dang 'bras bu yi/ /phyag chen 'dod na gzhi phyag chen zhig kyang / /'dod dam snyam na chos dbyings la/ /de 'dra bshad pa'i lung ma mthong / /yod srid na'ang nges pa min/ /bla med dbang lam ma brten pa'i/ /phyag chen 'byung ba mi srid gnad/ /rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ /phyag chen ming btags cha mthun gyi/ /rnam rtog rgyun chags thos bsam tsam/ /gyis bsdus go rtogs shes rab dang /

/bsgom byung yin kyang rnam rtog rgyun/ /ma zhi'i ban bun nyams rnams yin/ /gsung ngag lta khrid skabs kyi ni/ /'khor 'das dbyer med lta phal cher/ /rgyu dus lta bu dug can zhes/ /phyag chen ltar snang ming btags pa/ /de nyid yin par sems te des/ /gsung ngag 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi/ /lta ba 'di la gsum du mthong / /rgyu dus lta ba dug can ni/ /thos bsam las byung shes rab kyis/ /bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi/ /lta ba kun dang sgom byung gi /bsdus pa'i rigs ni kha cig ste/ /gsung ngag skabs su rtogs pa tsam/ /lta bar bzhag pa zhes gsung dang / /rab dbyer lta ba de yi ni/ /yan lag phyag chen dpe'i ye shes/ /gsung pa'i lta ba phyag chen gnyis/ /gnyis phye'i lta ba'ang 'di nyid yin/ /lam gyi lta ba dug med ni/ /dbang bzhi rim gnyis thabs las skyes/ /nyams myong skyon med 'khor 'das kyi/ /lta ba rnams te de nyid ni/ /nyams myong ting 'dzin lta ba ru/ /bzhag pa yin te rab dbye las/ /phyag chen dpe yi ye shes zhes/ /skabs der gsung pa 'di yin no/ /mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen ni/ /grub mtha' bzhi'i rgyu'i 'khor 'das gnyis/ /dbyer med don ni mngon rtogs so/ /des na snga ma gnyis po ni/ /'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba ni/ /don spyi'i tshul du mjal ba yi/ /rtogs pa yin gyi phyi ma ni/ /de la gsal snang shar ba yi/ /rtog med shes pa nyid yin no/ /'ba' zhig skyon dang bcas pa ni/ /gnas pa sor rtog snang stong phyogs/ /zung du ma 'jug pa yi nyams/ /brgyal dang tshogs drug 'gag pa ste/ /nyi tshe ba yi nyams rnams yin/ /phyag chen mtshan nyid pa la ni/ /bla med dbang dang lam la brten/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ni/ /rang bzhin med pa'i chos dbyings la/ /gsal snang thob pa'i nyams skyon med/ /skyes pa dpe yi phyag chen yin/ /mtshon bya don gyi phyag rgya che/ /bzhi pa rten can zhes bya ba/

/bzhi pa'i dbang gi rten dkyil 'khor/ /bzhi yi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yi/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi las ni/ /dbu ma'i mdud pa dang po grol/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid/ /mngon sum mthong de mtshon bya ni/ /don gyi ye shes rgyud la skye/ /grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med snyogs/ /mthong lam dang po'i sa thob cing / /grub pa thob pa zhes bya'o/ /rje btsun mchog gis gra ston gyi/ zhus len tshig bzhir snga ma yi/ /lta ba'i dug ni rnam par rtog /bsgom pa'i dug ni nyams skyon can/ /phyi mas skyon de bral ba yi/ /bla med dbang lam la brten pa'i/ /nyams myong skyon med phyag chen du/ /gsungs pa'ang de dag don yin no/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po yi/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rab dbye las/ /mtshan rtog nye bar zhi ba'i don/ /bshad pa tshig gi phyag chen dang / /rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin la/ /blo 'jog pa dang ltar snang la/ /rang bzhin med par rtse gcig 'jog /rdo rje 'chang chen lha yi skur/ /bsgom pa'i phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang / /de ltar bsgom pas gnyis med kyi/ /nyams myong mos pa gzhan gyis ni/ /'phrog mi nus pa nang nas skye/ /de yang bskyed rdzogs gang rung gis/ /dmigs pas skyes na nyams myong gi /phyag chen rgyud sde 'og ma dang / /pha rol phyin pa'i dmigs pa ni/ /bsgom skyes nyams myong de ltar min/ /'on kyang de dag phyag rgya che/ /btags pa ba yin dngos min te/ /de 'dra dbu ma'i bsgom la yang / /skye srid bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /sangs rgyas rgyu yin tshe 'di dang / /bar do sogs la 'tshang mi rgya/ /bla med dbang bzhi'i rim gnyis sam/ /dbang rjes lam zab bla ma sogs/ /thabs kyi khyad par la brten nas/ /mtshan rtog rang grol la song ste/ /gnas lugs don la gsal snang skyes/ /rtogs pa dpe yi phyag chen te/ /de ni tshe 'di 'chi kha'am/ /bar do tshun la mthong lam skye/ /de la brten nas mthong spong spangs/

/dbu ma'i rtsa mdud dang po grol/ /chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba yin/ /mthong ba don gyi phyag chen dang / /bcu gsum pa yi ye shes zhes/ /lam lnga sa ni phyed bcu gsum/ /rten 'brel lnga dang byang phyogs chos/ /so bdun la sogs lam mthar phyin/ /phyi nang spong bya'i mdud kun grol/ /ye shes lnga ldan sku lnga ni/ /lhun grub rtogs pa 'bras bu yi/ /phyag rgya che ste rnam drug go /de ltar spyi btang dmigs bsal las/ /gdul bya dbang po rab la ni/ /las kyi 'phro can ngang khams 'dud/ /bla med dbang dus nyid du ni/ /don gyi ye shes mngon gyur srid/ /sngon sbyang dpe don ye shes gnyis/ /skyes pa'i las 'phro sad pa yi/ /rten 'brel las byung brtson 'grus can/ /'bad stsol gyis khams 'du ba la/ /rim gnyis lam la brtson skabs sam/ /mos gus can ni byin rlabs kyis/ /khams 'du bla ma dam pa yi/ /thugs rje khyad par can la brten/ /don gyi ye shes skye srid de/ /dpe yi ye shes sngon sbyang gi /yod pa'i rkyen gyis drag bskul bas/ /rten 'brel dbang las de ltar 'byung / /'di la sku lnga sku gsum sogs/ /gcig char grub pa de ltar na/ /rgyud sde spyi rnams las sku gsum/ /rim can 'grub snyam dogs skye na/ /de ni mngon byang gsal snang gis/ /grub tshul gsung gis sku rim 'grub/ /gsung don ma yin dogs mi 'tshal/ /khyad chos rgyu yi khyad par ni/ /phyag chen ye shes rgyud bla med/ /dbang dang rim gnyis thabs zab la/ /brten dgos phar phyin theg sogs kyi/ /nyams rtogs bzang yang tha snyad med/ /phyag chen ngo bo'i gnas lugs ni/ spros pa'i mtha' bzhi bral ba'i dbyings/ /stong nyid de bzhin nyid la sogs/ /phyag chen ngo bor mi 'jog ste/ /rtogs bya'i yul tsam yin mod kyi/ /rtogs thabs yul can ma yin no/ /gzhan yang gzhi dus ye shes kyi/ /ming can rang bzhin lhan skyes sam/

/rang bzhin rnam dag sems 'od gsal/ /de yang ngo bo ma yin te/ /skye 'gro kun la rang chas su/ /yod kyang de yis grol mi nus/ /ci yang yid mi byed pa dang / /gzhi thog sems kyi 'jug pa bkag /rig pas dpyad nas spros bral la/ /blo 'jog thos bsgom gyi shes rab/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i nyams sna tshogs/ /rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad cung zad tsam/ /byung la sogs pa'ang ngo bo min/ /de 'dra rgyud sde 'og ma'am/ /phar phyin bsgom sogs la'ang 'byung / /nyon mongs chags sogs skyes pa na/ /gnyen po gzhan ni mi tshol bar/ /nyon mongs rang gi rang bzhin la/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yi/ /shes rab kyis ni dpyad pa na/ /nyon mongs rang grol ltar song la/ /nyon mongs lam byed ming btags pa/ /de yang phyag chen ngo bo dang / /phar phyin las lhag myur lam min/ /sems la gnad bsnun nyams len tsam/ /de 'dra phar phyin la yang yod/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ /mdo la sems dang sngags la ni/ /lus la gnad bsnun nyams len gyi/ /sgo nas khyad par byed pa yin/ /phar phyin las ni 'di skad gsung / /chags sogs nyon mongs skye ba'i tshe/ /de yi ngo bo'i gnas lugs la/ /dpyad pa'i shes rab kyis gzhig pa'i/ /rang grol song ba tsam la dgongs/ /spang bya nyon mongs chags sogs ni/ /gnas lugs dpyod pa'i shes rab kyi/ /mthu yis de zhi grol ba yi/ /dbyings kyi cha ste de gnyis la/ /gnyis kar nyon mongs ming btags pa/ /nyon mongs gnyen por nyon mongs ni/ /gsung bar 'khrul nas rnam rtog ni/ /chos sku yin sogs blun gtam smra/ /de ltar ma yin mdo dang ni/ /de 'grel byams mgon dbyig gnyen gyi/ /gsung gis gsal zhing bdag nyid chos/ /'chad na gnyis su yod mod kyi/ /'jug pa'i tshe na rnam dbye med/ /gsung ltar 'chad tshe rnam rtog dang / /de yi chos nyid so sor phye/ /smra ba dag mkhas 'jug pa'i tshe/ /rnam rtog gi ni chos nyid la/

/rnam rtog ming btags nas bsgom pa/ /bzang bar snang bas so so nas/ /thugs ni gzu bor gnas par 'tshal/ /rang lugs phyag chen ngo bo ni/ /bla med dbang dang byin gyis rlabs/ /rim gnyis las skyes de yi grogs/ /dri bral 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi/ /lta ba byang chub sems kyis zin/ /ngo bo bde stong zung 'jug sogs/ /zung 'jug ye shes skyon med de/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes yin/ /de la brten nas tshe 'di'am/ /bar do sogs su phyag rgya che/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob 'gyur ro/ /sgra don phyag chen skad dod ni/ /ma hā chen po mu tra zhes/ /rgya la 'jug pa zung 'jug gi /ye shes de yi snang ba kun/ /rgyas btab de las mi 'di'i don/ /gnyis snang 'khrul pa las gong du/ /gyur pas rgya chen po zhes bya/ /phyag gi skad dod rgya dpe la/ /med kyang lo tsās bsnan zhes gsung / /rten gyi khyad par gang zag ni/ /bla med dbang gis rgyud smin zhing / /phyag rgya che don ma 'khrul ba/ /ngos zin gnad ni ma bcos par/ /nyams su len shes zhig dgos shing / /dbang gi ma smin smin tsam kyang / /phyag rgya chen por ngos ma zin/ /zin kyang de yi gnad ma shes/ /phyag chen bsgom par rlom pa ni/ /yang mtha' dud 'gro de las cung / /bzang na gzugs med khams kyi lha/ /de las cung 'phags nyan thos kyi/ /'gog pa'i rgyu'am ji ltar rung / /bzang kyang phar phyin dbu ma yi/ /bsgom pa tsam las lhag mi 'byung / /rgyu ni bla med dbang lam bsgoms/ /las byung bskyed rim snang stong phyogs/ /gsang dbang nyon mongs rnam rtog dang / /sbrel zhi rang byung phyag chen dngos/ /ma yin grogs ni nyon mongs ltar/ /snang sogs kyis bslad nyams skyon can/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis/ /dwangs snyigs phyes nas 'byed pa dang / /dbang lam gang rung dang 'brel gzhi/ /mtshan rtog nyer zhi'i zhi gnas la/ /bde stong zung 'jug lhag mthong gis/

/zin de phyag chen lam mchog yin/ /gzhan lugs phyag chen rgya nag lugs/ /bstan pa sogs don da lta yi/ /phyag rgya sogs nas rnams kyi yin/ /bar don phal chen rtog sla zhing / /sngar gyi bkag pa'i phyag chen de/ /nā ro mai trir brgyud rlom na/ /ma yin nā ro mai tri las/ /brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /sam bhu ṭi las gsung pa'i don/ /phyi rol mtshan ldan las kyi rgya/ /der brten dbu ma stong pa nyid/ /ro gcig lhan skyes dga' ba ni/ /dam tshig rgya dang de'i rang bzhin/ /chos kyi dbyings ni chos kyi rgya/ /de 'bras rang byung gi ye shes/ /ye rgya rnam pa bzhi la bzhed/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang / /las kyi phyag rgya ma shes na/ /chos kyi phyag rgya yang mi shes/ /phyag chen ming tsam gang la rtogs/ /zhes gsung brtag gnyis sogs brgyud dang / /bstan bcos kun las bla med kyi/ /dbang bzhi ma 'brel phyag chen bkag /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes kyi/ /phyag chen rtogs na da gzod ni/ /mtshan bcas 'bad stsol la mi ltos/ /de rgyun skyong pas grol ba thob/ /mdo rgyud don dang mi mthun pa'i/ /byin rlabs bdud las yin srid spangs/ /phyag rgyas pa 'gas sngags chos la/ /dad na snga ma dbang thob yin/ /dbang bskur mi dgos zer dgag don/ /kha cig skye ba snga ma zhes sogs nas/ /ngo mtshar skye zhes bar don rgyal bstan la/ /brten bzhin mdo rgyud dang 'gal ba/ /mkhas kun khrel gyur 'khrul spyod spangs/ /sngon sbyang sngags sdom yon tan rgyun/ /yod rung tshe 'di dbang byas pa'i/ /phung khams skye mched gsar smin dgos/ /rin chen rgyan 'dra'i rjes 'brang gi /rngog gzhung dge bshes la la yi/ /zhi gnas cung zad tsam dang ni/ /snang stong zung 'jug rtog pa'i tshul/ /phra mo skyes la mthong lam du/ /ngo sprod byed pa dgag pa ni/ /la la zhi gnas cung zad sogs/ /zhes nas 'byung mi srid kyi bar/

/dgag don tshe 'di mthong ba'i lam/ /thob nas de yi rtogs yon tan/ /shi nas 'byung ba'i 'khrul rtogs spangs/ /rgyan can rgyan med nyan thos las/ /bshad kyi theg chen skabs mi 'brel/ /na ros dbang dus mthong lam skyes/ /de 'gag zhes dang 'phags pa lhas/ /bden mthong las mtha' la chags pas/ /'grib par gsung de dpe yi ni/ /ye shes rtogs tsam btags pa bar/ /bshad kyi mthong lam dngos ma yin/ /grub thob kun gyi dgongs mthun par/ /mthong lam 'phags pa kho nar 'byung / /sa thob de yi yon tan gnyis/ /zung 'brel 'khrul med shes par bya/ /theg gsum lag len spyod pa'i gnad/ /'khrul pa bkag don theg pa gsum/ /sogs nas yin zhes bya ba'i bar/ /go sla theg pa che chung gi /bla ma'i dbye ba nyan thos rnams/ /sogs nas shin tu bzang zhes bar/ /zhes pa'i don ni nyan thos skabs/ /dge slong bzhi yan dge 'dun dang / /de la nyung la gang zag zer/ /theg chen pha rol phyin pa'i skabs/ /sa thob dge 'dun dkon mchog dang / /tshogs sbyor la gnas dge 'dun tsam/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi/ /bla ma mchog ni dbang bzhi stsal/ /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin/ /bla ma de gsum mtshan nyid ni/ /theg gsum gzhung bshad yon tan mchog /ldan na bla ma dam pa yin/ /de ltar sdom pa gsum ldan gyi/ /mtshan nyid ldan zhing gsang sngags kyi/ /dbang bskur thob pa'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba btab na tshe 'di'am/ /bar do sogs su sangs rgyas pa/ /sbyin nus bla ma dam pa yin/ /de la gsol ba gdab tshul ni/ /theg pa 'og mar nam mkha' la/ /mchog gsum dmigs nas bla ma ni/ /der bstim de dag 'dus par dmigs/ /gsol ba btab na rnam grol lam/ /rim gyis grub pa'i rgyu byed cing / /gnas skabs byin brlabs ci rigs 'jug /gsang sngags skabs su dbang bzhi po/ /yongs rdzogs thob pa'i bla ma de'i/ /phung khams skye mched gdan gsum lhar/ /shes nas skyabs gsum kun 'dus su/

/mthong nas thag bcad gsol btab pas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod don 'byung / /dbang bzhi ma thob de'i lam bsgom/ /dgag don dbang bskur dang po zhes/ /sogs nas rgyang ring spang gi bar/ /zhes don lam bzhi bsgom pa la/ /sngon du dbang bzhi'i smin nges bya/ /dge slong ma thob mkhan slob bkag /'di 'thad gser mdog pas dogs slong / /mdzad kyang 'dul ba'i tshig tsam la/ /bshad mod nyes med phun sum tshogs/ /thob la tshigs gsum rim rdzogs pa'i/ /mkhan po 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs las/ /nges gsung rnam dbye shes par bya/ /gtor ma phud mchod lag len gyi/ /'khrul pa dgag don gzhan yang nas/ /la sogs ltos zhes bar gyi don/ /kha 'bar ma yi gtor ma la/ /sngon du bsngo sngags sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan gzhi rjes su brjod dgos kyi/ /chu sbyin nang du zan mi bsre/ /zan phud mai tri'i lta ngan sel/ /jo bo'i spyod bsdus sgron me dang / /rje btsun mchog gis las dang po'i/ /bya ba bdag nyid chen po yi/ /thub pa dgongs gsal nang bzhin bya/ /snar thang pa dang 'bri gung pas/ /gtor ma'i dbyibs kyi lag len 'khrul/ /bkag don 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas nas/ /gsung bzhin nyams su blang bar don/ /skabs don zas phud gru gsum spangs/ /lha yi sku mdog phyag mtshan la/ /'khrul pa dgag don sangs rgyas nas/ /mdo las gsung zhes bar gyi don/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku'i phyag mtshan la/ /mtshon cha spang zhing bka' gdams pa/ /la las rigs lnga ser 'jam bshad/ /mdo las rigs lnga bshad pa mod/ /gser mdog sangs rgyas sprul sku spyi'i/ /mtshan bzang gral bshad sman bla la/ /sku mdog sngon po dmigs bsal yin/ /rigs lnga bshad pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /bla med gnyis tsam de la ni/ /rten 'brel dbang gis mdog sna lnga/ /phyag rgya tha dad shes par bya/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg gsang 'dus sogs/ /mdo lugs bkag don yi dam lha/ /zhes nas dpyod de smros kyi bar/

/de don bka' gdams pa la las/ /sngags la mi mos yi dam gyi/ /bsgom bzlas sbyin sreg ro bsregs dang / /bdun tshigs sāts+tsha mdo sde nas/ /gsung pa'i dkon mchog mchod tsam la/ /brten pa'i cho ga'i rnam bzhag byed/ /mi 'thad mdo nas gsung pa med/ /'di dag sngags su shes par bya/ /de bzhin rab gnas gru go cha'i/ /rjes 'brang kha cig phyag rdor ni/ /gos sngon mdo lugs bod kha cig /ltung bshags sher snying sngar lugs 'khrul/ /mchod bstod bkra shis la sogs kyis/ /rgyal po rgyal par ston lta bu'i/ /rab gnas ming du btags tsam yin/ /mdo las rab gnas bshad pa med/ /mdo lugs jo bo'i man ngag tu/ /zer na bstan khungs mdo gang yin/ /ston rgyu med dang gsung 'dus ni/ /mdo lugs zer ba 'brel med yin/ /rab gnas gsang sngags gzhung las bshad/ /de yi mtshan nyid rang nyid lhar/ /bsgom zhing sngags bzlas rab gnas rten/ /dbang bskur phyir du bum pa dang / /lha yi sta gon rten gegs sbyang / /dri ma bkru sogs sta gon dang / /dngos gzhi bdag mdun dkyil 'khor sgrub/ /rten la dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed/ /ye shes 'khor lo bstim byas nas/ /dbang bskur rigs bdag rgyas gdab dang / /spyan dbye brtan bzhugs rab gsol 'debs/ /spyi bye'i mnga' 'bul sngags byin gyis/ /brlabs pa'i me tog dor nas mchod/ /rjes su dga' ston bkra shis kyi/ /tshigs bcad rgyas par byed pa'o/ /de ltar rab gnas dbang bskur ni/ /gsang sngags dbang ma thob pa yis/ /mi rung slob ma'i dbang thob kyang / /de yi rang gi me tog ni/ /phog pa'i lha yi bsgom bzlas dang / /sbyin sreg zhi rgyas sogs las sgrub/ /ril bu mig sman thun mong gi /dngos grub bskyed rim la brten nas/ /phyag rgya'i snang stong ye shes bsgrub chog dang / /rgyud sde 'og ma nyan la dbang / /gzhan min gzhan don rgyud 'chad dang / /dbang bskur rab gnas rang don du/

/dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom pa dang / /rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig ni/ /srung sogs slob dpon kho na'i las/ /yin zhing rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /dbang thob nas ni thun mong min/ /gzhal yas khang par byang phyogs chos/ /so bdun sbyar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /de kho na nyid lha rnams dang / /phung khams skye mched sbyar ba yi/ /lha yi de kho na nyid sogs/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed rnam gzhag sbyar/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /yongs rdzogs bsgoms nas dbang bskur dang / /rab gnas la sogs gzhan don gyi/ /'phrin las skyong dang sangs rgyas kun/ /zhes te rigs lnga so so yi/ /dam tshig sdom pa bla med pa/ /dkon mchog gsum bzung rdo rje dang / /dril bu bzung sogs thun min pa'i/ /dam tshig bcu bzhi bzung ba rnams/ /rdo rje slob dpon kho na'o/ /de lta'i rnam gzhag shes par bya/ /phyag rdor gos sngon gzungs bya rgyud/ /ltung bshags sngags lugs rgyal gsung med/ /dbang dang lha bsgom sngags bzla dang / /sbyin sreg gzhan don dbang rab gnas/ /cho ga thams cad sngags las bshad/ /mdo sde rang rkang las ma gsung / /mdo sngags khyad par shes par bya/ /rtogs bya spros bral lta ba la/ /'khrul 'gog rim bzhin theg rim dgur/ /lta ba tha dad yod bkag pa/ /la la theg pa rim dgu la/ /zhes nas rnying ma'i kun rdzob kun/ /lta ba dang 'khrul de ltar yin/ /zhes don nyan thos byang sems gnyis/ /spros bral rtogs dang ma rtogs pa'i/ /mtho dman yod cing theg pa che/ /dbu ma dang ni gsang sngags gnyis/ /rtogs bya'i spros bral khyad par med/ /rtogs byed thabs kyi khyad par yod/ /rnying phyogs nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /byang sems mtshan nyid theg gsum gyi/ /kri ya u pa yo ga gsum/ /nang gi sngags kyi theg pa dang / /ma hā a nu a ti ste/ /gsang ba gsum ste dgu ru bzhed/ /kri ya gsar ma'i bya rgyud dang / /u pa spyod rgyud yo ga ni/

/rnal 'byor rgyud yin ma hā ni/ /bla med rgyud dang 'dra mtshungs bzhed/ /a nu a ti yo ga gnyis/ /de las gong du lhag par bzhed/ /de la lta ba don dam dang / /kun rdzob gnyis su phye nas ni/ /gnyis kar lta ba'i ming btags nas/ /kun rdzob lha ru bsgom la btags/ /de yang bya rgyud rigs gsum dang / /spyod rgyud rigs lnga rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rigs lnga rnal 'byor chen po la/ /rigs brgya lha yi kha grangs la/ /mtho dman khyad par yod pa dang / /a ti kun gyi rtse mor bzhed/ /'di ni dmigs bsgom lta ba gnyis/ /dngos btags ma phyes lta bar 'dogs/ /gsar mar bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud/ /bla med bzhi yi thabs mkhas kyi/ /lha yi bsgom tshul bya rgyud la/ /bris sku lhar bsgom rang tha mal/ /spyod rgyud rang dang bris sku gnyis/ /lhar bsgom rnal 'byor rgyud la ni/ /bris sku'i rkyen byas rang nyid lha/ /bdag bskyed dam ye gnyis med dang / /de phyin dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal/ /bla med rang nyid dam ye ni/ /dbyer med du bsgom bya spyod dang / /rnal 'byor gsum la kun rdzob kyi/ snang ba lha ru bsgom pa med/ /bya spyod gnyis la mdog phyag mtshan/ /ye shes lnga dang sbyar ba yi/ /rigs lnga'i kha gsal btags pa med/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las rigs lnga bshad/ /bla med skabs su kun rdzob kyi/ /snang ba lhar bsgom rigs lnga gsungs/ /rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la ni/ /kun rdzob spyi ni ji snang bzhin/ /dmigs bsal bris sku lhar bsgom tsam/ /bla med snang ba kun lhar bsgom/ /kun rdzob ldog pa gnyis su phye/ /bsgom pa thabs dang lta shes rab/ /lta bsgom gnyis las dngos btags phye/ /'di dag rnams ni bsgom pa yin/ /rtog byed de yi dbyings rtogs bya/ /spros bral de ni lta bar bzhed/ /yang ni rnying mas rnal 'byor bzhir/ /lta ba tha dad yod bkag don/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba sogs nas/

/rim pa yod pa yin bar don/ /snga 'gyur ma hā yo ga dang / /a nu a ti gsum la ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po rjes rnal 'byor/ /shin tu rnal 'byor gsum du 'dogs/ /theg pa'i ming btags mchog dman bzhed/ /de dang gsar ma'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ /bod skad bsgyur dus ming tsam mtshungs/ /'on kyang don mi mtshungs pa ste/ /gsar mas rnal 'byor rjes rnal 'byor/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /rtogs bya ye shes na 'phar ba'i/ /rim pa tsam bzhed rgyud sde dang / /theg pa'i ming 'dogs mi mdzad do/ /mdor na rtogs byed theg par bzhag /rtogs bya'i ye shes theg pa ru/ /mi bgrang ba yi khyad par las/ /rnying ma'i a ti yo ga dang / /gsar ma'i rtogs pa ye shes mchog /don gcig yin par shes par bya/ kaḥthog dge sprul rin po che'i gsung rabs las kyang 'di 'dra zhig bzhed yod tshod 'dra/ /lta ba'i skabs 'dir yul yul can/ /gnyis su phye las yul zhes pa/ /rtogs bya'i mtha' bzhi spros bral yin/ /yul can sems kyi rtogs pa yis/ /dbu ma'i skabs su gtan tshigs kyis/ /spros pa bcad de spros bral bsgrub/ /sngags su rim gnyis thabs mkhas kyis/ /mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes rtogs/ /de dang mthar phyin don ye shes/ /ye shes de ni brjod bral te/ /lam bsgom pa yi rtogs don yin/ /theg par btags na brjod byar gyur/ /lam gyi rtogs pa'i don ye shes/ /mtha' bzhi spros pa las grol te/ /yul dang yul can gnyis med gyur/ /de lta'i ming dang ldog pa ni/ /legs par shes pas yul can gyi/ /bsgom byed lta bar zab chad tsam/ /yod kyi yul a ti theg pa yin na gyi lta ba dang / /yul dang yul can gnyis med la/ /bzang ngan mi 'byung dbu ma nas/ /rnal 'byor bla med bar kun mtshungs/ /lta bsgom ldog pas mi phye ba/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i bzhed pa 'dra/ /lta bsgom ldog pas phye ba dang /

/yul dang yul can lta ba yi/ /rnam gzhag gnyis mdzad gsar ma'i lugs/ /dbu ma yan nas bla med bar/ /mthun pa'i phyir na phar phyin gyi/ /lung rnams bla med skabs su yang / /theg chen gnyis ka drang mdzad pa/ /'phags bod mkhas pa kun gyis bzhed/ /rgyud bzhi'i bsgrub thabs 'khrul pa dgag /rgyud sde bzhi yi zhes sogs nas/ /bshad pa mtshar zhes bar gyi don/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi rgyud man ngag /ma shes rang bzos dngos grub dman/ /rgyud dang man ngan gnad zin gyis/ /bya rgyud rang rkang bdag bskyed med/ /bris sku lhar bskyed mchod bstod gsol/ /rje 'bangs tshul gyis dngos grub len/ /mchod gtor sha chang la bub dang / /gla rtsi lta bu srog chags la/ /gnas pa las byung spong ba dang / /'das dang ma 'das mchod pa'i lhag /bza' 'gom phyi dro'i kha zas spong / /gtsang sbra dang ldan dkar gsum dang / /'bras chen sdig med kha zas za/ /bya rgyud bdag bskyed yod rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brang bkral/ /bdag bskyed byed tshe bsnyung gnas med/ /lha la brnyas pa'i nyes pa yod/ /lhag par bla med nyams len mkhan/ /yin na lha yi nga rgyal ni/ /gtong na phung por brnyas skyon yod/ /dpe na lha dang phung po la/ /mi smad sdig pa sbyong thabs su/ /bsam pa'i rnam dbye shes par bya/ /spyod rgyud dang ni rnal 'byor rgyud/ /brtul zhugs gtso bor mi mdzad pa/ /gtsang sbra mchod pa so so yi/ /skabs der ji gsung ma 'khrul bya/ /sangs rgyas mchod lhag zar rung zhing / /'byung po'i gtor ma mi za'o/ /bla med skabs su thabs mkhas kyis/ /'dod yon thams cad ji 'dod bstan/ /thabs kyi gnad ni ji bzhin du/ /nges par byas pas dngos grub 'grub/ /spyod pa blang dor gnyis med rtogs/ /rnal 'byor brtan pa cher thob pas/ /nang gi rlung sems dbu mar thim/ /bcu gsum pa yi rtogs pa rnams/ /bgrod par bya ba dang phyi rol 'dzam gling gi

/yul dang yul can gnas pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas rgyu ba'i tshul/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs zhes nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya'i bar/ /zhes pa'i don ni drod thob nas/ /spyod pa spyad nas yul chen bgrod/ /drod ni chung 'bring che gsum dang / /spyod pa gsang spyod kun 'dar dang / /kun bzang gsum las rgyud ltar ni/ /drod ni 'bring po'i skabs su ni/ /kun 'dar spyod pa'i mgo brtsam nas/ /kun 'dar kun bzang rim spyod gyi/ /yul bgrod rim par 'phar ba ni/ /bdag nyid chen po'i bzhed pa'i gnad/ /yin zhes mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen/ /ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsungs so/ /skabs don cung zad bkral ba na/ /drod la rgyud dang man ngag lugs/ /gnyis las dang po rgyud lugs ni/ /drod kyi ngo bo dbye ba dang / /so so'i mtshan nyid drod ma thob/ /thob byed thabs dang de thob pa/ /brtan byed dus dang drod spyod pa/ /mtshams sbyor ba ste rnam pa drug /drod kyi ngo bo bla med kyi/ /dbang dang rim gnyis gang rung la/ /brten nas skyes pa'i sgo gsum gyi/ /nyams myong rnam dag ci rigs pa/ /dbye ba che 'bring chung gsum mo/ /de la spyi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /bla med lam la brten pa yi/ /gur las gsungs pa'i rtags bcu'o/ /so so'i mtshan nyid drod chung la/ /rnal 'byor pa de'i lta stangs kyis/ /shing thog sar phab srog chags gsod/ /rjes 'dzin zhes pa shing thog ni/ /'phral du slar sbyar sems can gso/ /drod 'bring gi ni de gang rung / /gcig nus rnam shes ye shes kyi/ /las cha mi mnyam zhes bya'o/ /chen pos tshar bcad rjes 'dzin nus/ /rnam shes ye shes cha mnyam pa/ /thob pa'i thabs ni chung ngu'i dus/ /rim gnyis bsgom pa de yin la/ /'bring la kun 'dar gsang spyod dang / /chen por kun 'dar mngon spyod yin/ /ma grub drag shul cho ga zhes/ /de tshul gzhan du gsal zhes gsung /

/thob pa brtan par byed pa'i dus/ /drod chen thob nas zla phyed la/ /sngar ltar goms zhing spyod pa spyad/ /drod dang spyod pa mtshams sbyar ni/ /drod chung thob nas kun 'dar ni/ /gsang bar spyod dang 'bring thob nas/ /kun 'dar 'jig rten pa mngon spyod/ /drod ni chen po thob pa na/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bya/ /rgyud kyi skabs 'dir drod chung 'bring / /'jig rten lam yin drod chen po/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam gyi ni/ /nang tshan mthong lam shes par bya/ /gnyis pa man ngag lugs kyi ni/ /drod bshad pa la chung 'bring che'i/ /drod gsum 'jig rten lam du 'jog /lam lnga ltar na dbang bzhi'i lam/ /bskyed rdzogs bsgom rnams tshogs lam ste/ /nyams myong lta ba ma skyes na/ /tshogs lam rang rkyang shar ba yin/ /nyams myong lta ba skyes pa rnams/ /sbyor lam drod kyi sne zin pa/ /'dus pa dang po drod chung ngu / /gnyis pa 'bring po gsum pa ni/ /chen por brjod cing de gsum nyams/ /mi brtan ngos nas lta ba dang / /lam la phan 'dogs chung bas drod/ /sems la 'char bas sems nyams dang / /rtog pa rgyun chags kyis stong pa'i ngos nas bsgoms/ /rnam rtog zin na yul grogs su/ /'char bas rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /mthong lam ma skyes bar nyams snang / /sbyor lam drod ces bzhag nas ni/ /de'ang khams 'dus dang po yi/ /nyams snang rnam rtog sngon song drod/ /ma nges 'khrul snang 'char ba'i dus/ /yul tshan gyis gnod drod chung ngu / /khams 'dus bar pa'i nyams snang rnams/ bdud rtsi lnga 'byung / khams dgu 'dus pa'i drod ces bya/ /nges pa'i mthong snang yul can gyis/ /mi gnod pas na drod 'bring po/ /'dus pa tha ma'i nyams rnams ni/ /thig le 'bar zhing 'dus pa'i drod/ /shin tu nges par gsal snang 'char/ /phyi rol yul gyi rkyen rnams kyis/ /phan 'dogs drod ni chen por shes/ /drod chen de yi ldog pa las/

/sbyor lam lhag ma gsum 'jog ste/ /bzhi pa'i dbang gi nyams len rten/ /pad+ma can gyi byed pa las/ /dbu ma'i mas sna ro rkyang gi /mas snang gnyis 'khyud rten 'brel gyi/ /phyi nang rtse mo zhes pa'i don/ /dbu ma'i sna rtsar rlung sems phyin/ /ma skyes chos la bzod dka' ba'i/ /bzod gcig don ni dbu ma'i nang / /rlung sems 'dus pas stong nyid la/ /mi skrag bzod pa ces bya ba/ /'khor ba yi ni chos las 'das/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam chos rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i chos mchog gnyis skyes don/ /ro rkyang gnyis 'das 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i chos mchog dbu ma'i sne'i/ /rtse mor rlung sems byon pa yi/ /mya ngan las 'das pa yi lam/ /chos rnams rdzogs pa'i chos mchog go /'di dag rim can tshul du skye/ /de ltar drod thob nas spyod pa/ /spyod pa'i tshul la rgyud dang ni/ /man ngag kyi lugs gnyis las ni/ /dang po rgyud kyi lugs la ni/ /spyod pa'i ngo bo dbye ba dang / /so so'i rang bzhin spyod pa'i dus/ /spyod pa'i gang zag de'i dgos drug /ngo bo nang du de kho na/ /nyid rtogs pa yis kun nas bslang / /phyi rol lus ngag ci 'dod pas/ /g.yo zhing rgyu ba'i khyad par ro/ /dbye ba kun 'dar spyod pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa gnyis/ /kun 'dar de la rnam grangs ni/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu'i spyod pa dang / /smyon pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa dang / /gsang spyod ces gsum kun bzang la/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar yi/ /spyod pa rgyal tshab chen po yi/ /sa la gnas pa'i spyod pa dang / /'jig rten pa yi mngon du spyod/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i spyod pa gsum/ /de ltar ming gi rnam grangs so/ /dbye ba gsum du dbye na kun 'dar gsang spyod dang / /mngon spyod kun tu bzang po gsum/ /ngo bo drod chung thob nas drod/ /'bring phyir spyod pa gsang spyod dang / /drod 'bring thob nas drod chen po/

/thob phyir spyod pa kun 'dar ni/ /mngon spyod ngo bo drod chen po/ /mthong lam thob phyir phyag rgya che/ /mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin/ /thob phyir spyod pa kun bzang po'i/ /spyod pa yi ni ngo bo'o/ /a wa dhu tī zhes pa'i don/ /gnyis spangs sam ni gnyis med do/ /kun 'dar zhes pa gzung 'dzin gyi/ /rnam par rtog pa 'dar ba'am/ /des bsdus bza' dang bza' bya min/ /gnyis med spyod pa kun 'dar grags/ /rang gi rigs la sogs pa gsang / /smyo brdzu'i brtul zhugs mtshan mor spyod/ /kun 'dar gsang spyod zhes su grags/ /drod chen thob byed gzhon nu yi/ /sar gnas spyod pa rgyal bu ni/ /gzhon nu'i spyod pa zhes grags dang / /drod chen thob nas rang nyid kyis/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes gcig gi ngor/ /chos kun bzang por rtogs pas na/ /kun du bzang po'i spyod pa'o/ /sa thob nas ni mi mthun phyogs/ /kun gyi brdzi bar mi nus shing / /rgyal bas phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal po'i rgyal tshab dang 'dra bar/ /rnam shes ye shes cha mnyam pas/ /zag med ye shes mngon gyur nas/ /gzhan don thog med du spyod pas/ /rgyal tshab chen po'i sar gnas pa'i/ /spyod pa zhes te sa thob pa'i/ /spyod pa'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /spyod pa'i dus ni gang gi tshe/ /spyod pa chung ngu'i drod thob nas/ /kun 'dar gsang spyod mtshan mo'i dus/ /bza' dang bza' min gnyis med sogs/ /spyod cing nyin mor rang rigs dang / /mthun par spyod cing drod 'bring po/ /thob nas kun 'dar 'jig rten pa'i/ /mngon spyod rang gi yul 'khor spangs/ /rang rigs la sogs gsang gnas nas/ /smyo brdzu'i nyin mor spyod pa'o/ /drod chen zhes bya zag med pa/ /dang po'i grub mtha' snyogs pa nas/ /lung du bstan pa'i phyag rgya brten/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'am/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa spyad/ /sa ni lhag ma rnams bsgrod do/

/dpe na dang po gsang spyod dang / /phyi ma gnyis ni mngon spyod do/ /yun tshad spyod pa de dag kyang / /ma mtha' zla ba re rer spyod/ /spyod pa'i gang zag drod thob cing / /tshe 'di nyid la sems can gyi/ /don du phyag rgya chen po ni/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob 'dod kyi/ /khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa dgos/ /spyad pa'i dgos pa sems brtan g.yo/ /brtags dang rang don mthar phyin phyir/ /gsang spyod mngon spyod gnyis spyod dang / /sems can smin dang gzhan don ni/ /mtha' ru phyin pa'i don du ni/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bya/ /gnyis pa man ngag lugs kyi ni/ /spyod pa'i tshul la khams 'dus pa/ /dang po spyod pa chung ngu ni/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni rkang pa bzhi/ /snang ba dgrar langs 'phrang las ni/ /rlung gi sbyor bas 'byung bzhi'i rlung / /dbang byas tshogs lam chung ngu chod/ /dug lnga ma dag snang ba rnams/ /'byung bzhi'i rlung ni rang gnas zin/ /stobs 'phel ba dang cha mnyam pa/ /'byung chung bcu drug zin pa yis/ /nyams kyi snang bar 'char ba'o/ /'dus pa bar mar spyod pa 'bring / /dran pa nye bar bzhag bzhi yis/ /stong pa dgrar langs 'phrang bsgral te/ /tshogs lam 'bring po chod pa ste/ /stong pa dgu ste dang po ni/ /shes rab a ru rlung sems thim/ /mthong yul 'gag pa'i stong pa dang / /gnyis pa snying po'i ā la ni/ /rlung sems thim pas gzung 'dzin stong / /gsum pa 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug rtsar/ /rlung sems thim pas tshogs drug stong / /bzhi pa rlung gi rlung spu gri/ /stobs gyur shes pa skad cig kyang / /mi gnas shing ni gnyid kyang chag /yon tan ting nge 'dzin gyis stong / /lnga pa phyi dbyibs kyi ni ār/ /rlung sems thim pas lus thig les/ /gang zhing zag bcas bde ba rgyas/ /bde bas brgyal ba'i stong pa dang / /drug pa rtsa rlung 'ga' zhig gis/ /rten 'brel las ni nang lus kyi/ /cha shas re re tsam dang phyi/

/chu la sogs pa'i cha shas ni/ /re tsam med mthong nyi tshes stong / /bdun pa phyi nang gi gnas lugs/ /de bzhin nyid ni ngo bo nyid/ /ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa dang / /brgyad pa thos bsam la brten nas/ /ma rtogs log rtog mdud pa grol/ /sgro 'dogs chod pa'i stong pa dang / /dgu pa 'bras bu chos kyi sku/ /ye shes dag pa gnyis ldan ni/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'o/ /de ltar dgu las dang po de/ /gsang gnas rtsa gsum gyis 'dur mdor/ /rkyang ma'i cha shas dang po yi/ /gzugs med sa bon shes rab kyi/ /a dmar de ru rlung sems thim/ /skyon ni dngos po mtshan ma stong / /yon tan ting 'dzin zhi lhag gi /stong ste bsam gtan gyi khang bu/ /bsam gtan gyis stong zhes bya ba/ /spang bya stong nyams 'ba' zhig shar/ /de yi gnyen po rang gi lus/ /lhar ldang ye shes 'khor lo gzhug /sngags bzlas rgyan drug dag pa dran/ /bzhi po bsgom pas snang stong nyid/ /zung chud snang ba lha dang sngags/ /chos su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rgyun mi chad pas de'i 'phrang sgrol/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi bsgom tshul/ /'di ni rgyu ming 'bras la btags/ /rgyud nas bshad pa'i kun 'dar ni/ /gsang spyod 'di nas spyod par sems/ /'dus pa tha mar spyod pa che/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi po yis/ /bying ba chen po'i 'phrang bsgral nas/ /tshogs lam chen po'i lam chod de/ /de yang nang gnas rtsa gsum gyi/ /'dus mdo dbu ma'i cha shas kyi/ /phyi dbyibs āḥyig dkar po la/ /rlung sems thims te bde ba yi/ /brgyal ba'i stong par chog shes pa'i/ /bdud kyi zin tshe dngos kyi rgya/ /pad+ma can gyi rten 'brel las/ /g.yon gyi rkyang ma'i cha shas kyi/ /yi ge bzhi pa snying po'i āḥ /dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ /phyi dbyibs āḥni gyen la bskyod/ /snying po'i āḥyi nyams de yi/ /phyi dbyibs ā yi byings ba ni/ /chen po de las ldang nus so/

/spyod pa snga ma gnyis po ni/ /phyag rgya'i nyams len dang ma 'brel/ /'di ni dngos kyi phyag rgya yi/ /nyams len dang ldan 'bras bu'i ming / /rgyu la btags te lung bstan ni/ /phyag rgya pad+ma can dang 'grogs/ /sems la brtan g.yo brtags phyir spyod/ /rgyud nas bshad pa'i kun 'dar ni/ /mngon spyod 'di nas spyod pa yin/ /man ngag las ni spyod pa chung / /dran pa nyer bzhag chen po ni/ /yang dag spong bar gsung pa'i gnad/ /phyi ma'i 'phrang gnyis bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gsang spyod mngon spyod shas che'o/ /de ltar yang dag spong bzhi yi/ /rten 'brel la brten drod sogs pa/ /sbyor lam bzhi ni bsgrod tshul lo/ /nye rgyur rgyud dang man ngag gi /lugs srol gnyis las rgyud la ni/ /phyag rgya bstan pa'i dgos pa dang / /nye rgyu nyams su len pa dngos/ /phyag rgya bstan la dus gsum ste/ /dang po'i dbang dus bar lam dus/ /tha ma 'bras bu gsum char la/ /phyag rgya bstan don dang po gnyis/ /skabs su ma bstan tha mar ni/ /bstan na phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'grub/ /dang po gnyis la bstan na yang / /'bras dus ma bstan mi 'grub pas/ /des na phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor ni/ /cis kyang gal che gur las gsung / /nye rgyu dngos la ngo bo dang / /mngon byed dus dang mngon bya'i gnas/ /bstan pa'i phyag rgya mngon byed thabs/ /'bras bu grub pa'i tshul dang drug /nye rgyu la ni de'i ngo bo/ /rang byin rlabs dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thabs gnyis las byung ā li dang / /kā li bdag nyid byang chub sems/ /brgyad dang drug gi bdag nyid can/ /brgyad ni thabs te rang byin rlabs/ /las 'byung ā li byang chub sems/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la brten byung / /kā li byang sems de nyid la/ /ldog pas phye na sgrub pa po/ /rang byin rlabs bsgom zhu bde gnyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa yi/ /zhu bde gnyis te bzhi po dang /

/shes rab de bzhin bzhi ste brgyad/ /drug tu byed na shes rab kyi/ /rang byin brlabs pa ma bsgom btub/ /yang na thabs la zhu dang bde/ /mi rtog rang rig pa ste bzhi/ /shes rab la'ang de bzhin gyi/ /bzhi ste brgyad dam de gnyis la/ /zhu bde mi rtogs pa gsum gsum/ /rang rigs spyi khyab btang bas drug /dus la nye rgyu bsgom pa'i dus/ /ljon shing las ni rim gnyis bsgom/ /gsang spyod zla gcig spyad pa'i mthar/ /nye rgyu bsgom pa'i skal ldan 'gyur/ /zhes dang drod ni chung ngu thob/ /gsang spyod spyad na nye rgyu bsgom/ /zhes gsung bdag med bstod 'grel las/ /nye rgyu spyod pa'i gang zag ni/ /sa brgyad yan gyi bsgrub du rung / /de yi bsgrub na zhag bdun 'gor/ /sa dgu pa nas rim bzhin du/ /bsgrub par nye zhing sa bcu gnyis/ /thob pas nyi ma gcig gis 'grub/ /gsung ste dri med thugs rje dang / /ldan pa'i bla ma'i zhal snga nas/ /nye rgyu zhag bdun sa 'dir dgongs/ /mdo las byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /mi skye'i chos la bzod thob pas/ /'dod na zhag po bdun la yang / /mngon par rdzogs sangs rgya gsungs mtshungs/ /ma mtha' sa brgyad thob pa na/ /nye rgyu nyams su len bshad pa'i/ /lugs ni mi 'dra gnyis snang ngo / /dus ni zhag bdun gyis 'grub pas/ /rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsung / /gnas ni thun mong phyi yi gnas/ /'phags yul rdo rje gdan lta bu/ /phyi yi thun min 'og min ste/ /rnam snang gangs can mtsho yi zhing / /nges don dam pa'i gnas la ni/ /rnal 'byor pa gang 'bras bu ni/ /mngon du bya ba'i gnas de ni /phyi ltar 'phags yul rdo rje gdan/ /nang ltar 'og min zhing 'jog go /nang gi gnas ni thabs rigs kyi/ /bdag po'i kha dang yum gyi rtsa/ /mdzes pa'i spyi bo gnyis 'dzom pa'i/ /chos 'byung ai waṃ bdag nyid de/ /gang la brten pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /goms dang grub pa lung bstan pa/

/mthu yis bkug pa dang bzhi las/ /saṃ bhu ṭi las de ltar gsung / /gur las mi yi phyag rgya gsung / /mngon du byed pa'i thabs la ni/ /rang byin rlabs ces rlung gtum mo/ /la sogs pa yi rnal 'byor te/ /des khams cung zad dwangs mar byas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dngos po ni/ /ye shes phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor te/ /dbang ni dngos kyi phyag rgya la/ /brten nas 'bras bu mngon du byed/ /ji ltar 'bras bu grub tshul ni/ /phyi yi mngon byang lnga mnyam sbyor/ /tshul gyis tshang ba thun mong lugs/ /nang gi mngon byang lnga mi mnyam/ /sbyor ba'i tshul gyis 'tshang rgya ba/ /thun mong ma yin pa yi lugs/ /de gnyis gcig char grub pa yi/ /tshul gyis sgo nas 'tshang rgya ba/ /gsang ba man ngag lugs te gsum/ /phyi yi mngon byang mnyam sbyor gyi/ /tshul gyis 'tshang rgya thun mong lugs/ /sgrub po de nyid 'og min du/ /sangs rgyas skabs su mi g.yo ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs kun gyis/ /se gol sgra yis sad byas te/ /oṃ tsit+ta pra ti be dhaṃ ka ro mi/ /zhes gsung don ni nyams blangs pas/ /mnyam bzhag rang bzhin rnam dag gi /rtogs pa skyes shing rjes thob tu/ /snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /snang ba shar te thabs kyi ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'i ngo bo ni/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi/ /rang bzhin mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang / /cha tsam rnyed pas sems so sor/ /rtogs las mngon par byang chub pa/ /zhes bya'i mngon byang dang po 'grub/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyi mngon byang ni/ /dang po dga' ba bsgom mtshon yin/ /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta uta pā da yā mi/ /zhes don bsgom pas mnyam bzhag tu/ /glo bur rnam dag gis stong pa/ /skye zhing rjes thob nag nog gi /dri ma bral ba'i zla ba'i dkyil/ /chos cher gsal ba'i snang ba shar/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin ngo bo ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin te/

/rin 'byung go 'phang cha tsam brnyes/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed las/ /mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya/ /gnyis pa grub cing rjes 'jug rnams/ /mnyam sbyor skabs su gnyis pa ni/ /zla bar bsgom par mtshon pa yin/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes don nyams su blangs pa las/ /mnyam bzhag gzung bya'i rtog pa bral/ /'od gsal stong nyid rtogs pa skyes/ /rjes thob zla dkyil steng du ni/ /rdo rje rtse lnga snang ba shar/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /ngo bo so sor rtog pa yi/ /ye shes rang bzhin 'od dpag med/ /go 'phang cha tsam brnyes pa las/ /brtan pa'i rdo rje las mngon par/ /byang chub zhes bya gsum pa 'grub/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyis mnyam sbyor tshe/ /zla ba gnyis steng rdo rje bsgom/ /de nyid mtshon par byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ /de don nyams blang mnyam bzhag tu/ /'dzin pa'i rtog pa bral ba yi/ /'od gsal stong pa'i rtogs pa skyes/ /rjes thob bum chur rdzas thim ltar/ /bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje thim pa'i snang ba shar/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ngo bo/ /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /don grub go 'phang cha tsam brnyes/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid las mngon par/ /byang chub mngon byang bzhi pa 'grub/ /rjes 'jug rnams kyi bzhi pa ni/ /ro gcig 'dres par bsgom pa mtshon/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta sta thā a haṃ/ /zhes don nyams su blangs pa yis/ /mnyam bzhag gzung 'dzin rtog pa ni/ /thams cad dang bral rnam pa kun/ /mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid/ /rtogs pa'i rtogs pa skyes nas ni/ /rjes thob du ni rang nyid ni/ /rnam snang chen por sangs rgyas pa'i/ /snang ba shar zhing ye shes kyi/ /pha rol phyin pa'i ngo bo ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi/ /rang nyid rnam snang chen po yis/ /go 'phang brnyes te de bzhin gshegs/ /ji lta ba las mngon byang chub/ /zhes bya'i mngon byang lnga pa 'grub/

/rjes 'jug rnams kyi lnga pa ni/ /yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i sku bsgom mtshon/ /mngon byang bzhi'i skabs ye shes bzhi/ /de de'i cha shas gsal tsam shar/ /mngon byang lnga sgrub gang zag de/ /ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga ni/ /yongs rdzogs sku ru sangs rgyas so/ /de ltar phyi yi mngon byang lnga/ /sgo nas 'tshang rgya'i tshul 'di ni/ /gtso chen rnal 'byor rgyud las ni/ /bshad kyang de nyid rang gang las/ /nyams len gsal bar ma bshad gsung / /nang gi mngon byang mi mnyam sbyor/ /tshul gyis grub ste 'tshang rgya'i tshul/ /nye rgyu zhag bdun par mtshon na/ /zhag bdun tho rangs sgrub pa po/ /thabs kyi rigs kyi bdag po yi/ /spyi bor byang chub sems dwangs ma/ /mngon du byas pas zla ba ni/ /me long lta bu las byang chub/ /mngon byang dang po shes rab kyi/ /rtsa mdzes spyi bor yum gyi ni/ /rak+ta mngon byas nyi ma ni/ /mnyam pa nyid las byang chub pa/ /dmigs pa nyi zla'i dwangs ma ni/ /ma 'dres so sor zhal sbyar gnas/ /so sor rtog par byang chub pa/ /gsum pa de dag ro gcig 'dres/ /bya ba grub las byang chub pa/ /bzhi pa nyi zla'i dwangs ma de/ /g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas 'dren pa/ /gsum gyi thabs dang shes rab rgyud/ /dag pa'i skad cig ma gnyis dang / /so sor dag pa'i skad cig ste/ /gsum mthar dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dwangs ma/ /dbu mar 'gros bzhi thim pa yis/ /gtsug tor mchog grub de yi tshe/ /sgrub po de nyid mngon sangs rgyas/ /sku ni yongs rdzogs chos kyi dbyings/ /ye shes mngon byang lnga mthar phyin/ /mngon byang phyi nang gcig char du/ /grub tshul man ngag skabs su 'byung / /de yang phyi nas bde gshegs kyi/ /dbang bskur de don nyams blang pas/ /phyi ltar mngon byang lnga rim bsgrod/ /nang du rang nyid nye rgyu la/ /brten pa'i dbang ni nyams blang pas/ /nang gi mngon byang gnyis char grub/ /man ngag lugs la nye rgyu yi/

/ngo bo bsgom pa'i dus dang gnas/ /rten dang mngon du bya ba'i thabs/ /'bras bu mngon du byed tshul drug /ngo bo dal bzhi'i 'gros thim pas/ /dbang de nye rgyu 'bras dus kyi/ /dbang zhes bzhi pa gtso che yin/ /dus ni sa ni bcu gnyis dang / /bcu gsum phyed tshe de yi yun/ /skad cig bdun gsum gnyis gang rigs/ /'di yi ngos 'dzin gong du song / /'di la phyi dus kyis mtshon na/ /zhag bdun gsum zhes la sogs dang / /skad cig gnyis su byas pa'i tshe/ /srod la bdud btul tho rangs ni/ /mngon par rdzogs byang chub pa'i dus/ /phar phyin sgo bstun gnad shes dgos/ /de yi tshe la sa phyed la/ /thams cad mkhyen chung bcu gsum par/ /thams cad mkhyen pa che zhes brjod/ /nye rgyu skad cig bdun ldan ni/ /nyams len cha mthun snga gong du/ /yod mod nyams len mtshan nyid pa/ /bcu gnyis pa'am bcu gsum pa/ /phyed pa'i skabs yin bcu gnyis ni/ /bcu gsum phyed mar 'pho ba dang / /phyed nas gong mar 'pho ba'i skabs/ /nyams len nye rgyu'am 'bras bu yi/ /dbang du bzhag par mdzad phyir ro/ /gnas ni phyi ltar thun mong pa/ /rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas mdzad/ /phyi yi thun min gnas 'og min/ /nang du rang nyid sgrub pa po/ /nye rgyu spyod de 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /gnas der de de'i snang ba shar/ /yang na nang ltar dbang gi gnas/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga zhes/ /yum gyi rtsa ni mdzes pa yi/ /spyi bo de la ming gdags rung / /phyi yi 'og min zhes pa de/ /lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo dang ni/ /'phags pa thog med kyi dngos gzhir/ /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun steng / /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas gsungs pa/ /srid pa gzugs khams 'og min dang / /dbang phyug ming la 'khrul mi bya/ /srid gsum las 'das zhing khams kyi/ /bkod par sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams/ /bzhugs shing de yi ston pa ni/ /longs sku chen po la ngos bzung /

/de bzhin dpal ldan rtse mo yi/ /mi mjed la sogs bsam mi khyab/ /nang du chud pa'i gzhi snying po/ /me tog gis brgyan zhing khams de/ /bsam gyis mi khyab nang du chud/ /'jig rten rgya mtsho rnam par snang / /gangs can mtsho yi phyag mthil gnas/ /rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas de'o/ /thun mong ma yin man ngag ni/ /dpal ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ gsungs pa'i gnas ni/ /'bigs byed gzhon nu'i grong khyer ni/ /chos dbyings byang chub sems kyis 'bigs/ /slob dpon dus gsum bde bar gshegs/ /kun 'dus yi dam lha bla ma/ /dbye ba med la bha ga ru/ /dngos grub len pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /srid pa shin tu rnam dag lam/ /bshad ltar sgrub po bcu gnyis pa/ /thob des yul chen so gnyis bgrod/ /dbu ma'i mdud pa so gnyis grol/ /zin yang phyi nang sbas yul lnga/ /ma bgrod spang rtogs mthar thug min/ /lam mthar phyin phyir sbas yul lnga/ bgrod dgos gnad kyi de 'og min/ /phyi nang gnyis su bzhag dgos so/ /phyi ltar rang nyid 'tshang rgya'i gnas/ /nang ltar yum gyis rtsa mdzes pa'i/ /spyi bo e waṃ zung 'jug do/ /'og min yin cing yul lnga ni/ /gong ma'i gsung las cha gnyis snang / /ro rkyang mas sna gnyis gnyis gyes/ /dbu ma'i mas sna dang lngar bshad/ /nye rgyu'i yab yum snyoms 'jug tshe/ /nyi zla'i dwangs mas gsang rtsa lnga/ /gang bas rlung sems mkha' la 'gro/ /yab yum bcu yi pho brang du/ /sangs rgyas yab yum gnas bha gar/ /dngos grub len pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /yang ni snying kha'i nang skor dbus/ /phyogs bzhi'i rtsa khams gnas de lnga'i/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi 'gros dbu mar thim/ /bcu gsum phyed gong rtogs pa skyed/ /lugs gnyis mi 'gal de dag rtsa'i/ /rtsa rtse'i gnad ma 'chol ba shes/

/'o na phyi yi sbas yul lnga/ /ji ltar snyam na 'di bzhin te/ /nye rgyu'i nyams len mthar thug la/ /slob pa'i gang zag de la ni/ /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel gnad/ /shes rab yum gyi bha ga'i rtser/ /snying kha'i rtsa lnga gang rung ba/ /'og min gnas su rang grub 'char/ /de la phyi yi 'og min 'dogs/ /lnga ru 'gyur don nang rtsa lnga'i/ /rten 'brel phyi yul lnga 'char te/ /don la tha dad med ces sam/ /rten dang brten pa'i gnad la 'dogs/ /de lta'i rnam bzhag byis blo yis/ /gzhal brjod mi nus bsam mi khyab/ /ye shes mkhyen pa tshad med do/ /nye rgyu mthar phyin rnal 'byor pa/ /'gros bzhi thim pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /bzhugs gnas 'og min kho nar nges/ /'og min zhes pa thag ring zhig /'gro dgos ma yin phyi nang gi /rten 'brel stong gsum yung 'bru'i dpe/ /rnal 'byor rang snang 'khrul med la/ /shar ba'i 'og min de ka'o/ /rten ni gong du bshad ltar gyi/ /phyag rgya mtshan nyid ldan de'o/ /mngon du byed thabs rang byin rlabs/ /sbyong pa sngon du song ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs khyad can/ /ji ltar mngon du bya tshul ni/ /phyi nang mngon byang lnga po ni/ /gcig char grub tshul 'bras bu'i sa/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /mngon du byed tshe yab yum sbyor/ /yab kyi zla ba rigs bdag khar/ /e yi rnam par phab pa na/ /mnyam bzhag chos kun rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtogs pa skyes/ /rjes thob snying khar zla ba yi/ /mtshan par 'char zhing mngon byang ni/ /dang po me long lta bu yi/ /ye shes rnam snang gsal snang thob/ /yum gyi rak+ṣa rtsa mdzes kyi/ /spyi bor baṃ gyi rnam par bab/ /mnyam bzhag glo bur rnam dag gi /rtogs pa skye zhing rjes thob tu/ /mnyam sbyor zla dkyil gnyis pa'am/ /mi mnyam sbyor ltar nyi dkyil 'char/ /gnyis pa 'grub cing mnyam nyid kyi/ /ye shes rin 'byung gsal snang rnyed/

/yab yum rtsa dang yi ge gnyis/ /dkar dmar khams rlung gnyis gnyis rnams/ /ma 'dres zhal sbyor gnas pa na/ /mnyam bzhag gzung ba dag pa yis/ /'od gsal stong nyid rtogs pa skye/ /rjes thob mnyam sbyor skabs zla gnyis/ /steng du rdo rje mi mnyam sbyor/ /ltar na nyi zla'i bar phyag mtshan/ /sa bon mtshan pa'i snang ba 'char/ /gsum pa grub cing sor rtogs kyi/ /ye shes 'od dpag gsal snang rnyed/ /yab yum rtsa yig khams rlung yod/ /gcig tu 'dres pas mnyam bzhag la/ /'dzin bral 'od gsal stong nyid rtogs/ /rjes thob bde gshegs sku gsung thugs/ /dwangs ma thams cad rdo rje la/ /thim pa 'char zhing bzhi pa grub/ /bya grub ye shes don grub kyi/ /gsal snang cher rnyed yab yum gyi/ /byang sems dbu ma nas drangs te/ /spyi gtsug dkyil 'khor bzhi 'gros thim/ /mnyam bzhag gzung 'dzin gnyis dag pa'i/ /'od gsal rnam kun mchog ldan skye/ /rjes thob mtshan dpes rab brgyan pa'i/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i skur sangs rgyas/ /snang ba 'char zhing lnga pa grub/ /chos dbyings ye shes gsal snang rnyed/ /bcu gsum gong ma mthar phyin te/ /ye shes sku lnga yongs rdzogs kyi/ /'bras bu mthar thug 'grub pa yin/ /des na mngon byang lnga pa'i tshe/ /ye shes lnga dang rigs lnga dang / /sku lnga la sogs gcig char grub/ /rim can grub par mi sems te/ /ye shes lnga dang mi ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa mi 'byung / /gong du phyi yi mngon byang tshe/ /chos kyi dbyings dang rnam snang sbyar/ /skabs 'dir mi bskyod dang sbyar ba/ /mi 'gal snga ma rnal 'byor rgyud/ /phyi ma bla med thun min lugs/ /des na rang nyid ye shes kyi/ /snang ba 'og min zhing khams der/ /sangs rgyas 'khor du sa bcu yi/ /byang chub sems dpas bskor ba'o/ /gtso 'khor tha dad tha mi dad/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /rgyud sde spyi rnam las gsung ste/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum ni/

/bshad pa'i go rim tsam yin gyis/ /sangs rgyas tshe na gcig char du/ /grub ste longs skur sangs rgyas pa'i/ /ston pa rnam par snang mdzad ces/ /de yi thugs kyi ye shes kyi/ /chos sku sems dang sems byung rnams/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bstan nas/ /chos ston ston pa chos kyi sku/ /de gnyis dbye ba med pa dang / /de yi bka' yi sdud pa po'i/ /tshul bzung la sogs bsam mi khyab/ /de la gsang sngags bla med kyi/ /sa lam bgrod tshul rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yong rdzogs mnga' bdag sa skya pas/ /rgyud dang man ngag bcas pa yi/ /zab gnad bkrol ba 'di lta ste/ /smin byed dbang dang grol byed kyi/ /rim gnyis de las skyes pa yi/ /ye shes phyag rgya chen po dang / /de la bogs 'byin spyod pa'i tshul/ /de las sa lam bgrod tshul lo/ /thun mong nyan thos theg pa yi/ /skyes bu ya bzhi zung brgyad la/ /dkar po'i sa brgyad btags pa dang / /rang rgyal la yang de dbyibs mtshungs/ /theg chen byang chub sems dpa' la/ /rab dga' la sogs sa bcu yi/ /bgrod tshul bcu gcig sangs rgyas sar/ /gsung pa grub mtha'i skabs smos bzhin/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lugs/ /'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa po/ /'jam mgon sa skya pa'i ring lugs/ /bcu gsum pa yi rnam bzhag ni/ /lung rigs man ngag kyis gtan phab/ /'thad ldan nyid du bzhed pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa yi bgrod tshul dang / /lam lnga byang phyogs so bdun gyi/ /bgrod tshul gnyis las dang po ni/ /bcu gsum pa yi bgrod tshul la/ /yul chen sum cu so bdun gyi/ /sgo nas sa lam bgrod pa'i tshul/ /dang ni dbu ma'i rtsa'i mdud pa/ /grol tshul sgo nas bgrod pa dang / /dga' ba bcu drug 'char tshul gyi/ /sgo nas sa lam bgrod pa'i tshul/ /sa dang lam gyi 'jug ldog bcas/ /rim pa bzhin du bstan pa la/ /dang po yul chen so bdun po/ /bgrod pa'i sgo nas sa thob tshul/

/phyi yi yul chen ngos bzung ba/ /nang gi yul chen ngos bzung ba/ /sa lam bgrod tshul dngos dang gsum/ /de la yul gyi ngos 'dzin ni/ /'khor lo bde mchog nas bshad pa'i/ /phyi yi yul chen so bdun ni/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i gnas brgyad ni/ /'dzam gling lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /dbus bzung phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas/ /pul+lī ra ma la ya dang / /dza lan+dha ra o ḍi ya/ /arbu ta go dā wa tī/ /rā me shwa ri de wī ko ṭa/ /mā la wa brgyad thugs 'khor lo/ /de yi phyi skor phyogs mtshams brgyad/ /kā ma rū pa o tre dang / /tri sha ku na ko pa la/ /ka ling ga dang lam bā ka /kāñci ra dang hi mā la/ /brgyad ni gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /de yi phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad/ /pre ta pu ti gri ha de wa/ /po rāṣ+ṭa dang pu war+ṇa/ /nā ga ra dang sin+dhu ra/ /ma ro ku lu ta ste brgyad/ /de ni thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /de yi phyi rol gling bzhi dang / /shar lho'i gling phran gnyis gcig tu/ /brtsis sogs gling phran bzhi dang brgyad/ /de ni dam tshig 'khor lo'i gnas/ /dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab rtse/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhi lnga po ni/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas yin no/ /'di dag shar nas brtsams phyogs rnams/ /g.yon bskor shar lho nas brtsams te/ /g.yas bskor nyid du gnas pa'o/ /nang gi yul chen so bdun ni/ /byang sems 'bab pa'i rtsa so gnyis/ /snying kha'i sbas pa'i rtsa lnga ste/ /so bdun po yi rtsa yig khams/ /rlung bcas la 'jog byang chub sems/ /'bab pa'i spyi bo nas gyes pa'i/ /rtsa mdud yig ge pu dzā o/ /a go rā de mā brgyad dang / /de nang khams dang rlung bcas pa/ /thugs 'khor gnas brgyad mgrin pa nas/ /gyes pa'i rtsa brgyad de'i yi ge /kā o tri ko ka la kā/ /hi yi rnam pa khams rlung bcas/ /gsung 'khor gnas brgyad lte ba nas/ /gyes pa'i rtsa brgyad de'i yi ge /pre gri so so su nā si dang /

/ma ku'i rnam pa khams rlung bcas/ /sku 'khor gnas brgyad snying kha nas/ /gyes pa'i phyi skor 'dab brgyad yig /hūm̐ ring brgyad po khams rlung bcas/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i gnas brgyad dang / /snying kha'i nang skor 'dab ma bzhis/ /rtsa dbyibs bh+rūm̐ aṃ dzīṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ /khams rlung dang bcas bde chen gyi/ /'khor lo yi ni gnas lngar 'jog /thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' spyod gnas/ /sangs rgyas thugs las sprul pa yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas byin rlabs/ /dbang phyug thugs sprul steng lha las/ /bab pa'i 'jigs byed brgyad dang por/ /byung ba'i gnas yin srung 'khor brgyad/ /sa spyod sangs rgyas gsung las sprul/ /dpal bo rnal 'byor mas byin rlabs/ /dbang phyug gsung sprul gnod sbyin gtso/ /'khor bzhi srin po gtso 'khor bzhi/ /sa steng spyod pa'i 'jigs byed brgyad/ /dang po'i 'byung gnas sku 'khor brgyad/ /sa 'og na spyod sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku sprul dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas/ /byin rlabs dbang phyug sku sprul gyi/ /rgya mtsho'i klu ni gtso 'khor bzhi/ /ri rab chu mtshams man chad na/ /gnas pa'i gtso 'khor bzhi po ste/ /sa spyod 'jigs byed brgyad po ni/ /dang po'i 'byung gnas gling mtshams bzhi/ /dam tshig 'khor lo 'phrin las gnas/ /shar du khwa gdong byang 'ug gdong / /nub tu khyi gdong lhor phag gdong / /shar lho la sogs gling phran bzhi/ /gshin rje brtan ma pho nya mo/ /mche ba can ma 'joms ma bzhi/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig las sprul pa'i/ /sgo mtshams brgyad kyis byin rlabs pa/ /dbang phyug phrin sprul ma mo brgyad/ /dang po'i 'byung gnas ri rab rtse/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhi dpal 'khor lo/ /bde mchog yab yum mkha' 'gro dang / /la ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang / /gzugs can ma ste lha lnga'i gnas/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /'khor lo sdom pa gtso 'khor lngas/ /byin rlabs sbas pa'i yul lnga zhes/

/nang gi sbas rtsa lngas mtshon pa'i/ /phyi yi gnas ni yin phyir ro/ /sa lam bgrod pa'i tshul dngos la/ /spyir btang rgyud kyi lugs dang ni/ /dmigs bsal man ngag lugs gnyis las/ /spyir btang rgyud kyi lugs la ni/ /phyi nang yul chen so bdun la/ /brten nas bcu gsum pa bgrod tshul/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas gnyis las/ /phye ba'i thugs kyi 'khor lo yi/ /yul chen dang po bzhi las ni/ /dang po'i sa bgrod phyi ma ni/ /gnyis pa bgrod cing zhing nye zhing / /tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho ste/ /sku 'khor brgyad kyi sa gsum pa/ /bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa bgrod/ /'du dang nye ba'i 'du ba dang / /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod de/ /gsung 'khor brgyad kyi sa bdun brgyad/ /dgu pa dang ni bcu pa bgrod/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod de/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i gnas brgyad kyi/ /bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis bgrod/ /sbas pa'i yul lnga'i bde chen gyi/ /gnas lnga bcu gsum pa bgrod do/ /de nyid zhib du bshad pa na/ /dang po'i sa thob yul chen bzhi/ /rtsa ni mi phyed mdud pa pu/ /khams ni so sen gnas spyi bo/ /rtsa ni phra gzugs mdud pa dzā/ /khams ni skra dang ba spu dang / /gnas ni spyi gtsug rtsa rtse ma/ /mdud pa oṃ dang khams lpags dri/ /gnas ni rna g.yas rtsa g.yon la/ /mdud pa a dang khams sha gnas/ /ltag pa rtsa bzhi re re la/ /las rlung drug brgya bdun cu ni/ /rtsa lnga re re'i rgyu ba rnams/ /dbu mar thim pas phyi yi gnas/ /pul+lī ra ma la dang ni/ /dzā len+dha ra o rgyan dang / /arbu bzhi yi dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams dbang du bsdud/ /sa ni dang po'i rtogs pa skyes/ /gnyis par yul bzhi rtsa thung ngu / /rtsa mdud go dang khams chu rgyus/ /gnas ni rna g.yon rtsa ru sbal/ /skyes ma rtsa mdud rā khams ni/ /rus phreng gnas ni smin phrag dang / /rtsa ni sgom la rtsa mdud de/ /khams ni mkhal ma gnas mig gnyis/

/rtsa ni dbang ma mdud pa mā/ /khams ni snying 'bab gnas phrag gnyis/ /de rer rlung ni drug brgya dang / /bdun cu lnga re dbu mar thim/ /phyi yul go da wa ri dang / /rasmi de wī ko ṭa dang / /mā la wa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams dbang 'dus nas/ /sa ni gnyis pa'i rtogs pa skyes/ /gsum pa nas ni drug pa'i bar/ /gnyis gnyis bgrod de rtsa skyon ma/ /rtsa mdud ka dang khams mig bab/ /gnas ni mchan gnyis rtsa mjug ma/ /rtsa mdud o dang khams mkhris bab/ /gnas ni nu ma gnyis dang rtsa/ /ma mo rtsa mdud tri khams ni/ /glo ba 'bab cing gnas lte ba/ /rtsa ni mtshan mo rtsa mdud ko /khams ni rgyu ma gnas sna rtse/ /de dag re rer rlung drug brgya/ /bdud cu rtsa lnga re'i rgyu ba/ /dbu mar thim pas phyi yi yul/ /kā ma rū pa o tre dang / /tri shu ku ne ko sa li'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dbang 'dus/ /sa ni gsum pa bzhi pa yi/ /rtogs pa skye zhing rtsa bsil sbyin/ /rtsa mdud ka dang khams chu rgyus/ /gnas ni kha dang rtsa tsha ba/ /rtsa mdud la dang lto ba 'bab/ /gnas ni mgrin pa rtsa gzhol ma/ /rtsa yi mdud pa kā dang khams/ /snying 'bab gnas ni snying kha'o/ /rtsa ni tsha ma rtsa mdud hi/ /khams ni dus 'bab gas 'doms bar/ /rlung ni drug brgya don lnga re/ dbu mar thim pas phyi yi gnas/ /ka liṅka dang lam+bhā dang / /kāñci ka dang hi ma la'i/ /dpal bo rnal 'byor ma dbang 'dus/ /sa ni lnga drug rtogs pa skye/ /de bzhin bdun nas bcu yi bar/ /gnyis gnyis bgrod de rtsa shin tu/ /gzugs can ma dang mdud pa ni/ /bro dang khams ni bad kan 'bab/ /gnas ni mtshan ma rtsa spyi ma/ /mdud pa gṛ dang khams rnag bab/ /gnas ni bshang lam rtsa rgyu sbyin/ /mdud pa so dang khams khrag 'bab/ /gnas ni brla gnyis rtsa sbyor bral/ /mdud pa su dang khams rdul bab/ /gnas ni byin pa gnyis dang ni/ /rlung ni drug brgya bdun cu ni/

/lnga re dbu mar thim pa yis/ /phyi yul pre ta pu ri dang / /gṛ ha de wā so rāṣ+ṭa/ /su war+ṇa bzhi dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams dbang du 'dus/ /sa ni bdun brgyad rtogs pa skye/ /rtsa ni sdug gu rtsa mdud nā/ /khams ni tshil bu 'bab cing gnas/ /sor mo bcu drug rtsa grub ma/ /rtsa mdud sa dang khams mchin pa/ /gnas ni bol gong gnyis dang rtsa/ /'tshed ma rtsa mdud ma dang khams/ /mchil ma gnas ni mthe bong bzhi/ /rtsa ni yid bzang rtsa mdud ku/ /khams ni gnag 'bab gnas pus gnyis/ /rlung ni drug brgya bdun cu lnga/ /re re dbu mar thim pa yis/ /phyi yul nā gar sin+dhu ra/ /ma ro ku lu bzhi yin te/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dbang 'dus/ /sa ni bcu dgu'i rtogs pa skye/ /de bzhin bcu gcig bcu gnyis la/ /gnas ni bzhi bzhi bgrod dgos te/ /gnas ni sum skor 'dod ma dang / /'khyil ma dang ni gtum mo bzhi/ /rtsa mdud hūm̐ dang khams rlung lnga/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'dres bdud rtsi bzhi/ /gnas ni snying kha'i phyi skor gyi/ /mtshams bzhi rtsa ni kun 'dar ma/ /ro ma rkyang ma mdud bral ma/ /rtsa mdud hūm̐ dang khams khu khrag /dri chen dri chu bzhi 'bab cing / /gnas ni snying kha'i phyi skor gyi/ /shar nye'i dbus dang g.yas g.yon rgyab/ /de dag rnams su rlung drug brgya/ /bdun cu don lnga re thim pas/ /phyi yul gling phran gling bzhi yi/ /dpal bo rnal 'byor ma dbang 'dus/ /sa ni bcu gcig bcu gnyis pa'i/ /rtogs pa skye zhing kun 'dar ma/ /ro rkyang gsum ni de gsum gyi/ /cha shas re la 'jog dgos kyi/ /yongs rdzogs nyid du 'khrul mi bya/ /sa ni bcu gsum thob pa la/ /yul rnams bgrod dgos sbas pa yi/ /rtsa lngar grags pa snying kha ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus nang skor/ /rtsa 'dab phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga/ /de dag gnas pa'i yi ge ni/ /dbus hūm̐ shar bh+rūm̐ lhor āṃ dang / /nub dz+rīṃ byang khaṃ dang khams ni/

/bdud rtsi lnga dang dbus nam mkha'/ /shar chu lho sa nub me byang / /rlung ste rlung lnga'i dwangs ma bcas/ /gnas ni gtsug tor phyi yi gnas/ /ri rab rtse yi dbus phyogs bzhi'i/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus/ /bcu gsum pa yi rtogs pa skye/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob ste/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mngon du gyur/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang thob bo/ /de yang dmigs bsal man ngag lugs/ /yul chen so bdun bgrod tshul ni/ /sbas pa'i yul lnga bgrod tsam gyis/ /ma yin sbas pa'i rtsa lnga de'i/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /dbu mar thim las bcu gsum pa'i/ /phyed slob gtsug tor phyed 'phags tsam/ /yin la rten de'i nye rgyu yi/ /srog rtsol gyis rlung dbu mar nag /gtsug tor hril po dwangs mas brtan/ /bcu gsum phyed gong rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas sa ni mtshan nyid pa/ /mngon gyur gsung ngag rin po che/ /rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi dgongs pa/ /'khrul med phul du phyin pa'o/ /bde mchog a bhi dha na las/ /gsungs pa'i sa dang yul so bdun/ /sbyar nas gsal bar byas pa'o/ /dpal ldan kyai yi rdo rje yi/ /rtsa rgyud dang ni phyag thig gnyis/ /sbyar tshul bla ma dam pa yi/ /man ngag gis bkral 'chad pa la/ /yul chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /sa ni bcu gnyis sbyar ba la/ /sa ni dang po thob pa la/ /yul chen bzhi ni bgrod dgos te/ /dzā lan+dha ra phyi kha che/ /rgya gar bar yod nang spyi bo/ /o rgyan phyi ni rgya gar gyi/ /nub phyogs nang gi spyi bo'o/ /ko la ki ri zhes pa phyi/ /lho nub kā ra pū ri yi/ /grong na yod cing nang 'tshogs ma/ /kā ma rū pa phyi gnyal mda'/ /rgya gar shar yod nang smin phrag /de bzhi rlung sems dbu mar thim/ /sa ni dang po'i rtogs pa skye/ /gnas kyi yul bzhi bgrod pa'o/ /gnyis pa thob la yul bzhi ste/ /mā la wa ste phyi lho yi/ /gling phran nang gi sna rtse'o/

/sin+dhu phyi ni chu bo che/ /sin+dhu 'bab pa nang mig gnyis/ /nā ga ra ste phyi grong khyer/ /yul dbus na yod nang rna gnyis/ /siṅgha la ni phyi gling ste/ /nang gi kha ste de bzhi yid/ /rlung sems dbu mar thim pa la/ /sa ni gnyis pa'i rtogs pa skye/ /nye gnas yul bzhi bgrod pa'o/ /gsum pa bzhi la gnyis gnyis bgrod/ /mu mu zhes pa phyi lho phyogs/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram yod nang koska/ /de wī ko ṭa phyi rgya gar/ /rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs yod/ /nang ni mgrin pa de gnyis kyi/ /rlung sems dbu mar thim pa yi/ /sa ni gsum pa'i rtogs pa skye/ /zhing gi yul gnyis bgrod pa'o/ /ku lu ta zhes lho nub na/ /rdo ni pus dbyibs nang rgyab tshig /arbu ta zhes lho phyogs ni/ /rdo ni nu 'dra nang nu gnyis/ /de gnyis rlung sems dbu mar thim/ /sa ni bzhi pa'i rtogs pa skye/ /nye zhing yul gnyis bgrod pa'o/ /ha ri ke la shar lho na/ /nam mkha'i shing ldan nang snying kha/ /go da wā rī phyi lho phyogs/ /dpal gyi ri ngos nang lte ba/ /de gnyis rlung sems dbu mar thim/ /sa ni lnga pa'i rtogs pa skye/ /tshan+dho'i yul gnyis bgrod pa'o/ /lam bha ka ni phyi rgya gar/ /nub kyi phyogs te nang gsang gnas/ /kañci zhes pa phyi lho nub/ /nang ni rtags dbus de gnyis kyi/ /rlung sems dbu mar thim pa las/ /sa ni drug pa'i rtogs pa skye/ /nye ba'i tshan+dho'i yul gnyis bgrod/ /byed pa'i grong zhes phyi lho phyogs/ /rgya mtsho'i gling phran nang rtags rtse/ /gser dang ldan pa'i gling phyi ni/ /lho phyogs mi med gling nang ni/ /gzhong kha de gnyis rlung sems ni/ /dbu mar 'dus pas sa bdun pa'i/ /rtogs skyes 'du ba'i yul gnyis bgrod/ /koska na zhes phyi lho phyogs/ /ma hā bi bha zhes pa yi/ /mchod rten rang byon gnas nang ni/ /brla gnyis bin+dha zhes pa phyi/ /ri bo 'bigs 'byed nang pus gnyis/

/de yi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus/ /sa ni brgyad pa'i rtogs pa skye/ /nye ba'i 'du ba'i yul gnyis bgrod/ /rab song dge 'dun 'du zhes phyi/ /ro mang gnas pa yi dwags 'dus/ /nang ni byin pa gnyis rgya mtsho'i/ /'gram zhes phyi ni rasmi shwa ra/ /yi dwags rgyu ba'i gnas yin na/ /rkang bol gnyis pa de dag gi /rlung sems dbu mar thim pa yi/ /sa ni dgu pa'i rtogs pa skye/ /dur khrod gnas gnyis bgrod pa'o/ /tsa ri tra zhes phyi lho phyogs/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram yin nang ser mo/ /gnyis po gzhon nu'i grong khyer zhes/ /bu mo gzugs bzang skye ba'i gnas/ /rgya mtsho'i gling phran nang mthe bong / /gnyis po de gnyis rlung sems ni/ /dbu mar thim nas sa bcu yi/ /rtogs pa skye zhing de gnyis kyi/ /nye ba'i dur khrod yul gnyis bgrod/ /grong khyer zhes pa phyi kha che'i/ /bye brag nang ni phrag pa'o/ /grong mtha' zhes pa phyi mon yul/ /nang ni rkang mthil lañca yi/ /rgya mtsho'i nang skyes pa khyab 'jug /gis byas rnam snang sku bzhugs gnas/ /so so raṣ+ṭa zhes yul 'khor/ /bzang po so ba na da na/ /yod ste de gnyis nang snying phyogs/ /de bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar thim/ /sa ni bcu gcig rtogs pa skye/ /'thung gcod yul bzhi bgrod pa'o/ /hi ma la zhes phyi bal por/ /gtogs pa'i bod de nang ltag pa/ /ko sa la zhes phyi rdo rje'i/ /gdan nub mnyan yod phyogs nang rked/ /ka liṅga zhes phyi lho phyogs/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram ni ling ka dang / /nye ba'i yul 'khor skyed tshul gyi/ /ra ba'i rdzing bu'i 'gram zhes pa/ /ma skyes dgra yi skyed tshal gyi/ /phyogs te de gnyis nang snying kha/ /de bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar thim/ /sa ni bcu gnyis rtogs pa skye/ /nye ba'i 'thung gcod yul bzhi bgrod/ /'di yi hi ma la zhes pa/ /gangs can skad dod yin mod kyang / /mngon pa dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i/ /gangs can mtshan nyid pa min te/

/'di ni bal bod mtshams na yod/ /der bshad khyad chos mi ldan pas/ /de ni yul chen nang tshan min/ /bde kyi'i yul gyi ngos 'dzin ni/ /'dra min byung yang rtsa dag gis/ /skyed pa dang ni 'bras bu smin/ /dbang gi tha dad tsam yin gyi/ /dper na rkang pa'i bol gong la/ /bku mnye byas pas mig bde 'gyur/ /de phyir sin+dhur de gnyis bshad/ /de bzhin lte bar bku mnyes byas/ /rna ba bde gyur de gnyis ni/ /go dā wa rir bshad ltar ro/ /rgyud la 'khrugs sdebs su bzhugs pa/ /rje btsun mchog gi gsung rab la/ /'phags pa rin po che yis ni/ /mchan gyis gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan bkod/ /de ltar yul chen so gnyis po/ /bgrod dgos gnad kyi sa bcu gsum/ /mam ni bcu gsum phyed 'og ma/ /thob la sbas pa'i rtsa lngas mtshon/ /yul lnga bgrod dgos sbas pa yi/ /rtsa lnga'i rlung sems dbu mar thim/ /rang nyid 'khor gyi tshom bu gcig /dang bcas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa yi/ /phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga yi ni/ /mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du ba'o/ /skabs 'di'i sbas pa'i yul lnga po/ /sgrub bo rang nyid nye rgyu ni/ /spyod bzhin sa de'i dbus phyogs bzhi/ /ngos 'dzin 'thad de ljon shing las/ /nye rgyu mngon du byed pa yi/ /gnas la phyi ni rdo rje gdan/ /nang ni 'og min don dam gnas/ /sgrub bo rang nyid gang na 'dug /gnas de yin par gsung phyir ro/ /de yi so bdun yul bgrod las/ /sa rnams thob tshul 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa yis ni/ /bshad pa'i srol las 'byon pa'o/ /rtsa ni dbu ma'i mdud pa rnams/ /grol tshul sgo nas sa bgrod tshul/ /dbu ma'i rtsa mdud chags tshul dang / /de grol sa lam bgrod tshul gnyis/ /dbu ma'i mdud pa'i cha lugs ni/ /dbu ma ro rkyang gnyis kyis ni/ /gcer ba'i mdud pa so gnyis gnas/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo yi/ /thad du dbu ma'i mdud pa bzhi/

/lte ba snying kha mgrin smin mtshams/ /mdzod spu bzhi yi 'khor lo la/ /mdud pa drug drug spyi bo yi/ /bde chen 'khor lo mdud pa bzhi/ /mdud pa so gnyis de grol bas/ /sa ni bcu gnyis man bgrod de/ /gsang gnas lte snying mdud pa ni/ /bcu drug grol bas bum dbang sa/ /drug bgrod 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi/ /grub mtha' snyog cing mgrin smin gyi/ /mdud pa bcu gnyis grol ba yi/ /gsang dbang sa bzhi bgrod nas ni/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' snyogs/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i mdud bzhi grol/ /shes rab ye shes sa gnyis bgrod/ /bde stong rgya chung grub mtha' snyogs/ /de yi sa ni bcu gnyis bgrod/ /bcu gnyis rten la nye rgyu yis/ /nyams len la rten dbang bzhi pa'i/ /sa phyir bgrod de grub pa'i mtha'/ /bde stong rgya che ba nyid thob/ /bcu gsum pa phyed 'og mar slebs/ /nye rgyu'i nyams len 'phro mthud pas/ /bcu gsum phyed gong sleb pa dang / /rang nyid 'khor ni tshom bu gcig /dang bcas gtan gyi bde ba mchog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob bo/ /de yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /gsung ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ /sa ni dang po bcu gnyis par/ /mdud pa re re grol dgos shing / /bar gyi sa ni bcu po la/ /gsum re grol dgos gsung pa ste/ /gsang gnas 'khor lo'i mdud pa ni/ /dang po grol bas rab dga'i sa/ /thob cing yul ni gnas kyi sa/ /phyi ma gsum po grol ba las/ /gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i sa/ /yul gyi nang nas nye gnas so/ /lte ba'i mdud pa dang po gsum/ /grol bas gsum pa 'od byed pa/ /thob cing yul ni zhing yin la/ /phyi ma gsum grol bzhi pa 'dod/ /'phro ba yul ni nye zhing ngo / /snying kha'i mdud pa gsum grol bas/ /lnga pa sbyang dka'i sa yul ni/ /tshan+dho phyi ma gsum grol bas/ /drug pa mngon gyur sa yul ni/ /nye ba'i tshan+dho bum dbang gi /sa drug rdzogs par thob zhes bya/

/de ni gtso bo bum pa'i dbang / /lam ni skyed rim sogs lag rjes/ /yin pas bum dbang gi nyer len/ /rgyu yi tshul dang dbang gzhan gsum/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rkyen lta bu/ /de bzhin mgrin pa'i mdud pa ni/ /dang po gsum grol sa bdun pa/ /ring du song ba yul 'du ba/ /bgrod cing phyi ma gsum grol bas/ /brgyad pa mi g.yo ba thob yul/ /nye ba'i 'du ba bgrod pa'o/ /smin mtshams mdud pa gsum grol bas/ /dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros yul/ /dur khrod bgrod cing phyi ma gsum/ /grol bas bcu pa chos kyi sprin/ /yul ni nye ba'i dur khrod bgrod/ /de ni gsang dbang sa bzhi zhes/ /gtso bo gsang dbang nyer len zhes/ /dbang gzhan gsum ni lhan cig pa'i/ /rkyen ni lta bu yin phyir ro/ /spyi bo'i mdud pa dang po gsum/ /grol bas bcu gcig dpe med pa/ /thob cing mdud pa phyi ma gcig /grol bas bcu gnyis ye shes ni/ /chen po'i sa thob de gnyis la/ /sher dbang sa gnyis dbang de yi/ /nyer len gzhan gsum lhan cig ni/ /byed pa'i rkyen yin de man chad/ /dbu ma'i mdud pa so gnyis grol/ /mthong lam sa ni dang po nas/ /bsgom lam sa ni bcu gcig ste/ /sa ni bcu gnyis po thob de/ /re re la'ang 'pho ba ri'i/ /rlung ni dgu brgya phrag gcig ste/ /stong brgyad brgya re 'gag pa yis/ /las rlung nyi khri chig stong dang / /drug brgyad 'gag cing sa re rer/ /las rlung phyi nang sor re 'gag /rlung de'i tshad ni sor bcu gnyis/ /'gag pas rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang / /spang bya rnam rtog bcu gnyis 'gag /phyi nang yul ni so gnyis bgrod/ /yon tan dga' ba bcu drug rdzogs/ /'on kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa/ /mtshan nyid pa nyid mngon byed la/ /sbas pa'i yul lnga bgrod byed kyi/ /thabs la bslab par bya dgos so/ /dga' ba bcu drug 'char tshul gyi/ /sgo nas sa lam bgrod tshul la/ /yas bab dga' ba bcu drug dang /

/de bzhin mas brten bcu drug la/ /yas bab dga' ba bcu drug pa/ /lhan skyes kyi ni lhan skyes sam/ /mas brten dga' ba bcu drug gi /dang po dga' ba'i dga' ba nas/ /dang po'i sa skyes mgo tshugs te/ /mas brten gyi ni dga' ba dang / /mchog dga' dga' bral gsum gyi tshe/ /sa ni dang po'i skabs yin la/ /mas brten lhan skyes mchog dga' dang / /dga' bral lhan skyes gsum gyi tshe/ /sa ni bcu gnyis bar slebs zin/ /bar gyi sa bcur dga' ba re/ /'char ba yin te rdo rje'i rtser/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bar thig le/ /gnas pa ltar lus bde ba yis/ /myos shing brgyal zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje lus kyi 'khor lo drug /lte gsang gnyis dang dpral spyi gnyis/ /gcig tu brtsis pa'i 'khor lo bzhir/ /lte bar mas brten dga' bzhi shar/ /khams kyi dwangs ma brten pa yis/ /dga' bas bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi/ /de bzhin snying khar mchog dga'i bzhi/ /mgrin par dga' bral gyi bzhi dang / /spyi bor lhan skyes dga' bzhi shar/ /'khor lo de dag las rlung dag /khams ni dwang bas gang zhing brten/ /lam lnga dang ni byang chub chos/ /so bdun gyis ni bgrod tshul gnyis/ /dang po lam lnga bgrod tshul la/ /rgyud dang man ngag gi lugs gnyis/ /rgyud kyi lugs ni drod chung ngu'i/ /tshogs lam 'bring pos sbyor lam dang / /chen pos mthong ba'i lam de nas/ sa ni gnyis pa nas bzung ste/ /bcu gnyis bar gyi bsgom lam dang / /bcu gsum mthar phyin lam du bzhed/ /man ngag lugs la phar phyin dang / /sgo bstun lam lnga'i rdzogs mtshams ni/ /'jig rten lam la khams 'dus pa/ /gsum gyi skabs su tshogs sbyor gnyis/ /'dres zhing bskyed la 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i lam ni sa dang por/ /mthong lam thob cing de nas ni/ /sa ni bcu gnyis bar bsgom lam/ /bcu gsum phyed ni 'og ma la/ /mthar phyin lam yin de man chad/ /lam lnga rdzogs pas bcu gsum phyed/

/gong ma de na bcu gsum pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa sangs rgyas/ /mtshan nyid pa nyid mngon gyur to/ /bcu gsum pa la gong 'og gnyis/ /phye nas 'og mar ming mthar phyin/ /lam dang gong ma 'bras bu nges/ /yin pa'i rnam bzhag shes pa gces/ /tshogs sbyor 'dres zhing skyes tshul ni/ /dbang bzhi'i lam bzhi ting nge 'dzin/ /skye ba'i rgyu ni tshogs lam dang / /de la brten nas skyes pa yis/ /lta ba bzhi ni tshogs lam 'jog /tshogs lam bzhi las phyi dbyibs ni/ /bskyed rim lam yin nang sngags lam/ /lte bar rlung sems tshogs byed pa/ /gsang lam gtum mo de gnyis khams/ /'dus pa dang po gtso che gsang ba ni/ /dbang lam zhes pa yum gyi mkhar/ /rlung sems tshogs pa'i rgyu sher dbang / /rgyu de 'dus pa bar ba gtso/ /mthar thug de kho na nyid kyi/ /lam ni pad+ma can gyi ni/ /bha gar rlung sems tshogs byed pa/ /bzhi pa'i lam ste khams 'dus pa/ /tha mar gtso cher 'dus gsum la/ /tshogs lam gsum dang de chung 'bring / /che gsum 'dus pa de gsum gnyis/ /drod ni che 'bring chung gsum 'jog /drod chen mthong lam du mi 'jog /rgyud dang man ngag srol tha dad/ /tsam yin rags pa zhib pa ni/ /'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che'i/ /tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs ltar 'chad na/ /'dus pa tha mar tshogs kyi lam/ /chen po'i rten la dngos dbang ni/ /bzhi pa la brten sbyor ba'i lam/ /drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog bzhi/ /lugs 'byung dga' bzhi dang sbyar nas/ /rim can skye bar bshad pa ste/ /dbu mar mdud pa med pa ni/ /sor bzhi yod la phyi shun la/ /thur du bskyod pas drod rtse gnyis/ /de la dga' ba mchog dga' gnyis/ /nang shun la ni gyen du bskyod/ /bzod pa dang ni chos mchog gnyis/ /de la dga' bral lhan skyes gnyis/ /de bzhi bzhi bzhir phye ba yi/ /drod sogs bcu drug dga' bcu drug /skye zhing spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi/

/rnam rtog bcu drug spong tshul bshad/ /de don cung zad bkrol ba ni/ /mchog gi ze bar rlung sems ni/ /'dus des rtsa mdud dang po yan/ /mdud pa med pa sor bzhi la/ /rtsa gsum 'dres ma ltar yod pa'i/ /phyi shun la ni sor phyed bzhi/ /thur du bskyod pas drod chung ngu / /'bring po chen po'i chung ngu dang / /chen po bzhi la rim bzhin du/ /dga' bas bsdus pa'i dga' bzhi skye/ /mthong spang 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /khong khro ser sna nga rgyal te/ /rdzas 'dzin rtag chad mthar bzung ba/ /brtags 'dzin mdor na rtsa nyon drug /nye nyon nyi shu'i char gtogs pa'i/ /'di zhes bzung ba'i rtogs pa ni/ /chen po'i chen po de'i chung ngu / /'bring dang chung ngu rim spangs nas/ /rang bzhin med par rtog pa'o/ /lam du 'byong na nyan thos kyi/ /lam chod gol na 'dod khams rgyu/ /de nas sor bzhi thur du bskyod/ /rtse mo'i che 'bring chung ngu bzhi/ /rim bzhin mchog dga'i dga' ba bzhi/ /skye zhing rnam rtog rnam byang phyogs/ /sems dang sems byung dge ba ni/ /mtshan rtog bcas la 'di'o zhes/ /bzung ba'i rtog pa chen po dang / /de yi chung ngu 'bring chung spangs/ /lam du slong na rang sangs rgyas/ /lam chod zhen na gzugs khams su/ /nang shun bzhi la sor bzhi ni/ /gyen du bskyod pas bzod pa ni/ /chen po de yi chung ngu dang / /chung 'bring bzhi dang dga' bral gyi/ /bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi skye zhing / /mthong spong rdzas 'dzin shes gang zag /rdzas yod bem shes ldan min gyi/ /'du byed gsum 'dzoms rten can la/ /'di zhes bdag gir 'dzin pa yi/ /rtog pa chen po de'i chung ngu / /chung 'bring bzhi spong rang bzhin ni/ /med par rtogs so yang sor bzhi/ /gyen du bskyod pas 'dzin rtog ni/ /btags 'dzin zhes pa nga zhes pa'i/ /ngar 'dzin skyes bu btags yod kyi/ /rten can la ni 'di zhes nas/ /bzung ba'i bdag gi 'dzin pa ni/

/chen po de yi chung ngu dang / /'bring po dang ni chung ngu spong / /rang bzhin med par rtog pa'o/ /de ltar spang bya bzung 'dzin gnyis/ /mtha' dag spangs pas bar chad med/ /ma nor sngags kyi lam bzang chod/ /de ltar rags pa phyi yi ni/ /rten 'brel yang dag spong bzhi dang / /phra ba nang gi rten 'brel gyi/ /yang sngags lam la sbyar ba dag spong bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /lhan skyes dga' ba dang po gsum/ /'char zhing pha rol phyin pa dang / /sgo bstun sbyor lam nges 'byed bzhi'i/ /mthong spangs spong tshul bla med kyi/ /thun mong ma yin lugs 'byung gi /dge ba bcu drug shar ba'o/ /mas bstan dga' ba dang po dang / /mthong ba'i lam mchog sa dang po/ /rab tu dga' ba gcig char 'char/ /des na khams 'dus dang po gnyis/ /skabs su sbyor lam drod rtogs pa/ /skye med 'dus pa tha ma yi/ /skabs su drod bzhi skye ba'i tshul/ /sbyar 'di pad+ma can rten la/ /brten nas yang dag sngags lam la sbyar ba'i spong bzhi yi/ /tshogs lam chen po la brten nas/ /drod rtse bzod mchog khyad par ba'i/ /rtogs pa skye tshul bye brag pa/ /sbyar ba yin gyi rtse bzod mchog /'dus pa tha ma'i skabs ma gtogs/ /de yan skye bar ma bshad pas/ /rnam dpyod 'dab mar chags pa gces/ /rdo rje lus 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos lam lnga ltar gyi bgrod pa'i skabs/ 'dir nang gi lus kyi gnad la brten nas tshogs sbyor mthong spang dang bsgom spang gi rnam bzhag gsung pa gsung ngag rin po che'i skabs 'phags pa rin po che'i tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs ltar bkral zhing der rdo rje lus kyi 'khor lo'i gnas la sa bgrod pa spang bya rnam rtog spang tshul la rten 'brel 'gag lugs phyi nang de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'char tshul rnams gsung pa ltar zhib tu bkral nas bris so/ la 'khor lo drug /gnas pa'i 'khor lo re re la/

/sa ni gnyis gnyis bgrod pa yi/ /spang bya bsgom spang rnam rtog ni/ /che 'bring chung gsum bcu gnyis spang / /rga shi la sogs rten 'brel ni/ /bcu gnyis lugs ldog tu 'gag nas/ /phyi nang de kho nyid kyi rten/ /gsum gsum 'char ba 'di lta ste/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo yi/ /rtsa mdud bzhi las dang po grol/ /dang po'i sa thob phyi yi yul/ /pul+lī ra ma dza lan+dha/ /au ḍi ya na arbu bzhi/ /dbu mar grong stong bsgom spang ni/ /rnam rtog che 'bring chung chung ngu / /bzhi las gsum gsum phye ba yi/ /chen po 'gag cing phyi rtags ni/ /gsang gnas 'khor phyed thig les gang / /nang rtags phyi nang rlung sor re/ /'pho gcig las rlung stong dang ni/ /brgyad brgya pa 'gag de kho nyid/ /rtags ni sems la shar ste rtsa/ /'khor lo bzhi dang gtso mo gsum/ /mngon mthong byang chub yan lag bdun/ /de nas gsang gnas rtsa mdud ni/ /phyi ma bzhi grol sa gnyis thob/ /'di nas bzung ste bcu gnyis bar/ /sgom pa'i lam gyis bsdus par bzhed/ /phyi yul go dā wa ri dang / /rasmi shwa ra de wī ko /ṭa dang ma la ya bzhi'i grogs/ /dbu mar stong shing sgom spang gi /rnam rtog chen por gsum phye ba'i/ /gnyis pa 'gag nas phyi yi rtags/ /gsang gnas hril po khams dwangs mas/ /gang zhing brten nas nang gi rtags/ /rlung ni phyi nang sor re re/ /'gag bas las rlung stong brgyad brgya/ /'gag cing de bzhin lte ba yi/ /'khor lo'i rtsa mdud drug nas ni/ /dang po gsum grol sa gsum thob/ /phyi yul ka ma ru pa dang / /o tre'i grong ni dbu mar stong / /bsgom spang rnam rtog chen po las/ /gsum du phye ba'i gsum pa 'gag /phyi rtags lte ba'i 'khor lo'i phyed/ /khams kyi dwangs mas gang zhing brtan/ /nang rtags phyi dang nang gi rlung / /sor re 'gag pas las kyi rlung / /stong dang brgyad brgyad dbu mar thim/ /lte ba'i rtsa mdud phyi ma gsum/
