/grol bas sa ni bzhi pa thob/ /phyi yul dri sha ko ne dang / /ko pa la'i grong dbu mar stong / /bsgom spang rnam rtog 'bring la gsum/ /phye ba'i dang po 'gag nas phyi'i/ /rtags ni lte ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /hril po khams kyi dwangs mas gang / /brtan zhing nang rtags phyi nang drug /sor re 'gag pas las rlung ni/ /stong dang brgyad brgyad dbu mar thim/ /de bzhin snying kha'i 'khor lo yi/ /rtsa mdud drug las dang po gsum/ /grol bas sa ni lnga pa thob/ /phyi yul ka liṅka dang ni/ /lam bha gnyis grong dbu mar stong / /bsgom spang rnam rtog 'bring la gsum/ /phye ba'i gnyis pa 'gag nas phyi'i/ /rtags ni snying kha'i 'khor lo'i phyed/ /khams kyi dwangs mas gang zhing brtan/ /nang rtags phyi nang rlung sor re/ /'gag pas las rlung stong brgyad brgya/ /dbu mar thim zhing snying kha yi/ /rtsa mdud phyi ma gsum grol bas/ /drug pa'i sa thob phyi yi yul/ /kañci ka dang hi ma la'i/ /grong ni dbu mar stong nas ni/ /bsgom spang rnam rtog 'bring la gsum/ /phyi ba'i gsum pa 'gag nas phyi'i/ /rtags ni snying kha'i 'khor lo ni/ /hril po khams kyi dwangs ma yis/ /gang zhing brtan nas nang gi rtags/ /las rlung stong dang brgyad brgya pa/ /dbu mar thim zhing bum dbang gi /sa drug ring la de kho na'i/ /sems kyi rtags ni sprul sku yi/ /zhing khams stong bskul ba nas bzung / /rim par de tshe sprul sku yi/ /zhing khams bye ba phrag bdun bskul/ /nus shing yon tan sogs 'phel ba/ /rnam rtog 'gro ldog 'gag nas phyi'i/ /lte snying thig le brtan pa yis/ /longs sku 'ga' mthong grub mtha' ni/ /bzhi las 'khor 'das dbyer med thob/ /de nas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /rtsa mdud drug las dang po gsum/ /grol ba yis ni sa bdun thob/ /phyi yul pre ta pū ri dang / /gri ha da wa'i grong gnyis stong / /bsgom spang rnam rtog chung ba la/

gsum du phye ba'i dang po 'gag /phyi rtags mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i phyed/ /khams kyi dwangs mas gang zhing brtan/ /nang rtags rlung ni phyi dang nang / /ser re 'gag pas las kyi rlung / /stong dang brgyad brgya dbu mar thim/ /de bzhin mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud ni/ /phyi ma gsum grol sa brgyad thob/ /phyi yul ni sau raṣ+ṭha/ /su war na gnyis kyis grong stong / /bsgom spang rnam rtog chung ba la/ /gsum du phye ba'i gnyis pa 'gag /phyi rtags mgrin pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /khams kyi dwangs mas hril gang brtan/ /nang rtags phyi nang rlung sor re/ /'gag pas las rlung stong brgyad brgya/ /dbu mar thim zhing smin mtshams kyi/ /rtsa mdud drug las dang po gsum/ /grol bas sa ni dgu pa thob/ /phyi yul na ga ra dang ni/ /sin dhu'i grong stong bsgom spang ni/ /rnam rtog chung ba'i gsum pa 'gag /phyi rtags smin mtshams 'khor lo'i phyed/ /khams kyis dwangs mas gang zhing brtan/ /nang rtags rlung ni phyi nang gi /sor re 'gag pas las kyi rlung / /stong dang brgyad brgya dbu mar thim/ /smin mtshams mdud pa phyi ma gsum/ /grol bas sa ni bcu pa thob/ phyi yul ma ru ku lu ta/ /gnyis kyi grong stong bsgom spang gi /rnam rtog chung ngu'i chung ngu la/ /gsum du phye pa'i dang po 'gag /smin mtshams 'khor lo hril po ni/ /khams kyi dwangs mas gang zhing brtan/ /nang rtags phyi nang rlung sor re/ /'gag pas las rlung stong brgyad brgya/ /dbu mar thim zhing gsang dbang gi /de kho nyid rtags sems la 'char/ /dbang po lnga dang dwangs ma lnga'i/ /rlung la mnga' brnyes nus pa lnga/ /lta stangs lnga la thogs pa med/ /bha ga'i dal du rigs drug gi /sa bon mthong zhing sems can rnams/ /skad du chos ston chos spyi rang / /mtshan nyid thogs med lte ba yi/ /yi ge brgyad dang dbyangs gsal mthong / /mdo sde'i chos kun ji bzhin shes/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ro drug la/

/longs spyod tshangs pa'i dbyangs 'gyur ba/ /ā ni yig 'bru ces sogs don/ /longs sku'i zhing khams dung phyur phrag /bdun nas rim par longs sku'i zhing / /ther 'bum chen po phrag bdun bsgul/ /grub mtha' bzhi las ma 'dres pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i grub mtha' snyogs/ /de nas spyi bo bde chen gyi/ /'khor lo'i rtsa mdud bzhi las ni/ /dang po gsum grol sa bcu gcig /thob cing phyi yul las kyi grong / /ha ri ke la zhes pa dang / /lañca rgya mtsho'i nang skyes pa/ /bin+dha bzhi'i grong dbu mar stong / /bsgom spang rnam rtog chung ngu la/ /gsum du phye ba'i gnyis pa 'gag /phyi rtags bde chen 'khor lo'i phyed/ /khams kyi dwangs mas gang zhing brtan/ /nang rtags phyi nang rlung sor re/ /'gag pas las rlung stong brgyad brgya/ /dbu mar thim zhing spyi bo yi/ /rtsa mdud phyi ma gcig grol bas/ /bcu gnyis sa thob phyi yi yul/ /gzhon nu'i grong zhes bya ba dang / /rab song dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /skyed tshal rwa ba'i rdzing 'gram grong / /dbu mar stong zhing bsgom spang gi /rnam rtog chung ngu'i gsum pa 'gag /phyi rtags spyi bo'i 'khor lo ni/ /hril po khams kyi dwangs mas gang / /nang rtags phyi nang rlung sor re/ /'gag pas las rlung stong brgyad brgya/ /dbu mar thim zhing sher dbang gi /sa gnyis tshe na de kho na/ /nyid rtags sems la 'char ba ni/ /stobs lnga byang chub sems kyi rlung / /lnga spyod pa yi dwangs ma yi/ /dwangs ma rtsa khams nang gi khams/ /dang zhing thogs pa med pa yis/ /'od zer rnam pa ji bzhin mthong / /sku gsum dang ni ye shes lnga/ /phyag rgya lnga dang he ru ka /bcu gcig rnams te lha yi ni/ /de kho na nyid nyi shu bzhi/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sngags dang ni/ /de kho na nyid bzhi nyams su/ /myang ba'i rtogs pa dang ldan zhing / /yas 'bab dga' bzhi'i ye shes kyi/ /dbang thob sher dbang zhes bya thob/

/bdud rtsi lnga po gar 'dus mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzhan don mdzad/ /mthong zhing sprul pa bde chen su/ /thig le 'du mthong sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang bzhin gnas ni zab mo la/ /bzhugs mthong lte ba sprul 'khor du/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang rlung lnga 'du/ /mthong nas longs sku rigs lnga sogs/ /yum gyi bha ga na bzhugs nas/ /skal ldan byang chub sems rnams la/ /gsang ba sgrogs mthong phyag rgya ma'i/ /dwangs ma mthong nas mngon shes la/ /thogs pa med cing rtsa yi ge /rnams su dwangs ma 'drongs na ni/ /rdzu 'phrul la ni thogs pa med/ /de nyid slar yang spros nas ni/ /sngon gnas rjes dran chos sku yi/ /zhing khams rab bkram bsgul bar nus/ /grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung thob/ /de ltar dbu ma'i mdud pa ni/ /sum cu gnyis grol yul chen ni/ /so gnyis bgrod cing phyi yi rtags/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo bar khams kyi/ /dwangs mas gang brtan nang gi rtags/ /de dag re rer phyi nang rlung / /sor re 'gag pas las rlung ni/ /stong phrag gcig dang brgyad brgya re/ /dbu mar thim zhing sa bcu gnyis/ /rdzogs shing bum gsang sher dbang gi /grub mtha' gsum thob de nas ni/ /nang gi snying dbus sbas pa yi/ /rtsa lngar rtsa yig nus pa 'dus/ /bdud rtsi shin tu dwang ba dang / /rlung ni shin tu byang ba der/ /gnad du zin pa'i dbang gis ni/ /phyi yi sbas pa'i yul lnga bgrod/ /ri rab rtse yi dbus phyogs bzhi/ /yang na rang nyid sangs rgyas pa'i/ /gnas de phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /rdo rje gdan zhes yul lnga yi/ /rnam bzhag mdzad cing phyi yi rtags/ /gtsug tor phye ni khams dwangs mas/ /gang brtan nang rtags srog rtsol rlung / /phyi dbyibs āḥnas gtsug tor gyi/ /phyed kyi bar zhugs de kho na/ /nyid rtags sems la 'char ba ni/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad gsal bya/ /rgyu rgyud kyai yi rdo rje la/ /sgrib byed rnam shes tshogs brgyad po/

/ye shes lnga ru gnas gyur to/ /gzung pa rnam dag mtshan ma bral/ /'dzin pa rang grol smon pa med/ /gzung 'dzin las grol bde chen thob/ /sa chen 'di ni dga' zhing mgu /rnam pa drug g.yos bdud gnas su/ /sgra grags phyag rgya ma'i gnas su/ /khams gsum mthong zhing mkha' 'gro rnams/ /ring na 'du zhing ha ri ma/ /la sogs dbang phyug brgyad don 'char/ /bde stong rgya che'i grub mtha' thob/ /de'ang bar gyi sa brgyad la/ /zhib tu dpyad na sbyor ba yi/ /mgo ni rtsom la mdud pa gcig /grol zhing dngos gzhir longs spyod la/ /mdud pa gcig grol rjes thim par/ /mdud pa gcig grol zhes 'byung ngo / /byang phyogs so bdun dang sbyar te/ /sa lam bgrod pa'i tshul la ni/ /rgyud dang man ngag lugs gnyis kyi/ /dang po rgyud kyi lugs la ni/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan bcos las/ /sbyor lugs lnga ste rgyu rgyud kyi/ /sbyong bzhi rtsa sogs la sbyor dang / /lam gyi bskyed rim lha rten dang / /brten pa la ni sbyor ba dang / /so so'i skye bo'i lam zhugs nas/ /bzung ste lam lnga so sor sbyar/ /bden pa mthong ba nas bzung ste/ /sangs rgyas mngon byas bar sbyor dang / /sangs rgya kho na'i gzugs sku'i lhar/ /sbyor ba lnga las mthong lam yan/ /sbyar 'di'i lnga ka shes nus gsung / /de ltar mthong lam yan chod la/ /sbyor ba'i lugs ni 'di lta ste/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi'i/ /dang po'i sa bgrod yang dag pa/ /spang bzhi'i sa ni gnyis pa bgrod/ /gsum nas bcu'i bar sa brgyad la/ /byang phyogs gnyis gnyis 'gro dgos pas/ /rdzu 'phrul zung bzhi'i sa gsum bzhi/ /dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga yi/ /sa ni lnga drug bdun brgyad dgu/ /byang chub yan lag bdun gyi ni/ /dang po gnyis kyis sa bcu bgrod/ /de nas bzhi yis bcu gcig bgrod/ /de nas gcig dang 'phags lam gyi/ /yan lag brgyad kyi dang po gsum/ /de yis sa ni bcu gnyis bgrod/

/lhag ma gsum gyis sa bcu gsum/ /bgrod 'di rdo rje bdag med ma'i/ /bstod pa rtsa 'grel dgongs pa'o/ /de nas man ngag lugs la ni/ /byang phyogs so bdun tshogs lam nas/ /bcu gsum 'og ma man chad sbyar/ /snang ba dgra langs gnyen po ni/ /'byung bzhi'i rlung la rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /rkang pa bzhis mtshon snang ba ni/ /dgra langs 'phrang bsgral khams 'dus pa/ /dang po'i lam chod de nas ni/ /stong pa dgrar langs kyi gnyen po/ /lha bsgom ye shes sems dpa' bcug /snying po bzla zhing lha de yi/ /rgyan drug dgos pa bsam pa bzhi'i/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag bzhi mtshon/ /stong pa dgrar langs 'phrang las sgrol/ /khams 'dus bar ma'i lam chod de/ /de nas bde bas brgyal ba yi/ /gnyen por yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /bsgom ste de yang ro rkyang gi /mas sna dbu ma'i mas snar chud/ /lus la rtsa yi rten 'brel dang / /rkyang ma'i mas sna na yod pa'i/ /yi ge bzhi pa snying po'i a/ /dbu ma'i mas snar ru slebs pas/ /dbu ma'i cha shas kyi yi ge /bzhi pa phyi dbyibs a gyen la/ /bskyod pas rtsa yig gi rten 'brel/ /de las 'byung bzhi'i rlung lnga po/ /dbu ma'i mas snar chud pa yi/ /rlung gi rten 'brel de las rtsa/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi las rlung gi /rgyu ba'i sgo ni thig les bkag /khams kyi bdud rtsi rten 'brel te/ /de bzhi'i gzung 'dzin rnam rtog spangs/ /yang dag spang ba bzhi mtshungs zhing / /bying ba chen po'i 'phrang las bsgral/ /khams 'dus tha ma'i lam chod pas/ /'jig rten pa yi lam man chad/ /byang phyogs bcu gnyis kyis bgrod do/ /yang dag spong bzhi tshogs lam ni/ /chen po yin zhing nges 'byed bzhis/ /rtogs pa 'char tshul lam gyi skabs/ /gong du bshad bzhin shes par bya/ /de nas byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /nyi shu rtsa lngas 'das pa'i lam/ /sa ni phyed dang bcu gsum bgrod/ /rtsa ni 'khor lo bzhi yi dbyibs/ /e waṃ ma ya'i rnam pa bzhi/

/rtsa yi gtso mo ro rkyang dbu/ /gsum mthong byang chub yan lag bdun/ /bum pa'i dbang gi sa drug bgrod/ /'byung bzhi'i rlung la dbang thob pas/ /dbang po lnga ste gsang dbang gi /sa bzhi bgrod cing 'byung lnga'i rlung / /stobs su gyur pa stobs lnga ste/ /sher dbang sa gnyis ye shes lnga/ /gnas 'gyur pa la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /brten pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad ni/ /'phags pa'i lam ste sangs rgyas pa'i/ /yan lag rgyu yin 'phags lam brgyad/ /bzhi pa'i dbang gis sa phyed bgrod/ /bcu gsum 'og mar slebs phyir ro/ /bcu gsum pa la cha gnyis su/ /byed pa'i 'og ma 'bras dus kyi/ /dbang dang mtha' ru phyin pa'i lam/ /'gros bzhi thim phyed dbang yin la/ /nyams len gtso bo nye rgyu yi/ /nyams len yin te skad cig ma/ /bdun dang gsum dang gnyis su bshad/ /bdun ni thabs rgyud dag pa la/ /skad cig gsum dang shes rab rgyud/ /dag la gsum dang thabs shes ni/ /so so dag la skad cig gcig /gsum du byed na thabs shes kyi/ /rgyud la skad cig re re dang / /so sor dag la skad cig go /gnyis su byed na thabs shes gnyis/ /rgyud dag skad cig gcig du bsgrangs/ /so sor dag la'ang skad cig gcig /de ltar skad cig sa gnyis su/ /phye ba'i skad cig dang po de/ /bar chad med dus srod la ni/ /bdud btul cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus/ /'bras bu gnyis kyi dus zhes dang / /skad cig gnyis pa rnam grol gyi/ /dus dang tho rangs mngon par ni/ /byang chub dus dang thams cad mkhyen/ /chung ngu'i dus dang 'bras gcig gi /dus zhes ming gi rnam grangs bstan/ /bcu gsum phyed 'di sangs rgyas ni/ /mtshan nyid pa min phar phyin dang / /sgo bstun mthar phyin lam zhes 'dogs/ /bla med theg pa'i khyad chos ni/ /'di yang lam gyi skabs bzhag cing / /bcu gsum phyed ni gong ma zhes/ /nye rgyu skad cig ma gnyis pa'i/ /byed las srog rtsol rlung dbu mar/

/'gag zhing gtsug tor hril por 'phags/ /'gros bzhi rdzogs par thim tshar dang / /'bras bu sku lnga mngon gyur la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa/ /'bras bu mngon gyur 'di nyid do/ /nye rgyu tsam la'ang so skye yi/ /rdo rje rba rlabs lam tsam zhig /nyams len bshad cing sa brgyad ni/ /nye rgyu'i nyams len bya bar bshad/ /des na nye rgyu'i dbye ba dang / /lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag gi /ma 'khrul 'di bzhin shes par bya/ /bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi lung / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag go/ ༈ /de nas sa lam 'jug ldog la/ /phar phyin theg pas 'jig rten pa'i/ /lam ni phar cher bgrod de nas/ /rdo rje theg pa la zhugs te/ /sa ni dang po man chad bgrod/ /yang ni dang po'i sa man chad/ /phar phyin gyis bgrod gnyis pa nas/ /yan chad rdo rje theg pas bgrod/ /yang ni sa drug man chad de/ /phar phyin gyis bgrod de nas ni/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam dang ni/ /ro gcig gyur te yan chad bgrod/ /yang na sa bcu pa man chad/ /phar phyin gyis bgrod de nas ni/ /rdo rje theg pa la zhugs nas/ /bcu gcig bcu gnyis bcu gsum phyed/ /bcu gsum phyed ni gong ma bgrod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du byed/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po mchog /bla ma sa skya pa chen pos/ /lam gyi 'jug ldog yi ger gsung / /des na phar phyin rang rkang las/ /sa bcu man chod bgrod pa yod/ /bcu gcig yan tu bgrod pa med/ /slob lam bcu gcig sa sogs ni/ /phar phyin theg par sbas phyir ro/ /phar phyin rang rkang sa bcu pa/ /'dod pa'i byang sems de'i rtsa mdud/ /grol dang ma grol zhes dogs ni/ /skyon med phar phyin gzhung las ni/ /rtsa mdud grol bar ma bshad kyang / /sa bcu thob pa'i 'gal rkyen rnams/ /zhi nas thob bya'i yon tan thob/ /rtogs bya'i gnas lugs rnam rtogs pas/ /rtsa mdud grol dang gnad gcig gyur/ /rtsa mdud grol bar kho nar yang /

/ma nges spang rtogs kyi gnad de/ /lam zab bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rtsa mdud grol srid spang rtogs kyi/ /yon tan mchog ni rgyud la skyes/ /yang ni sa bcu man bgrod pa'i/ /byang sems sngags la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /phyi nang yul chen nyer bzhi po/ /bgrod dang ma bgrod zhes pa dang / /de nyid dga' ba bcu drug las/ /dga' ba bcu gnyis thob ma thob/ /zer ba dgos pa mi 'tshal te/ /sa bcu bgrod pa'i phar phyin pa/ /spyi bo sogs kyi khams rnams ni/ /dbu mar zin na yul nyer bzhi/ /tha snyad tsam du ma bgrod kyang / /spang rtogs mtshungs pas don gyis bgrod/ /gnas dang nyer gnas sogs kyang ni/ /tha snyad ma thob kyang de don/ /spang rtogs na mnyam gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin las brten lhan skyes sogs/ /de'ang gnad don na mnyam ste/ /dang po rab dga'i sa thob tshe/ /gsang gnas 'khor lo dang mas brtan/ /zag med dga' bde thob phyir ro/ /yang ni phar phyin sa bcu pa'i/ /byang sems sngags la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /de ma thag tu sa bcu gcig /thos pa yin nam smin byed dbang / /dgos sam lam dang 'bras dbang la/ /zhugs pas chog pa yin zer na/ /rgyu yi smin byed ma thob bar/ /lam dbang 'bras dbang thob pa med/ /gal te smin byed dbang nas brtsams/ /'jug na de yi dngos sta gnyis/ /dgos sam dngos gzhi nus zhugs chog /sta gon thob ma thag pa ru/ /bcu gcig pa ni thob mi srid/ /dngos gzhi la'ang phyi 'jug dang / /nang 'jug dgos sam bum dbang gi /chu dbang sogs nas zhugs pas chog /dbang gi ma smin lam dang po/ /'jug pa zhus ma thag pa dang / /de bzhin slob ma'i dbang thob 'phral/ /bum dbang thob ma thag sogs la/ /bcu gcig sa thob mi srid cing / /de thob pa la bla med kyi/ /dbang bzhi thob dgos gal te de/ /dbang bzhi bcu gcig pa sogs ni/ /gcig char thob pa ci 'gal snyam/ /dbang bzhi gcig char thob pa dang / /'og ma ma thob gong ma thob/ /lung mchog 'di la khas mi len/

/'di la spyir btang dmigs bsal gnyis/ /byang sems sngags la zhugs pa des/ /sngags kyi bla med tshogs sbyor gnyis/ /mngon du byed dgos mthong lam gyi/ /dang po'i sa nas bsgom lam gyi/ /sa bcu'i bar du sngon song khong / /sbyor lam 'jug nas bcu gnyis par/ /zhugs pas chog par 'dod phyir ro/ /'o na gsang sngags bla med kyi/ /tshogs sbyor mngon du byed dgos pa'i/ /gnad ni ji ltar yin zhe na/ /de ltar bla med lam du ni/ /zhugs ma thag de las dang po/ /dbang gi ma smin pa yin pas/ /smin byed dbang bzhi rim can du/ /thob dgos dbang bzhi thob nas ni/ /mtshon bya don gyi ye shes gcig /nam zhig rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe/ /'di phar phyin rang rkang gis bcu lan bgrod pa'i skabs bshad pa'o sa ni bcu gcig sa thob la/ /de yi sngon song dbang bzhi'i lam/ /rnams ni tshogs lam dbang de dag /la brten lta ba ngo bo nyid/ /gsum sogs sbyor lam du 'jog dgos/ /mdor na theg chen sa bcu nas/ /gsang sngags lam du zhugs phyin chad/ /dbang bzhi rim gyis thob nas ni/ /de la brten nas khams 'dus pa/ /tha mar yang dag spong bzhi la/ /brten nas mtshon bya don gyi ni/ /ye shes skye tshe sa bcu gcig /thob 'di gsung ngag sa yi lugs/ /phar phyin theg pas sa bcu man/ /bgrod nas sngags lam zhugs ma thag /theg chen 'phags pa yin mod kyang / /sngags la gnas pas phar phyin par/ /mi 'gro sngags kyi ye shes ni/ /ma skyes bla med 'phags pa yang / /ma gyur gnyis kar dbye mi nus/ ༈ /da ni 'bras bu'i sa bcu gsum/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thob tshul la/ /dngos dang dgos pa dpyad pa gnyis/ /dang po dngos kyi rnam gzhag ni/ /bcu gsum sa phyed gong ma de'i/ /brgyud ring rgyu pa'i rgyu ni spyod pa gsum/ /lhan cig byed rkyen nye rgyu zhes/ /ming btags 'gros bzhi thim byed kyi/ /'bras dus kyi ni dbang yin la/ /nyer len rgyu ni 'gros bzhi po/

/thim ka ma yi dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /brten dang bcas te dkyil 'khor bzhi'i/ /'gros bzhi thim pas rang don gyi/ /che ba sku lnga gzhan don gyi/ /che ba long bas mig thob sogs/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i che ba ni/ /'khor ni tshom bu gcig dang bcas/ /'tshang rgya 'gros bzhi thim tshul ni/ /bum dbang rtsa yi 'gros thim ste/ /rtsa kun nus pa dbu mar thim/ /de yang gtsug tor mchog thim ste/ /tshad ni sor bzhi dbyibs yi ge /na dā zhes pa sum 'khyog gi /rnam pa sbom phra rta rnga ni/ /brgyar gshags tshad tsam de yi tshe/ /rtsa ni gnas 'gyur sprul pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang nas shākya thub/ /bar gyi rnam pas 'gro don mdzad/ /gsang dbang yi ge'i 'gros thim ste/ /snying po'i a de rtsa yi mdud/ /gang grol sar phyin spyi bo yi/ /haṃ dang 'phrad pas kha dog thim/ /dkar po dbyibs ni thim pa yis/ /a haṃ mi thi stobs thim pas/ /hūm̐ gi stobs gyur de yi tshe/ /yi ge gnas gyur longs sku zhes/ /legs sbyar skad nas rigs drug sogs/ /skad kyi 'gro don byed pa 'byung / /sher dbang bdud rtsi'i 'gros thim pas/ /khams dgu'i dwangs ma rnams gtsug tor/ /mchog gi dbu mar thim pa'i tshe/ /bdud rtsi gnas gyur chos sku zhes/ /shes bya ji lta ji snyed kun/ /sa ler mkhyen pas 'gro don mdzad/ /bzhi pa'i dbang gi rlung gi 'gros/ /thim pas las rlung rnam grong stong / /ye shes rlung ni 'ba' zhig gyur/ /rlung ni gnas gyur ngo bo nyid/ /skye 'gag 'gro 'ong sogs dang bral/ /dri bral dbyings kyi mngon sum du/ /gzigs te 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /de ltar rten ni sku bzhi ru/ /gyur dang mnyam du brten pa yi/ /kun gzhi gnas gyur shin tu ni/ /rnam dag ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /zhes bya dbyings dang ye shes zungs/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku/ /thob ste 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /'gro don rgyun mi chad pa mdzad/

/bdag nyid sku lnga brnyes pa'i tshe/ /rang dang rgyud dag pa'i phyag rgya/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i bla ma dang / /mos pa thob pa'i slob ma dang / /bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /tshom bu gcig bcas dus mnyam du/ /grol ba bla med rdo rje yi/ /theg pa'i rten 'brel che ba ste/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gzigs pa yi/ /brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud las gsungs so/ /bcu gsum pa la dogs pa ni/ /dpyad la snga rabs mkhas pa yi/ /gsung sgros bskyar dang sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun gong mas ji gsung tshul/ /snying po don gyi ngos bzung gsum/ /bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs/ /phar phyin theg pas sngags la 'jug /phyi mtha' tshogs lam chen po nas/ /yin gyi theg chen sbyor lam yan/ /sngags lam kho nas bgrod dgos smra/ /de ltar yin na ston pa yi/ /rgyu yi theg pa'i chos kyi ni/ /'khor lo bskor ba dgos med gyur/ /wa ra ṇa sir bden bzhi yi/ /chos 'khor bskor las ston pa'i 'khor/ /lnga sdes bden pa mthong ba sogs/ /gsung ba rnam dang 'gal bar gyur/ /yang ni 'brug pa pad dkar gyis/ /sa ni bcu drug bar du bshad/ /snga ma snga ma phyi ma yi/ /slob lam 'dod cing bcu drug gi /sgrub byed dga' ba bcu drug la/ /sbyar rung de 'dra'i sa mtshan nyid/ /sa ru 'dod na sa thams cad/ /gcig char thob gyur de mi srid/ /dus kyi 'khor lor sa bcu gcig /bshad dang kyai yi rdo rje las/ /bcu gsum bshad dang gzhan du ni/ /bcu drug 'dod sogs yon tan ni/ /bcu gsum de las gzhan med do/ /re mda' ba yi sa bcu gcig /khong du bcu gnyis bcu gsum gnyis/ /gcig par 'dod kyang mdo sngags kyi/ /dbye ba'i rnam gzhag dka' bar snang / /paṇa shāka mdo yi bcu gcig dang / /sngags kyi bcu gsum gnad gcig 'dod/ /des na mdo las bshad pa yi/ /bcu gcig sngags kyi bcu gsum pa/ /sngas rtogs mnyam 'dod mdo sngags kyi/ /'phags chos dbye ba dka' bar snang /

/de dag bshad pa'i rnam grangs tsam/ /bla ma sa skya pa chen pos/ /rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnam 'grel las/ /lnga bcu la gsang zhes pa'i don/ /phar phyin longs sku rigs lnga la/ /gsang zhes phar phyin rang rkang la/ /sangs rgyas 'phags pa yod med kyi/ /gsang sngags sangs rgyas 'phags pa las/ /cung zad rtogs pa dman lta bu/ /gsung zhing rje btsun rtse mo yis/ /rgyud sde spyi rnams las mdo nas/ /bshad pa'i kun 'od la gnas pa'i/ /'phags pa de ni mdo lam gyi/ /sangs rgyas yin kyang gsang sngags nas/ /bshad pa'i ye shes lnga ldan dang / /sku bzhi sku lnga shes bya ni/ /thams cad rang snang mkhyen pa sogs/ /ma yin mdo sngags sangs rgyas la/ /khyad par yod pa lta bur gsung / /bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi/ /phar phyin theg las bshad pa yi/ /bcu gcig sar gnas sangs rgyas de/ /btags pa ba dang bla med kyi/ /bcu gsum sar gnas sangs rgyas de/ /mtshan nyid pa ni yin no zhes/ /dngos btags gnyis su phyes nas gsungs/ /de lta'i gnad don ngos bzung ba/ /rgyud dang man ngag lugs gnyis so/ /bcu gcig pa de thob pa la/ /sngags kyi lam la ltos dgos pa/ /bla ma sa skya pa chen pos/ /lam gyi 'jug ldog skabs gsungs so/ /sa ni bcu gcig sngags lam yin/ /rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam dang / /bdag nyid chen pos bdag med kyi/ /stod 'grel nas gsung dgongs pa de/ /mdo lugs rang rkang sa bcu gcig /kun tu 'od ces ming tsam bshad/ /mdo lugs pa yi sa de thob/ /sangs rgyas bzhed pa tsam la dgongs/ /bcu gcig sar gnas gang zag de/ /mdo yi spyi don mthar thug pa/ /pha rol phyin pa'i mdo las ni/ /bshad tshod tsam gyis sangs rgyas ni/ /yin kyang spyi don spang rtogs ni/ /mthar thug brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /ma yin sangs rgyas btags pa ba/ /brjod kyi de ni phar phyin gyi/ /mdo las thob pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /yin kyang sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa/ /min zhes khas kyang ma len ste/

/sa ni bcu gcig mtshan nyid pa/ /su yi thob kyang sngags lam la/ /brten nas thob pa zhig dgos so/ /des na rgyud kyi skabs 'di na/ /mdo nas bshad pa'i bcu gcig pa/ /kun tu 'od de gsang sngags nas/ /bshad pa'i bcu gcig dpe med pa'i/ /sa yin de gnyis gnad gcig mod/ /'on kyang rang rang ldog pa nas/ /don gcig tu ni khas mi blangs/ /sngags kyi bcu gcig dpe med pa'i/ /sa de mdo nas bshad pa yi/ /bcu gcig pa ni ma yin te/ /de ni gsang sngags bla med kyi/ /thun min rgyud sde nas bshad do/ /man ngag lugs la mdo sde nas/ /bshad pa'i bcu gcig kun tu 'od/ /sa de man ngag gi skabs 'dir/ /dbang ni bzhi pa'i sa phyed ces/ /grags pa'am ni sa bcu gsum/ /phyed kyi 'og ma zhes grags pa/ /gnad ni gcig pa thams cad mkhyen/ /klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa ni/ /bcu gsum sa phyed 'og ma des/ /pha rol phyin dang sgo bstun gyi/ /thar phyin pa yi lam du bzhag /gsum ngag lam 'bras las 'di gsungs/ /bcu gsum phyed kyi 'og ma de/ /skad cig ma ni gnyis bzhag pa'i/ /dang po bar chad med pa'i dus/ /bdud btul cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus/ /zhes sogs bshad nas skad cig ma/ /gnyis pa sa rnams grol ba'i dus/ /tha ma rdzogs pa'i byang chub dus/ /thams cad mkhyen pa chung ngu'i dus/ /zhes sogs gsung de phar phyin gyi/ /lugs kyi sangs rgyas de la dgongs/ /de ltar sa chen yab sras dang / /bdag nyid chen po paṇ+ḍi tas/ /dgongs don 'gal med gcig tu rtogs/ /sngags kyi bcu gsum gong ma yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon gyur to/ /de ltar 'di las phar phyin la/ /sa bcu bar du sa rnams la/ /bgrod tshul yon tan dang bcas gsung / /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams brjod nas/ /de la bcu gcig sa zhes 'dogs/ /don du sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa/ /sngags la ma brten thob pa med/ /des na phar phyin rang rkang gi /bcu gcig sa de sngags kyi ni/

/bcu gsum phyed kyi 'og ma yin/ /'on kyang gsang sngags bla med skabs/ /bcu gcig sangs rgyas sa thob tsam/ /bcu gsum mngon gyur sangs rgyas thob/ /'khor gyi tshom bu lnga'i don la/ /nye rgyu sogs la brten dgos kyang / /bla ma sogs la so so ya/ི /nye rgyur brten mod 'dir rang nyid/ /gtso zhing gzhan rnams 'khor gyi ni/ /rnam gzhag tsam yin nye rgyu ni/ /gzhan la yod med dogs mi 'tshal/ /dper na shing ni yal 'dab lnga/ /kho na yod pa zhig la ni/ /shing gi yal 'dab lngar brjod mtshungs/ /ces 'di mdo sngags thams cad mkhyen/ /mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho yi/ /gsung las gnad bsdus bkod pa'o/ /skye 'gro kun la 'chi ba'i tshe/ /'chi ba 'od gsal ngos zin min/ /de yi bde 'gro ngan 'gro'i lam/ /dbye ba mdo sngags gnyis char bshad/ /sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa yis/ /dgos pa skye 'chi bar do gsum/ /sbyong byed yin gyi tshe 'di la/ /grub mtha' ma snyogs pa dag la/ /'chi ka 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ /bskyed rim man ngag la brten pa/ /lha ni phal cher la 'byung zhing / /khyad par gsung ngag rin po cher/ /bum dbang bskyed rim 'da' ka ma/ /nang gi dmar dkar khams thim tshe/ /gsang dbang dang ni sher dbang gi /'da' ka'i man ngag gsung pa dang / /rtsa thig rlung gsum gcig char du/ /thim tshe bzhi pa'i 'da' ka ma/ /gsung zhing de yi tshod 'dzin ni/ /nyin mo sgyu lus mtshan rmi lam/ /gdam ngag zab mo la brten nas/ /bar do'i 'phrang la mi 'jigs pa'i/ /gdengs tshad rtogs pa'i zab khyad yod/ /ces pa'ang zhar byung du bkod do// ༈ /spyod pa blang dor gnyis med rtogs/ /rnal 'byor brtan pa chen po la/ /gnas des phyi nang yul bgrod nas/ /mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu bar gsungs/ /de la bod rnams 'khrul spyod bkag /deng sang gsang sngags mi shes par/ /zhes sogs nas ni gang zag gi /yul der 'gro ba rgyud las bkag /zhes gsung bar don dbang thob cing /

/rim gnyis brtan pa thob pa yi/ /gnas yul bgrod pa rgyud sde'i lugs/ /dbang ma thob cing rim pa gnyis/ /mi sgom yul chen rgyu bar rlom/ /ngal ba tsam yin mdo las ni /yul bgrod nyams len ma bshad phyir/ /der spyod mos na sngags bzhin sgrubs/ /bod kyi ti se ma pham mtsho/ /gangs can ma dros mtshor 'dod pa/ /'ga' zhig nyams dbyangs gsum bsgrags kyang / /rnal 'byor nyams snang tsam la dgongs/ /lung dang bshad tshod ma mthun na/ /mi 'thad rgyal ba las lhag pa'i/ /mkhas pa 'jig rten na med do/ /bod yul tsa ri 'thung gcod du/ /'dod pa 'khrul mod bha ṭa'i shing / /nges par yod na ming mthun tsam/ /yin mod ti se ma dros dang / /tsa ri la sogs gnas chen gras/ /yin min gang ltar de ru ni/ /'gro ba'i gang zag dbang thob cing / /rim gnyis rtogs pa ldan tsam zhig /dgos zhes rgyud las gsung ltar gyis/ /dbang dang rim gnyis mi bsgom pa'i/ /phal pa don med ngal bar mthong / ༈ /'bras bu mngon du byed tshul la/ /mthar thug dang ni gnas skabs gnyis/ /bla ma zhang pa sogs kha cig /dkar po chig thub ces pa la/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'byung 'dod dang / /zung 'jug 'bras bu 'od gsal gcig /'od dang sa lam ma bgrod pa/ /dbang bzhi lam bzhi med par ni/ /'bras bu sku bzhi 'byung 'dod dang / /'bras bu'i mthar thug 'od gsal du/ /'dod 'gog kha cig dkar po nas/ /ldang ba mthar thug yin gsung bar/ /dkar po chig thub stong rkyang la/ /rgyu med 'bras bu 'byung mi 'thad/ /bsngo rgyu med pas ci zhig bsngo/ /skyabs sems yi dam bsgom pa sogs/ /mi dgos sangs rgyas rgyur mi 'gro/ /byas na chig thub du mar 'gyur/ /chig thub chos skad mdo ltar na/ /byang chub sems kyi gnad 'phyug cing / /sngags dang sbyar na lam gyi gnad/ /'phyug pa yin no mkhas pas spangs/ /mdo las stong nyid bsngags pa ni/ /bden 'dzin can rnams bzlog phyir yin/

/stong nyid rkyang pas sangs rgyas min/ /sgra don dgongs pa shes par bya/ /dper na mda' ni rkyang pa yis/ /don byed mi nus gzhu 'brel na/ /de yis 'phang 'bras dgos pa 'byung / /stong nyid bsngags pa sgra ji bzhin/ /mi zhen thabs shes zung 'brel du/ /dgos pa lung dang bstan bcos gsal/ /dper na snam bu dang gos dar/ /thags kyi rgyu rnams phal cher mtshungs/ /spun gyi dbye bas bzang ngan gyi/ /ri mo bkra min byung ba bzhin/ /lta ba theg gsum phal cher mthun/ /'bras bu 'phrin las che chung yod/ /lta bas mya ngan 'da' thob cing / /'bras bu sangs rgyas thabs kyis so/ /gnad des lta ba'i steng du ni/ /thabs mkhas nan tan bgyis pa yi/ /nyan thos dgra bcom rang sangs rgyas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas gsum rnam grol tsam/ /mtshungs yang sems bskyed rgya che chung / /thabs kyi dbang gis gzhan gyi don/ /'bad med lhun grub sangs rgyas la/ /'byung ba thabs dang rten 'brel gnad/ /mdo sde rgyan las mdud pa yi/ /gos mtshon bkra min dper mdzad dang / /slob dpon ma ti tsi tra yis/ /bse ru 'dra ba'i rang rgyal dang / /nyan thos nyon mongs zhi ba tsam/ /mtshungs shing yon tan stobs sogs dang / /gzhan don phrin las bsam yas kyi/ /yon tan sangs rgyas khyad 'phags gsung / /des na sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /stong nyid lta bar 'dris byas nas/ /thabs mkhas la 'bad gal che'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don phyir/ /gang la mi 'jigs med na yang / /stong nyid lta bas dman pa yi/ /myang 'das mthar lhung la 'jigs gsung / /phyag chen stong rkyang bsgom pa las/ /sku gsum 'byung bar 'dod rlom ni/ /rgyu 'bras rigs mi mthun du 'ong / /zung 'jug 'bras bu'ang 'od gsal ru/ /'dod pa'ang rgyu 'bras mi mtshungs so/ /phyag chen sa lam chig chod 'gro /sa lam mi dgos smra ba dang / /nang gi rim gnyis ma rtogs par/ /ti se sogs bskor lus la ni/ /rtsa yi mdud 'khor sogs med 'khrul/

/'khrul 'khor rlung sbyor mi bsgom par/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa mi shes pa'i/ /gsang sngags bstan la shin tu 'gal/ /'di dag phyi nang rten 'brel gnad/ /rgyud dang man ngag las gsung pa/ /ma go 'di 'dra bzhad gad gnas/ /nang gi sa lam bgrod rgyu med/ /phyi yi yul chen bgrod pa la/ /dgos pa ci yang mi 'dug phyir/ /nang dang phyi yi yul bgrod gnyis/ /phan tshun ltos grub yin phyir ro/ /bdag med bstod 'grel las gsungs pa'i/ /nang yul rnams kyi rlung sems ni/ /dbu mar thim pas sa rnams kyi/ /rtogs pa skye bar dngos su bshad/ /'dir gsung don ni dgag pa'i gzhi/ /rgyud ma sbyang pa 'ga' zhig gi /blun dad tsa ri gangs can sogs/ /yin par rlom nas bskor ba la/ /'brel med gal te gnas de dag /nges par yin rung de bskor ba'i/ /gang zag rim gnyis rnal 'byor dang / /ldan par dgos te de yi ni/ /de bsgom mthu las nang gi ni/ /rtsa thig rlung gi rten 'brel dang / /gnas der phyin pa phyi'i rten 'brel/ /gnyis ka 'dzom las yul chen gyi/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus/ /rnal 'byor byin rlabs sa lam bgrod/ /rgyu mtshan de yi dbang gi ni/ /gzhung 'dir phyi yul sngon gsung pa/ /de dang rjes 'brel grol tshul bstan/ /bdag med bstod 'grel skabs su ni/ /rim gnyis bsgom las nang rten 'brel/ /'grig las phyi yul mkha' 'gro rnams/ /dbang 'dus byin gyis brlabs tshul bstan/ /de gnyis bshad tshul de ltar yin/ /tha dad nyid du go mi bya/ /gzhung 'dir skabs don bkral tshul gyi/ /dbang du byas pa'i bstod 'grel lung / /rgyu 'bras go rim ltar du gsung / /don du phyi nang rten 'byung ni/ /'grig pas bgrod pa'i rten 'brel dang / /gnad gcig bgrod zin rten 'brel zhig /yod pa lta bur 'khrul mi bya/ /de don rgyu 'bras go rim ni/ /bstod 'grel las ni dngos su gsung /

/'dir ni rgyu 'bras dngos bstan dang / /bgrod zin pa yi rten 'brel yin/ /gzhung 'dir rgyu rkyen tshogs pa yi/ /rten 'brel las ni nang gi ni/ /de de'i rtsa mdud grol gsungs pa/ /de ni bgrod pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /de lta'i rnam bzhag nges par bya/ /rgyu ni dbang bzhi lam rim gnyis/ /'bras bu sku bzhir shes par bya/ /rgyu med 'bras bu'i 'khrul rtogs spangs/ /gsang ba 'dus bsgom pa 'ga' res/ /'bras bu 'od gsal stong par brjod/ /de yang rang gzhung lung 'gal spangs/ /'dir ni 'phral gyi 'khrul pa 'gog /zhar byung gzhan dag lam gyi ni/ /'khrul pa rnams ni 'gog pa ste/ /sa lam mi dgos chig thub la/ /sku gsum 'byung rlom lam la ni/ /log par rtog pa che shos yin/ /rim gnyis mi 'dod de dang mtshungs/ /des na 'bras bu'i rgyu lam la/ /log par rtog dang 'bras bu la/ /log par rtog pa khyad 'byed dgos/ /gzhung 'di'i lus kyi rnam gzhag tu/ /lam las 'bras bu mdor bstan ni/ /ma gsal bas kyang 'bras bu la/ /'khrul pa 'gog par bshad pa 'di/ /sa lam ma thob 'bras 'dod bkag /de yi shugs las lam bgrod nas/ /'bras bu mngon du byed bstan pas/ /'bras thob bshad la 'gal ba med/ ༈ /la la grub thob zhes sogs nas/ /mkhas pa rnams la min bar don/ /grub thob rnam gzhag tshad ldan gyi/ /lung las gsal zhing rtogs ldan zhes/ /dri med lung med ngan rtog dag /rtog pa'i tshig spyi 'gro kun la/ /'jug zhing 'khrul pa zhig pa yi/ /ming la rtogs ldan brjod rung tsam/ /la la nyams dang zhes sogs nas/ /rnam par dbye ba med par don/ /de bzhin nyams dang go rtogs gnyis/ /don gcig de gsum ming tsam la/ /ma 'khrul so sor dbye zhes bya/ /rtse gcig dang ni zhes sogs nas/ /kun dang 'gal bar gyur par don/ /phyag chen pa 'gas rnal 'byor bzhi/ /sa lam rnam gzhag byed pa rmongs/ /'bras bu'i rten 'brel tsam du ni/

/brjod las nges pa can la yin/ /'khrul rtog 'di dag mdo rgyud kyi/ /lung dang 'gal bar shes par bya/ ༈ /gzhung ni spyi la rtsod spangs sogs/ /sgo nas don bsdu ba kha cig /theg pa rang sa zhes pa nas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gis bzung / /zhes pa'i bar gyi don smras tshad bden na ni/ /brdzun zhes mi srid mu stegs pa/ /rgyu 'bras med dang lta ba log /bden tshul srid kyang brdzun la gzhol/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi'ang mtha' drug gis/ /gsung zhing mthar thug phan pa ru/ /sbyor ba skabs thob shes par bya/ /skyabs gnas lta ba thabs kyi gnad/ /'khrul na chos gzhan gyis mi skyob/ /chos gnad ma 'phyug gal che ba/ /chos gzhan legs par ston na yang / /sogs nas 'khrul med dpyad dgos bar/ /de don gzhung gsung go sla zhing / /chos kyi gnad 'phyug legs 'dra yang / /'bras med 'khrul med bshad par bya/ ༈ /gnad bcos pa yi bdud byung tshul/ /de la gnad rnams 'chos pa'i bdud/ /zhes nas byams pas rgyud blar gsung / /bar 'di gzhung la gtam rgyud bcas/ /go sla so sor thar pa yi/ /sdom pa'i tshul dang byang sems kyi/ /sems bskyed bslab bya gsang sngags kyi/ /dbang bskur rim gnyis bsngo ba bcas/ /gnad la 'jam dbyangs gsung bzhin gyis/ ༈ /'khrul pa'i grub mtha' lung rigs kyi/ /sun 'byin gleng gzhi bcas ston par/ /'khrul pa'i grub mtha' sun byin pa'i/ /zhes nas rigs pas sun phyungs shig /zhes don gzhung don go ba sla/ ༈ /bye brag lung gi sun 'byin don/ /gal te lung dang 'gal gyur na/ /zhes nas khrims la cis mi thug /zhes gsung gzhung bzhin go sla'o// ༈ /lung sbyor ji ltar byed pa'i tshul/ /blun po mkhas par 'chos pa 'ga'/ /zhes nas gzhung dang ma 'brel ba'i/ /chos lugs mang yang ro dang 'dra/ /zhes don dge sdig med lta bu'i/ /lung rnams mnyam par bzhag dus kyi/ /lta ba'i lung yin bsgom pa dang / /spyod pa gnyis la de mi 'brel/

/dbang dang cho ga lha sgom sogs/ /rnam dag bya dgos bsgom pa yi/ /lung du yang ni shes par bya/ /de gsum bsre sogs 'khrul pa spongs/ /de bzhin 'jig rten 'das ma 'das/ /skabs kyi lung yang so so ru/ /shes bya mdor na gzhung lugs ni/ /gang yin dpyad cing ma nor bya/ ༈ /khungs nas ma byung gdam ngag sogs/ /grags rnams tshad mar mi rung bstan/ /snyan brgyud dang ni chig brgyud du/ /grags pa'i sogs nas yod mod kyi/ /'on kyang yid brtan mi bya gsung / /zab par bsgrags kun mdo rgyud kyi/ /lung gis bsgrub du med rnams spangs/ /mdo rgyud lung gis dpyad pa gnad/ ༈ /sku gzugs ring bsrel glo bur ltas/ /rtogs dpyod bya dgos bstan pa ni/ /ring bsrel dang ni thugs sogs nas/ /dbye ba mdo tsam yin gsung bar/ /zhes pa'i bar ni go ba sla/ ༈ /tshig la 'khrul pa dgag pa ni/ /de nas tshig la zhes sogs nas/ /'thad phyir mkhas pas blang zhes bar/ /de don gzhung ltar go ba sla/ /sngar nas rgya bod chos log rnams/ /skyes chen gong mas bkag tshul dang / /chos log 'phel rnams 'gog par bstan/ ༈ /sangs rgyas gsung rab dri ma med/ /zhes nas rung bas tshim par snang / /zhes pa'i bar yang go ba sla/ ༈ /bstan bcos brtsam pa'i kun slong gi /lhag bsam rnam dag bstan pa ni/ /bdag ni sems can kun la byams/ /zhes nas blo yis spyod kyis bar/ /gzhan ni go sla chos log rnams/ /pham par byed dang bdud kyi rigs/ /yi mug par gyur chos shes pa'i/ /mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed/ /'bras bu rnam pa gsum zhes brjod/ ༈ /bstan bcos brtsam pa'i rgyu mkhas pa'i/ /shes rab bstan par bya ba ni/ /bdag gis sgra dang tshad ma bslab/ /zhes sogs nas ni legs sprod pa'i/ /'jam mgon bla ma de la 'dud/ /zhes gsung gzhung bzhin go sla'o/ /de ltar lhar bcas 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs gcig dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/

/legs gsungs sdom gsum rab dbye ba'i/ /tshig don go bde mdor bsdus tshul/ /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs pas/ /ngag dbang chos grags 'grel pa ltar/ /de la dbang dang rim gnyis dang / /ye shes phyag chen sa lam rnams/ /gsang sngags zab mo yin mod kyi/ /sbas par 'os kyang dus dbang gis/ /zom lus rgyun chad gyur dogs nas/ /de la phan phyir gsal tsam bkod/ ༈ /drin can bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mchog la 'dud do byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan 'dzin mchog /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yis/ /phyis su bstan pa rin chen la/ /nor 'khrul byung ba bsal ba'i phyir/ /sdom gsum kha skong zhes bya ba'i/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum gsal byed pa'i/ /legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba mdzad/ /de yi dgongs don mdo tsam bri/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab dbye yi/ /kha skong zhes sogs mtshan don bstan/ /rje btsun bla ma la sogs dang / /yon tan lhun grub tshig bzhi yi/ /mchod par brjod pa mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ldan sogs/ /tshigs bzhis bshad par dam bca' ba/ /de don gzhung bzhin go sla'o/ /thog mar gzhi yi ngos bzung la/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal shel gyi khams/ /zhes nas 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ /zhes don rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /shel dkar lta bu khams bde bar/ /gshegs pa'i snying po can zhes so/ /de ni 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ /de la bag chags bzang ngan gyi/ /tshon gyis bsgyur bas gnas skabs su/ /'khor 'das du mar snang ba yin/ /de la chos kyi dbyings zhes 'dogs/ /thabs kyi ma zin 'khor ba'i gzhi/ /thabs kyis zin na lam 'bras bu/ /stobs dang yon tan byang chub thob/ ༈ /lam ni theg gsum bslab pa nas/ /sel byed lam gyi mchog zhes bar/ /zhes don lcags zangs dngul ser sbyar/ /dbyibs kyi steng gi sgrib pa ni/ /rang rang ngo skal re spangs shing / /yongs su spangs pa rdo rje theg /spyir btang lam la mchog zhes pa'i/

/sgra ni bla med theg la 'jug ༈ /'bras bu'i don ni gnas gyur nas/ /'char ba'i 'bras bu'o zhes don/ /'bras bu gnas gyur ngo bo nyid/ /nam mkha' dri bral yon tan gyis/ /rnam mkhyen zla ba shar ba la/ /gdul bya dag pa'i chu gtsang du/ /longs sku mchog gi sprul sku gnyis/ /ci rigs sku gzugs 'char ba ni/ /lam mchog de yi 'bras bu yin/ /bla med lam ni sgom stobs kyi/ /'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa'o/ /de yi rgyas bshad gzhi yi skabs/ ༈ /gzhi la grub mtha'i bye brag gi /zhes nas 'dus byas yin par don/ /bye brag grub mtha'i 'dod tshul ni/ /bye smras sems byung ma chags pa'i/ /rang bzhin 'dod pa chung ba dang / /chog shes pa la rigs su 'dod/ /mdo sde pa yi thob pa sogs/ /rkyen gyi dbang la brten nas ni/ /gsar du byung ba'i zag med kyi/ /sa bon la ni rigs su 'dod/ /sems tsam pas ni thog med nas/ /grub pa'i skye mched drug gi ni/ /khyad par zag med sa bon dang / /sgrib spang dang ni rung ba dang / /thos pa'i bag chags zhes bzhag pa'i/ /de la rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dod/ /de gsum dbu ma pas gzhal na/ /gzhi rigs mtshan nyid pa ma yin/ /'dus byas yin no bye mdo gnyis/ /rigs zhes 'dogs pa tsam zhig las/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs khas mi len/ /sems tsam skye mched drug gi ni/ /khyad par de la gnyis su phyed/ /snga ma rkyen gyi yang dag pa/ /blangs pa rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs dang / /phyi ma chos nyid kyis thob pa/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'jog pa/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs pa ste/ /ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas gsungs/ ༈ /de nas dbu ma'i lugs bstan pa/ /'dir ni byams mgon klu sgrub kyi/ /zhes nas la sogs bgrang yas gsung / /bar gyi don ni byams mgon gyi/ /sems ni gsal ba sems can nas/ /sangs rgyas bar du rgyun chags zhing / /ma 'gag par bzhed klu sgrub kyis/ /ngo bo mtha' bzhi spros kun gyis/

/stong par bzhed cing de gnyis ni/ /zung du 'jug pa'i 'dus ma byas/ /rang bzhin gyi ni gnas rigs dang / /rgyu dus bde gshegs snying por bzhed/ /de yang byams pa'i bzhed pa ni/ /ji snyed ldog par zhes bya ba/ /sems can rgyud la bde gshegs snying / /yod pa bsgrub tshul bshad pa ste/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan gyi/ /ldog pa ma lus tshangs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po nyid/ /sems can rgyud la yod pa ni/ /sgrub byed gsum gyis sgrub pa la/ /dpe dgur yod de de bzhin gshegs/ /sku gzugs dri ma med pa dang / /sbrang dang sbrang rtsi ro gcig dang / /'bras bu sna tshogs shun pa'i sbub/ /snying po gsum gyi rim pa bzhin/ /glo bur dri bral chos dbyings dang / /zab mo stong nyid ston gsung rab/ /dang ni brjod bya sna tshogs ston/ /gsung rab dpe yi mtshon don gsum/ /gser gyi gzugs kyi dpes mtshon pa'i/ /rang bzhin rnam dag gi de bzhin/ /nyid kyi dpe yi mtshon don gcig /de bzhin gter dang 'bras bu can/ /shing dang rin chen las grub sku/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal gser las grub/ /srog chags gzugs brnyan dpe lnga yi/ /rim pa bzhin du rang bzhin gyi/ /gnas rigs dang ni rgyas 'gyur rigs/ /sku gsum dang lnga mtshon pa'o/ /klu sgrub bzhed pa ji lta ba'i/ /ldog pa bde gshegs snying po yi/ /ngo bo spros bral bshad pa ste/ /rten 'brel gyi ni chos thams cad/ /mtha' bzhi spros pas stong pa'i tshul/ /don dam dpyod byed rigs pa bstan/ /spros bral stong pa nyid de la/ /'khor 'das thams cad rung bar gsung / /bstod tshogs la ni zung 'jug gi /ldog pa zhes pa bde gshegs snying / /ngo bo spros bral de yang sems/ /gsal ba zung du chud pa ste/ /rigs pas gtan la phab pa yi/ /stong nyid de yis stong rkyang spangs/ /'khor 'das rang bzhin lhun grub kyi/ /sems dang zung du chud pa nyid/

/'khor 'das bya byed rung bar gsung / /de yi byams mgon gsal cha la/ /ji snyed ldog par 'dogs pa dang / /klu yi spros bral la ji lta'i/ /ldog pa'i ming 'dogs yangs can mkhan/ /dbang phyug dpal bzang khyad chos bzhed/ /rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po dang / /rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub gnyis/ /dgongs pa mthun ste byams pa yi/ /chos can gsal ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /yongs rdzogs bstan cing 'phags mchog klus/ /chos nyid stong pa dang zung 'jug /sgo nas bstan pas shing rta yi/ /srol 'byed gnyis ni bde bar gshegs/ /snying po gsal stong zung 'jug la/ /'jog pa'i bzhed pa gcig tu mthun/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs gzhung tshig gi /go sla kun gzhi'i sgrar bzhed ces/ /'di ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi/ /nang tshan ma yin de 'dus byas/ /'dir ni gong du bshad pa yi/ /gsal cha 'dus ma byas de la/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyis ni sgra/ /bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan du bzhed/ /'di ni sems tsam dang gsung ngag /skabs su ming tsam la ma 'khrul/ /bden pas stong pa'i spros bral gyi/ /rnam dbye'i gnad shes gal che'o/ /sngags kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs kyang / /gzhung bzhin go sla de yang ni/ /lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes pa zhu bde lhan skyes dang / /rang bzhin lhan skyes gnyis las ni/ /snga ma dpe yi ye shes dang / /phyi ma don gyi ye shes te/ /de ni bde gshegs snying po'o/ /'jam dpal dang ni rdo rje sems/ /de yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum du/ /yod pa'i nang nas gzhi dus de/ /bde gshegs snying po yin phyir ro/ ༈ /log par rtog pa bye brag tu/ /dgag las dang po dar ṭīka pa/ /bkag don deng sang tshig sogs nas/ /'di dor zhig ces bar gyi don/ /dri bcas sems la bden med kyi/ /ming 'dogs med dgag 'khrul pa dor/ /rong ṭīka dngos bstan la zhen bkag /kha gcig sems kyi stong gsal sogs/ /zhes nas lugs la med par don/

/gsal rkyang 'dus byas gzhir mi 'thad/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas gnyis ka /rang bzhin gnas rigs so so ru/ /bzhag pa mi 'thad zung 'jug tu/ /bsdu phyir 'khyog po bsrang ba'i tshul/ /de ltar yin na 'gal ba med/ ༈ /paṇa shāka pa yi rab dbye la/ /sgro btags bde snying 'gro rgyud la/ /med zhes bshad pa bkag don ni/ /'ga' zhig chos ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes nas 'bad med sgrub par don/ /tsan dan snying po sbrul yod dang / /'o ma'i snying por mar yod pa/ mngon sum grub pas dper mi 'thad/ /de bzhin zla ba sgron me sogs/ /lung dang 'gal zhing drang don rnams/ /tha snyad du yang med pa ni/ /phung khams skye mched la sogs chos/ /med mthar lhung zhing bden gnyis kyi/ /rnam bzhag mi 'byung 'jam dbyangs gsungs/ /min pa gzhung ni rang gi gsal/ /chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po dang / /stong nyid spros bral don dam bden/ /dpe dgu'i tshul gyis bstan pa ni/ /drang don kun rdzob bden pa yin/ /dgongs gzhi mtha' bzhi spros bral dang / /dgos pa dpe dgu'i bstan don ni/ /'gro ba'i rgyud kyi skyon lnga spangs/ /sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod la 'thad/ /sgrub pa'i tshul gyi zhes pa ni/ /sgrub byed tshul gyi don yin zhes/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags gsungs/ /de nyid nges don yin zer na/ /mu stegs bdag mtshungs skyon rnams 'byung / /byams mgon dgongs pa 'gro sems rgyud/ /bdag gnyis spros pa bral mthong ba/ /ji ltar mthong zhes de nyid kyang / /sems can la yod mthong ba ni/ /ji snyed mthong gsung shes pa gnad/ ༈ /mtshan nyid pa 'gas glo bur gyi/ /dri bral chos dbyings rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam dag chos dbyings ma yin te/ /de gnyis phan tshun spangs 'gal yin/ /zer ba de ni bkag pa'i ched/ /kha cig rang bzhin rnam dag dang / /zhes nas rnam dag shes par gyis/ /zhes don dri ma bden grub kyi/ /dag pa'i dbyings dang glo bur gyi/

/dri ma gnyen pos bcom pa yi/ /dbyings gnyis gzhi mthun med pa yi/ /tshig ni 'brel med 'khrul gtam yin/ /dri ma bden grub kyis dag dang / /gnyen pos bcom pa'i dag pa gnyis/ /dag tshul snga phyi'i rnam pa las/ /dag cha 'gal na skye 'jig dang / /byas dang mi rtag 'gal bar 'gyur/ /dri ma bden grub dag pa ni/ /dag pa tsam gyis gnyen po yi/ /bcom pa'i dri ma dag mi 'gro/ /de 'dra yin na gang zag gi /bdag med rtogs tshe chos bdag kyang / /phyogs su rtogs 'gyur de mi 'byung / /des na klu sgrub zhabs sogs kyi/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag la/ /glo bur dri bral dag pa ni/ /gnyis ldan gsung 'di tshad ma yin/ /chos kyi dbyings kun rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam par dag par shes par bya/ ༈ /jo nang kun mkhyen chen po yi/ /snying po bden grub 'dod bkag pa/ /mkhyen rab gshog yangs rgyas pa yi/ /zhes nas snying por shes par gyis/ /bar gyi don ni gzhi'i gnas tshul/ /jo nang pa yi 'dod lugs ni/ /gzhi 'bras gnyis su yon tan gyi/ /ldog pa dang ni ngo bo ste/ /dbyer med chos dbyings bde bar gshegs/ /snying po yin no chos dbyings te/ /stobs sogs yon tan lhun grub kyi/ /don dam sangs rgyas yin pa 'thad/ /mdo rgyud lung gi'ang gsal ba'o/ /gnad kyi don ni gzhi'i dri ma/ /gnyen pos bcom pa'i glo bur gyi/ /dri mas bde gshegs snying po stong / /de gnyis 'bru dang 'bru shun ltar/ /'bral rung tshul du yod pa yin/ /bde gshegs snying po sangs rgyas su/ /gnas gyur stobs sogs yon tan ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dus rtag tu/ /mi stong yon tan de dag dang / /dbyer med ldan zhing mi 'bral lo/ /gzhi 'bras 'dod tshul tha snyad dang / /'gal te dri bcas sangs rgyas su/ /yin na gnod byed 'di ltar 'byung / /dri bcas chos dbyings sangs rgyas su/ /'dod na de ltar tha snyad tshe/ /skye gnas 'jig gsum yod med dang /

/dman 'bring mchog gsum gyi khyad par/ /med par 'gyur ro tha snyad kyi/ /tshe na de dag so so ru/ /phye nas smra dgos lung las gsal/ /yang na tha snyad du de ltar/ /khas len dgos kyang tha snyad la/ /tshad mar byas na gang zag la/ /mi ston chos la ston pa dang / /tshig la mi ston don la ston/ /drang don mi ston nges don ston/ /rnam shes mi ston ye shes ston/ /gzhi las chos la mi ston cing / /gang zag ston gyur skyon med do/ /zer na de dag go rim ni/ /thog mar tha snyad khas blang nas/ /phyis nas don dam gnas lugs la/ /'jug pa'i gnas skabs go rim yin/ /tha snyad dang po nas dor na/ /tha snyad gsung pa don med gyur/ /go rim ldog pa khyod la 'gyur/ /don dam rtogs pa'i rten thog mar/ /tha snyad khas len 'phags mchog ni/ /klu sgrub zla ba'i lung las gsal/ /yang ni tha snyad tshe na yang / /dri bcas chos dbyings sangs rgyas su/ /yin pas skyon med zhes zer na/ /byams pas rgyud blar gsung pa yi/ /ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /zhes sogs 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis/ /ji ltar sos ka'i dus su chu/ /dpe dang bcas ste gsung dang 'gal/ /mtshan btags phye ba dpe bcas ni/ /slob dpon dpal ldan rtse mo yi/ /rgyud sde spyi rnam las kyai rdor/ /mtshan gyi 'bras rgyud dngos su bstan/ /rgyu rgyud thabs rgyud shugs bstan pa/ /phyogs kyi glang po'i brgyad stong gi /don bsdus nas gsung lung bkod bzhin/ /des na gzhi dus dri bcas chos/ /sangs rgyas yin pas ma khyab shes/ /spyi rnams lung gi dngos don ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dmigs med pa'i/ /thugs rje che dang shes rab che/ /zung 'jug kyai rdor 'bras bu'i rgyud/ /de nyid thob byed lam la yang / /kyai rdor rgyu yang kyai rdor du/ /ming btags gsum ka kyai rdo rje/ /yin par phyogs glang lung gis gsal/ /mtshan btags mi phyed mi 'thad la/ /rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs/

/rang lugs bla ma kha cig gis/ /spyi rnam las ni rgyud gsum ka /kyai rdor mtshan nyid par bzhed zhes/ /rje btsun sku mched gsung zer na/ /gsum ka kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa/ /mi 'thad kyai rdor rgyud kyi ni/ /mtshan don bshad tshe rgyu lam gnyis/ /thabs shes zung 'jug gi sgo nas/ /kyai rdor mtshan don bshad du yod/ /gsum ka brjod bya don gyi ni/ /kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa yin kyang / /de la mtshan btags phye ba'i tshe/ /heni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra shes rab brjod par bya/ /zhes pa'i dngos bstan kyai rdo rje/ /mtshan nyid pa yin de yi ni/ /shugs bstan rgyu lam kyai rdor gnyis/ /kyai rdor btags pa ba yin no/ /rje btsun sku mched lung gi don/ /rgyu dang lam la dngos btags ni/ /ma phyes tshe na kye rdor sgra/ /'jug ste rgyu rgyud kyai rdor sogs/ /gsum char 'chad pas kyai rdor 'chad/ /zhes tsam don yin yang na ni/ /rgyud gsum mtshan don gyis ni skabs/ /dngos btags ma phye'i kyai rdo rje/ /yin zhes kun mkhyen bla mas bzhed/ /kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa la ni/ /lha sku zhal phyag rnam pa ni/ /gang zag yin pas rgyud gsum gyi/ /nang tshan 'bras bu'i kyai rdor yin/ /phyi ma he sogs rgyud tshig gis/ /dngos bstan rgyud gsum nang tshan du/ /gyur pa'i 'bras bu'i kyai rdo rje/ /mtshan nyid pa ni de yin no/ /gal te rgyud ni gsum ka ni/ /kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa yin na/ /kyai rdor sgra yi 'bras rgyud ni/ /dngos bstan rgyu lam shugs bstan du/ /mi 'thad gsum ka mtshungs par gyur/ /dper na gser bum bstan pa yis/ /bum ming tsam las dngul zangs bum/ /shugs la bstan pa mi 'byung ngo / /mtshan btags mi phye'i gzhung 'gal ba/ /sher phyin skabs su gzhung lam gnyis/ /sher phyin mtshan nyid pa min pa/ /slob dpon seng ge bzang po yi/ /brgyad stong 'grel chen las gsung dang / /de bzhin dkon mchog 'bang gis ni/

/'grel pa las ni gsung pa ltar/ /dngos btags gtso phal rnam bzhag ni/ /gzhung lugs chen po spyi la mdzad/ /dper na kha che sna nyag la/ /seng ger btags pa kha che ni/ /seng ge ma yin sna nyag par/ /seng ge'i ming btags lta bu'o/ /bod gzhung jo nang rang gi ni/ /nges don rgya mtshor gzhi 'bras gnyis/ /gnyis med ye shes spyi tsam pa/ /sher phyin mtshan nyid pa mi 'thad/ /de ltar yin na brgyad stong pa/ /don bsdus sogs las de bzhin gshegs/ /sher phyin mtshan nyid pa'i rten gyi/ /khyad par gsungs pa don med gyur/ /yang ni de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /gzhi dus de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ /mang du yod pas gzhi dus kyi/ /gnyis med ye shes rten yin pas/ /skyon med snyam na de mi 'thad/ /gzhi dus su ni de bzhin gshegs/ /mtshan nyid pa yod tha snyad dang / /'gal ba'i skyon ni sngar bstan zin/ /gzhan yang gzhung dang lam gnyis la/ /gzhan dbang kun btags yongs grub/ mtshan nyid gsum phye yongs grub ni/ /yongs grub sher phyin mtshan nyid pa/ /ma yin na ni chos thams cad/ /mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba yis/ /yongs grub sher phyin mtshan nyid par/ /jo nang rang gi 'dod dang 'gal/ /yin na shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gnyis zhes gzhung na brgyad stong gi /'grel chen sogs las sher phyin la/ /dngos btags phye ba rgyab brten du/ /drang ste bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /'khrul med blang byar bstan pa ni/ /sher phyin dngos btags phye dgos pas/ /gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa slob dpon ni/ /seng ge bzang sogs 'phags yul gyi/ /mkhas grub kun mthun sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun gong mas rgyud sde yi/ /spyi rnams las gsung gus pas long / /glo bur dri bral chos sku de/ /thob la tshogs bsag dgos gyur na/ /don dam chos kyi skur mi 'gyur/ /de yang tshogs gnyis bsags pa la/ /ltos mi dgos na 'gro ba kun/ /dang po nyid nas glo bur gyi/ /dri bral 'gyur bas snying po la/

/dri mas sgrib pa dpe dgu yi/ /bstan pa de'ang don med 'gyur/ /don dam gnas lugs 'gal ba'i skyon/ /chos kyi dbyings zhes yongs grub la/ /bden grub 'dod pa 'khor tha mi/ /nges don gzhung dang 'gal ba ste/ /chos dbyings bden grub 'dod pa ni/ /don dam sgro 'dogs kyi mthar lhung / /mdo las zab zhi spros bral sogs/ /rnam grangs lnga ru gsungs pa las/ /chos kyi dbyings ni 'dus ma byas/ /bden med du bstan rtsa she yi/ /'dus byas brtags pa'i rab byed la/ /skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa dag /ces sogs skye gnas 'jigs gsum bral/ /'dus byas bden par ma grub pas/ /'dus ma byas kyang bden grub min/ /des na 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /bden med nyid du mtshungs par ston/ /'phags mchog klu yi dngos smra ni/ /'gog par mdzad pa'i rigs pa nyams/ /khyed la log gyur bden grub kyi/ /chos su khas blang byas phyir ro/ /dbu ma pa yi chos thams cad/ /rang bzhin med ces 'ashad pa la/ /dngos smras de lta'i tshig de yang / /rang bzhin yod med med na ni/ /med pa'i dam bca' nyams yod na/ /rang bzhin grub par khas len gyur/ /de la dbu ma pas 'di gsungs/ /dngos smra khyed kyi bden grub kyi/ /dam bca' byas shing dbu ma pas/ /yod med gnyis kar ma bzung pas/ /rang bzhin med pa ces pa'i don/ /dam bca' med par 'chad pa yin/ /de ltar dngos smra'i tshig gi lan/ /tsam min dbu ma'i dgongs pa dngos/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyis gsung pa dang / /'phags pa lha dang zla bas kyang / /de bzhin gsungs pa dbu ma pas/ /don dam yod med gnyis ka ru/ /dam bca' khas len med pas na/ /skyon dang klan ka kun las grol/ /de yang sgrub pa'i dam bca'ang med/ /dgag pa'i dam bca' yang med pas/ /gnas lugs la ni dpyod pa'i tshe/ /rang rgyud gtan tshigs mi 'thad zhes/ /'phags mchog klu yi drug cu pa/ /de 'grel zla ba'i tshig gsal las/ /dbu ma yin na rang rgyud kyi/

/rjes dpag bya ba rig ma yin/ /phyogs gzhan khas blang med phyir ro/ /zhes gsung gnas lugs gtan 'bebs phyir/ /dgag sgrub rnam bzhag byed pa ni/ /thams cad kun rdzob sgyu ma yi/ /rnam rol khas len phyir yin te/ /ji ltar sprul pas sprul pa dang / /sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i sgyu ma la/ /dgag pa byed pa ci 'dra ba/ /dgag pa de yang de 'dra 'dod/ /de ltar byas pas jo nang pas/ /skyon med 'dus byas bden ma grub/ /bden grub dam bca' med bshad pa/ /'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gzigs ngor yin/ /rjes thob yod med yin min gyi/ /shan 'byed skabs yin zer mi 'thad/ /snga ma gdul byas gnas lugs don/ /rtogs phyir rig pas gtan 'bebs skabs/ /phyi ma dbu ma pas dngos smra'i/ /rtsod bzlog skabs yin de gnyis ni/ /mnyam bzhag skabs zhes smra ba ni/ /hang thal tshig ste rjes thob tu/ /rtsod pa mi byed mnyam bzhag du/ /rtsod pa byed ces smra ba ni/ /jo nang grub mtha'i skyon yin no/ /dgos pa 'gal ba spang pa ni/ /snying po bden par grub pa de/ /mgon po byams pas rgyud bla mar/ /skyon lnga spangs zhes gsung dang 'gal/ /sher phyin mdo las sprin rmi lam/ /sgyu ma gsum dpes chos thams cad/ /bden stong gsung dang bka' 'khor lo/ /tha mar sems can rgyud la ni/ /bde snying rtag brtan ther zug gi /bden grub yod gsung 'gal ba yi/ /dgos pa bkod nas de yi lan/ /'khor lo tha mar gsung pa ni/ /skyon lnga spang phyir gsung pa yi/ /shugs las sher mdo nges don dang / /tha ma drang don yin par gsal/ /sdom gsum tshig don thal 'gyur ni/ /bsgrub pa'i phyir na 'di 'thad bzhed/ /des na dbu ma pa yi lugs/ /sher mdo nges don bka' tha ma/ /drang nges sna tshogs 'dres smra dgos/ /gnad don bsdus te bstan pa ni/ /gzhi yi gnas skabs mdor bsdus na/ /phyi nang chos kun sems su 'dus/ /sems nyid gdod nas mtha' bzhi yi/

/spros bral ngo bo stong nyid yin/ /stong nyid de dang gsal ba'i cha/ /ya ma bral bar zung du 'jug /blo 'das brjod bral rgyu dus kyi/ /bder gshegs snying por shes bya ste/ /zung 'jug de ni gzhi dus kyi/ /gnas lugs mthar thug nyid yin no/ /gzhi yi skabs te dang po'o/ ༈ /de nas lam gyi gnas skabs la/ /lam gyi rnam bzhag spyir bstan pa/ /lam la grub mtha' rnam bzhi yi/ /sogs nas ngo bo gcig gi bar/ /gzhi yi steng gi dri ma ni/ /sbyong ba'i lam la grub mtha' bzhi'i/ /rang rang gzhung las theg gsum gyi/ /lam gyi rnam bzhag bstan par bzhed/ /'dul ba lung dang mdzod sogs las/ /nyan rang theg chen lam bgrod tshul/ gsung 'di bye smra mdo sde'i lugs/ yang ni sa yi dngos gzhi las/ /nyan rang byang sems gsum gsung pa/ /de ni sems tsam pa yi lugs/ /mdo sde rgyan la rtogs rigs kyi/ /sgo nas theg gsum lam gsung pa/ /skabs de'i dbu ma'i lugs yin no/ /'on kyang grub mtha' 'og ma las/ /'og ma de las gong gong ma/ /gtso cher dbu ma pas gzhal na/ /dbu ma'i gzhung ma gtogs pa gzhan/ /byang chub gsum thob lam ma tshang / /dbu ma'i gzhung las bshad pa yi/ /lta grub la ni ma brten par/ /gzhan gyis byang chub thob mi nus/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni/ /pha rol phyin las khyad chos bzhi'i/ /khyad 'phags sngags kyi lam zhugs tshe/ /rten gyi gang zag sdom gsum ldan/ /thabs ni rim gnyis nyams len la/ /'bad pas 'phral du bla med pa'i/ /byang chub bsgrub pa nus pa yin/ /sdom gsum de yang len byed kyi/ /tshul ni 'dul ba dbu sems kyi/ /sems bskyed sngags kyi dbang chog las/ /rim gyis blang nas 'jug pa'am/ /'og ma gnyis kyi sbyang pa ni/ /ma song na ni dbang bskur gyi/ /dkyus thog gcig la sdom pa gsum/ /gcig char thob tshe sdom pa gsum/ /ldan tshe gang zag de'i rgyud la/ /sdom pa gsum char sngags sdom gyi/

/ngo bo gcig yin skye 'jig ni/ /gcig char byed na btang thob kyang / /dus gcig 'gyur ro ces zer na/ /phyi ma ma nges skye 'jig gi /skad cig gis byed btang thob ni/ /rgyun la 'jog pa lung rigs gnad/ /thob pa so so'i cho ga'i dus/ /btang ba nyan thos so thar ni/ /tshe 'phos tshe dang byang sngags gnyis/ /byang chub snying po'i mtha' can yin/ /so sor bshad pa'i so thar ni/ /bka' gdams pa sogs 'ga' zhig gi /so thar sdom pa gzugs can dang / /grangs kyang rigs brgyad kho nar dang / /'chi tshe gtong bas khyab 'dod pas/ /bkag don de la kha cig nas/ /sogs nas ci ltar gtong zhes bar/ /don ni dga' gdong pa sogs kyi/ /'khrul gzhi bye smra'i 'dul mdzod kyi/ /grub mtha' a 'thas pa la brten/ /byung 'di theg chen skabs mi 'thad/ /bye smras sdom pa rigs byed min/ /gzugs su 'dod pa mdo sde pas/ bkag nas shes pa lkog na mo/ /bsgrub pa'i rtsod pa rtsod lan bcas/ /rgyas par mdzod 'grel sogs las gsung / /dbu sems skyabs dang sngags kyi gzhung / /sdom pa gzugs can mi 'thad pa/ /smos kyang ci dgos kyai rdo rje'i/ /rgyud ni 'bum pa las 'di gsung / /rigs can gsum gyi bslab pa yang / /dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs nas/ /rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /gsung pa'i lung la gnod pa ste/ /de ltar yin na theg dman gyi/ /sdom pa sngags sdom gnas gyur tshe/ /bems po shes par gnas gyur pa/ /khas su len dgos lus sems gnyis/ /rdzas gcig 'dod pa mu stegs ni/ /rgyang 'phen pa yi lugs yin zhing / /sangs rgyas gzhung la de mi srid/ /sor sdom grangs la rigs brgyad po/ /kho nar bzung ba mi 'thad de/ /nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa yi/ /mdo dang byang sems so sor thar/ /bstan pa'i mdo dang chos bzhi bstan/ /mdo las gsungs pa'i sor sdom dang / /gzhan yang sngags sdom byang sdom gnyis/ /rigs brgyad gang du 'du zhes smros/

/de nyid sor sdom yin pa'i phyir/ /sngags la byang sdom gyis khyab cing / /de la sor sdom gyis khyab pa'i/ /ngo bo gcig pa mdo rgyud kyi/ /dgongs pa sa skya pa yi lugs/ /'on kyang dbang bskur cho ga las/ /thob pa'i sngags sdom rigs brgyad po/ /gang rung gzhi mthun tsam yod de/ /rdo rje rtse mo las bshad pa'i/ /sdom pa sta gon 'jug pa'i skabs/ /thun min skyabs 'gro'i rjes bzlos ni/ /byed tshe thob pa'i sor sdom de/ /yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen sdom pa yin/ /bla ma ngor pa yab sras bzhed/ /shes byed rdo rje rtse mo yi/ /lung dang gnad don gcig pa'o/ /cho ga las ni thun min kyi/ /skyabs 'gro'i skabs su bzung thob yin/ /rigs pas 'thad de skyabs 'gro ni/ /rtsom byed du ni byas pa yi/ /sgo nas spang bya lnga spangs pa/ /don gyi khas blang sdom pa yin/ /yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rgyu mtshan des na gong bshad kyi/ /nye bar 'khor gyis zhus mdo sogs/ /gsung dang so byang sngags kyi ni/ /ngo bor gyur pa'i sor sdom rnams/ /byang chub bar blang sdom pa yin/ ༈ /paṇa shāka sogs kyi sor sdom la/ /nges 'byung gis ni ma khyab par/ /'dod de 'jigs skyob tshul khrims sogs/ /gsum du phye ba dgag pa ni/ /la las so sor thar sogs nas/ /thod bzhin khur bar mdzad par don/ /de dag gi ni dus kun slong / /skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas tshe/ /sangs rgyas myang 'das lam ston pa/ /chos la lam dngos dge 'dun ni/ /lam bsgrub grogs su skyabs song nas/ /myang 'das bsam pas zin mod kyang / /kun slong sgo nas 'jigs skyob kyi/ /tshul khrims la sogs gsum du dbye/ /de ni mi 'thad phyi rol pa'i/ /rgyud la sor sdom yod par gyur/ /de la 'jigs skyob legs smon yod/ /de yang mdzod kyi rang 'grel las/ /phyi rol pa la yang dag pa'i/ /tshul khrims cha mthun yod srid kyang /

/'khor ba spang 'dod blo med pas/ /sdig las thar ba'i so thar min/ /de la yang ni snying po'i gnad/ /phyi rol pa yi thar pa yi/ /ming du btags kyang srid rtse las/ /ma 'phags 'bras bu 'khor ba yin/ /'khor ba'i rgyu tsam la mi ltos/ /tshul khrims 'bras bu'i gnas skabs su/ /lam stegs lha mi'i go 'phang thob/ /don gyi snying po so thar gyi/ /sdom pa rnal ma 'bras bu ni/ /srid grol byang chub thob pa'o/ /de bzhin 'jam mgon bla mas kyang / /mu stegs byed la sdom pa med/ /gsung don srid gsum las thar ba'i/ /'bras bu don ma gnyer de'o/ /de bzhin spyir btang mchog gsum la/ /skyabs su song min phyi nang khyad/ /zhes bshad nges 'byung tshul khrims dang / /so thar don gcig 'dul ba'i lugs/ /'ga' zhig zag med sdom pa ni/ /nges 'byung tshul khrims yin smra ba/ /theg chen ltar na 'dod rung kyang / /bye smra'i lugs la gtan tshigs med/ /de ni zag med snyoms 'jug gi /bsgom pa'i stobs kyis thob tsam yin/ /nges 'byung bsam pa'i tha snyad med/ /de bzhin mdzod kyi lung las gsal/ /de don rgyu dang dus gnyis ka /srid gsum 'khor ba las thar ba'i/ /bsam pas zin pa gnad du gces/ ༈ /nam bsod sogs kyi ngo bo la/ /'khrul pa dgag don la la gzhan/ /sogs nas khungs ston cig ces bar/ /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spang ba ni/ /dge slong sdom pa'i ngo bo yin/ /so thar spyi yi ngo bo min/ /zer ba rang bzo kho na yin/ /slob dpon kha che blo brtan gyis/ /bye brag bshad pa'i lung dang ni/ /sa skya'i rje btsun yab sras kyis/ /sdom pa nyi shu 'grel pa dang / /rtsa ltung 'khrul spong dpang lo dang / /mchims ston kun mkhyen bu ston gyi/ /gsung las gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas/ /spong ba dge slong sdom pa ni/ /kho na'i ngo bor 'jog mi 'thad/ /dge ldan bla ma 'dul ba pas/ /skyes tshogs cho gar log par rtog /bkag don 'ga' zhig skyes tshogs nas/

/bstan pa ma dkrug ces bar don/ /dge slong pha ma so so yi/ /so so'i cho ga bsnor nas ni/ /byas rung yin kyang skyes tshogs kyi/ /bud med bsnyen par rdzogs pa la/ /sngon du tshangs spyod nyer gnas ni/ /ma song thabs med de yang ni/ /dge slong ma tshogs kho nas bskur/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas de la ni/ /bslab tshigs zhes bya'i tha snyad med/ /de dag 'dul ba mdo rtsa sogs/ /lung las gsung zhing sngon byon gyi/ /rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba mtsho/ /bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang / /kha che paṇa chen gyis kyang ni/ /bud med bsnyen par rdzogs ma mdzad/ /de phyir ma tshogs kho na yi/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas ma sgrub pa'i/ /pha tshogs bud med bsnyen rdzogs spang / /skyes tshogs kho nas pha chog gi /skyes pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa nyid/ /mchog tu zung la bstan pa spel/ /grangs la 'khrul pa dgag pa ni/ /paṇa shāka sogs kyis rab byung dang / /dge tshul dag la bsgrub byas nas/ /gsum las mang ba 'jug rung 'dod/ /de dag bkag don la la yi/ /sogs nas sor sdom skabs rdzogs bar/ /bsgrub bya gsum las mang byed pa'i/ /rab byung lag len 'khrul pa ste/ /dpal ldan rtse mo paṇ+ḍi tas/ /nyan thos lung dus ma nub pa'i/ /dper brjod rab byung bsnyen rdzogs pa/ /bsgrub bya grangs su bcad par mdzad/ /des na bsnyen rdzogs thag rgya ma/ /grags kyang mi 'thad gsol bzhi yi/ /las byed tshe na sgrub pa dang / /dge 'dun bar du rags pa'i mtshams/ /rtsig pa me dang chu la sogs/ /phra mtshams rdzu 'phrul nam mkha' la/ /'dug pa lta bu'i bar ma chod/ /dgos la thag pas bar chod 'gal/ /ma nor ba yi gnad ston pa/ /thar pa'i rgyur gyur so so thar/ /len 'dod 'dul ba las gsungs pa'i/ /cho ga ji lta ba bzhin la/ /bsam pa theg chen bsam pa yi/ /zin pa'i sgo nas len par rigs/ /de ltar byas na byang sems kyi/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ru/ /gyur zhes 'jam mgon bla mas gsungs/

/yang na deng sang theg chen gyi/ /thun min so thar len 'dod na/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes sogs dbu ma'i sems bskyed kyi/ /sngon du len pa'i skyabs 'gro yi/ /sdom pa'i don la byang chub kyi/ /snying po'i mtha' can yongs rdzogs kyi/ /dge bsnyen sdom pa thob pa'am/ /yang na don zhags rtog pa las/ /bshad pa'i nyin zhag gi mtha' can/ /gso sbyong rang gis blangs pa yis/ /sdom pa len par rigs so zhes/ /'jam mgon bla ma mchog gis gsungs/ /so thar skabs te gnyis pa'o/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la/ /pha rol phyin pa'i dbu sems sogs/ /zhes nas nyams su len pa yin/ /bar don dbu sems sdom gnyis dang / /sngags kyi rgyud sde'i cho ga las/ /thob kyang rung ste smon 'jug gi /sems bskyed thob nas tshul khrims gsum/ /bsrung ba nyams len dngos gzhi las/ /'di yi smon 'jug sems bskyed gnyis/ /yin/ khyab mnyam yin zhing smon sems dang / /'jug sems tsam ni bslab pa yis/ /ma zin kyang ni sems bskyed ni/ /mtshan nyid pa ni bslab pa yis/ /zin pa gzhir bzhag byang chub kyi/ /ched du slob pa'i 'dun pa ni/ /mtshungs par ldan pa'i smon sems dang / /de thos ched du lam la ni/ /bslab pa'i sems pa mtshungs ldan ste/ /'jug pa sems bskyed du 'jog pa/ /gzhung lugs chen po'i dgongs pa yin/ /gsar du skye kha ma gnyis kyi/ /nyams len gtso bo bdag dang gzhan/ /brje ba'i byang sems ngo bo ni/ /spros bral stong nyid zung 'brel du/ /nyams su len ste lta spyod zung / /'brel des pha rol phyin pa yi/ /sa lam mchog ni bgrod par gyur/ ༈ /de la rje btsun tsong kha pas/ /bdag gzhan brje bar ma bzhed don/ /bkag don de la kha cig nas/ /mos pa tsam la byin rlabs 'byung / /zhes don rje btsun tsong kha pas/ /lam rim 'bring po zhes pa las/ /bdag gzhan brje ba las dang pos/

/gces 'dzin brje ba yin mod kyi/ /bde sdug brje bar mi nus bshad/ /bde sdug brje bar mi 'dod na/ /gces 'dzin brje bas dngos su ni/ /brje bar mi nus pa mtshungs so/ /gnyis ka blo yi steng du ni/ /brje las dngos su ma brjes mod/ /dper na kha zas gzhan la ni/ /ma byin rang gi lkog tu zos/ /gzhan la ster 'dod ma byas mtshungs/ /lung dang 'gal ste klu sgrub kyi/ /rin chen phreng ba zhi ba lhas/ /lung las gsal bzhin bde sdug ni/ /brje ba nyid la 'bad par bya/ /des na gnad ni mdor bsdus na/ /blo la bde sdug btang len gyi/ /nyams len 'khrul pa med pa ste/ /lung ni dbyug pa gsum phreng dang / /nam mkha'i snying po dri med grags/ /rigs pa bslab btus spyod 'jug dang / /rta dbyangs gsungs dang mdo sde rgyan/ /sogs kyi dgongs pa jo bo rjes/ /blo sbyangs don bdun ma'i zab khrid/ /'brom ston la gnang zab chos dang / /de bzhin jo bos skyes bu gsum/ /lam rim dgon pa bar gnang zhing / /sne'u zur bar brgyud pa ste/ /bka' gdams lugs gnyis zhes su grags/ /de yang 'brom las brgyud pa ni/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir shin tu 'phel/ /spyan snga sku mched gsum las brgyud/ /deng sang bar du dar bar yod/ /'di la shāka thub la sogs pa'i/ /lha bzhi bsgom tshul bshad pa'ang yod/ /bdag gzhan brje ba nyams khrid du/ /skyong ba rje btsun sa skya pa/ /yab sras rnams kyi phyag len te/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag dang / /jo bo bka' gdams pa ston gnyis/ /khyad med bstan pa'i snying po yin/ /mos pa tsam la byin rlabs 'byung / ༈ /lta ba log rtog dgag la gnyis/ /kha cig mtha' bzhi spros bral ni/ /sogs nas gang rung bkag pa'i tshe/ /gcig shos de ni 'gyur phyir ro/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po tsong kha pas/ /bden pa bkag rjes bden med kyi/ /zhen pa dbu ma'i mthar thug bzhed/ /de ltar theg gsum rtogs tshul la/

/khyad med rang rgyud pa yi ni/ /bden tshad blo la ma ltos shing / /yul gyi ngos nas grub 'dod pa/ /dgag bya thun mong ming gi ni/ /btags don btsal tshe ma rnyed pa'i/ /nges shes de la bden tshad byas/ /de yi bden 'dzin 'gog pa ni/ /thal 'gyur khyad chos yin par gsung / /bdag 'dzin gcod la zab par bzhed/ /bden med zhen 'dzin 'gog pas na/ /bden 'dzin skye zhing thug med 'dod/ /rgya nag ha shang dag gis ni/ /ma dpyad rang gar rtog pa bkag /de dang tshad ma'i rigs pa yis/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa kun grol ba/ /'dzin med lta ba gnyis mi mtshungs/ /'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang / /de bzhin mdo sde ting 'dzin rgyal/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud dang ni/ /mgon po byams pa'i rgyud bla ma/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub dbu ma yi/ /rtsa ba'i bstan bcos rig ldan che/ /pad+ma dkar dang 'phags pa lhas/ /mtha' bzhi spros bral kho nas gsung / /yang ni yod min med min don/ /bden pa gnyis la dgongs pa ste/ med pa don dam yod kun rdzob/ /yin zer don dam med mthar 'dzin/ /de ltar yin na 'jig rten par/ /yongs grags bum pa lta bu la/ /mngon sum mthong zhing med mi 'gyur/ /yod med gnyis ka tshang mi srid/ /des na tshig gi sgrib g.yog las/ /don du med pa'i mthar lhung gyur/ /yang ni yod med sogs mtha' bzhi/ /nges pa bzung ba bden med kyi/ /don yin gsung pa 'phags mchog ni/ /klu sgrub yab sras kyis ma gsung / /de lta'i med dgag la dbu ma'i/ /lta bar byas na tshad ma yi/ /lung dang mi mthun rgyud las kyang / /rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'byung bar gsung / /theg gsum lta bar chad med na/ /byams pas theg pa gsum la ni/ /bdag med rtogs tshul rtog bya la/ /bdag med tsam du gzhi mthun kyang / /bdag med chos dang gang zag gi /zlas phye'i chung 'bring che ba gsum/ /theg chen lam khyad sbyor lam nas/ /'go brtsam sbyor mthong sgom pa gsum/

/theg dman lam khyad spyod pa nas/ /brtsam ste sbyor mthong bsgom pa gsum/ /lta bas 'phags tshul gsung 'di ci/ /de bzhin klu sgrub yab sras kyi/ /'khor gsum mi dmigs shes rab dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid sogs/ /lta ba'i khyad par gsung la gzigs/ /nyan thos mthong ba'i lam nyid nas/ /bde gshegs snying po mthong gyur na/ /las nyon las byung skye sogs las/ /'das par gyur zhing nyan rang la/ /snying po'i lta ba mi ldan pa/ /thogs med zhabs kyi gsung la gzigs/ /blo la ma ltos yul ngos nas/ /grub des rang rgyud 'gog zhe na/ /rang rgyud srol 'byed legs ldan gyis/ /zhal bzhes gnang bar gzigs par mdzod/ /btags don btsal tshe ma rnyed don/ /tha snyad yin na 'dogs byed kyi/ /ming gi tha snyad med par 'gyur/ /tha snyad ming gis kun rdzob rtogs/ /kun rdzob thabs la brten nas ni/ /don dam rtogs gyur de gsum ka /phan tshun gcig la gcig ltos gyur/ /las kyi rten 'brel tsam zhig gi /chos kun ltos grub tshul gyi 'jug /de las byed po gzhan med pa/ /'phags mchog klu yis dbu ma yi/ /lung las gsal zhing dam pa'i don/ /ma rnyed pa tsam thal rang gnyis/ /mthun phyir khyad chos ji ltar dbye/ /blo yi zhen yul rig pa yis/ /dpyad nas 'gog pa log rtogs su/ /yin nas rdzogs sangs rgyas nas bzung / /rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyis ni/ /de dag stong dang mi stong gi /gnyis 'dzin zhen yul bkag par mdzad/ /de dag gi ni spros bral du/ /sgrub des med pa'i mthar 'dzin nyid/ /'gog par mdzad na khyed dang 'gal/ /ma 'gog med mthar 'dzin pa ni/ /'dzin pa yin na bden 'dzin gyi/ /log rtog gang gis bkag par nus/ /rtog pa'i blo yi yul gyi ni/ /gnas lugs dpyod las gzhan ci zhig /de tshe yod med mthar bzung na/ /de ni mthar 'dzin gyur las ci/ /blo yi gnyis ka'i skyon bsal la/ /thug med yin 'dod dgos pa med/

/'phags mchog klu yi dbu ma yi/ /rtsa ba'i bstan bcos las gsung gsal/ /'di la 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag gi /don gyi spros kun nyer zhi'i tshe/ /skyon ni rang bzhin gyis dag mod/ /so skye'i rigs pas dpyad pa'i tshe/ /yod med gnyis ka'i mtha' gsal bas/ /de yi gnas lugs rang bzhin rtogs/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub gsung las gsal/ /dgag pa gnyis min rnal ma zhig /mi 'ong 'dod 'khrul med mtha' la/ /'dzin ni med pa'i mthar lhung 'gyur/ /mdor na thos bsam bsgom pa'i tshe/ /gtan tshigs rigs pas yod med kyi/ /mtha' las dpyad pa res 'jog gis/ /tshul las de de'i mthar mi 'dzin/ /de ltar byas pa'i goms 'bras kyi/ /re zhig tshe na mnyam gzhag las/ /spros bral rtogs pa rang lugs bzhed/ ༈ /lo tsā skyabs mchog dpal gyi ni/ /kun rdzob spros bral smra bkag don/ /kha cig tha snyad tshe na yang / /sogs nas dbu ma'i lugs bar don/ /tha snyad skabs su yod med min/ /mtha' bzhi spros bral smra mi 'thad/ /mdo las ston pas 'jig rten pa/ /nga dang rtsod cing nga yis ni/ /'jig rten pa yi yod med kyi/ /gang smra de la rtsod pa min/ /de bzhin slob dpon zla bas kyang / /tha snyad 'jog tshe yod med sogs/ /bkag na 'jig rten gyis gnod pas/ /yod med so sor smra dgos gsung / /des na kun rdzob spros pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir rig pa yi/ /kun rdzob rnam bzhag byed mi shes/ /zas gos me chu la sogs pa/ /de yi rnam par yod med min/ /gnas skabs don yang mi 'grub cing / /gzhan gyi rtsod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /'on kyang kun rdzob kyi nang nas/ /rgyu dus 'bras bu yod med min/ /de bzhin 'bras dus rgyu yod dang / /med pa gnyis min khas len ni/ /tha snyad tshe na rgyu 'bras la/ /rtag chad spong pas grub pa yin/ /de ltar yin na rgyu dus na/ /'bras yod 'bras dus rgyu yod na/ /rtag mthar 'gyur zhing de yi tshe/

/de dag med na chad mthar 'gyur/ /myu gu sa bon las gzhan min/ /gnad kyi myu gu'i tshe sa bon/ /zhig dang med pa yang ma yin/ /myu gu sa bon gcig kyang min/ /gnad kyi myu gu'i tshe sa bon/ /yod pa yang ni ma yin te/ /'phags mchog klu yi zhal snga nas/ /rgyu dang bcas pa skyes mthong nas/ /med pa nyid las 'das pa yin/ /rgyu dang bcas pa 'gag mthong na/ /yod pa nyid du khas mi len/ /zla bas kyang ni de bzhin gsung / ༈ /paṇa shāka grub pa'i mtha' snga ma/ /zhig dang gzhung lugs ma myong pa'i/ /mtshan nyid pa 'gas bdag gang zag /rnam grangs smra ba mu stegs yin/ /bdag ni tha snyad du'ang med/ /gang zag zhes par yod par 'dod/ /zhes sogs dgag don la la bdag /sogs nas so sor smros zhes bar/ /yum gyi mdo dang klu sgrub ni/ /yab sras gzhung lugs rnams las ni/ /bdag dang sems can srog gang zag /gso ba skyes bu shed bdag dang / /shed skyes byed po tshor po dang / /shes pa po dang mthong ba po/ /de la skyes bu bcu gnyis grags/ /de don ji srid phung po la/ /'dzin yod der srid ngar 'dzin yod/ /ces bshad ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi/ /dmigs yul gyur pa'i nga tsam pa/ /de la bdag dang sems can sogs/ /byed pa'i skyes bu bcu gnyis 'dogs/ /de yi nang tshan gyur pa'i bdag /sems can sogs pa ming gi ni/ /rnam grangs tsam kyang spyir de dag /don gcig tu ni khas mi len/ /nyan rang byang sems gsum ka yi/ /bdag med ma yin de rnams kyi/ /ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi dmigs yul/ /ma yin nyan rang slob rnams dang / /dgra bcom thob pa sngon du ni/ /ma song byang sems so skye dang / /lam la zhugs pa mtha' dag gi /bdag yin de rnams ngar 'dzin can/ /gang zag yin gyi ngar 'dzin gyi/ /lhan skyes dmigs yul nga tsam mo/ /nga nyid gdags pa'i rgyu phung po/ /de dag gcig dang tha dad dang / /rten dang brten pa dang ldan lnga/ /de steng tshogs dang dbyibs bcas te/

/bdun gyis btsal tshe mi rnyed kyang / /ma dpyad 'jig rten pa'i snang ngor/ /nye bar blang bya cha shas dang / /yan lag phung po lnga yi rten/ /nga 'ang bdag nyid len pa po/ /cha shas yan lag can du 'jog /dper na shing rta nyid la ni/ /nye bar blang bya 'phang lo sogs/ /nyer len 'dus la shing rtar 'jog /des na rtsod pa'i tshe na ni/ /bsnon 'phri med par khas len rig /'chad tshe slob ma mi bslu ba'i/ /don de nges par 'chad par bya/ /phung po la ni brten nas ni/ /btags pa bdag zhes tha snyad du/ /khas len dgos par zla bas gsungs/ /dper na myu gu bdag gzhan las/ /skye sogs khas mi len mod kyi/ /sa bon la brten myu gu ni/ /skye ba'i tha snyad tsam zhig 'dod/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang phyi rol pa'i/ /btags pa'i khyad par lnga phung po lnga la rgyan dang 'dra sogs sgro 'dogs pa can bdag /nyan thos mchan mang bskur pa yi btags pa yi/ /phung po dang ni rdzas gcig pa'i/ /bdag rnams bkag nas rang lugs kyi/ /tha snyad rnam par 'jog tshul ni/ /phung po la ni brten pa yi/ /btags pa'i bdag 'dzin 'jig rten ni/ /lhan skyes yongs grags tsam zhig ni/ /slob dpon zla ba grags pa yis/ /'jug 'brel las ni rnam dpyod kyi/ /spyan gyis gsal bar gzigs pa'i phyir/ /yang ni khams dang skye mched drug /brten nas bdag tu btags pa dang / /kha che bye smra nas bzung ste/ /grub mtha' bzhi char phung po la/ /brten nas btags pas btags pa yi/ /bdag tsam khas len 'jig rten pas/ /rang rang bdag tu 'dod pa'i bdag /khas len re zhig thal gyur skabs/ /bdag ni 'dus byas yin nam zhes/ /rtsa she dang ni 'jug pa yi/ /lung de mang bkur ba yi bdag /phung po rdzas gcig khas blangs dang / /bdag dang bdag tu 'dogs pa'i rgyu/ /rnam smin phung po gnyis gcig tu/ /khas blang de ni dgag ched tsam/ /phung po zhes pa phung po lnga/ /phung khams skye mched sum cu gnyis/

/bdag 'dzin de la ngar 'dzin sems/ /spyir btang dngos po'i bsdu ba'i skabs/ /ming spyi tsam gyi nang gtogs tsam/ /'on te ngo bo khyab mnyam dang / /dmigs rnam 'jug ldog gi dbye bas/ /phung po bdag 'dzin so sor gyur/ /de ltar mi dbye gcig 'dod pa/ /de ni rdzas gcig 'dod grags shing / /rtag ltar nye dgos de 'gog don/ /de yang rtsa she'i lung don ni/ /phung po rang bzhin skye 'jig can/ /bdag ni stsol bas skye 'jig can/ /de la dgongs shing tha snyad tshe/ /skye 'jig byed pa mi 'gog cing / /'dus byas su gtogs 'jog pa'i lugs/ /mang bkur ba yi bdag dang ni/ /bdag tu btags pa'i rgyu rnam smin/ /phung po gnyis ni gcig par 'dod/ /rgyu zhes las ni 'gog med kyi/ /bslu ba med pas zab pa dang / /shin tu phra ba'i len pa'i shes/ /phan tshun dmigs res dang bral kyang / /sred len rten 'brel tsam de la/ /rgyu zhes 'dog cing kun gzhi nas/ /bzung ste phung shes yongs rdzogs par/ /rnam smin du grags des na ni/ /'gro ba rnams kyi tshe snga ma'i/ /phung shes snga ma ji bzhin du/ /phyi ma 'pho ba mi srid de/ /de 'dra yod na bdag gi rgyun/ /khas len mu stegs pa'i lugs gyur/ /bdag 'dzin zhes pa kun gzhi'i rjes/ /nyon yid rang nas gsar skyes gyur/ /des na phung po bdag 'dzin gnyis/ /gcig na phung po'i chos grangs kyi/ /bdag 'dzin grangs mang mthar lhung dang / /bdag ni rtag pa can du gyur/ /de 'gog don yin yang dag par/ /gnas lugs la dpyod rig pa yis/ /tha snyad rnam gzhag la mi gnod/ /'dus ma byas na bdag skye 'jig /med par thal zhing bdag lta na/ /rtag dang mi rtag gang rung tsam/ /khas blangs tsam gyis lung ma bstan/ /lta bar mi 'gyur lung ma bstan/ /lta ba bcu bzhi zhes pa ni/ /don dam la ni zhugs pa'i tshe/ /rtag dang mi rtag sogs smras na/ /lta ba ngan pa'i rgyur gyur pas/ /gang du yang ni lung ma bstan/

/de ni don dam skabs yin pa/ /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /gtam bya rin che phreng bar gsungs/ /phyogs sngas gong gi sgrub byed na/ /gang zag bdag med rtogs pa'i blos/ /yul gyi gnas tshul rtogs pa dang / /bdag 'dzin de la ma zhugs zhes/ /smra ba des na skye med dang / /mtshan med dang ni spros med rnams/ /gang zag rtogs pa'i blor mtshungs shing / /de dag tha snyad du yod bzhin/ /bdag kyang tha snyad du yod gyur/ /yang ni phyogs sngas kun rdzob tu/ /bdag yod khas blang don dam la/ /med zhes brjod pas don mthong na/ /bdag 'dzin tha snyad du mngon sum/ /med par ma mthong don dam du/ /med mthong tsam gyis grol gyur na/ /mo sham bu med med mthong gyi/ /grol gyur dpe yang mi 'thad de/ /'phags mchog klu yi don dam par/ /yang dag ji lta bzhin yongs shes/ /bdag dang bdag 'dzin gnyis mi 'byung / /zhes gsungs phyi rol pa yi bdag /yod 'dod nang pas med 'dod zhes/ /tshig tsam la brten tha snyad skabs/ /bdag med 'dod pa bzhad gad gnas/ /bdag la gang zag dang chos kyi/ /bdag med zhes pa rtsol bas rtogs/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi'i nang gi ni/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med pas/ /zhes ni ngo bo kho nar dgongs/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i gsung gis gsal/ /tshig don ma 'dres shes par bya/ ༈ /yang ni paṇa shāka grub mtha' la/ /tha snyad skabs su gang zag dang / /bdag 'dzin gnyis yod don dam skabs/ /gnyis ka med do ces bkag don/ /la la gang zag bdag 'gog nas/ /bdag tu 'gyur ba'i don yin phyir/ /bar gyi don ni chos gang zag /bdag gnyis khyad med mu stegs dang / /mang bkur lugs yin gzhan nang pa'i/ /rigs ni kha che bye smra yan/ /phar cher zhig gis spyir bdag zhig /bzhed pa'i tshul las phung po dang / /bdag 'dzin khyad par med pa ni/ /tha snyad du'ang bzhed pa med/ /des na chos dang gang zag gi /steng du de dang de'i ngar 'dzin/
