/rnam lnga 'am ni rnam bdun gyi/ /rigs pa zhes te phung po dang / /bdag 'dzin gnyis ni gcig tha dad/ /rten dang brten pa ldan pa lnga/ /dbyibs tshogs gnyis te rnam bdun gyis/ /btsal bas ma rnyed bdag med rtogs/ /bdag 'dzin gang zag gcig yin na/ /rnam bdun rigs pas gang zag dang / /rten 'brel rig pas chos dpyad tshe/ de gnyis med pa tsam cig gyur/ /'phags pa rnams kyi rjes thob kyi/ /chos kyi bdag med rtogs tshe yang / /chos tsam med pa zhig rtogs gyur/ /'di dag bden gnyis bzhag pa'i tshe/ /'khrul ngo dang ni thug med spangs/ /rig ngor bzhag pa'i gnad kyis ni/ /chos dang gang zag gi steng du/ /ngar 'dzin bcad pas bdag med rtogs/ /chos dang gang zag med rtogs na/ /med pa'i mthar lhung skyon du gyur/ ༈ /dge ldan lcags ra mkhan po sogs/ /dbu ma bsgom skabs nga bgrang pa/ /bkag don kha cig dbu ma'i lta/ /sogs nas snying po can yin no/ /bar don nga bgrang ngar 'dzin rnyed/ /nga med bgrang pas med blo skye/ /de yi gnas lugs rtogs zer ba/ /grub mtha' bzhi la grags pa med/ /de 'dra'i bdag ltar bskyed mi dgos/ /sems can 'khrul pa sngon nas goms/ /nga med brjod pa'i med dgag gi /'dzin rtogs goms la don yod na/ /dbu ma'i gzhung lugs don med gyur/ /mkhas blun khyad par med pa'i rtags/ /med dgag blo la shar ba ni/ /lhag mthong yin na zhi gnas dang / /zung 'brel bsgom pa mi srid 'gyur/ /nga med brjod pa'i rjes 'brang las/ /skyes pa'i lhag mthong yin phyir ro/ /blun po'i gtam la dbu ma la/ /sbyangs pas yid ches skyongs mi rung / /theg pa chen po'i lta spyod ni/ /mtha' bzhi spros bral stong pa dang / /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /nyams blang 'phral phug dge bar 'gyur/ /byang sdom skabs te gsum pa'o/ ༈ /rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa'i skabs/ /rig 'dzin sdom pa'i dbang bskur sogs/

/rgyud las gsum bar smin grol gnyis/ /rnam bzhag spyir bstan go ba sla/ /rgyud sde'i smin byed spyir bstan don/ /smin byed rgyud sde bzhi sogs nas/ /thob tshul rnam bzhir nges par don/ /ye shes thig le'i lung gi don/ /bya rgyud dngos bzhi'i chu cod paṇa/ /thob nas sngags sdom thob pa dang / /de bzhin spyod rgyud chu cod paṇa/ /rdor dril ming dbang lnga rdzogs nas/ /sngags sdom rdzogs so rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga slob dpon dbang / /thob pa'i tshe na sngags sdom rdzogs/ /bla med dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /sngags sdom rdzogs thob sum ldan gyur/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi dbang bskur ni/ /sngags kyi sdom pa thob byed yin/ /sngags sdom dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs nas/ thob pa sa lugs 'phags chos bzhed/ /sngags sdom thob mtshams rgyal ba yi/ /lung zin ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / /sems dpa' chen po yab sras dang / /go rams kun mkhyen chen po dang / /paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gnyis/ /bzhed tshul gsar snying 'dra min bzhed/ /so so'i sgrub byed mang mchis kyang / /deng sang phyag len dbang bzhi ka /sbrel nas gnang bzhin dbang gral gcig /nyid du thob phyir khyad ma mchis/ ༈ /bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs/ /rgyud sder rang bzo'i chog 'khrugs sbyar/ /de dag bkag don kha cig nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yin/ /bar gyi don ni bo dong pas/ /bla med dkyil 'khor gcig tu ni/ /dbang thob thams cad thob zhes zer/ /de ni phag mo mngon 'byung dang / /mi g.yo bla med sogs lung 'gal/ /bde mchog rgyud kyi tshig zin la/ /'khri nas zer na rgyud de las/ /spro ba bskyed phyir phan yon bshad/ /phan yon brjod las nges pa min/ /yin na kyai rdor rgyud las kyang / /gal te sangs rgyas gsung ba'i bka'/ /mi gsung na yang 'grong par 'gyur/ /de yang sgra ni ji bzhin 'gyur/ /bla med rigs lnga'i dbang gis nang /

/bya spyod gnyis kyi dbang mtha' dag /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi slob ma yi/ /dbang gi nus pa rtogs pa'i rigs/ /rdzogs shing 'dus pa la dgongs phyir/ /de yi 'og ma'i dbang thob gyur/ /theg chen mthong lam thob pa yis/ /nyan rang mi slob lam thob 'gyur/ de tshe nyan rang rtogs rigs rtogs/ /'di ni rnam dag rig pa ste/ /drang nges gnad 'byed mig lta bu/ /bdag 'jug blang pas chig brgyud dang / /de las brgyud na gnyis brgyud 'dod/ /gyur cing bdag 'jug blang pa yis/ /dbang kun ma chad sgrub dgos na/ /gcig gi kun thob don med 'gyur/ /slob brgyud gnyis brgyud du 'dod na/ /rim gyis sum brgyud sogs gyur te/ /bdag nyid bdag 'jug blang nas ni/ /gcig brgyud 'ba' zhig cis mi 'gyur/ /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams/ /'khrul zhes brjod pa go sla zhing / /de 'dra'i log rtog spang bar byos/ /bdag nyid gtan tu legs 'dod na/ /rdo rje 'chang dang 'phags yul gyi/ /grub chen las brgyud lo paṇa bsgyur/ /brgyud pa ma nyams dbang bskur zhus/ /de 'dra'i dbang dang dam tshig la/ /gnas na rdo rje theg pa yi/ /bstan pa rmad du byung ba'o/ ༈ /ngor pa ma gtogs gsang sngags pa/ /'ga' zhig dam tshig 'khrul pa ni/ /bkag don deng sang gsang sngags par/ /rlom sogs nas ni bag yod mdzod/ /bar gyi don ni rnal 'byor che'i/ /gsang spyod dbang ma thob pa la/ /ston cing sgrogs pa mi rung cing / /dbang bskur thob nas dam tshig nyams/ /de la gsang spyod bstan pa la/ /bstan pa'i yul de rtsa ltung ni/ /nyams gyur kyang ste dbang thob pa/ /sngon gyi dbang thob kyi tshe na/ /gsang spyod yod lugs shes pa des/ /ston pa po la ltung ba ni/ /rtsa ltung tsam zhig mi 'gyur te/ /yul des snga ma shes pa las/ /go rgyu gsar du med pa'i phyir/ /dus skabs yan lag ma tshang ngo / /rje btsun mchog gi 'khrul spong las/

/dus skabs ma tshang bshags byar gsung / ༈ /rje btsun tsong kha pa yis ni/ /rdo rje theg par zhugs tshad kun/ /rdo rje spun 'dod ha cang ni/ /rgya che'i skyon yod gyur pa'i phyir/ /bla ma gcig dang dkyil 'khor ni/ /gcig la dus gcig dbang thob pa/ /rdo rje spun yin gzhan du na/ /mngal gyi sgo ni mi gcig pas/ /spun zhes don mi gnas zhes zer/ /bkag don kha cig gsang sngags kyi/ /sdom ldan kun zhes sogs nas ni/ /mngal sgo mi gcig phyir bar don/ /'o na bslab gsum ldan pa kun/ /tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod zhes grags/ /de yang rgya che'i skyon yod gyur/ /'dod na rnam bshad rigs pa las/ /tshangs pa mya ngan 'das yin te/ /de yi ched du spyod pa ni/ /tshul khrims/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab bslab pa gsum bslab gsum yin te de ldan kun/ /tshangs pa mtshungs spyod gsung dang 'gal/ /de bzhin yul chen so gnyis po/ /spyod pa'i tshe na brda' dang ni/ /brda' yi len shes gang zag kun/ /rdo rje spun dang sring mo ni/ /ma yin gyur te de la ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid ma tshang phyir/ /'dod na bde mchog kyai rdor gyi/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud dang kha sbyor las/ /gang gi spun dang sring mo dang / /the tshom med par shes par bya/ /zhes gsung pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ /mngal sgo gcig min dper na ni/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal btsun mo ni/ /lnga brgya'i sras kun 'khor sgyur gyis/ /rigs kyi spun zla ma yin gyur/ ༈ /bo dong pa yis theg pa ni/ /gsum char tshogs lam chen po yan/ /gsang sngags yin 'dod bkag pa ni/ /kha cig theg pa gsum sogs nas/ /mthong tshe gsal bar 'gyur bar don/ /mdor bstan tshigs bcad gzhung go sla/ /lugs dang rigs pa 'gal tshul ni/ /theg chen tshogs kyi lam du ni/ /chos rgyun ting 'dzin yod zhes pa/ /byams pas mdo sde rgyan las gsung / /theg dman lam du chos rgyun gyi/ /ting 'dzin thob pa tshad ldan gyi/

/gzhung dag las ni ma gsungs so/ /rigs pas gnod de theg dman gyi/ /tshogs kyi lam du chos rgyun gyi/ /ting 'dzin thob na theg dman gyi/ /so skye de yi nyan rang gi /'phags lam thob tshe rgyun zhugs dang / /phyir 'ong gtan nas mi srid cing / /'bras bu gsum pa la gnas pa'i/ /chags bral sngon song phyir mi 'ong / /zhugs 'bras pa ni kho nar gyur/ /theg chen chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin/ /thob pa la ni bsam gtan gyi/ /dngos gzhi thob dgos de thob la/ /'dod pa'i khams la chags bral ba/ /sngon du 'gro ba dgos pa'i phyir/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis grub pa'i mtha'/ /'di ni mi 'thad 'dul lung las/ /dgra bcom thob kyang rdzu 'phrul ni/ /ma thob mang du bshad dang 'gal/ /gnad kyi snying po chos rgyun gyi/ /ting 'dzin bsam gtan dngos gzhi la/ /'jog na theg dman la yod de/ /bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug thob/ /nyan thos skye 'phags mang yod bshad/ /des na ming tsam 'dra ba yin/ /bsam gtan dngos gzhi la mi 'jog /chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin de yi/ /ngo bo chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin/ /yin na bsam gtan dngos gzhi la/ /gtogs kyang bsam gtan kho nas min/ /ngo bo'i snying po lus sems ni/ /shin sbyangs bde ldan nyer bsdog la/ /brten nas skyes pa'i bsam gtan gyi/ /dngos gzhi chos rgyun ting 'dzin yin/ /de ni theg pa dman la med/ /mdo sde rgyan gyi lung las gsal/ /theg dman gyis ni nyer bsdog la/ /yid byed bdun bshad shin sbyangs kyi/ /bde ldan theg pa chen po'i lugs/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon mchog des bzhed/ /lam ni zab pa tsam gyis ni/ /gdul bya kun gyis nyan pa yi/ /nges pa med de dper mtshon na/ /zab mo theg chen gsang sngags kyang / /nyan thos rigs can gyis mi nyan/ /ston pas gdul bya rigs gsum la/ /dgongs te gsungs so brtag gnyis kyi/ /lung dang lang kar gshegs pa dang / /'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis/

/gsung sogs nges pa'i lung las gsal/ /des na lam gyi mthar thug gam/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i gsang sngags kyi/ /'bras bu dma' shos nyan rang gi /lhag med byang chub thob smra ba/ /rgyu 'bras bskur 'debs smra ngan yin/ /gsang sngags dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i/ /nyan thos nyan rang mtshan nyid pa/ /yin na sngags kyi dam tshig skabs/ /nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag gnas ltung bar gsungs/ /kun rig dkyil 'khor khyams bkod pa'i/ nyan thos rang rgyud pa yin na/ /rigs lnga'i gdan gyi seng ge sogs/ /dud 'gro rang rgyud pa ru 'gyur/ /nyi zla sogs kyang de bzhin 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bo dong pa yis ni/ /dbang bskur yi ni rgyun bshags kyi/ /sngon du theg gsum gang 'dod la/ /dmigs nas rjes zlos gyis zer ba/ /sngags kyi sdom pa bsgrags pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje rtse mo las bshad lung / /gzhan yang theg pa che chung gnyis/ /rang don gzhan don sems bskyed kyis/ /dbye ba mdo rgyud kun bshad 'gal/ /'di 'dra rgyud sde phal cher dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug gzhung bzang rnams/ /'dra min 'byung ba gzhung chen po/ /spyi ni mthong tshe gsal bar 'gyur/ /de yang bo dong pa'i 'dod pa/ /rigs can gsum char tshogs kyi lam/ /chen po nas ni sngags la 'jug /dmigs bsal nyan rang dbang brtul gyi/ /sbyor lam rtse mo nas sngags kyi/ /bzod pa la ni 'jug par 'dod/ /de bzhin bo dong 'dod pa'i mthil/ /nyan thos theg chen la zhugs la/ /de la 'bras bzhi zhugs gnas brgyad/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rnam gzhag yod/ /nyan thos rkyang par zhugs gnas sogs/ /rnam gzhag med pa bka' tha ma/ /phyir mi ldog 'khor mdor gsung 'dod/ /de yi don kyang nyan thos ni/ /rang rkang zhugs la zhugs gnas kyi/ /rnam gzhag med pa bsgrub par 'dod/ /gong gi kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung / /bzlog tu med pa'i lung rigs yin/ ༈ /rje btsun tsong kha pa yis ni/

/bya rgyud bdag bskyod yod gsungs pa/ /bkag don kha cig bya rgyud nas/ /log pa'i skyon du 'gyur bar don/ /de 'dra spyod rgyud lung gis ni/ /bya rgyud bdag bskyed yod sgrub na/ /bla med rim gnyis lung gis ni/ /bya rgyud bskyed chog yod 'grub gyur/ /gzhan yang bya spyod gnyis kyi ni/ /nyams len khyad par mi shes gyur/ /lung gis gnod de rgyud sde ni/ /gong ma'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i/ /ye shes rdo rje kun btus las/ /gtsang sbra byed dang ye sems kyi/ /bde ba med cing bdag lha yi/ /nga rgyal med dang rmad byung gi /spyod yul min dang skyon gyi rgyud/ /rtog la rab tu dpyod sgrubs shing / /bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs so zhes/ /gsung pa'i lung dang 'gal phyir ro/ /bltas pa'i bde ba yod tsam gyi/ /bdag bskyed mi 'grub mdun bskyed kyi/ /lha ni pho mos bltas pa la/ /dmigs de bltas pa'i lam byed yin/ /spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang gi /yi ge dang ni yi ge sbyar/ /gsung ni sngon 'gro stong nyid kyi/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom pa dang / /de yi ngang las gsang sngags kyi/ /sgra ru ldang ba gnyis yin cing / /gzhi las gzhir gyur zhes pa'i don/ /dang po bdag bskyed gnyis pa ni/ /mdun bskyed nyid de rnam grangs bzhi/ /bya rgyud bsam gtan phyi ma las/ /sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /zhes gsung de ni sgra dang sems/ /sngon 'gro gnyis kyi don la mtshungs/ /gzhi ni mdun bskyed kho nar dgongs/ /des na gzhi yi kha grangs kyang / /mang nyung nyid kyis gsal bar ston/ /skyon spang mi 'thad bya ba'i rgyud/ /phal cher bltas pa'i bde ba yi/ /lam byed med gyur bdag bskyed ni/ /med par 'dod phyir lam dang ni/ /gdul bya'i gtso bo go ldog ste/ /khyed cag gi ni bzhed pa la/ /bya rgyud lam gtso bdag bskyed mdzad/ /gdul bya'i gtso bo srog rtsol sogs/ /bsgom par mi nus 'dod phyir ro/

/gzhan yang dogs sel 'di lta ste/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rgyud 'grel las/ /gzhi gnyis brjod pas bdag bya rgyud la bskyed ni/ /yod pa 'dra 'khrul de min ste/ /bya rgyud spyod rgyud ltar 'grel yin/ /'di la bsam gtan phyi ma'i don/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba'i 'grel pa las/ /gzhi gnyis lta bur bshad pa'i don/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi mdun bskyed dang / /bcas pa'i sgrub thabs de nyid ni/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhir gnas dang / /de yi ngang la gsang sngags bzlas/ /yi ge re rer gsang sngags dang / /ldan pa gzhi las gzhi gyur don/ /mdor na rang lugs bya rgyud la/ /bdag bskyed 'byung kun bya rgyud ni/ /rgyud sde gzhan ltar 'grel pa dang / /bdag bskyed med pa bya rgyud kyi/ /khyad chos dngos bstan yin pa ni/ /rgyal bas lung bstan rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' bzang po'i gsung las gsal/ /de skabs 'dir bdag bskyed med mod/ 'dir rang gi snying khar mdun bskyed lha mi dngos grub zhu ba'i phyir du bsgom pa ngo bo lha la rtsi dgos pa 'dra'o/ snying khar sngags phreng bkod/ /de yi phyogs bzhir me ri bsgom/ /de la sems 'dzin mer gnas yin/ /sngags kyi sgra ni dril bu yi/ /gsung 'dra sems gtad sgrar gnas dang / /de tshe rlung ni nang du 'jug /phyir dbyung tshe na mdun bskyed ni/ /bsgom pa rnams kyis skur dmigs shing / /ngal gso 'di la srog rtsol gyi/ /tha snyad mdzad pa rgyud 'di'i lugs/ /slar yang dmigs pa rnams bsdus te/ /'od gsal sems 'dzin smra mtha' 'o/ ༈ /ngor pa'i slob brgyud bla ma yi/ /gsung sgros ma zin 'ga' zhig gis/ /lha la 'khrul pa bkag pa'i don/ /kha cig ngan song sbyong sogs nas/ /mtha' yas shes par bya bar don/ /sbyong rgyud lha la rgyal chen sogs/ /'jig rten rang rgyud par khas blang / /de bzhin dpal mchog 'jigs byed sogs/ /'khor gyi 'jig rten ming can rnams/

/rang rgyud par 'dod de yin te/ /rang lugs sbyang dkyil bcu gnyis kyi/ /dkyil 'khor la bkod 'jig rten pa'i/ /ming can de dag rang rgyud pa/ /yin na de yi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur ba ni don med gyur/ /gtso bo de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /thugs ka nas ni 'jig rten pa/ /spro ba de ni 'brel med gyur/ /mdun bskyed grub tshe 'khor de dag /ye shes dgug zhugs mchod bstod dang / /rgyun bshags tshe na skyabs yul grar/ /me tog dor tshe lha gang rung / /gcig la bob zhes 'dor ba dang / /dngos gzhi'i tshe na 'khor sngags bzla/ /bum chu'i dbang bskur rgyud dang ni/ /gong ma'i gsung rabs las 'byung na/ /'jig rten dkyil 'khor drug po ni/ /'jig rten rang rgyud smra mi nus/ /gal te ye shes 'gugs gzhug sogs/ /gtso la yod cing 'khor la med/ /smra na rgyud la de ma bshad/ /ston pas sbyong rgyud gsung pa'i tshe/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sprul pa yi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor yin pas kyang / /'jig rten rang rgyud ma yin gsal/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du ni dbang / /thob pa tsam gyis grub pa thob/ /des kyang dkyil 'khor lha 'jig rten/ /rang rgyud yod pa 'gal ba dang / /sgo srung ye shes lha yod bzhin/ /nang du 'jig rten pa mi 'byung / /bla mas gsung zer byung rgyal smra/ /khyed kyis gsung sgros ma zin te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi kun rig gi /gsung tsam dngos las rgyal ba ni/ /rigs bzhi nas na phyi rol gyi/ /'khor yug pa'i bar thams cad ni/ /gtso bo kun rig thugs ka nas/ /bskyed nas rang gnas so sor bkod/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par gsung / /khyad par sangs rgyas gang gang 'dul/ /sgo nas 'di dag skur ston yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal bar gyur/ /sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor rgyal chen sogs/ /srog snying phul tshul bstan pa ni/ /'jig rten pa ru 'gyur zer na/

/gdul bya drag po dbang phyug dang / /'dul byed he ru ka gnyis kyang / /de mtshungs gdul bya drag po ni/ /'jig rten par gyur de bas ni/ /rje btsun mchog gi he ru ka /mngon byung sogs la gdul 'dul byed/ /rgyud gcig pa ru bshad dang 'gal/ /de la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam 'phrul rnams la 'di 'jig rten/ /'di ni 'das zhes blo tshod kyi/ /sbyar du mi rung sangs rgyas rnams/ /gdul bya 'dul ba'i tshul gyi ni/ /sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa'o/ /'jig rten ming gi 'jig rten par/ /gyur na mi la seng ge'i ming / /btags pa'i mod la sna nyag pa/ /ral sprug seng ge'i mtshan nyid gyur/ /ming don ngo bo nyid 'brel ba/ /ngo bos grub 'dod mu stegs kyi/ /grub mtha' chos grags phyogs glang gis/ /tshad ma rig pa'i rgyal pos bkag /ming la dngos ming btags ming gnyis/ /gsung rabs 'jig rten gnyis ka las/ /yod pas ming 'dogs tsam gyis ni/ /de yang de ru ga la 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'jig rten rnam gzhag gi /sgrub byed ming la re ba nongs/ /ston pas rgyud gsung tshe na 'khor/ /rang rgyud yin na sprul pa dang / /rang rgyud 'khor gnyis dngos gsung 'gal/ /gdul bya 'dul phyir sangs rgyas ni/ /rang nyid 'khor gyi tshul bzung dang / /sems can gyur pa'i 'khor gyi ni/ /mtshan nyid gnyis yod gsung dang 'gal/ /ston pas sbyong rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe/ /tshangs dang lha chen klu chen sogs/ /sprul pa yin phyir kun rig gi /'khor yug tu ni tshangs par bkod/ /slar yang phyag rdor skur bzhengs nas/ /sbyong rgyud brtag pa phyi ma gsung / /de tshe tshangs sogs srog snying phul/ /dkyil 'khor so sor bkod pa la/ /phyag na rdo rje'i 'khor du ni/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ /lha klu brgyad dang gza' rgyu skar/ /'jigs byed dgu yis bskor ba la/ /'jig rten dkyil 'khor drug tu grags/

/'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug zhes pa/ /kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /shāka thub sku dang tshe dpag gsung / /phyag rdor thugs dang 'khor los sgyur/ /yon tan me ltar 'bar phrin las/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po/ /deng sang dbang bka' ma nub yod/ /de yang sngon dus sprul pa dang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor phyis dus ni/ /so skye'i slob dpon dbang byas te/ /rdul tshon ras bris ting 'dzin gsum/ /de la yongs dril dbang po drug /sman bla'i dkyil 'khor gnod sbyin sogs/ /'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin na/ /cho ga 'don kun skyabs sdom 'chor/ /zhi mtshos mdo las gsungs pa ni/ /bde gshegs brgyad po sangs rgyas su/ /byas na skabs der dam chos bstan/ /lhag ma skyabs 'gro la sogs pa/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i/ /skur ston dge 'dun khongs su bsdus/ /skyabs gnas gsum la phyag mchod sogs/ /yan lag drug po dngos sbyar nas/ /bdun pa mdo smon nyid la sbyar/ /de bzhin don yod rdo rje yi/ /'jigs byed skabs kyi gshin rje ni/ /pho brgyad mo brgyad rdo rje sems/ /yab yum mkha' spros de bzhin du/ /'dod khams dbang phyug rigs lnga'i yum/ /bram ze chen pos bshad pa dang / /gdong bzhi gnyen po rdor 'chang gi /thugs phrin las sprul ston pa yi/ /sprul par bshad dang las mgon lnga/ /mgon po lcam dral sa bon las/ /brgyud de rim bzhin bskyed pa dang / /pho nya lnga la sprul pa yi/ /pho nyar brjod pa rnams kyang ni/ /'jig rten pa ru smra nus min/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i skal dman ma'i/ /lha skal chad nas 'byung po bsgrub/ /zhes gsung dran byos yi dam dang / /chos srung phal cher 'byung po yin/ /ma smra skyabs la the tshom gyi/ /rgyu ni nyes dmigs shin tu che/ /de la phan po'i gdam ngag ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas ni/ /byang sems sprul dang rang rgyud pa/ /gsum yod tshangs dang brgya byin sogs/

/'jig rten che dgu dur khrod bdag /sha za 'jig rten cha lugs ldan/ /srog chags la sogs rigs drug gis/ /gzugs ston rnams la snga ma bzhin/ /rnam pa gsum yod de 'dra yin/ /rnam dbye mdo rgyud dgongs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnam sprul nyid nges bya/ ༈ /thun mong lam la 'khrul pa dgag /dga' gdong chos rgyal dpal bzang sogs/ /lam 'khrul la la rgyud sde nas/ /nyid la gsung phyir ro bar don/ /rgyud sde 'og mar dbang bzhi ni/ /med la ltos pas rim gnyis kyang / /med kyang nges par 'dod dgos ltar/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung yin pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /phrin zhur gsang sngags lam zhes pa'i/ /tshig spyi dang ni rab dbye yi/ /tshig spyir 'khris mdo gsang sngags lam/ /gsung pa bla med theg par dgongs/ /de ni rgyud sde 'og ma la/ /bkab nas smra ba dgos pa med/ /rgyud sde 'og mar dbang bzhi ni/ /med la rim gnyis dgos smra na/ /de yang 'jam mgon bla mas bkag /blo yi rim pas lha bskyed tsam/ /bskyed rim don min bskyed rim gnad/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnyis sbyar ro/ /mtshan med tsam gyi rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rdzogs rim don min rdzogs rim ni/ /lus ngag yid gsum rdzogs la gsung / /rnal 'byor chen po'i nyams len la/ /'khrul pa dgag don mkhas pa che/ /yang ni tsong kha pa'i bzhed don/ /bskyed rdzogs snang ba lhar 'char don/ /yid ngor rten dang brten pa yi/ /lha dang ye shes bsgoms pa'i tshe/ /rtog gnyis gcig char mi 'jug pas/ /yid ngo'i snang ba lhar 'char yin/ /phyi rol snang ba lhar 'char min/ /de ni log shes nyid yin pas/ /lha ru mi 'gyur sel ba ni/ /brdar bas dung du mi 'gro bzhin/ /zhes pa'i grub mtha' 'dzugs bkag don/ /kha cig bskyed rdzogs sogs nas ni/ /bkag zin bstan par bya bar don/ /'di ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi/ /gnad bcos lung rigs gnyis dang 'gal/

/rgyud sde gsang 'dus kyai rdor gyi/ /lung dang 'gal zhing de bzhin du/ /bde mchog rnal 'byor mi'i kun spyod/ /sogs dang 'phags yul grub pa'i gzhung / /rnams dang bod kyi sngags 'chang mchog /rwa rngog dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /man ngag 'di 'gog gnyen po yin/ /phyi rol snang ba lha ru ni/ /bsgoms su mi rung log rtog dor/ /snang ba lha yi ngo bo yi/ /rang bzhin rnam dag yin nam min/ /yin na de ni lhar bsgom kyang / /lha ru mi 'gyur snang ba de/ /lhar 'char log shes yin zer 'gal/ /min na rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ /dag pa gsum gyi rnam dag bstan/ /'on kyang nyams dang shes sgrib kyis/ /glo bur sgrib pa sbyang gsung 'gal/ /'ga' zhig tha mar snang ba ni/ /ngo bos dag cing rnam pa ni/ /dag tu mi rung rgyud las ni/ /lha ni so so'i dag pa zhes/ /gsung de sgrub byed ma yin no/ /snyam nas 'khrul mdo de min te/ /rgyud la so so'i lha yi ni/ /rnam pa gzugs kyi bzhin lag ni/ /kha dog gnas pa phung lnga sogs/ /skyes shing grub pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha ni rnam par gnas pa'o/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pa ste/ /tha mal rnam rtog gis sgrib pa'i/ /rnam rtog de ni sbyang dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa yi gsal bar ston/ /lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyi sogs/ /rgyud tshig yang ni de don gcig /'chad pa mkhas pa dag gi lugs/ /des na tha mal bag chags rang / /dag bya rdo rje gur las gsal/ /yang ni phyogs snga de nyid kyis/ /sbyang gzhi'i lam bsgom sgrub pa po'i/ /ma 'ongs pa nas 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /'dzam bu'i gling mi mngal skyes kyi/ /skye 'chi bar do kho na yin/ /de min 'das pa snga 'das zin/ /da lta sbyang mi dgos pa ni/ /rang gi ngang gis 'jig pa ste/ /sbyong byed lam bsgom gnas skabs kyi/ /bskyed rim kho na sbyang ba'i tshul/ /skye 'chi bar do gsum dod du/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'byung ba yi/

/sgro btags de yang kyai rdo rje/ /man ngag lugs kyi rnams bshad dang / /gsang 'dus rtsod spangs su bkag ste/ /'o na sang phod skye 'gyur gyi/ /'bud shing da lo'i mes bsreg 'dra/ /ma 'ongs pa na 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /skye 'chi bar do gsum po ni/ /da lta bskyed rim bsgom pa yis/ /sbyong gzhir khyod kyis khas blang byas/ /khyod kyi 'das pa'i sbyong gzhi ni/ /na ning 'bud shing da lo'i mes/ /bsreg dang 'dra zhes brjod de mtshungs/ /gzhan yang mtshams med lnga byas pa'i/ /dbang gis dmyal bar skye 'gyur sdig /rnal 'byor pa yi lam bsgom pas/ /sbyong gzhi dmyal ba'i chos gsum po/ /khegs pa med par mtshungs phyir te/ /dmyal ba'i chos gsum sbyong gzhi ni/ /ma yin pa ru khas blang gyur/ /de ltar yin na rtsa rgyud kyi/ /lung dang khyod kyi grub mtha' 'gal/ /gzhan dbang zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /sa ni thob kha'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /rgyud la sbyong gzhi'i lam med gyur/ /de lta'i rnal 'byor pa de la/ /ma 'ongs pa na 'byung gyur gyi/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi mngal skyes/ /skye 'chi bar do gsum po ni/ /sbyang ni mi dgos par gyur te/ /rigs pa 'di dag ldog nus min/ /ma 'khrul pa yi don gyi gnad/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ni/ /skyes pa'i gzhir gyur gzugs la sogs/ /ma dag yul kun sbyong gzhi yin/ /rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis lung las gsal/ ༈ /bsgom pa'i gzhi la jo nang sogs/ /'khrul pa dgag pa'i tshul la ni/ /kha cig snang ba'i dngos sogs nas/ /lus la 'dogs pa kyis bar don/ /jo nang pa yi kun btags zhes/ /snang yul kun dang gzhan dbang zhes/ /der 'dzin gnyis ni lhar bsgom min/ /de yi ngo bo yongs grub ni/ /gcig pu lha ru bsgom dgos smra/ /yongs grub don dam lha yin pas/ /de ni lhar bsgom glo bur gyi/ /dri ma bral tshe don dam gyi/ /lha nyid mngon gyur rgyud las ni/

/phung khams skye mched la sogs pas/ /dngos kun ltar gsungs 'di la dgongs/ /des na yongs grub lha nyid yin/ /ye shes tshogs bsag dus su ni/ /spros bral nyid la a haṃ zhes/ /nga rgyal 'jog pa 'di nyid de/ /'og tu lhar bsgom phyir yin smra/ /de ni gzugs sogs kyis steng gi /chos dbyings bden grub byas nas lhar/ /bsgom 'dod 'di ni kyai rdo rje'i/ /rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ /nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i lung dang 'gal/ /lhar bsgom gzhi ni chos kyi dbyings/ /yin la re re zhes pa yi/ /tshig des gnod de re re zhes/ /so so'i tshig yin chos dbyings la/ /so sor dbyer med spros bral lo/ /de bzhin brtags pa phyi ma las/ /kun rdzob gzugs su gnas pa yi/ /sbyong gzhi kun rdzob de sbyong byed/ /bde gshegs lha yi rigs 'gyur te/ /dper na bud med kyi mtshan nyid/ /'di ni ji ltar skyes pa la/ /de bzhin des na kun rdzob kyi/ /tha snyad tshul la sbyong byed ni/ /de yi rigs su sbyong gzhi de/ /'gyur bar gyur zhes gsungs pa dang / /de bzhin rdo rje gur las kyang / /don dam chos nyid kyi dngos nas/ /'gal ba sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnyis/ /ma yin na'ang kun rdzob tu/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyi/ /snang ba 'char ba de yi tshe/ /sbyong byed rgyal ba'i dngos po yis/ /sbyong du yod de kun rdzob kyi/ /rnam gzhag la gnas de sbyong byed/ /dkyil 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi ni/ /sbyong gzhi phung khams skye mched kyi/ /chos tsam lha yi rnam par brtags/ /de bzhin du ni dpal gsang 'dus/ /'khor lo sdom pa mdo rgyud sder/ /mdor na phung po rnam lnga sogs/ /sngar drang bzhin du kun rdzob kyi/ /spros pa'i dbye ba kun lha ru/ /bsgom par gsung dang khyed kyi ni/ /kun rdzob lhar bsgom mi 'dod 'gal/ /rigs pa gzhan dbang gis bsdus pa'i/

/chos can phung po lnga sogs la/ /tha mal rnam rtog yod pa ltar/ /bsgom dgos de las gzhan pa yi/ /'ching ba las grol thabs med de/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ /tha mal rnam rtog rgyun ma gtogs/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba gzhan yod min/ /de dang rnam par 'gal gyur sems/ /gang yin kun rtog snang mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsung don ni chos kyi dbyings/ /spros bral lha ru bsgom pa na/ /spros pa gzhan 'gog thabs mi 'gyur/ /spros med spros pa byas pas so/ /de skad du'ang brtag gnyis las/ /bskyed rim rnal 'byor brtul zhugs kyi/ /sgo nas spros pa bsgom par gsung / /de las don dam bsgom pas so/ /bsgom dang bsgom bya'i lha sngags kyang / /med ces gsung pa spros pa la/ /spros med rgyas btab lung yin gyi/ /spros med spros par byed pa yi/ /lung ma yin no sgra rtog gis/ /yul du gyur pa'i rnam grangs kyi/ /sgra rtog gi yul gyi steng gi chos dbyings chos dbyings kun rdzob bden pa yin/ /tha mal rnam rtog ldog ched du/ /lha ru bsgom dgos rigs drug pa/ /rdo rje sems sam lha mo ni/ /chos dbyings ma ru bsgom pa'i tshul/ /rgyud dang sgrub thabs gzhung las gsal/ /'di yang kun rdzob lha ru ni/ /bsgom zhing don dam spros bral lhar/ /mi bsgom pa yi rig pa yin/ /don dam spros bral mtshan nyid pa/ /tha mal 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ /phung po sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ /yin la smad na rtsa ba'i ltung / /brgyad pa 'byung ba'i gzhi de ni/ /phung po lnga yi chos nyid ni/ /yin nam chos can yin zer na/ /chos nyid yin na rigs pas gnod/ /spros bral smras pa med pa'i phyir/ /chos can phung po lnga sogs pa/ /lha ru mi bsgom khyod kyis 'dod/ /bskyed rim bsgom pa'i gzhi yi don/ /chos sku yongs grub la 'jog pa/ /mi 'thad bskyed rim la brten nas/ /thun mong 'grub cing mchog mi 'grub/

/khas blang pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ /gal te bskyed rim bsgom pa dang / /'bras bu gzugs sku 'byung zhe na/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i gzhi/ /chos nyid gzugs skur 'gyur bar gyur/ /des na gzugs sku kun rdzob dang / /chos sku don dam yin khas blang / /khyed rang grub mtha' dang yang 'gal/ /'o na bskyed rim gzugs kyi sku'i/ /rgyu ma yin na rdzogs rim yang / /chos sku'i rgyu ni ma yin gyur/ /des na bskyed rim gzugs sku dang / /rdzogs rim chos skur rgyud gsung mtshungs/ /des na sbyong gzhi sbyong byed ni/ /'chol ba'i lugs ngan 'di dor la/ /don dam spros bral mngon sum du/ /ma rtogs bar du kun rdzob kyi/ /'khor ba'i snang ba 'byung ba kun/ /ngo bo stong pa nyid yin pas/ /'ching grol gnyis kyi gzhir rung ba/ /ngo bo lha yi rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam par dag pa'i gnad kyi ni/ /lha ru bsgom pas lhar 'gyur bar/ /gsungs pa'i gnad yin gser gyi ni/ /rgyan ltar mkhas pa'i lus rgyan mdzod/ /kun rdzob lha ru bsgom pa ni/ /rgyud dang grub pa'i gzhung bzang gi /dgongs pa'i gnad ni zab mo yin/ /sbyong gzhi 'di dag dper mtshon na/ /gzugs kyi phung po sbyang ba'i gzhi/ /de ni lha ru ma shes par/ /tha mal 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ni/ /sbyong bya rnal 'byor pa rang gi /blos snang rnam snang mdzad lta bu/ /sbyong byed gzugs phung de nyid ni/ /rnam snang me long lta bu yi/ /ye shes rang bzhin rnam par dag /shes nas lha dang ye shes kyi/ /ngo bo'i rgyun goms sbyang tshul lo/ /de gsum bsgom pas gzugs kyi phung / /rnam snang me long ye shes su/ /gnas gyur pa ni sbyong 'bras te/ /thams cad 'di bzhin shes par bya/ /des na lugs 'di'i sbyang gzhi ni/ /gtso bo yul gyi gzugs sogs dang / /sbyong bya yul can rtogs pa la/ /'jog pa rtsa rgyud lung gis bstan/ /gnad don zhe sdang lta bu la/

/yul dang yul can ldog pa yis/ /zhe sdang rang nyid sbyong gzhi dang / /de la tha mal du 'dzin pa/ /sbyong bya yin gyi de'i rnam dbye/ /shes par bya ba gnad du gces/ ༈ /lam gyi yan lag 'khrul sel la/ /ngor pa'i rjes 'brang phal cher dang / /gsang sngags 'dzin pa phal mo che'i/ /lag len 'khrul rtog bkag pa'i don/ /da ni lam gyi zhes sogs nas/ /bcu cha sgrub par bya bar don/ /gzhung tshig go sla 'di lha sngags/ /rdzas sngags spel tshig gsum char ni/ /bcu cha rab yin lha rdzas gnyis/ /bcu cha las sngags skabs re tsam/ /brjod pa 'bring la lha yi sngags/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rdzas sngags ni/ /kho na bcu cha bzung bas 'grub/ /sbyin sreg las sngags gtso che ba/ /dper na mchod par mchod sngags gtso/ /de dang mtshungs zhes ngor lugs kyi/ /mkhas pa 'ga' yis bzhed pa'i don/ /de dang mthun par mkhan chen ni/ /ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsungs so/ /gtor mgron gshegs la bo dong pa/ /sogs kyis 'khrul pa dgag pa'i don/ /kha cig gtor mgron la sogs nas/ /spel phyir mkhas rnams mdzad par don/ /gzhung gi tshig bzhin go sla'o/ ༈ /dkyil 'khor lha bkod la 'khrul pa'i/ /mgo mjug ldog pa bkag pa'i don/ /mi 'khrugs mgon po'i dkyil sogs nas/ /khyad med shes dgos pa'i bar don/ /de yang gzhung don go ba sla/ ༈ /nyang stod sgom chen nyams snang sogs/ /lha bkod 'khrul pa dgag pa'i don/ /sman lha'i pho brang zhes sogs nas/ /dge legs 'byung zhes bar gyi don/ /gzhung gi tshig don go ba sla/ /sman bla'i cho ga shāka mchog pas/ /mdo lugs rang rkang yin par bzhed/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yi/ /mdo rgyud gnyis kyi gzhi mthun dang / /cho ga bya rgyud yin par bzhed/ /mdo sngags dbye ba lha yi ni/ /rnam pa bsgom min khyad ces bya/ ༈ /gshin po rjes 'dzin 'khrul pa ni/ /sgom sde'i yul na dar ba sogs/ /bkag don kha cig ngan song sbyang /

/sogs nas gzab par bya bar don/ /gzhung don go sla de'i nang nas/ /mi slob zhes pa lam lnga yi/ /mi slob lam thob dag gis ni/ /dad zas rang gi bdag po'i tshul/ /spyod nus slob lam bzhi po yi/ /sbyin pa'i bdag pos dad pa yis/ /phul de rang dbang tshul gyis dpyad/ /so skye'i gang zag tshul khrims dang / /bsam gtan klog dang ldan pa yis/ /ston pas rjes su gnang ba yi/ /tshul gyis spyod gsum nyes med dang / /gzhan dag yon tan med pa dang / /le lo bag med dbang gis ni/ /spyod na bu lon can du 'gyur/ /bsam gtan zhes pa yang dag gi/ ༈ /lta ba rim pa gnyis la 'jug /phyag mchod yul la dpyad pa'i don/ /jo gdan pa rnams 'khrul bkag don/ /dkyil 'khor lha bkod la sogs nas/ /sngar bkag zin bar don go sla/ /gtsang phyogs chos sde 'ga' zhig gi /'khrul pa bkag don la la 'khor/ /zhes nas gzhan la'ang sbyar bar don/ /de yang gzhung tshig go sla'o/ /rten gyi nang gzung dril ba'i lugs/ /'khrul pa dgag ched rten gyi nas/ /phyag len yin par go ba sla/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin 'khor lo yi/ /brtsegs tshul 'khrul pa bsal ba'i don/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i zhes sogs nas/ /dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'byung bar don/ /bu ston sogs bzhed bkag pa'i don/ /nor rgyun rgyud la brten mod kyang / /mo 'khor steng du mi 'os te/ /dper na gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ /pha rgyud yab ni gtsor ston kyang / /ras bris skabs su yab yum gnyis/ /'chad pas yab nyid 'og tu 'byung / /sgrol lam bla med mdo rgyud yin/ /de nyid 'og tu 'byung ba dang / /de dag blos slong lta bu'i tshe/ /gtso bo mdun gzigs 'ong bar gyur/ /de phyir mo 'khor 'og dang ni/ /pho 'khor steng du 'thad par bzhed/ /de ltar lag len thams cad la/ /bla ma mkhas la dris nas ni/ /dag par byas pas dpal 'byor kun/ /phun sum tshogs par 'byung zhes bsngags/

/rim mam gcig char blang sogs nas/ /bsrung ba sngags sdom yin par don/ /sdom gsum dbang las gcig char du/ /thob pa rang rang so so yi/ /cho gar ldan byas rdo rje theg /nyams len gsum char bsrung ba ni/ /gsang ba sngags kyi sdom pa yin/ /sngags sdom skabs te bzhi pa'o/ /de ltar sdom gsum ldan pa yi/ /rim gnyis bsgom pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /myur du 'grub ste rab tshe 'di/ /'bring gi bar do sogs su ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'grub phyir ro/ /so skye'i rten la dbang rim gnyis/ /bsgom pas mtshon byed dpe yi ni/ /ye shes skye zhing de la brten/ /mtshon bya don gyi ye shes skye/ /de la 'phags pa'i sa thob 'jog /bla med 'phags pa'i sa de la/ /kyai yi rdo rje'i dgongs pa yi/ /rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis nas bshad dang / /saṃ bhu ṭi las gsungs pa gnyis/ /'khrugs sdebs tshul gyis phyi nang gi /sa yul bgrod tshul la brten nas/ /bcu gsum pa yi rnam gzhag dang / /de bzhin bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / /kha sbyor a bhi dha na rnams/ /dgongs pa dngos bstan kha skong kyi/ /sgo nas pha rol phyin pa dang / /mthun pa'i mi dang phyi nang gi /yul dang lha yi rnam dag la/ /sbyar nas gsung pa sdom gsum skabs/ /zhib tu smos zin gzhung tshig la'ang / /gsal zhing bde la mkhas pa'i dbang / ༈ /tsong kha pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis/ /bzhed tshul dgag pa'i rim pa ni/ /'di la kha cig zhes sogs nas/ /'di la dgongs zhes bar gyi don/ /rdzogs rim rlung sems thim tshul la/ /phyi yul so bdun mkha' 'gro ni/ /dbang du 'dus dang nang yul gyi/ /spyi bo la sogs gnas so bdun/ /rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa las/ /bcu gsum pa grub rnam bzhag ni/ /bla med rgyud las gsungs pa'o/ /sa ni bcu gsum khas len tshe/ /slob lam bcu gnyis bcu gsum pa/ /bcu bar mi 'dus slob lam ni/ /bcu gnyis nyid du grangs nges so/ /bla med thabs lam rnam gzhag gi

/mi 'dod bcu gsum tha snyad med/ /de tshe slob lam bcu gnyis su/ /dbye dgos phyir na bcu bzhi gnyis/ /bcu bar bsdu 'dod don med yin/ /bcu gcig bcu gnyis slob lam dang / /bcu gsum mi slob lam byed pa/ /bla med theg pa'i khyad chos so/ /de bzhin sa dang gnas yul rnams/ /gong ma 'og mar 'du mi 'gyur/ /phar phyin slob lam sa bcu las/ /mi bzhed de yi bla med kyi/ /bcu gnyis sa la gnod mi 'gyur/ /bye smras sa bcu med 'dod kyi/ /dbu sems sa la gnod pa med/ /bskyed rim lha bsgom dang sbyar tshe/ /lha dang rtsa sbyar de sa dang / /sa lam dod dang bsgrig pa yi/ /skabs kyang lha la lha bsdu na/ /sbyong gzhi sbyong byed lha yi grangs/ /med 'gyur bdag med lha bco lnga/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i dpe bzhin no/ /phar phyin sa bcu gsang sngags la/ /bcu gsum so so'i bzhed pa la/ /phar phyin kho nar bstun mi dgos/ /phar phyin mngon zhen ches gyur na/ /bla med sa lam 'chol bar 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin dang sgo bstun pa'i/ /sa yi rnam gzhag gsungs pa ni/ /gdul bya kha drang phyir du yin/ /don la phar phyin theg pa'i sa/ /'bras bu lam byed thabs ma zin/ /rdo rje theg pa'i phyi nang gi /gnas kyi sa ni 'bras bu ni/ /lam du byed pa'i gnad shes bya/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyis kyang / /de dang mthun par gsung pas so/ ༈ /mkhas pa tsong kha pa dang ni/ /rang lugs bla ma phyi ma 'ga'/ /'bras bu'i mtshan gzhi la 'khrul ba/ /bkag don kha cig ces sogs nas/ /sa mtshams gang du 'jog bar don/ /bla med bcu gsum sa bsgrub 'dod/ /sgrub byed ha cang thal ba ste/ phar phyin theg par sangs rgyas sa/ /bcu gcig bshad pa la 'khrul nas/ /grangs dang mtshan gzhi nor ba ste/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan gzhi'i sa la mi mthun kyang / /spangs rtogs mtshan nyid mthun pa'o/ /de'i gnad phar phyin theg pa yi/ /sku gsum ye shes bzhi po ni/

/sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes ni/ /mtshan nyid pa ste bye smra nas/ /bla med bar gyi 'bras bu yi/ /rnam dag sku dang ye shes ni/ /gong bshad rang rang gdul bya yi/ /blo dang mtshams pa'i yon tan gyi/ /ldog chas smos pa ma gtogs pa'i/ /mthar thug 'bras bur mtshungs pa ste/ /dper na shākya thub pa bzhin/ /de ltar gzhung lugs de dang der/ /'bras bur bshad de rang rang gi /lam la brten nas thob dgos zhes/ /snyam na nges pa med pa ste/ /sems tsam gzhung las sems can gyi/ /skabs nas rgyud la sangs rgyas nyid /yod ces gsung pas sems can dang / /sangs rgyas gnas skabs mtshams 'jog dka'/ /des na 'di ru dogs pa ni/ /dpyad pa'i dgos pa phar phyin gyi/ /bcu gcig sa la sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan gzhi bzhag nas yon tan brjod/ /des na sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa/ /min par ma nges 'on kyang ni/ /phar phyin theg par sa bcu yan/ /lam gyi gsal kha med pa dang / /rdo rje theg par bcu gsum pa/ /sangs rgyas mtshan gzhir 'jog pa dang / /de la bcu gcig bcu gnyis kyi/ /lam gyi gsal kha bshad pa des/ /phar phyin skabs der sangs rgyas ni/ /mtshan nyid par yang cung mi 'gro/ /dper na shākya thub pa nyid/ /mdo sngags gnyis ka'i sangs rgyas su/ /gzhung bzhin so sor dbye ba bral/ /don du bcu gcig bcu gnyis dang / /bcu gsum bla med kho na yi/ /bgrod dgos rgyud sde'i dgongs pa yin/ /rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos/ /lam gyi yig chung las kyang gsungs/ /rdzong chung pa sogs phar phyin gyi/ /dang po'i sa yang bgrod med ces/ /'dod pa'ang 'dis khegs de bzhin du/ /stag tshang lo tsās sa bcu nas/ /sngags la 'jug tshe sngags lam gyis/ /tshogs sbyor gsar du bgrod dgos par/ /bzhed mod kyang ni rang lugs ni/ /rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos/ /lam gyi 'jug ldog yig chung las/ /sbyor lam chos mchog man chod ni/ /phar phyin bgrod des sngags lam la/

/'jug tshe tshogs sbyor de ka yi/ /spangs rtogs mnyam pas go chod cing / /dang po'i sa nas 'jug par bzhed/ /mdo rgyud dgongs pa 'khrul med pa/ /rje btsun sa skya pas bzhed do/ /lhag ma'i sa gsum 'di la ni/ /sbas sa gsum zhes bcu gcig sa/ /phar phyin sa la ming bshad cing / /don ni sbas te bcu gnyis sa/ /ming don gnyis ka sbas pa dang / /bcu gsum ming ni ma bshad cing / /don ni bshad pas de ltar grags/ /'bras bu sku yi gzhag pa ni/ /bye smras rnam grol chos sku nas/ /spro ba bskyed phyir yin bar don/ /'bras bu'i rnam gzhag sde snod las/ /bye brag smra bas chos sku dang / /gzugs sku gnyis 'dod longs sku dang / /de yi gzhi byas sprul pa'i gzugs/ /dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' la/ /de mthun gzugs sprul kha drang mthar/ /sku dngos bstan nas rjes bzung bzhin/ /bshad cing tshad ma smra ba yi/ /mdo sde pa nas dbu ma'i bar/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum/ /me long mnyam nyid sor rtog dang / /bya grub ye shes bzhi ru bzhed/ rje btsun rtse mo'i zhabs kyis ni/ /sku gsum ye shes bzhir bzhed pa/ /phar phyin lugs yin sku bzhi dang / /ye shes lngar bzhed rdo rje'i theg /lugs yin gsung zhing bdag nyid che/ /'jam mgon bla mas thub pa yi/ /dgongs pa rab gsal las mdo rgyud/ /'ga' nas sku bzhir bshad pa ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku chos sku 'dogs/ /de lta'i sku gsum dbyer mi phyed/ /khyad par 'ga' la ngo bo nyid/ /sku zhes bzhed mod 'on kyang ni/ /sku bzhi gsang sngags rgyud sde las/ /gtso cher grags pa yin zhes gsung / /rgyud sde las ni gsung pa yi/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum las/ /sku gsum 'dod tshul phar phyin dang / /cha 'dra rnam pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ /so sor yod de rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud du gzugs sku rigs lnga bor/ /'dod tshe ye shes lngar khas len/ /ye shes lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/

/dag bya dag byed sbyar nas gsung / /bla med theg par sku bzhir bzhed/ /rgyu dbang bzhi dang lam bzhi bsgom/ /de la 'bras bu sku bzhi 'byung / /rten 'brel chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ /rgyu la gnas pa dbang las thob/ /lam bsgom lta bas nyams su myong / /grub mthar rtags shar 'bras bu la/ /don kun mngon gyur man ngag drug /gnad drug dbang bzhi so sor sbyar/ /sku lnga'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa ni/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug lugs/ /thun mong ba nas gsung pa'i tshul/ /'jam dpal lha 'dod mdor bstan las/ /ye shes mig gcig dri med ces/ /sku gcig dang ni de bzhin du/ /rang don don dam sku dang ni/ /gzhan don kun rdzob sku gnyis gsung / /de bzhin chos sku longs sku dang / /sprul sku gsum gsung sku bzhir yang / /bshad tshul mdo sde las 'di skad/ /ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa dang / /chos sku mdzad par bcas pa ste/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /zhes gsung de la byams mgon gyis/ /sprul pa ni zhes sbyor mdzad de/ /don du sku gsum chos sku yi/ /dbye bas sku bzhir bzhag pa las/ /phar phyin theg par ngo bo nyid/ /sku zhes zur du mi bzhed do/ /yang ni mdo sder sku lnga gsungs/ /bshad tshul mi 'dra'i rnam dbye ni/ /ma shes rgya bod kha cig gi sa zhes so sor 'byed pa'i don/ /phar phyin lugs la sku bzhi yi/ /rnam bzhag byams pa'i lung gis 'grub/ /smra ba lung tshig dpyad ma shes/ /dgar tshig zhes pa'i de don dmigs su dgar pa'i lha dgar tshig 'byed tshig khyad par la/ /'khrul zhes kun mkhyen bla mas bzhed/ /mdor na nyan thos bye smra yi/ /bla med bar gyi 'bras bu yi/ /rnam gzhag thams cad mthar thug gi /'bras bu'i mtshan nyid gcig pa la/ /bshad tshul tha dad 'byung ba ni/ /gdul bya'i blor 'tshams yon tan gyi/ /ldog pa spro ba bskyed ched smos/

/'di la dogs pa dpyod pa ni/ /mdo sngags 'bras bu don gcig la/ /rgyu lam don gcig lta bu dang / /'jam mgon bla mas bdag med kyi/ /bstod 'grel las ni mdo sngags kyi/ /rgyu 'bras khyad zhugs chos nyid de/ /skyu ru chu dang 'o ma yis/ /dper mdzad de dang mi 'gal ste/ /lung de'i don ni phar phyin gyi/ /theg par 'bras bu'i mtshan gzhir bzung / /bcu gcig pa la sangs rgyas kyi/ /ming du btags kyang mtshan nyid pa/ /ma yin spang rtogs ma rdzogs par/ /skyu ru chus sbag dpe ru mdzad/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa yi/ /'bras bu'i mtshan gzhi bcu gsum par/ /bzung ste skyu ru 'o ma yis/ /sbag pa'i dpe bzhin spangs rtogs rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa yin cing / /slob lam mthar phyin mi slob lam/ /mngon du gyur pa nyid yin no/ /'bras bu'i skabs te lnga pa'o/ ༈ /rtsom pa mthar phyin mjug gi don/ /de ltar tshul bzhin bshad sogs nas/ /legs bshad 'di spel cig ces bar/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yis/ /gzhung tshig gsungs nyid go sla'o// ༈ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /gdung brgyud bu slob bcas kun 'dus/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la 'dud/ /zhar byung chos 'byung mdor bsdus tsam/ /'dri la phar phyin theg pa ni/ /'phags pa'i yul du lha dang mi'i/ /ston mchog shākya seng ge yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum/ /bskor zhing 'phags pa dgra bcom dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsdus/ /de nas rim bzhin 'phags bod dar/ /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa ni/ /thub dbang mchog 'di'i sprul pa'i gzhi/ /longs sku'i ston pa rnam snang mdzad/ /chen po rdo rje 'chang gang nyid/ /gnas mchog 'og min stug po bkod/ /ston pa chos longs gnyis med kyi/ /'khor ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /byang sems rnams la zab pa dang / /rgya che'i mi 'gyur chos 'khor bskor/

/bcom ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa de/ /sku ni 'og min la bzhugs bzhin/ /mkha' zla chu nang 'char ba bzhin/ /gdul bya grub pa'i sa la ni/ /bzhugs rnams la snang sprul sku mchog /de yi gnas ni ri rab rtse/ /chos dbyings pho brang gzhi snying po/ /me tog gis brgyan dbang bskur khang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed gnas gtsang ma/ /bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga dang / /gsang ba mchog gi rgyas pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs nas/ /rdo rje dbyings dang de nyid 'dus/ /rnam snang mngon byang mi g.yo ba/ /phyag rdor dbang bskur dpal mchog ni/ /dang po gdan bzhi gsang ba 'dus/ /kyai yi rdo rje bde mchog sogs/ /mdo rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab gsungs/ /gnas gcig tu yang dus gcig la/ /gdul bya tha dad mdo rgyud kyi/ /chos tshul tha dad bsam mi khyab/ /gsung zhing spyir ni gsang sngags kun/ /sngar bshad tshul gyis ston pa mchog /shākya seng ge'i sprul mchog gis/ /gsungs shing phyis kyang thub pa yis/ /bzlas dang ma bzlas de nyid kyis/ /rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis gsung ba'ang yod/ /mdor na gsang chen rgyud sde kun/ /grub pa mchog gi gdul bya la/ /sprul sku mchog gi gsung zin yang / /de nyid 'dus dbang bde mchog tsam/ /ma gtogs phal cher ston pa mchog /shākya seng ge rang nyid dang / /de yi rnam sprul gzhan gyis gsungs/ /gsang sngags bka' yi bsdu ba ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mchog tu o ṭi yis/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas smin par mdzad/ /mgon po phyag na rdo rje yi/ /rgyud sde kun bsdus nges don du/ /ston pa sdud po tha dad med/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor de ltar ston/ /slar yang gsang ba'i bdag po yi/ /o rgyan rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /byin nas yul de rgya mtshor gyur/ /de 'khod klu rnams phyag rdor gyis/ /smin par mdzad nas rgyud sde kun/

/yi ge bris pa glegs bam rnams/ /de dag la byin rgyas par mdzad/ /de rjes klu las gyur pa yi/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams las/ /slob dpon bi pu kalpa sogs/ /grub pa thob pa rnams kyis blang / /'phags pa'i yul du rgya cher dar/ /mchog gi grub thob mang du byung / /de dag rnams las rim brgyud nas/ /bod kyi yul du snga phyir dar/ /sngar 'gyur gsang sngags byung tshul ni/ /ston pa shākya seng ge nyid/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su rig pa yi/ /ye shes grol bas mngon byang chub/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med/ /de yi ngang las dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas kun dang dgongs pa gcig /bzhugs las rang snang rnam dag gi /rdo rje'i zhing khams 'og min cher/ /ston pa longs spyod rdzogs sku dpal/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis/ /nyid las mi gzhan rang snang gi /'khor gyi rgyal ba zhi khro la/ /chos nyid ye shes 'od gsal gyi/ /dgongs pa brjod du med pa yi/ /dus ni bzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /dbyings su rang shar tshul gyis snang / /de nyid ngang las sa bcu yi/ /rgyun mthar snang ba'i gzhan snang gi /longs sku'i zhing khams khyad par can/ /'og min nyid du longs sku yi/ /ston pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /sa bcu'i byang sems rig 'dzin la/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde dpag tu med/ /dgongs pa brda' yis chos 'khor bskor/ /de yang byang sems sa dgu pa'i/ /gnas ni 'og min tsam po dang / /sa brgyad gnas la btags pa ba'i/ /'og min rnams su de bzhin gsung / /de'i tshe drag po 'jigs byed sogs/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor 'dul byed kyi/ /he ru ka yi sprul bshad mdzad/ /de dag bsdu tshul lang ka yis/ /yul gyi ri bo ma la ya'i/ /rtse mi ri rab gzhan tshig gsum mi gsal/ /phyag na rdo rjes de rnams ston/ /srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyi/ /glegs bam bris nas dgongs pa yi/ /rtsal gyis mdun gyi nam mkhar sbas/

/za hor yul gyi rgyal po dza/ /rmis ltas ngo mtshar bdun byung sgrubs/ /rgyud sde'i glegs bam mi yul du/ /bab ste kri ya wa ra na'i/ ( 'dir tshig rkang gcig mi gsal/) /ma hā yo ga rgyal po dza'i/ /khang steng a nu seng gling dang / /a ti yo ga o rgyan gyis/ /yul du sprul pa'i sku mchog ni/ ( 'dir tshig rkang gcig mi gsal/) /rdo rje sems dpa' dngos su ni/ /gsan nas bka' bsdus glegs bam bkod/ /sgrub sde rnams ni 'og min du/ /ston pa kun bzang chen po ni/ /he ru ka yi chos nyid kyi/ /rang sgras gsung pa'i rgyud sde rnams/ /gsang bdag rdo rje chos kyis bsdus/ /mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo cher/ /gnas nas de yi spyi bye brag /rgyud rnams phyes nas sgrom so sor/ /bcug nas mchod rten chen po ni/ /bde byed brtsegs par gter du sbas/ /srung mar bka' bsgos bka' bab kyis/ /slob dpon brgyad kyi phyag du sprad/ /spyi rgyud sgrom ni o ṭi yis/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma ni/ /sam bha wa yi spyan drangs so/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i yul du dar/ /bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir gsang sngags kyi/ /'byon tshul snga 'gyur rgyud sde rnams/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi slob dpon ni/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba bi ma la/ /la sogs paṇa grub du ma dang / /lo tsā chen po bai ro dang / /rma gnyag ska lcog zhang sogs kyis/ /bsgyur nas rim par so zur gnubs/ /sogs las 'phel zhing bka' brgyad skor/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa yi/ /las can rje 'bangs bu dgu la/ /gdams shing de dang bi ma la/ /bai ro nam mkha'i snying po las/ /bka' brgyad bka' ma'i rgyun srol bcas/ /o rgyan smin grol gling sogs su/ /legs par bzhugs shing de nyid la/ /brten nas khams phyogs 'dir yang dar/ /zab mo gter gyi brgyud pa ni/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa des/ /bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub sde brgyad/

/s+ph+yir ni zab mo'i gter gyi gnas/ /so sor gter srung la gnyer gtad/ /sbas te lo paṇa rje 'bangs ni/ /sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i skur/ /bsten nas spyan drang dus bab kyi/ /'gro don mdzad pas brgyud pa yi/ /bab lugs sngar smos dgongs pa brda'/ /snyan brgyud gsum ste bka' bab kyi/ /lung bstan smon lam dbang bskur dang / /mkha' 'gro gtad rgya gsum bsnan pas/ /brgyud pa drug ldan tha snyad 'byung / /rnying ma bka' ma'i skor 'di ni/ /rnying ma'i mtshan gzhi dngos ma ste/ /gter ma rnams kyi'ang rgyab brten gyur/ /gter ma zab mo'i man ngag ste/ /de yang bka' ma'i rgyud lung dang / /'brel zhing zab gnad ldan pa yi/ /mchog gnyis gling sa bcu gcig dang / /rigs 'dzin rgod kyi cho 'phrul sogs/ /gna' nas deng bar byon rnams ni/ /byin rlabs tshan kha shin tu che/ /yon kyang rnying ma'i dus dbang gi /brdzu ma phal cher yang 'byung srid kyi/ /rgyud lung man ngag mdo sngags kyi/ /tshad ma'i rig pas rtogs par bya/ /bka' gdams lha chos bdun ldan gyi/ /bstan pa'i bdag po jo bo rje/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad yin te/ /de yi theg gsum bka' ma lus/ /gang zag gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob pa'i cha rkyen du/ /gdams sam rgyal ba'i bka' mtha' dag nyams su bstar bya'i gdams ngag ni/ /legs par rtogs pa'i ched du grags/ /jo bo mchog gi zhal slob ni/ /rgya bal bod du mang byon las/ /jo bo nyid dang mkhyen pa mnyam/ /dbu spyan g.yas g.yon phyag lta bu'i/ /sras kyi thu bo paṇ+ḍi ta/ /pi to ba dang rin chen 'byung / /sa yi snying po bshes gnyen gsang / /dbu ma seng ge la sogs dang / /bod kyi mnga' ris stod du ni/ /btsan po lha btsun byang chub 'od/ /lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / /nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i zhabs/ /dge ba'i blo gros 'brog mi che/ /'gog dang ling lo mgar dge ba/

/lha btsun sgra gcan 'dzin sogs dang / /dbus su khu rngog 'brom gsum dang / /lho brag rnal 'byor chag khri mchog /dge ba skyong dang khams su ni/ /phyag dar ston pa'i phar phyin gyi/ /ṭīk+kar khams lugs grags mdzad dang / /rnal 'byor a mi byang chub dang / /'jing sgrom dbang phyug rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /gsang phu 'od du yal ba yi/ /rnal 'byor shes rab la sogs byon/ /bka' gdams phrin las rgyun skyong ba'i/ /brgyud 'dzin chen po gsang bdag gi /rnam par grub pa khu ston ni/ /brtson 'grus g.yung drung 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /rnam sprul rngog lo chen po ni/ /legs pa'i shes rab 'phags pa mchog /spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul/ /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes/ /rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags ma mchog /sgron mas jo bor lung gis bsngags/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i bdag po ni/ /jo bo yab sras zhes grags pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po 'di nyid dang / /gang gi legs gsung bdud rtsi ni/ /nye bar spyad pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /phu chung ba dang spyan snga ba/ /la sogs mkhas btsun bzang ldan gyi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang 'byon nas/ /gang gi ring lugs dar bar byas/ /da lta bka' gdams grub mtha' yi/ /mdo sngags brgyud pa phal che ba/ /sa dge dkar gsum nang 'dres te/ /mi nub skyong ba 'di nyid do/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bka' srol gyi/ /rnam gzhag rgyas pa 'og tu 'chad/ /mar pa lo tsā las brgyud pa'i/ phyag rgya pa'am sgrub brgyud pa'i/ /lugs srol zhes grags lho brag pa/ /mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi/ /'phags pa'i yul du lan gsum byon/ /bla ma dam pa brgya rtsa bsten/ /'khor lo bde mchog gsang 'dus sogs/ /rgyud sde'i smin grol gdams pa'i tshogs/ /bod du bsgyur bshad gtan la phab/ /gsung skyes slob bu bka' chen bzhi/ /'pho ba'i bka' babs mtshur ston ni/ /dbang de rgyud bshad thabs man ngag /zab mo yi ni bka' babs pa/

/rngog ston chos sku rdo rje dang / /'od gsal bka' babs gtsang rong gi /mes ston gtum mos bka' babs pa/ /gung thang mi la ras pa ste/ /dang po gsum gyi rgyud bshad srol/ /skyongs shing mi las grub pa thob/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srol bzung grags/ /de slob gtso bo ras chung pas/ /rgya gar byon nas lus med kyi/ /mkha' 'gro'i chos skor lhag ma rnams/ /spyan drangs ras chung snyan brgyud sogs/ /dar zhing dwags po lha rje ni/ /dbu rur 'byon te bya yul dang / /snyug rum lcags ri gong kha ba/ /rnams la bka' gdams chos gsan sbyangs/ /mthar phyin rjes su mi la bstan/ /zab chos gdams pa gsan nas ni/ /dwags la sgam por dgon pa btab/ /der zhugs dwags po zhes su grags/ /slob ma'i tshogs la bka' gdams chos/ /phyag chen gdams pa rgya cher spel/ /phrin las rgyal bas bka' phyag ni/ /chu bo gnyis 'dres zhes grags te/ /bka' brgyud kun gyi 'byung khungs yin/ /de slob brgyud 'dzin bu chen ni/ /dwags po sgom tshul phag gru pa/ /khams pa rdo rgyal zhes grags dang / /grub thob dbu se dus gsum mkhyen/ /'ba' dom ras pa la sogs yang / /phag gru'i thog mar dbus kyi ni/ /stod lung rgya dmar la sogs las/ /dbu tshad gtsang du las stod par/ /dkon mchog mkhar dang sa skya pa/ /byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan dmar/ /chos kyi rgyal po la sogs par/ /zab chos gsan sbyangs mdzad pa yis/ /nyams rtogs khyad can rgyud la 'khrungs/ /phyis su dwags po lha rje bsten/ /de yi zab chos bdag por gyur/ /de yi slob ma gling ras pa/ /'bri khung skyu ra rin chen dpal/ /stag lung bkra shis dpal grub dang / /khro phu ba la sogs pa'o/ /gling ras slob ma gtsang pa ni/ /rgya ras ye shes rdo rje'o/ /de slob rgod tshang lo ras dang / /dbon sras la sogs de gsum po/ /so so las mched stod smad bar/ /'brug pa'i srol 'dzin rnams 'byung ngo /

/dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi/ /bka' srol grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog /dam pa sangs rgyas kyis dar mdzad/ /'di la brgyud pa snga phyi bar/ /gsum byung dang po rgya gar gyis/ /kha che dz+nyā na gu h+ya la/ /zhi byed sgrol ma skor gsum gsan/ /de rnams dam pa kha che ba/ /gnyis kas ogs so lo tsār bshad/ /kha ches pu hrangs lo chung la/ /bshad nas de yi dmar ston ni/ /chos rgyal la sogs par bshad do/ /bar pa dam pa bod yul la/ /lan lnga 'byon pa'i bzhi pa'i dus/ /rma chos shes rab po dge 'dun/ /kam pa ye rgyal gsum la bshad/ /phyi ma dam pa lan lnga pa/ /ding rir 'byon dus phyar che chung / /badz+ra kro dha kun dga' la/ /sogs par gsung nas rim gyis dar/ /de nas brgyud pa'i gcod skor ni/ /dam pa bod yul lan gsum par/ /'byon dus yar klung sma ra ser/ /skye na bsod nams bla ma la/ /bshad pa pho gcod brgyud par grags/ /ma gcig gis ni dam pa dang / skye sngon gnyis ka las gsan pa'i/ /brgyud pa mo gcod zhes grags so/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i/ /lugs ni grub pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog /khyung po rnal 'byor rgya gar du/ /byon te rdo rje gdan pa dang / /mai tri pa dang ye shes kyi/ /mkha' 'gro ni gu ma la sogs/ /bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu lhag /dag las chos gsan thugs nyams bstar/ /bod kyi shangs pa gzhong gzhong gi /dgon pa btab pas shangs pa yi/ /bka' brgyud ces par yongs su grags/ /'di yi slob ma la stod kyi/ /dkon mchog mkhar dang rmog cog pa/ /la sogs khri phrag brgyad byung ngo / /man ngag sbyor drug byung tshul ni/ /dpal chen rga los 'phags yul du/ /tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa dang / /a bha yar gsan bsgom pa yi/ /grub brnyes grags pas zangs gling bar/ /khyab cing bod byon zhang tshal pa/ /sogs la gnang zhing dbus gtsang khams/ /kun tu dbang dang gdams pa yis/ /gzhan don mang mdzad sku tshe ni/

/brgyad cu rtsa dgu'i bar du bzhugs/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra zhes pas/ /dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug /las gsan ko brag par brgyud dang / /kha che paṇ+ḍi tas dpyal ba/ /chos kyi bzang por gnang ba sogs/ /sbyor drug bod 'dir mang du byon/ /dpal ldan dam pa dang po ni/ /sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug gi skor/ /gnyen dang se lo tsā'i phyogs kyis/ /a bha ya nas brgyud pa dang / /rwa ba'i phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mañju kīrti las brgyud dang / /'gro ba'i phyogs kyi kha che ni/ /zla ba mgon las brgyud pa rnams/ /dus kyi zhabs pa chung ba yis/ /dngos slob yin par mthun pa dang / /dus zhabs chung ba dus 'khor zhabs/ /chen po'i dngos slob yin par mthun/ /kha che zla ba mgon po yi/ /sbyor drug gdams ngag yongs rdzogs rnams/ /sgom pa dkon mchog srung la gnang / /de la sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ /kyis gsan de yis grub thob che/ /yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /de nyid las brgyud rgyud 'grel pa/ /man ngag bcas stsal de nyid ni/ /'u yug byon nas de bsgom pas/ /grub pa brnyes shing de nyid las/ /slob ma'i tshogs ni wa brag dkar/ /grub thob dharma bo dhi dang / /sras mchog dharme shwa ra sogs/ /la gnang rgyud 'grel man ngag 'phel/ /mkhas pa bu dol rnam gnyis kyis/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa las/ /rgyal ba byams pa'i rnam par sprul/ /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa mchog /rin chen grub kyis dang po ni/ /thar lor sgra gsan lo tsā mkhyen/ /sbyor drug man ngag 'phags yul gyi/ /dpe med mtshor brgyud gsan bsgoms pas/ /nyams myong 'khrungs zhing dur 'khor gyi/ /dka' gnad mang po thugs chud mdzad/ /bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i/ /drung byon rgyud 'grel gsan pa dang / /dri rtogs zhib mdzad rtsis la sbyangs/ /dus 'khor yan lag phra rags gsan/ /bla ma de yi bka' bzhin du/

/dbang gi mdor bstan 'grel pa bsgyur/ /zha lugs phebs nas dus 'khor lo/ /dus chos mdzad nas gsungs pa dang / /de skor bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ /phyis su bla ma dam pa ni/ /'phags bod yon tan rgya mtsho las/ /sbyor drug man ngag mang bzhugs gsan/ /rgyud kyi 'grel dang 'gyur bcos ni/ /mang mdzad dus kyi 'khor lo la/ /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa ni/ /mang byung nang nas rgyud 'grel dang / /man ngag phyag bzhes thams cad la/ /mchog tu gyur pa kun mkhyen ni/ /bu ston rin chen grub nyid do/ /de yi slob ma sa skya pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang / /gdan pa thugs sras lo tsā ba/ /rin chen rnam rgyal la sogs las/ /rim par 'phel zhing rgyas pa'o/ /jo nang kun mkhyen chen po zhes/ /dol bu shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ /gzhon nu'i dus su skyi ston zhes/ /'jam dbyangs khu dbon zhabs la gtugs/ /bka' chen bzhi sogs sde snod dang / /rdor phreng la sogs sngags gsan sbyangs/ /mdzad cing khyad par dus 'khor ni/ /rwa lugs bshad pa legs par gsan/ /sku na phra dus dpal sa skyar/ /bka' chen bzhi lar bshad pa dang / /dbus gtsang rnams su grwa skor mdzad/ /mkhas pa'i grags pa chen po thob/ /bla ma mang por chos bka' ni/ /rgya cher gsan mdzad jo mo nang / /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho las/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /rgyud 'grel man ngag bcas pa gsan/ /man ngag nyams bzhes gnang pa yis/ /nyams rtogs khyad par can dag 'khrungs/ /sku 'bum mthong grol chen po bzhengs/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa spel/ /de yi slob ma sa bzang pa/ /ma ti paṇa chen lo tsā ba/ /blo gros dpal gnyis la bka' stsal/ /dus 'khor 'gyur bcos mdzad pa dang / /kun mkhyen dol bu nyid kyis ni/ /dus 'khor rgyud 'grel chen po yi/ /bsdus don dbang dang sgrub thabs dang / /rtsis sogs yig cha mang mdzad cing / /dus 'khor bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/

/gzhan yang nges don rgya mtsho sogs/ /gsung rab mang mdzad de'i slob ma/ /kun spang chos grags dpal bzang dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal ba/ /nya dbon kun dga' dpal la sogs/ /mkhas shing dus 'khor sbyor drug gi /rnal 'byor lhur len mang du byon/ /de ltar 'byon las thams cad mkhyen/ /bu ston rin chen grub nyid kyis/ /mdo dang rgyud sde kun la ni/ /bshad sgrub rtsal 'dod mdzad pa yis/ /zha lu bu lugs zhes su grags/ /de bzhin jo nang kun mkhyen gyis/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub gzhan stong skor/ /mdzad cing slob brgyud rim pa yi/ /khyad chos 'ga' mdzad jo lugs grags/ /de bzhin bo dong pa yis kyang / /khyad chos rtsom pa mang mdzad de/ /de la bo dong brgyud par grags/ ༈ /ri bo dga' ldan pa'i lugs srol/ /kun mkhyen bla ma tsong kha pa/ /blo bzang grags pa rjes 'jug bcas/ /yin te rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud mkha' 'gro yi/ /gsang ba'i rgyud dang bka' gdams kyi/ /glegs bam bka' bstan mang po nas/ /lung bstan sngon gyi bde gshegs ni/ /dbang po'i tog drung thugs bskyed cing / /ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas zhing / /bkod pa sna tshogs mdzes zhes par/ /sangs rgyas seng ge'i nga ro zhes/ /lung du bstan pa'i skyes bu des/ /sku tshe'i stod du mdo sngags dang / /rig gnas bod du dar 'phel cher/ /gsan sbyangs phul du phyin par mdzad/ /bar du thos pa'i don la dpyad/ /bsgom pa'i sgo nas nyams su bzhes/ /'phral gyi kun tu dpyod pa rnams/ /'dul ba dang mthun lag len spel/ /rgyal gsung mdo sngags snying po bsdus/ /klu sgrub thogs med gnyis kyi srol/ /skyes bu gsum gyi nyams len gyi/ /rim pa tshang bar ston pa yi/ /byang chub lam rim gtsor gyur pa'i/ /phrin las gtso bor skyong bar mdzad/ /'phags pa 'jam dbyangs zhabs gzigs nas/ /bla ma dbu ma par grags pa'i/ /lo tsā'i tshul mdzad mdo sngags kyi/

/chos tshul the tshom mdud pa bkrol/ /sku tshe smad du 'gro don ni/ /shin tu rgyas te lha ldan du/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i dus kyi tshe/ /smon lam chen po'i rgyun btsugs cing / /'brog gi ri bo dge ldan du/ /rnam rgyal gling btab de nas brtsams/ /rjes 'jug yongs la dge ldan par/ /yongs su grags pa rgya cher 'phel/ /de nyid gsung las sgres pa yi/ /slob ma'i mchog ni rgyal tshab rje/ /mkhas grub rje dang thams cad mkhyen/ /dge 'dun grub pa'i zhal snga nas/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa grags rgyal dang / /'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa zhes/ /'dul 'dzin gnyis la sogs pa yi/ /mkhas pa mang byon phrin las rgyas/ ༈ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /mtshan mchog gsum ldan 'jam dbyangs gdung / /dpal ldan sa skya par grags pa'i/ /brgyud srol thog ma 'khon ston mchog /klu yi dbang po srung ba ni/ /bod 'dir bstan pa 'dzugs pa'i skabs/ /sad mi mi bdun nang gses su/ /rab tu byung ste u rgyan gyi/ /slob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa'i/ /zhabs pad bsten te gsang sngags kyi/ /smin grol gdams pa mang du gsan/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu sogs/ /gsang sngags bka' babs grub pa brnyes/ de nas bzung ste 'khon rog pa/ /shes rab tshul khrims yan chad la/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub pa brnyes/ /ji tsam zhig nas de yi gcung / dkon mchog rgyal pos dbang phyug ma/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'chams byed pa/ /la sogs gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis ni/ /gsang sngags gsar ma la 'jug pa'i/ /sgo phye rnying ma'i chos skor ni/ /yang phur rnam gnyis tsam min pa/ /phal cher ba ni gter du sbas/ /bla chen 'brog mi lo tsā sogs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur/ /dus ma'i zhabs bsten thos bsam bsgom/ /rgya mtsho lta bu mthar son mdzad/ /sa dkar logs la sā lu yi/ /sman ljongs rdo rje gdan chen por/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa che/

/'di nyid skye dgu ma lus pa'i/ /bsod nams zhing du btab par mdzad/ /de phyin lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung / /sa skya pa zhes mtshan mchog gsum/ /dang ldan 'jam dbyangs dngos su grags/ /gang de'i sras mchog 'phags pa mchog /'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro don du/ /bsam bzhin skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /rol pa dpal ldan 'gro kun la/ /brtse ba chen po sa skya pa/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhal snga nas/ /gang gi lhag pa'i lha yi mchog /'jam dbyangs bsgrub pas zhal gzigs shing / /pha rol phyin pa'i lam yongs rdzogs/ /ston byed zhes pa bzhi bral gyi/ /gdams pa'i lam srol chen po stsal/ /de nas brtsams te rgyal ba'i bka'/ /sde snod chos tshul thams cad la/ /'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa rnyed/ /de nas rim bzhin brang ti pa/ /dar ma snying po khyung rin chen/ /grags dang mes lhong tsher pu hrangs/ /lo chung ba ri kha'u pa/ /dar ma rgyal mtshan skyi chu ba/ /dgra lha 'bar dang mal lo tsā/ /sogs las mdo sngags chos tshul ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ /de ltar mdo dang sngags kyi chos/ /zab cing rgya che'i smin byed dang / /grol byed man ngag bshad dka'i tshogs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mnga' ba yi/ /nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni/ /khyad par bla ma zhang dgon pa/ /chos 'bar zhabs pad yun ring bsten/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len mchog /grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba mchog /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung gsung ngag rin po che/ /lam dang 'bras bu bcas pa yi/ /gdams ngag yan lag dang bcas pa/ /legs par gsan cing thugs nyams bzhes/ /rje btsun mthu stobs kyi mgon po/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /gtso 'khor lnga po dam pa'i chos/ /sgo skyel tshul du dpal sa skyar/ /byon nas rgyud sde chen po ni/ /bdun bcu rtsa gnyis gnang ba ni/ /thabs kyi rgyud la dpal gsang 'dus/

/rtsa rgyud de yi rgyud phyi ma/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba dgongs pa ni/ /lung ston lha mo bzhi'i zhus rgyud/ /ye shes rdo rje dgra nag dang / /gdong drug rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyud/ /rnam snang sgyu dra lnga phrag gnyis/ /ldan dang shes rab rgyud la ni/ /sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /phyi ma phyi ma'i phyi ma dang / /zla gsang rdo rje gdan bzhi de'i/ /bshad rgyud ma hā ma ya dang / /de bzhin sangs rgyas thod pa dang / /rdo rje bdud rtsi bde mchog gi /rtsa rgyud a bhi dha na dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang ni/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho kun spyod dang / /he ru ka mngon phag mo ni/ /mngon 'byung kha sbyor zhes pa'i rgyud/ /bde mchog sdom 'byung ma rgyud skor/ /gter zla'i grangs dang gnyis med rgyud/ /kyai yi rdo rje rtsa rgyud dang / /phyag chen thig le rdo rje gur/ /ye shes thig le de kho na'i/ /rgyud dang sgrol ma gsang sgron gyi/ /de kho'i man ngag dang rnyog med/ /a ra li dang de bzhin du/ /rdo rje la ra li rigs kyi/ /a ra li dang mgon po ni/ /mngon par 'byung dang de bzhin du/ /nam mkha' mnyam rgyud thog btags dang / /mtshan brjod dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /bsdus rgyud dbang don rdor 'dus dang / /rgyud kyi dum bu mi g.yo ba'i/ /rgyud dang bshad rgyud sam bhu ṭi/ /de rgyud phyi ma ye shes kyi/ /snying po'i rgyud ste gnyis med kyi/ /rgyud sde nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /sam ṭa'i char gtogs rgyud sde ni/ /'og ma dgu dang rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud la de nyid 'dus pa dang / /rdo rje rtse mo dang dpal mchog /dang po'i rgyud dang sgrol ma ni/ /rgya mtsho'i rgyud chung zung gnyis grangs/ /spyod rgyud rta mgrin rtogs pa chung / /stobs po che yi rtogs pa dang / /rnam byang mngon byang rtse mo'i grangs/ /bya rgyud 'od zer rigs mchog rgyud/ /gnyis ni saṃ bhu ṭa'i skabs su/

/phan thogs pa yi rgyu yin gsung / /rdo rje rnam 'joms gzugs bla med/ /ltar bkral bshad tshe de 'brel gyi/ /rgyud ni rnam 'joms gzungs dang de'i/ /rgyud ni ri rab brtsegs pa dang / /rdo rje mi pham rdo rje yi/ /snying po'i gzungs dang phyag rdor gyi/ /bcu phrag snying po'i gzungs 'jigs byed/ /gzungs dang rdo rje gnam lcags mchu/ /lcags nag drang srong klu'i gnod pa'i/ /gzungs dang sogs ma med pa'i rtogs/ /brgyad dang bcu drug 'di rnams ni/ /rang ngos bya ba'i rgyud yin kyang / /'grel lugs dbang gis bla med ltar/ /bshad pas bla med khongs su gtogs/ /de ltar bla med kyi rgyud sde/ /bcu phrag lnga dang saṃ ṭa'i char/ /gtogs pa'i rgyud sde 'og ma dgu /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ni/ /dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i lugs kyi/ /char gtogs rgyud sde bcu phrag ni/ /rtses mos lhag bsnan bcu phrag bdun/ /zung dang bcas te bla med kyi/ /rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis gsan/ /khyad par lcags ri'i khongs las ni/ /mi 'da' ba yi zab pa'i chos/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i srung ba/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms lha don gnyis/ /lam gyi sbas bshad bcas te bzhi/ /gsung ngag yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /yongs rdzogs nye rgyud gdams pa bcas/ /de bzhin rgya gar slob dpon ni/ /bal po ye shes rdo rje las/ /rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu ti yis/ /bkral ba'i phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ /lo chung legs pa'i shes rab las/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi rigs gsum spyi/ /skyu ra a skyabs las gdugs dkar/ /bcu bdun ma dang rga lo las/ /dur khrod bdag po yab rje mchog /dkon mchog rgyal por gdugs dkar ni/ /zhe gcig ma dang legs ldan gsum/ /gza' yum so sor 'brang ma dkar/ /tshogs bdag thun min khyad par gyi/ /rjes gnang skad gnyis smra ba'i mchog /ba ri lo tsār spyi bka' ni/ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bya ba'i rgyud/

/mi 'khrugs pa dang tshe dpag med/ /lha dgu rnam par rgyal ma dang / /sgrom ma dkar mo sme ba brtsegs/ /seng ldeng nags sgrol lo gyon ma/ /'od zer can ma dzam ser nag /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dang / /mi g.yo ba dang gzungs grwa lnga/ /sgrol ma dmar mo gser chos kyi/ /'jam dpal nag po seng ge sgra/ /tshe dpag med pa sprul sku dang / /spyod rgyud ā ra pa tsa na/ /bla med 'byung po 'dul byed dang / /sgrol ma bcu bdun seng gdong ma/ /rje btsun rig byed dbang mo dang / /'dod pa'i rgyal po tshogs bdag dkar/ /gur gyi mgon po dpa' rkyang sogs/ /lcags thang pa las 'dod rgyal dang / /jo sras zhang dger pu trar gsan/ /'khon ston sgyi chu dgra lha 'bar/ /gang las kye yi rdo rje ni/ /ḍom bhi lugs dang de'i chos sna/ /bco lnga kyai rdor nag po lugs/ /de yi chos sna bcu bzhi dang / /lam skor dgu las pad+ma dang / /nag po shān+ta bha dra'i skor/ /bshad rgyud saṃ bhu ṭa dang ni/ /thun mong ma yin rdo rje gur/ /gser chos dzam dmar la sogs gsan/ /grub mchog zhang ston chos 'bar las/ /kyai yi rdo rje man ngag lugs/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len mchog /gsung ngag yid bzhin nor bu dang / /kyai yi rdo rje mtsho skyes lugs/ /de yi chos sna bcu bzhi dang / /lam skor dgu las nag po'i skor/ /sgo drug chos 'brel las rgyal chen/ /in+d+ra bhu ti pad+ma dang / /ḍoṃ bhi tog rtse klu sgrub zhabs/ /ngag dbang grags pa'i skor dang ni/ /rig byed ma dang gur gyi mgon/ /dpa' rkyang gri gug lha lnga yi/ /sin dkyil snyan brgyud dbang sogs gsan/ /mal lo blo gros grags pa las/ /dpal ldan nā ro ta pa yi/ /thugs thig mkha' spyod dbang mo dang / /'khor lo sdom pa lo nag dril/ /kun rig rdo rje khyung khra dang / /a ra pa tsa lha lnga'i dbang / /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i ded dpon che/ /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po yi/

/dbang chen bzhi dang lha gsum pa/ /lha brgyad bcu gcig lha bcu gnyis/ /lha dgu phyi nang gsang ba dang / /ru mtshon la sogs rjes su gnang / /phyi khrid phyi nang gsang gsum dang / /nang khrid gsang khrid thun min sogs/ /phyi nang gsang gsum ches zab pa'i/ /gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /gser chos lha chen tshogs kyi bdag /dmar chen skor sogs rgya cher gsan/ /grub pa'i gtsug rgyan kha'u pa/ /gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags pa'i lugs/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes zhabs/ /gyis bkral 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /rje btsun sgrol ma yan lag drug /ldan dang dpal mo gser snying dang / /nor rgyun dmar mo ti nu ma/ /zhing skyong yid bzhin nor bu'i skor/ /bsnyen dus bsgrub dus thun thun min/ /glang gdong brtsegs zhal gsang sgrub dang / /gdong brnyan dkar po tshe 'phel ni/ /thun mong thun min ser por ni/ /lha lnga dmar po sngon po dang / /bram ze mngags gtad bcas rjes gnang / /srung 'khor 'chi med tshe khrid dang / /gsang khrid gdams ngag skor yongs rdzogs/ /la sogs chos bka' rgya cher gsan/ /mdor na thub gsung mdo dang sngags/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho rgyud man ngag /yongs rdzogs mnga' bdag sa skya pa/ /brtse chen kun dga' snying po zhes/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ /gang des zab rgyas mdo sngags kyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ /khyad par dgung lo lnga bcu'i mtshams/ /gsung ngag yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /gdams ngag zab mo'i bka' rgya grol/ /khams pa byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /a seng zhes pas zhus pa'i ngor/ /gsung ngag lam 'bras thog mar gsung / /de nas gsung ngag gdams pa rnams/ /rim par stsal ba'i slob ma ni/ /mchog thob gsum dang bzod pa thob/ /bdun dang rtogs pa ldan pa ni/ /brgyad cu gzhung bshad 'dzin pa yi/ /thugs sras bcu gcig rdo rje yi/ /tshig rkang rnam par 'grel mdzad pa'i/ /thugs sras bdun dang phyogs kyi ni/

/mkhas grub chen po bzhi la sogs/ /gsung ngag la ni de bzhin mtshon/ /mdo rgyud man ngag 'dzin pa yi/ /slob tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /byon pa'i gtso bo kun gyi mchog /rje btsun sku mched zhes pa ni/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mi thub zla ba'i rnam par sprul/ /slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo dang / /skye ba du mar 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /lhag pa'i lhar gyur skye ba 'dir/ /'jam dpal mtshan brjod thugs la ni/ /rang rdol byung sogs yon tan mchog /rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mdo sngags kyi/ /gter mdzod rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /grags pa rgyal mtshan mkhyen rab kyi/ /bdag po 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / /gnyis med gangs can ljongs 'di ru/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun gyi/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs gsal byed pa'i/ /thog mar gyur pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan lung rtogs kyi/ /yon tan gter mdzod sku'i cha shas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yi/ /dkyil 'khor sprul dang bsdu mdzad pas/ /sa steng 'gro khams rgya mtsho rnams/ /dad par byas te mdo sngags kyi/ /snang byed 'gro ba'i mgon po ni/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun ni/ /gong ma lnga zhes yongs su grags/ /de mtshungs mtshan mchog gsum ldan gyi/ /gdung brgyud spyi la dbang bsgyur dang / /bla brang go bzhir grags pa la/ /rim byon khyad par rin chen sgang / /dus mchod bla brang gdung brgyud rnams/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal du byon pa ste/ /dpal yon 'gran bral sha stag dang / /khyad par bla ma bdag nyid che/ /bzang po dpal dang mkhas btsun che/ /nam mkha' legs pa gzhi thog pa/ /bdag chen kun dga' rin chen dang / /de sras blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /de bzhin bla brang rin chen sgang / /chos rje bla ma dam pa ni/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan de yi dbon/ /bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs/

/rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / /bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan mchog /lha khang bla brang gdung brgyud ni/ /theg chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / /rtses dong gdung brgyud khri chen ni/ /kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang / /dus mchod gdung brgyud sa lo tsā/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams dang / /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ /bdud kyi stobs 'phrog sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po che/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / /sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros mtshan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa a mes zhabs/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dang / /'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug pa/ /sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis dang / /yab rje rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /ngag dbang bsod nams rin chen zhabs/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po/ /ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang / /de sras mthu stobs mgon po ni/ /'jam mgon dbang sdud snying po'i zhabs/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /bka' drin sum ldan sa skya pa/ /khri chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /maṅga'i mtshan can mthu stobs kyi/ /dbang phyug 'jam mgon rat+na'i mtshan/ /mgon po dngos grub dpal 'bar dang / /'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ /'jam mgon yid bzhin nor bu mchog /ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen dang / /'jam mgon bkra shis rin chen zhabs/ /da lta bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du/ /'tsho bzhes brtan dang 'byung 'byung 'gyur/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin chad pa med/ /'byon dang 'byon 'gyur sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud rim par 'byon rnams so/ /gang gi bstan 'dzin skyes bu ni/ /a nan dam pa tshogs sgom pa/ /kun dga' dpal dang grub thob pa/ /yon tan dpal dang zhang ston ni/ /dkon mchog dpal dang nyan chen pa/ /dga' ldan pa dang grub pa'i dbang /

/na bza' brag phug pa chen po/ /bsod nams dpal dang chos kyi rje/ /dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen pa/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan grub pa'i dbang / /bud+dha shrī la la sogs so/ /mdo phyogs mtshan nyid theg pa la/ /sa skya paṇa chen bka' drin gyis/ /gang gi brgyud 'dzin 'o yug pa/ /rig pa'i seng ge nas bzung ste/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag ston ni/ /sangs rgyas dpal dang re mda' ba/ /gzhon nu blo gros rong ston dang / /sangs rgyas 'phel sogs mang du byon/ /sa skya'i mtshan nyid grwa drug 'phel/ /shāka mchog pa dang kun mkhyen ni/ /seng ge'i mtshan can mdo sngags kyi/ /bstan pa'i bdag po sdom rigs sogs/ /sa skya'i grub mtha'i srog bzung nas/ /mus kong nyang gsum la sogs pa'i/ /slob tshogs 'phel nas yangs can pa/ /dbang phyug dpal bzang mkhas pa'i dbang / /ngag dbang chos grags la sogs byon/ /mdo sngags spyi dang sa skya pa'i/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bstan 'dzin ni/ /yar klung klu pa'i gdung brgyud las/ /yar sgom se bo yon tan khri/ /sogs nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug ni/ /seng ge rgyal mtshan de yi dbon/ /bsod nams rgyal mchog la sogs byon/ /da lta brgyud 'dzin rkang tshugs tsam/ /med kyang gong dkar tshar lugs sogs/ /rgyun khyab chos rje bla ma yi/ /thugs sras gzungs dpal chos kyi rje/ /bzang po rgyal mtshan dkon mchog mtshan/ /dge rgyal la sogs mus sred pa/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs byon dang / /theg chen chos rje rdzong chung ba/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan brag thog pa/ /sogs brgyud gong dkar pa chen po/ /kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa ni/ /kun dga' rnam rgyal slob brgyud bcas/ /da lta'ang brgyud 'dzin dar bzhin pa/ /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin rdzogs pa dang / /ngor pa zhes grags rgyal ba yi/ /lung bstan brnyes pa rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir mkhas dang grub/ /kun gyi bla na mngon mtho zhing /

/dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan 'dzin gyi/ /nang nas mchog tu gyur pa de'i/ /zhal slob sa skya'i gdung brgyud dang / /thugs sras sems dpa' chen po ni/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rgyal tshab pa/ /kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin rje/ /dkon mchog 'phel dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gu ge grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /mkhas mchog gung ru shes rab bzang / /dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal dang / /rong ston chen po gser mdog pa/ /shākya mchog ldan byams chen po'i/ /rab 'byams sangs rgyas 'phel ba dang / /'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang pa/ /paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / /sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa/ /grub mchog dkon mchog blo gros dang / /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i zhabs/ /zha lu mkhyen rab chos rje dang / /grub thob thang stong rgyal po sogs/ /mkhas dang grub pa du ma dang / /gdan sar ngor chen thams cad mkhyen/ /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang / /mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs/ /mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub dang / /thar rtse rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /byams pa nam mkha' bsam grub dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs/ /bdag la sdom pa gsum gyi ni/ /bka' drin mchog stsol thams cad mkhyen/ /byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs/ /ngor chen brgyud 'dzin rim pa bzhin/ /je 'phel je bzang deng sang yang / /dpal ldan ngor pa'i phrin las ni/ /dar rgyas mkha' khyab bzhugs 'di'o// ༈ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud/ /bu slob grub pa ngor rdzong gong / kun gyi zhal ngo nang brgyud dang / /tshig brgyud snyan brgyud zab dgu yi/ /bdag po bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /phyogs las rnam rgyal rdo rings pa/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor lo sgyur/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po che/

/blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ /gong gi thugs sras 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen/ /klu sgrub rgya mtsho mkhan chen pa/ /gzhon nu blo gros bod mkhar ba/ /don grub rgyal mtshan lding ma ba/ /bslab gsum rgyal mtshan ta ra ba/ /bsod nams chos 'phel rdo rje 'chang / /dbang phyug rab brtan mkhas pa'i dbang / /ngag dbang chos grags bka' 'gyur ba/ /mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dang / /gong sa rdo rje 'chang lnga pa/ /zha lu mkhan chen rgyal rtse ba/ /ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / /ngag dbang rnam rgyal ka spe ba/ /bstan pa rab rgyas mkhyen rab rje/ /byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub dang / /mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs/ /rmor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub dang / /grub dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /brag rtsa rdo rje 'chang dang ni/ /gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang chen sogs/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung gi mchog /ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /legs pa'i mtshan can la sogs te/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i snyan brgyud kyi/ /bdag po kha'u brag rdzong pa/ /zhes sam tshar chen bla ma yis/ /ring lugs zhes grags ris bral gyi/ /mkhas grub kun gyi spyi bor bkur/ /snyan brgyud slob bshad pa zhes pa/ /yongs grags dar zhing rgyas 'di'o/ /gtso bo'i brgyud 'dzin de ltar dang / /mdor na gangs ri'i khrod 'di yi/ /rnam dag grub mtha' phal mo che/ /rtsa ba dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /slob brgyud phrin las las byung ngo / /mdo sngags gdams pa'i rnam gzhag gi /sa bcad mdor bsdus tsam smos na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /'dul ba so sor thar pa yi/ /ring lugs rnam dag paṇ+ḍi ta/ /shākya shrī'i sdom rgyun las/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu'i 'dul ba'i khrims/ /gnang bkag bslab bya rnam dag gi /rgyun bzang 'jam mgon bla ma ni/ /sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas bzung /
