/ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /kun dga' bzang po slob brgyud bcas/ /la sogs 'dul bstan nyi ma shar/ /rgya che'i phung khams skye mched kyi/ /rnam gzhag bye brag smra ba dang / /yod sde'i rnam gzhag gsal ston pa'i/ /dam chos mngon pa'i gzhung lugs dang / /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho'i don/ /gsal byed theg chen byang sems kyi/ nyams len byams chos sde lnga sogs/ /sems bskyed phyin drug bsdu dngos gzhi/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam cha tshang / /ngan smra'i rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel kun btus sogs/ /tshad ma'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho yi/ /snying po tshad ma rig pa'i gter/ /spros bral lta ba rnam dag pa/ /ston pa zab mo dbu ma'i lam/ /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs nyams len rnams/ /snying por dril ba'i bstan bcos mchog /sdom pa gsum gyi rab dbye bcas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma ni/ /grags pa'i mtshan can paṇ+ḍi ta/ /khu dbon nas bzung kun mkhyen rje/ /ngag dbang chos grags la sogs pa'i/ /mkhas mchog du mas bzhed pa'i rgyun/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i lha khang che'i/ /chos grwar mdo phyogs dar zhing rgyas/ /lung bstan brnyes pa klu sgrub dang / /byams mgon thogs med las brgyud de/ /rnam dag sems bskyed cho ga dang / /bslab bya lag len 'khrul med dar/ /snying po rdo rje theg pa la/ /'chi med mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /la sogs bya ba'i rgyud dang ni/ /'jam dpal a ra pa tsa sogs/ /spyod pa'i rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud/ /kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ /bla med skor la pha rgyud ni/ /gsang ba 'dus pa lugs gsum dang / /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed/ /dmar nag 'jigs gsum la sogs dang / /ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa ni/ /lu hi nag po dril bu gsum/ /na ro mkha' spyod la sogs dang / /gnyis su med rgyud kyai rdo rje/ /man ngag lugs dang nag po lugs/ /mtsho skyes ḍoṃ bhi rnam bzhi sogs/

/rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lhag pa'i lha/ /mdor na yi dam chos skyong skor/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub ni/ /kun ster bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /spyi bka' zur bka' thun min gyi/ /smin byed dbang dang byin gyis brlabs/ /rjes gnang grol bar byed pa'i khrid/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho tsam mnga' las/ /thun mong gdul bya 'dul ba yi/ /lag len rgyud dang bla ma yi/ /man ngag rten 'brel gnad ldan pas/ /mchod gtor gar 'chams dbyangs rol mo/ /gzur gnas mkhas kun dga' ba bskyed/ /'gro ba'i sdig sbyang thar pa'i lam/ /ston la ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi/ /kun rig rnam par snang mdzad che/ /rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sogs dang / /'chi med dngos grub bsgrub pa la/ /gsang bdag lag na rdo rje ni/ /'chi bdag 'joms pa rnam rgyal ma/ /tshe dpag med dang sgrol dkar sogs/ /nad rims klu gdon 'dul ba la/ /lo ma gyon ma 'jig rten gyi/ /dbang phyug seng ge sgra klu dbang / /sman bla phyag na rdo rje dang / /mkha' lding khra nag la sogs so/ /grib sel khrus chog sme ba brtsegs/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'jam dpal sogs/ /'byung po gdon bgegs 'dul ba la/ /'byung 'dul rta mgrin mi g.yo sngo/ /sogs dang shes rab blo 'phel ba/ /'jam dpal dkar ser smra ba'i seng / /mi g.yo dkar po rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rigs spel so sor 'brang ma dang / /chos skyong dur bdag ngan sngags brgyad/ /bzlog dang bsrung la seng ge'i gdong / /gdugs dkar gtsug tor 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed gur zhal sogs/ /bar gcod 'jigs sel seng ldeng sgrol/ /gnyan sgrol phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs/ /nor bsgrub dzaṃ lha nor rgyun ma/ /tshogs bdag dkar dmar dbyug gu chos/ /rnam sras sogs dang dbang sdud la/ /rig byed tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal dang / /dbang gi sgrol ma la sogs pa/ /mngon spyod las la 'jigs byed dang / /gur zhal bka' bstod bcas sogs so/

/mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la/ /bde kyai gsang gsum rnal 'byor ma/ /gshed dmar 'jigs byed gur zhal sogs/ de las khyad par gyur pa ni/ /gser chos bcu gsum grags pa ste/ /dmar po skor gsum dmar chung gsum/ /dmar mo skor gsum dzam nag dang / /khyung khra seng ge sgra dang ni/ /dzam dmar srog sgrub dang bcas gtso/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can bcas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang 'dra'i/ /cho ga brgyad ldan rdul tshon dang / /rnam dag ras bris la brten nas/ /rnam dag cho gas sbyor dngos rjes/ /tshang ba'i cho ga rnam dag gis/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga brtul zhugs dang / /bum gsang sher dbang bzhi pa ni/ /mtha' brten dang bcas rgyu lam gyi/ /dbang bskur sngags kyi gsum ldan gyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog tu grub/ /de bzhin rgyud dang man ngag gi /gnad ldan byin rlabs brgyud pa ni/ /ma nyams byin rlabs rjes gnang gi /rim pas smin par mdzad pa'o/ /de nas grol bar byed pa'i lam/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas ni/ /mdo sngags rgyud kyi rdo rje yi/ /'dir tshigs gsum mi gsal ston bshad bka' dang / /dbang don rim gnyis lam zab mo'i/ /bkri tshul bshad pa tshig sbyor gyi/ /phreng bas tshogs par bshad pa yi/ /bshar khrid 'dir tshigs lnga mi gsal/ /man ngag zab mo'i gnad sbas don/ /zhib bkral ston pa slob bshad kyi/ /khrid rim grol bar byed pa'i lam/ /de yang nyams bzhes rtsa ba ni/ /gsung ngag rin chen nor bu mchog /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len te/ /sngon 'gro snang gsum bka' khrid la/ /mdo phyogs nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' la/ /grub mtha' bzhi yi lta sgom spyod/ /don gyi gnad tshang phar phyin gyi/ /theg rtse dbu ma'i lta ba ston/ /de nas dbang gis smin byas te/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rgyud don gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi/ /gnad zab bkrol ba rig thog tu/

/bdar sha bcad pa gzhi dus kyi/ /rang sems dwangs ma dri bral gyi/ /bde chen lhan skyes ye shes che/ /ngos zin de nyid sbyong byed kyi/ /lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa yi/ /rig gdangs lha ru shar ba yi/ /bskyed rim rtsa thig rlung gsum la/ /brten pa'i rlung dang gtum mo dang / /zhu bde spros bcas rdzogs rim yin/ /de dag ngo bo gdangs ma 'gags/ /ngo bo spros mtshan mthar mtshan gyi/ /'dzin bral spros med rdzogs rim ste/ /mdor na ma 'gag gdangs gsal cha/ /'khor ba'i tha snyad ngo bo ni/ /spros bral mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu 'khor myang 'das/ /dbyer med bum gsang sher dbang dang / /bzhi pa'i lam dang lta ba dang / /grub mtha' de yi cha rkyen du/ /'pho ba 'da' ka ma bzhi dang / /de yi tshod 'dzin rmi lam dang / /sgyu lus dug lnga'i bdud rtsi bsten/ /lus sbyang 'khrul 'khor gegs sel dang / /bogs 'don man ngag zab khyad can/ /tshe 'dir gnas skabs mthar thug gi /gtan bde rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje 'chang dbang mngon du gyur/ /gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha/ /mtha' dag bkri nus lam cha tshang / /ris bral gdams pa kun gyi rtse/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len no/ /de mtshungs nā ro mkha' spyod sogs/ /bskyed rdzogs khyer bde ches zab zhing / /mchog sgrub thun mong zhar las 'byung / /'jam mgon bla ma sa skya pa'i/ /dbang sdud lha mchog dmar po gsum/ /'dod dgu'i dpal ster rig byed ma/ /gtso bo dbang gi las la babs/ /tshigs gcig mi gsal lugs man ngag gnad ldan mang / /bskyed rdzogs zab mos mchog gi ni/ /dngos grub myur 'byin lha chen po/ /tshogs kyi bdag po 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /lha bsgom sngags bzlas las bzhi yi/ /las tshogs rab 'byams zab gnad kyi/ /dbang sogs thun mong mchog gi ni/ /dngos grub lag khel nyams myong can/ /rwa tshar thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/

/'jam dbyangs rnam sprul rwa chen gyi/ /thugs bcud snying po tshad mas grub/ /smin byed las bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /rim pa (blo gzhan pa gsum ) mi gsal kyang 'di ltar min nam snyam gyi/ /man ngag gnad dril rwa khrid ni/ /mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud grub gnyis ster/ /chos skyong rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /bu lugs gtsor gyur lnga phrag gsum/ /gsar rnying gdams pa zhi drag gi /las tshogs srid gsum dpal yon ster/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung kun gyi gtso/ /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po ni/ /ga ya dha ra ba ri dang / /kha che paṇa chen mal lo bzhi/ /bla ma gyi ljang man ngag bcas/ /bka' srol rnam lnga shing mgon dang / /rdo mgon bris mgon khyad par du/ /ston mchog shākya seng ge yi/ /rab gnas gur gyi mgon mngon sum/ /bse mgon yid bzhin nor bu dang / /dam can pu tra dngos zhugs kyi/ /khrag mtsho bkra shis 'od 'bar sogs/ /de bzhin brtan bsrung dbang po ni/ /khyad myur mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /zhing skyong yid bzhin nor bu mchog /gnyen lo chen po'i thugs kyi bcud/ /grub mchog dbang po kha'u pa/ /las brgyud gdams pa'i bka' bab cing / /zhing skyong dngos bzhugs gnas mchog ni/ /kha'u brag rdzong rten brten pa/ /la sogs rten dang gdams pa ni/ /gnyis ka'i bka' bab bdag por gyur/ /de bzhin 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /sa rngog bka' srol zab dgu dang / /gnod byin be gdong lcam dral gyi/ /man ngag bka' gter zab mo'i chos/ /mtha' yas srung zhing rnal 'byor pa'i/ /'dod don sgrub la gtso bo ni/ /mngon spyod dbang dang zhi rgyas kyi/ /rab 'byams las tshogs spros bcas dang / /spros med bsnyen sgrub las kyi gtso/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor nyams len gyi/ /rim par brten dang 'khor lo ni/ /mchod gtor las sbyor zor sbyin sreg /de dag gegs sel bogs 'don gyi/ /rim pa spyi yi spros bcas dang /

/nang gi rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs kyi/ /rim pa rten 'brel gnad ldan pa'i/ /spros bcas spros med nyams len gyi/ /rim pas bstan dang sgrub pa po'i/ /gnas skabs las bzhi'i 'dod dgu 'grub/ /mthar thug gtan bde rnam grol lam/ /bde blag 'grub nus mchog thun gyi/ /dngos grub myur thob nyams myong can/ ( 'dir tshigs rkang gcig mi gsal/) /'phags bod byang sems paṇ+ḍi ta/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i bstan bcos dang / /man ngag gnad ldan 'gran zla bral/ /de ltar dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud 'byon dang 'byon gyur pas/ /bstan 'dzin grub pa ngor rdzong dang / /khyad par rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bdag /rgyal bas rgyal bar lung bstan pa/ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /brgyud par bcas dang snyan brgyud kyi/ /bdag po kha'u brag rdzong pa/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po ni/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa gtso/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir gsar rnying gi /mkhas pa spyi dang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yongs rdzogs mnga' bdag sa gsum gyi/ /'gro mgon rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang / /thams cad mkhyen gzigs lnga pa yi/ /bstod cing bsngags par mdzad pa ltar/ /snyan pa don ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i ring lugs/ /ris bral yongs kyi gtsug na mtho/ /des na su zhig mkhas btsun bzang / /'dod na sa skya'i bka' srol zungs/ /thun mong dngos sgrub 'bad med 'grub/ /grub pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog gi sa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang 'dod na/ /sa skya'i bka' srol gus pas longs/ /de ltar rang bzhin brjod pa yi/ /bden pa'i tshig gi bod yul gyi/ /grub mtha'i rnams bzhag mdor bsdus tsam/ /smras 'di'i bstan 'gro bdag cag gi /'phral yun gtan du dga' dang bde'i/ /legs tshogs 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /mdo dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi/ /mdo sdom grub mtha' sdom gsum don/ /mdo sngags sa lam rnam gzhag bcas/

/mdo don go bder dril ste bkod/ /legs byas gtan gyi bde ba'i rgyu/ /legs mchog mdo sngags lam bzang don/ /legs par 'khrul med rtogs la re'i/ /legs don go bde don tshang 'di/ /rang gzhan mdo sngags chos tshul la/ /rang gzhan gtan gyi bde thob phyir/ /rang gzhan chos kyi don ma nor/ /rang gzhan rnam dag chos spyan mchog /legs par thob nas gzhung lugs don/ /legs rtogs gzhung lugs kun la mkhas/ /legs pa'i gzhung bzang 'dir kun 'jug /legs bshad gzhung lugs bshad sgrub dar/ /de ltar 'byung rung la sogs dge /de dag mthu las rgyal ba'i bstan/ /de 'dzin rab byung sde bas 'phel/ /de bzhin mkha' mnyam snod bcud kun/ /khyad par sa ngor snyan brgyud bstan/ /de 'dzin ngur smrig sde bcas 'phel/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bdag chen yab sras sku mched dang / /mkhan chen thams can mkhyen chen po/ /yongs 'dzin smon lam mtshan can mchog /zhabs brtan phrin las rgyas pa dang / /bdag cag byams skyong 'dod dgu stsol/ /bdag cag brtses skyong ltos 'khor bcas/ /'gal rkyen phyi nang bar chad zhi/ /lugs zung dpal yon phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde dgar spyod par shog /bdag kyang skye dang tshe rabs su/ /mi 'dod srid pa'i 'ching las grol/ /rab byung rdo rje 'dzin mchog grub/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub legs rtser son/ /'brel tshad byang chub mchog gi sar/ /'god nus lugs zung bya ba kun/ /legs shing bstan 'gror phan thogs pa'i/ /mthu ldan rab byung mchog thob shog /bkra shis dge legs kun stsol mchog /mchog gsum bla ma chos srung gi /mchog thun dngos grub bde blag tu/ /thob pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /ces grub mtha' bzhi dang rgyud sde bzhi yi rnam gzhag bstan pa'i snying po sdom pa gsum gyi don gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gnad bsdus zhar byung bod kyi grub mtha'i lo rgyus bcas lhan cig tu bkod pa mdo sngags chos tshul snying po'i gsal byed ma rig mun pa sel ba'i dpal ldan 'od zer brgya pa skal bzang blo yi pad tshal bzhad pa don gnyis lhun gyi grub pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba 'di rang nyid chung ngu'i dus nas dkor zan gyi bag chags lta bu'i chos phyogs la thos bsam bsgom sgrub la spro ba lta bu zhig yod cing /

de mus legs lam du song na dal 'byor don yod tsam dang rang gzhan la phan thogs phran bu e yong kyang / snyigs dus kyi nag phyogs kha rgyal zhing thams cad ngan 'gro'i lam la chas pa phal che ba'i dus dbang dang / rang nyid 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor srid pa'i 'ching ba'i nang du chud pa'i rgyu dang / ngan 'gro'i lam la chas pa phal mo che 'ga' zhig gi rang gzhan thar pa mchog gi lam las ldog cing duḥkhar sbyor ba'am/ ji skad du 'jam mgon bla mas/ /blo chung zhig gis phan btags pas/ /'ga' zhig gnod pa chen por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don lta bu yin nam/ lugs zung gi bslab bya ji bzhin ma yin pa'i sgo gsum sdug bsngal gyi 'dam du byings kyang / chos blo ma bor tsam khul gyi mdo sngags zab mo'i lam phyin ci ma log pa zhig shes la re ba'i/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i mdzod 'grel shing rta rnam gnyis zhig mthong ba de la lta rtogs byed 'dod kyi kun gzigs dge sprul rin po cher lam tsam zhu khul bgyis kyang rnam g.yengs khag gzan gyis mthar ma 'khyongs/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub gyis mngon rtogs ljon shing rin po che dang / gong ma'i dgongs rgyan zhig mjal ba lhag par de don mdo sngags kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum cha tshang zhig la thos sbyang de yang mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med mchog dang / 'dren mchog bla ma ngag dbang rin chen zung la bka' 'dri lam tsam thos pa tsam las/ gzhan gsar rnying gi bla ma mkhas tshul 'dzin pa 'ga' la dri gtugs byas khul kyang sbug thum zhig las sor chod pa ma byung zhing / lar yang rang skal ba dman pas/ 'di phyi'i bde thabs dang thar pa'i lam ston pa ni drin chen bla ma yar klung pa rdo rje 'chang de nyid dang / 'dren mchog ngag dbang rin chen/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang khu dbon tsam du zad cing /

byang chub bsgrub pa la 'gal rkyen sna tshogs kyi ngang du 'byams mur skyabs mchog bslu ba med pa bla ma mchog gsum chos skyong srung ma'i thugs rje la brten/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs te mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen por rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gis mkhyen brtse nus pa chen po'i nyi gzhon gsar pa'i thig phreng gis rmongs pa'i mun pa bsal zhing lugs zung blo yi cung zad rgyas pa'i skal bzang thob pas gsar rnying ris bral spyi dang rje btsun sa skya pa'i mdo sngags snyan brgyud zab mo la thos bsam bsgom pa'i mos pa lam byed la rtse gcig tu gzhol mur sa khyi sa phag skor sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam bzang pos rjes su bzung ba'i smra ba'i seng ge byams pa smon lam grags pa'i zhabs pad nye bar bsten te gang gi zhal sgo las grub mtha' bzhi dang / 'jam mgon bla ma sa skya pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i de yi kha skong / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi dka' 'grel zung gi ljags khrid zhib mor zhus shing / der brten slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mor/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /dpal mang du thos pa thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho rnams kyi gsung rab la zhib mjal zhus/ gzhan yang 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyi deb ther/ sde dge zhu dag rin po che'i dkar chag grub dbang bla ma sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i gsung rtsom bcas rnams la legs par mjal te 'phags bod kyi lta grub gzhi lam 'bras gsum yongs rdzogs kyi bshad pa/ gnad dril go bde'i tshul dang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde phal cher man ngag gsang ba'i skor yin kyang gsang ba dam ches pa'i zal lus su mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/

zhal gsal tsam bcas rang dang dpal ldan lhun grub steng gi bla ma dge 'dun pa rnams kyi mtshon/ rje btsun sa skya pa bstan 'dzin ngor pa dang / tshar pa'i brgyud 'dzin sogs kun gyis rtogs sla zhing mdo sngags zab mo'i don la thos bsam gyi rgyun bzang po 'phel du re ba'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslang te bka' drin gzhal du med pa yar klung rdo rje 'chang byams pa ngag dbang ku na dga' nam mkha' legs pa lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang / thar rtse rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rje btsun 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis mthu stobs bstan 'dzin dbang po bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dpa' bo bdud las rnam rgyal dbang gi rgyal po bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ yang dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug mgon po dngos grub dpal 'bar bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan rin chen tshul khrims dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dbang sdud bkra shis rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyi zhal snga nas gtsos/ gzhan yang sa ngor zha lu dge ldan/ dwags brgyud/ rdor smin/ rdzogs chen/ kaḥthog pa sogs ris bral gyi 'dren pa kha shas dang / don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ chos tshul gyi bka' drin chen pos rjes su bzung ba/ rab 'byams smra ba'i seng ge byams pa smon lam grags pa sogs kyi rjes su bzung zhing /

gsar rnying chos tshul mdo sngags spyi dang rje btsun sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud zab dgu legs par thob pa gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi byin rlabs snying la smin pa'i mdo smad sa skyong sde dge'i rigs skyes shākya'i dge slong tshe la dbang ba'i rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa byams pa kun dga' sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dge byed kyi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes gcig bzang por lugs brgya'i 'dun pa chen po dpal ldan lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i dpe khungs 'tshol ba dang / yi ge'i grogs dan pa ni rig gnas gzhung lugs zab mo la spobs pa dge ba phrin las rgya mtshos bgyis pa 'dis kyang 'brel tshad thams cad byang chub mchog la myur du 'god pa dang / bdag cag brtses skyong ltos 'khor bcas pa rnams kyi lugs zung gi legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas te 'phral yun bde dgar spyod pa dang / rgyal bstan rin po che gsar rnying ris su ma chad pa spyi dang / rje btsun sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che mdo sngags bshad sgrub rab byung gi sde bcas byams bstan ma shar gyi bar du 'tsho gzhes brtan par gyur cig /dza an+tu/ dmigs pa bden bzhi'i spyod yul can/ /rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug re rer bzhi tshan phye bas sdug bsngal mi rtag stong dang bdag med sogs bcu drug /de la'ang che 'bring chung gsum yod/ /mthar phyin sbyor laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 238 dge slong tshe dbang rdo rje/ sdom gsum gyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 237
